issues.title: Non-interactive (headless/SDK) mode delays the terminal `result` until managed auto-memory tasks finish, while the TUI and ACP return immediately / 非交互（headless/SDK）模式的最终 `result` 要等托管自动记忆任务完成才输出，TUI 与 ACP 则立即返回

labels.name: priority/P1
labels.description: High priority issue

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

labels.name: category/cli
labels.description: Command line interface and interaction

labels.name: scope/non-interactive
labels.description: Non-interactive mode

labels.name: scope/memory
labels.description: Memory and context management

labels.name: scope/latency
labels.description: Response time optimization

labels.name: status/ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified; an AFK coding agent can pick this up with no human context

issues.body:
### What happened?

In non-interactive (headless/SDK) mode the terminal `result` message is emitted only **after every pending managed auto-memory task (extract + dream) has settled**. Each task issues a 28k–36k token model call, so consumers observe a gap of **40 s to ~5 minutes between the model's last token and the end of the turn**, with zero messages on the stream during the gap.

The interactive TUI returns to the prompt immediately, and the ACP integration is explicitly documented to never await these tasks — headless is the only one of the three modes that blocks.

**Impact**

Every headless consumer — IDE plugins, bots, CI agents, other SDK integrations — keeps a spinner running long after the model has stopped. In our JetBrains plugin this looks like a hang and was reported as a performance bug; users cannot tell "model finished, background memory work still running" from "still thinking". The only workaround disables the feature for the interactive CLI too (see field 5).

**Reproduction**

1. Run a headless session with default settings (e.g. `query()` from `@qwen-code/sdk` with `includePartialMessages: true`) and a prompt that ends a turn normally.
2. Timestamp every message on the stream.
3. Observe the gap:

```
+14596ms type=assistant blocks=text(42c)
+14596ms type=stream_event ev=message_stop
+142414ms type=result        <-- 127.8s gap, zero messages in between
```

4. Enable `QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE=1`; inside the gap the debug log shows `managed-auto-memory-dreamer` prompts (`#5`, `#6`, `#7`, `originalTokenCount` 28809 → 34081 → 36434) and later `Draining pending work before shutdown`.

Measurements (same task, same machine):

| SDK / settings | `message_stop` → `result` |
|---|---|
| 0.1.17, defaults | 70.3 s, 127.8 s |
| 0.1.18 (bundled CLI 0.25.0), defaults | 49.1 s |
| memory settings disabled | 9–17 ms |

Interactive TUI on the same machine: returns to the prompt in 1–2 s. On an OpenAI-compatible corporate gateway the gap ranged 28–292 s — it scales with model latency.

**Root cause**

Both modes collect the same background promises via `llmClient.consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises()`, but consume them differently. The promises are already-running background work — `LlmClient` pushes them in `packages/core/src/core/client.ts` (extract at L3184, dream at L3210) — so waiting is purely a consumer-side choice.

Non-interactive main loop — blocking (`packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts`, L3217–L3223, immediately before `emitResult` at L3280):

```ts
const memoryTaskPromises = config
  .getLlmClient()
  .consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises();
if (memoryTaskPromises.length > 0) {
  await Promise.allSettled(memoryTaskPromises);   // <-- gates the result
}
finalizeOneShotMonitors();
// ... metrics ...
await emitResult({ isError: false, ... });        // L3280
```

https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts#L3217-L3224
https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts#L3280-L3287

Interactive TUI — non-blocking (`packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.ts`, L4265–L4287):

```ts
const memoryTaskPromises =
  llmClient.consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises();
for (const p of memoryTaskPromises) {
  void p.then((count) => {
    if (count > 0) addItem({ type: 'memory_saved', ... });
  });
}
```

https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.ts#L4265-L4283


ACP — never even queues them (`docs/design/auto-memory/acp-managed-auto-memory.md`, L371–L375):

> Do not await either task and do not store their promises in
> `LlmClient.pendingMemoryTaskPromises`; ACP has no TUI `memory_saved` item to
> consume that queue.

https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/docs/design/auto-memory/acp-managed-auto-memory.md?plain=1#L371-L373

Points that suggest the `await` is unintended rather than required:

- The comment directly above the block says monitors "intentionally continue in the background, **so final result emission is not gated on monitor lifetime**" — `result` is already not gated on background work; memory tasks are the exception.
- The holdback loop that *does* wait before `result` exists to pair `task_started` / `task_notification` stream events. Managed memory tasks emit no stream events, so there is nothing to pair.
- The loop-detected result path (`emitLoopDetectedResult`, L1757–L1790) emits `result` without draining memory tasks — headless is not internally consistent either.
- The unit test only asserts `expect(mockLlmClient.consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises).toHaveBeenCalled()` (`nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` L3589–L3590) — it pins "called", not "awaited before result".


<details>
<summary>中文（Chinese translation，点击展开）</summary>

非交互（headless/SDK）模式下，最终的 `result` 消息要 **等所有待处理的托管自动记忆任务（extract + dream）全部结束** 才发出。每个任务都会发起一次 28k\~36k token 的模型调用，因此消费方会观察到"模型最后一个 token"到"回合结束"之间存在 **40 秒~约 5 分钟的空档**，期间流上没有任何消息。

交互式 TUI 立即回到提示符，ACP 集成也被设计文档明确要求绝不等待这些任务——三种模式里只有 headless 会阻塞。

**影响**：所有 headless 消费方（IDE 插件、bot、CI agent 等 SDK 集成）都会在模型早已停止输出后继续转圈。在我们的 JetBrains 插件里表现为"卡死"并被当作性能 bug 上报；用户无法区分"模型已结束、只是后台记忆任务还在跑"和"仍在思考"。唯一变通办法会连交互式 CLI 的功能一起关掉（见最后）。

**复现步骤**

1. 用默认配置跑一个 headless 会话（例如 `@qwen-code/sdk` 的 `query()` 且 `includePartialMessages: true`），发一条正常结束回合的提示。
2. 给流上每条消息打时间戳。
3. 观察空档：

```
+14596ms type=assistant blocks=text(42c)
+14596ms type=stream_event ev=message_stop
+142414ms type=result        <-- 127.8s 空档，其间零消息
```

4. 打开 `QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE=1`；空档期内 debug 日志出现 `managed-auto-memory-dreamer` 提示（`#5`、`#6`、`#7`，`originalTokenCount` 28809 → 34081 → 36434），其后有 `Draining pending work before shutdown`。

同机同任务实测：

| SDK / 配置 | `message_stop` → `result` |
|---|---|
| 0.1.17，默认配置 | 70.3 s、127.8 s |
| 0.1.18（内含 CLI 0.25.0），默认配置 | 49.1 s |
| 关闭记忆配置 | 9~17 ms |

同机交互式 TUI：最后一个 token 后 1~2 秒回到提示符；公司内网 OpenAI 兼容网关下空档 28~292 s，随时延波动。

**根因**

两种模式都通过 `llmClient.consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises()` 收集同一批后台 promise，但消费方式不同。这些 promise 对应的是"已在后台运行"的任务——`LlmClient` 在 `packages/core/src/core/client.ts` 入队（extract 在 L3184，dream 在 L3210）——所以等不等纯粹是消费侧的选择。

非交互主循环——阻塞（`packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts`，L3217-L3223，位于 L3280 的 `emitResult` 之前）：

```ts
const memoryTaskPromises = config
  .getLlmClient()
  .consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises();
if (memoryTaskPromises.length > 0) {
  await Promise.allSettled(memoryTaskPromises);   // <-- 卡住了 result
}
finalizeOneShotMonitors();
// ... 指标统计 ...
await emitResult({ isError: false, ... });        // L3280
```

https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts#L3217-L3224
https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts#L3280-L3287


交互式 TUI——不阻塞（`packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.ts`，L4265-L4287）：

```ts
const memoryTaskPromises =
  llmClient.consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises();
for (const p of memoryTaskPromises) {
  void p.then((count) => {
    if (count > 0) addItem({ type: 'memory_saved', ... });
  });
}
```

https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.ts#L4265-L4283

ACP——连 promise 都不入队（`docs/design/auto-memory/acp-managed-auto-memory.md`，L371-L375）：

> Do not await either task and do not store their promises in
> `LlmClient.pendingMemoryTaskPromises`; ACP has no TUI `memory_saved` item to
> consume that queue.

https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1e1c4a4aeecd612aabd532bacc91f4010897efb1/docs/design/auto-memory/acp-managed-auto-memory.md?plain=1#L371-L373

以下几点表明这个 await 更像疏漏而非必要设计：

- 紧邻代码块的注释写着 monitors "intentionally continue in the background, **so final result emission is not gated on monitor lifetime**"——`result` 本就不该被后台工作 gate，记忆任务是唯一的例外。
- result 之前那个 holdback 循环存在的意义，是为 SDK 消费方配对 `task_started` / `task_notification` 流事件；托管记忆任务不产生任何流事件，没有可配对的东西。
- loop 检测的结果路径（`emitLoopDetectedResult`，L1757-L1790）产出 `result` 前不 drain 记忆任务——headless 自身内部也不一致。
- 单元测试只断言 `expect(mockLlmClient.consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises).toHaveBeenCalled()`（`nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` L3589-L3590）——钉死的是"被调用过"，不是"必须在 result 之前 await 完成"。

</details>

### What did you expect to happen?

`result` should be emitted as soon as the turn itself completes, in every mode — the same behavior the interactive TUI already has.

Managed auto-memory tasks should remain background work in headless mode too (as they already are for the TUI and ACP), while memory writes are still guaranteed to complete before the process exits: nothing should be truncated on one-shot `qwen -p` runs or at stream-json session EOF.

<details>
<summary>中文（Chinese translation，点击展开）</summary>

所有模式下，`result` 都应在回合本身结束时立即发出——交互式 TUI 现在就是这个行为。

托管自动记忆任务在 headless 模式下同样应保持后台执行（TUI 与 ACP 已是如此），同时保证进程退出前记忆写入完成：一次性 `qwen -p` 运行与 stream-json 会话 EOF 都不能截断写入。

</details>


### Client information

<details>
<summary>Client Information</summary>

Run `qwen` to enter the interactive CLI, then run the `/about` command.

```console
$ qwen /about
Qwen Code v0.25.0
Model: mimo-v2.6-flash
Fast Model: not set
Auth: openai
Platform: win32 x64 (10.0.26200)
Node.js: v22.22.2
Session: b45581cf-c7ba-4063-a3a3-7259bc427983
Git commit: 6788c03569
LSP: disabled
```

Platform: Windows 11 (win32 x64, build 10.0.26200)

Integration details:

- `@qwen-code/sdk` 0.1.18, driving the CLI with `--input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json`
- Bundled CLI / core: 0.25.0
- Reproduced on SDK 0.1.17 as well
- Source verified against `main` at commit `4a6eca8` (2026-10-10): the blocking await is still present at `packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts` L3217–L3221

</details>


### Login information

API config: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured in Qwen Code (shown as `Auth: openai` in `/about`), with the API key stored through the CLI's normal auth flow. Managed auto-memory left at its defaults (`enableManagedAutoMemory: true`, `enableManagedAutoDream: true`).

<details>
<summary>中文（Chinese translation，点击展开）</summary>

API config：Qwen Code 中配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（`/about` 显示 `Auth: openai`），API key 走 CLI 常规认证流程保存。托管自动记忆保持默认（`enableManagedAutoMemory: true`、`enableManagedAutoDream: true`）。

</details>

### Anything else we need to know?

**Suggested fix (reference)**

The tricky part: today the `await` is also what guarantees memory writes land before a one-shot process exits, and `Session.waitForAllPendingWork()` (`packages/cli/src/nonInteractive/session.ts` L842–L884) drains only initialization, control requests, and the message-processing queue — it has no memory-task drain. So simply deleting the `await` risks truncating writes on `qwen -p` runs and on stream-json session EOF.

1. **Stop gating `result` on memory tasks** — move `await Promise.allSettled(...)` to *after* `await emitResult(...)`, or keep the promises without awaiting and retain them for shutdown (same shape as the TUI loop).
2. **Drain at shutdown instead** — extend `waitForAllPendingWork()` (and the one-shot exit path) to await the retained memory promises, with a bounded timeout (the existing `STRUCTURED_SHUTDOWN_HOLDBACK_MS` pattern is a good model) so a slow gateway cannot hang exit.
3. If gating is required for some one-shot case, make it opt-in (setting / `QueryOptions`) rather than unconditional — today the only knob disables the feature for all modes.

Suggested tests: a deferred memory promise must not delay `emitResult` (emit-order assertion); shutdown drains pending memory promises before exit and gives up after the bound.

**Workaround**

Disabling both memory settings:

```json
"memory": { "enableManagedAutoMemory": false, "enableManagedAutoDream": false }
```

Before/after on the same task: `message_stop → result` went from 70.3 s / 127.8 s (0.1.17) and 49.1 s (0.1.18) to 9–17 ms. The cost is that managed auto-memory stops working for the interactive CLI as well — there is no per-mode switch.

**Additional context**

- Searched existing issues before filing: `auto-memory headless`, `consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises`, `message_stop result delay` — no duplicate found.
- Happy to provide the full debug logs and the probe script used for tracing the raw SDK stream.
- Our integration is a JetBrains IDE plugin driving `@qwen-code/sdk` in stream-json mode, which is why the delay surfaces as a visible "busy" state after the model has stopped.


<details>
<summary>中文（Chinese translation，点击展开）</summary>


**参考修复方案**

棘手之处：目前这个 await 正是一次性进程退出前记忆写入能落地的保证，而 `Session.waitForAllPendingWork()`（`packages/cli/src/nonInteractive/session.ts` L842-L884）只 drain 初始化、control request 和消息处理队列——没有记忆任务的 drain。所以单纯删掉 `await` 会让 `qwen -p` 运行与 stream-json 会话 EOF 的写入面临被截断的风险。

1. **让 `result` 不再被记忆任务 gate**：把 `await Promise.allSettled(...)` 移到 `await emitResult(...)` **之后**；或保留 promise 但不 await、留存到关闭时 drain（与 TUI 循环同构）。
2. **改为在关闭时 drain**：扩展 `waitForAllPendingWork()`（以及一次性退出路径）去 await 留存的记忆 promise，并加有界超时（现有 `STRUCTURED_SHUTDOWN_HOLDBACK_MS` 模式是很好的范本），避免慢网关卡死退出。
3. 若确有一次性场景需要 gate，应做成可配置（设置项 / `QueryOptions`）而非无条件行为——今天唯一的开关会对所有模式同时关闭该功能。

建议测试：延迟完成的记忆 promise 不得推迟 `emitResult`（产出顺序断言）；关闭流程在退出前 drain 待处理的记忆 promise，超时上限后放弃。

**变通办法**

关闭两个记忆配置项：

```json
"memory": { "enableManagedAutoMemory": false, "enableManagedAutoDream": false }
```

同机同任务前后对照：`message_stop → result` 从 70.3 s / 127.8 s（0.1.17）与 49.1 s（0.1.18）降到 9~17 ms。代价是交互式 CLI 的托管自动记忆也一起停用——没有按模式区分的开关。

**附加信息**

- 提交前已检索现有 Issue：`auto-memory headless`、`consumePendingMemoryTaskPromises`、`message_stop result delay` —— 未发现重复。
- 可提供完整 debug 日志，以及用于追踪 SDK 原始流的探针脚本。
- 我们的集成是以 stream-json 模式驱动 `@qwen-code/sdk` 的 JetBrains IDE 插件，因此这段延迟在界面上表现为模型停止之后仍然可见的"忙"状态。


</details>

prs.title: docs(verify-pr): budget the turn-axes secondary A/B as a harness slot
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Scope selection in the `/verify-pr` skill now says where the mandated secondary turn-lifecycle A/B gets its time. #13819 made the turn-axes rule fire on the diff rather than on the central claim. When the turn-lifecycle code is not the central claim, it "gets its own A/B as a secondary claim". This PR extends that sentence with ", which takes one of the harness slots in item 2 rather than time from the central A/B". Item 2 is "One or two wire-oracle harnesses on the changed surface". The skill gains one net line. The pin test gains one `toContain` on the new clause, which sits in the same `scopeSelection` slice as the #13819 pins. It also gains one `toMatch` on the raw section text that item 2 is still the wire-oracle harness line, so the ordinal in the clause cannot silently come to name another item. A third pin holds item 1's `(always, ~half the budget)` together with that item's title, because the clause only protects the central A/B while that reservation is there.

## Why it's needed

The #13819 triage review raised this as a non-blocking reservation: [stage 2](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13819#issuecomment-6094449374) and [final, point 1](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13819#issuecomment-6094461489) ("Give the secondary A/B a budget line, or say what it displaces"). Item 1 is titled "A/B load-bearing proof of the central claim (always, ~half the budget)". The section closes with "Never let breadth eat the A/B". No numbered item budgets a secondary A/B, and #13819 made one mandatory. The one run with data, arm D, shows the pressure. Its budget went to the A/B, the axis probe and two findings. As a result no mutation matrix ran, the Java central claim was never executed, and the verdict was `inconclusive`. Placing the extra A/B in a harness slot keeps item 1's half for the central claim. The cost falls on item 2, the breadth item the section already treats as lower value than the A/B.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/verify-capture.test.js`. Locally the result is 199 passed and 1 skipped, the same counts as `main`. The new pin was mutation-checked by the same matrix used for #13813 and #13819. Each pinned phrase in the turn-axes paragraph was mangled one at a time, and the paragraph was moved out of Scope selection. All 17 mutants were killed, and the tree was restored to the commit afterwards. The item-2 pin was checked on its own. With items 2 and 3 swapped in place, the suite without it still passes (199 passed, 1 skipped), while with it the run fails at `qwen-triage-workflow.test.js:5057` (1 failed, 198 passed). Relabelling item 2 also fails it. The item-1 pin was checked the same way. Deleting `(always, ~half the budget)` from item 1 leaves the suite without the pin green (199 passed, 1 skipped). With the pin, the same deletion fails at `qwen-triage-workflow.test.js:5061`, and so does dropping only `~half the budget` or renaming the item. `npx prettier --check` passes on both files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (skill text and its pin test). The rendered change is the one sentence quoted above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A, unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: if a PR needs both harness slots for its central claim, the turn-lifecycle A/B now displaces one of them. That trade is deliberate, since the section ranks the A/B above breadth. Still, a run on such a PR covers less of the changed surface than before. The skill grows by one line. The #13819 review also pointed out that this series keeps growing a skill that every verify run reads.
- Not validated / out of scope: this is a budget clarification with no new arm run. I have not re-run the before/after rig with this text, at about an hour and about 10M prompt tokens per arm. It is therefore unmeasured whether an agent now completes the mutation matrix or the central claim on a run like arm D's. The review's other suggestion, an out-of-sample re-run on a PR the turn-axes rule was not written from, was run after this PR opened. The results are in [this comment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13850#issuecomment-6103811604): with one run per arm, neither arm found any of the three target defects in #13769.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #13819 (triage reservation). Related: #13732, #13813.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`/verify-pr` 技能的 Scope selection 现在写明了：强制要求的次要 turn 生命周期 A/B，时间从哪里出。#13819 让 turn-axes 规则按 diff 触发，不再按中心主张触发。当 turn 生命周期代码不是中心主张时，它"作为次要主张单独做一次 A/B"。本 PR 在这句话后面补上："它占用第 2 项里的一个 harness 名额，而不是从中心 A/B 拿时间"。第 2 项是"在改动面上做一到两个 wire-oracle harness"。技能文本净增 1 行。钉子测试新增 1 条针对新子句的 `toContain`，与 #13819 的钉子在同一个 `scopeSelection` 切片里。另外新增 1 条 `toMatch`，在未折叠的原始章节文本上钉住第 2 项仍是 wire-oracle harness 那一行，这样子句里的序号不会悄悄指向别的条目。第三条钉子把第 1 项的 `(always, ~half the budget)` 和该项的标题一起钉住，因为只有这份预留还在时，子句才真正保护了中心 A/B。

## 为什么需要

#13819 的 triage 审查把这一点列为非阻塞的保留意见：[第 2 阶段](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13819#issuecomment-6094449374)，以及[最终意见第 1 条](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13819#issuecomment-6094461489)（"给次要 A/B 一条预算行，或者写明它挤占什么"）。第 1 项的标题是"中心主张的 A/B 承载性证明（必做，约占一半预算）"，本节结尾写着"Never let breadth eat the A/B"。没有任何编号项给次要 A/B 列预算，而 #13819 把它变成了必做项。唯一有数据的 D 臂显示了这个压力：预算花在了 A/B、维度探针和另外两个发现上，于是没跑变异矩阵，Java 中心主张没有执行，结论是 `inconclusive`。把这次额外 A/B 放进 harness 名额，第 1 项的一半预算就留给了中心主张。代价落在第 2 项上，而本节本来就把这个广度项看得比 A/B 次要。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/verify-capture.test.js`。本地结果是 199 通过、1 跳过，与 `main` 的数量相同。新钉子用 #13813、#13819 同一套变异矩阵检验过：逐条破坏 turn-axes 段落里每个被钉住的短语，再把整段移出 Scope selection。17 个变异全部被杀，检验后工作树已恢复到提交状态。第 2 项的钉子单独检验过：原地交换第 2、3 项后，没有这条钉子的测试套件仍然全部通过（199 通过、1 跳过）；加上它，运行在 `qwen-triage-workflow.test.js:5057` 处失败（1 失败、198 通过）。改写第 2 项的标题同样会让它失败。第 1 项的钉子也用同样的方式检验过。从第 1 项删掉 `(always, ~half the budget)` 后，没有这条钉子的测试套件仍然全部通过（199 通过、1 跳过）。加上钉子后，同样的删除会在 `qwen-triage-workflow.test.js:5061` 处失败；只删 `~half the budget`，或者改写该项标题，也都会失败。两个文件都通过 `npx prettier --check`。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（技能文本及其钉子测试）。渲染后的改动就是上面引用的那句话。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

不适用，仅单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：如果某个 PR 的中心主张本身就要用掉两个 harness 名额，turn 生命周期 A/B 现在会挤掉其中一个。这是有意的取舍，因为本节把 A/B 排在广度之前；但这类 PR 的运行对改动面的覆盖会比以前少。技能文本又长了一行。#13819 的审查也指出，这一系列改动在持续加长一个每次 verify 都要读的技能。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：这只是预算上的澄清，没有新跑一臂。我没有用这段文本重跑前后对比测试环境，每臂约一小时、约 1000 万 prompt token。因此，像 D 臂那样的运行，现在能否跑完变异矩阵或执行中心主张，并未测量。审查的另一条建议，即在不是规则来源的 PR 上做样本外重跑，已在本 PR 开出后完成，结果见[这条评论](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13850#issuecomment-6103811604)：每臂各跑一次，两臂都没有找到 #13769 中三个目标缺陷里的任何一个。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

#13819 的后续（triage 保留意见）。相关：#13732、#13813。

</details>

prs.title: fix(rewind): resolve legacy turns by source identity
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Legacy conversation rewind links the visible turn, model entry and recorded boundary through the existing source record, or refuses before mutation. The recovered conversation key cannot authorize file restore. Live Ink and ACP no longer independently count model text to guess a cut.

ACP preserves identity across JSON history rollback, resolves recorded boundaries independently of snapshot indexes, and permits valid live rewind when chat recording is disabled. Retry and interrupted-prompt resend retain the original identity without creating another recorded user turn. Rejected recorder input no longer leaves an orphan boundary that shifts a later rewind.

## Why it's needed

A genuine legacy prompt with cleared-media-placeholder text could disappear visibly but remain in model context. Retry snapshots and invisible image turns could also shift the persisted cut or drop retained history on cold resume. Local review and actual execution identified JSON identity loss, recording-disabled refusal, rejected-input boundary misalignment, and original identity loss after retry. These corrections reuse existing identities, without a new counter or positional heuristic.

This is #9437's legacy-mapping follow-up, separate from merged #9466 and retained-snapshot seeding in #13729.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Resume legacy `hello`, `[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`, and `world`, each with its reply. Rewind the second prompt: visible, next-request and cold-restored history should retain only `hello` and its reply. The recovered key must not authorize file restore.
- Include a delivered notification and an invisible ordinary image turn before a later target. They must not shift the retained recorded boundary. Missing or duplicated associations must refuse before mutation.
- Fail A, retry A successfully, then send B. Use original A's recorder-created promptId to rewind A: it must be listed and accepted, and the next model request must contain neither A nor B. Rewinding B should instead retain A, including after cold resume.
- Echo the exact JSON pre-rewind history through restore. Retained identities must remain resolvable, with no rewind metadata reaching model requests.
- Disable recording and check both conversation-only and file-mode admission. Valid targets remain available without a recording write. Also check selective cold restore and identified compression; unlinked old compressed history must refuse, and advertised snapshot indexes must not be renumbered.
- At the recorder API, record T0, reject empty input, then record B/C. Rewinding C and cold-reading the generated transcript must retain T0/B and their replies. This is an API check, not a demonstrated UI empty-input sequence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual Ink/tmux on `ad34f0acc2` verified seven cases and repeated image rewind/resume: legacy placeholder cut **2**, versus baseline **4**; notification retention; and invisible image recording retained correctly after cold resume. Earlier `d5013614` actual ACP checks verified B rewind after retry, JSON history echo, selective cold restore and producer-shaped identified compression. On `212b3b421b`, actual ACP/wire checks verified recording-disabled admission and a separate real recorder/cold-read probe verified the rejected-input boundary correction.

The latest retry comparison is actual **212 → d208**, not a merge-base-wide claim. Before, original recorded A was absent from status and its exact promptId refused after retry. After, A is listed and accepted at cut **1**; the next real provider request contains the probe only, not A/B. The ordinary-A control also passes, retry records A only once, and neither arm leaks `rewindId`/`promptId` fields into model messages. The real tmux capture and raw ACP/model/socket/recording ledgers are retained.

Fresh actual Ink/tmux at `947726ae` also confirms the cold-resumed custom-command boundary: selecting the original `/proofscope` invocation refuses visibly, and the next model request still contains A, the expanded command and B. Ordinary B rewind succeeds on that same resumed session and its next request excludes B. The expanded row appears separately and was not the selected target. This is a current-candidate observation, not a matched-base runtime regression claim or a skill-tool test.

Current head `13f530c59279d432a0cce7cf18ac1017509ec979` adds only comment corrections after that execution. Relative to executed `d208508ce8`, only the two existing bilingual designs and one helper docblock differ; runtime logic, tests and the retained bundle are unchanged. Historical runtime results are reused only for unchanged paths; they are not described as new final-head keyboard runs. Versions, hashes, commands and review limits are in the [verification comment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6077085058).

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ actual Ink keyboard, ACP, model wire and recorder cold-read checks at the stated versions |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2, merge base `5ddd43815bf141ad448a546aeba768b0bc90820d`, isolated loopback mocks. Build, bundle, workspace/integration typecheck, changed-file lint/format and normal hooks passed. Earlier eleven-file validation completed 4024 tests; it is reused, not repeated. The latest source correction passed five named regressions with1197 skipped, including red-before identity and null-stream-continuation witnesses. The subsequent design-only commit passed formatting/hooks and preserves the tested bytes.

Local source review found no substantiated in-scope correctness blocker. Remote triage completed source inspection at `947726ae`; its three nonblocking advisories are answered by the explicit compatibility boundary, helper-comment correction and wire disclosure below. The original full native engine did not finish a canonical final review. Three bounded exact-947 source-only Qwen attempts also timed out without verdicts; that gate remains unverified, not clean. Small provider/CLI probes succeeded but do not validate this change. Parent, independent and triage source reviews are separate evidence, not a passing CI-equivalent gate or approval. Ready means ready for human review, not approved for merge.

## Risk & Scope

- Unique retained associations are required. This deliberately includes a compatibility cut in Ink: after cold resume, a model-sent custom slash/skill invocation row without a persisted association refuses, even when the separate expanded user row retains its identity. Fresh sessions can also hit this after resume; it is not limited to old ACP transcripts. This PR does not add invocation persistence or duplicate-row reconciliation. The custom-command refusal/no-mutation and ordinary-B control were actually executed; skill-tool timing and successful rewind of the expanded row were not. The refusal that row shows is the shared retained-turn string, which names a retry; rewording it is deferred to #13794 because the string lives in nine locale catalogs.
- ACP requires snapshot/model identity and, only with recording enabled, a recorded boundary. Old ACP histories without matching persisted/model identity may refuse rather than guess. Its pre-rewind history response now includes an optional plain `rewindId` for JSON echo; it is stripped before model history is restored. This is a wire-response addition, not a persisted transcript-schema change.
- Numeric ACP targets are advertised snapshot positions, not visible user ordinals; use the returned promptId or index. The old ordinal-based witness remains a negative compatibility result, not a claimed default VS Code UI regression.
- 23 files, +1183/-932: ten production-logic files +193/-150 (net43), one comment-only source file, nine regression files, two existing bilingual designs, and removal of two lint exceptions. The latest closeout adds no runtime logic or tests. Test growth protects observed boundary/identity regressions; obsolete positional assertions account for most deletions. No dependency, persisted transcript schema, route, setting or new ID counter.
- Not validated: Windows/Linux, current VS Code webview retry/edit, unwired OpenTUI, every slash-entry timing or natural model-driven compression. ACP file-mode checks use empty checkpoints, not changed-file byte restoration.
- Pre-existing full recording/snapshot rollback semantics and full-message preservation on a non-cancelled null-stream retry are not redesigned. Optional localization, title projection, snapshot-list optimization and extra assertion suggestions are not added to this patch.
- #13794 remains a separate maintenance follow-up. No merge, release or issue closure; remote CI is sampled, not awaited.

## Linked Issues

Refs #9437; separate follow-up from #9466. #11408 is handled independently by #13729. No issue is auto-closed.

真实用户提交的旧占位符形状 prompt 可能从可见历史消失，却仍保留在模型上下文。重试快照和不可见图片轮次也可能使持久化截断错位，或在冷恢复后丢失应保留的历史。本地审查和真实执行发现 JSON 身份丢失、关闭录制时拒绝回退、失败输入边界错位，以及重试后原身份丢失。修正复用现有身份，不新增计数器或位置式推断。

这是 #9437 的旧历史映射后续，与已合并的 #9466、#13729 的保留快照播种分开。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 恢复 `hello`、`[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`、`world` 旧轮次及各自回答，回退第二轮：可见、下一模型请求和冷恢复历史都应只保留 `hello` 及回答。恢复 key 不能授权文件恢复。

`ad34f0acc2` 真实 Ink/tmux 验证了七组场景及重复图片回退／恢复：占位符截断为 **2**，而基线是 **4**；通知保留；不可见图片的录制在冷恢复后正确保留。此前 `d5013614` 的真实 ACP 检查验证了重试后回退 B、JSON 历史回传、选择性冷恢复及 producer 形状的已标识压缩。`212b3b421b` 的真实 ACP/wire 验证了关闭录制准入，独立真实录制器／冷读探针验证了失败输入边界修正。

Node 22.23.2，merge base `5ddd43815bf141ad448a546aeba768b0bc90820d`，隔离回环 mock。构建、bundle、workspace/integration typecheck、改动文件 lint/format 和正常 hooks 已通过。此前十一文件验证共4024条测试，复用而不重跑。最新源码修正通过五条定向回归、跳过1197条，包含身份与 null-stream continuation 的修复前失败证据。后续仅设计提交通过格式／hooks，保留已验证字节。

- 要求唯一保留关联。这明确包含一项 Ink 兼容性收缩：冷恢复后，发给模型的自定义 slash/skill invocation 行若没有持久化关联，即使独立展开用户行仍有身份，也会拒绝。新会话恢复后同样可能遇到，不仅是旧 ACP transcript。本 PR 不新增 invocation 持久化或重复行协调。真实执行了自定义命令的拒绝／不误截断及普通 B 对照，没有执行 skill-tool 时序或展开行成功回退。该行显示的拒绝文案是共用的「保留轮次」字符串，其中点名了「重试」；改文案需连带九个本地化目录，随 #13794 处理。
- ACP 要求快照／模型身份，仅在启用录制时要求录制边界。没有匹配持久化／模型身份的旧 ACP 历史可能拒绝，不猜测映射。回退前历史响应新增可选明文 `rewindId`，用于 JSON 回传；恢复模型历史前会移除。这是 wire 响应新增字段，不是持久化 transcript schema 改动。
- ACP 数字目标是已返回的快照位置，不是可见用户序号，应使用返回的 promptId 或下标。旧序号对照保留负面兼容性结果，不声称默认 VS Code UI 出现回归。
- 23 文件 +1183/-932：十个生产逻辑文件 +193/-150（净增43）、一个仅注释源码文件、九个回归文件、两份既有双语设计及两条 lint 例外删除。本次收尾没有新增运行逻辑或测试。测试增长保护真实发现的边界／身份回归；多数删除来自失效的位置式断言。不新增依赖、持久化 transcript schema、路由、设置或 ID 计数器。
- 未验证 Windows/Linux、当前 VS Code webview 重试／编辑、未接线 OpenTUI、全部 slash 时序或自然模型压缩。ACP 文件模式使用空检查点，不证明实际文件字节恢复。
- 不重设计既有完整录制／快照回滚语义，以及重试遇到非取消 null-stream 时的完整消息保留。可选本地化、标题投影、快照列表优化和额外断言建议不加入本修复。
- #13794 保留为独立维护后续。不合并、发布或关闭 issue；远端 CI 只取状态，不等待。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.zh-CN.md)。

Refs #9437，与 #9466 分开的后续；#11408 由 #13729 独立处理。不自动关闭 issue。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): run the H4e-b1 team flow end to end in the Hosted MySQL lane
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This adds `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT`, so CI runs the H4e-b1 team flow that #13846's physical pass checked by hand. A real Spring server on MySQL drives the packaged Hosted Harness through its own HarnessConnector, with the embedded Runtime Broker and the child result relay; only the model is scripted. Three cases:

- **Team flow.** A lead creates a team, launches two named members, keeps a board, reads the roster, and is refused `team_delete` while the members run (the refusal writes no `team_state` revision). It takes each member's report under its own `<teammate>` label, completes both tasks (one owner kept from before the member finished, one set only once the member had finished, with the refused open ownership writing nothing), and deletes the team.
- **Close wait.** Closing the lead cancels its running member through the H4b cascade. Through four refused cascade attempts the close stays owed, the member's Session stays active and its Turn keeps running. After the member is released its Turn completes on its own, the team records stay as they were, and once the relay is done the lead holds no acceptance of the result and has made no new model request.
- **Approval cards.** In `default` mode each team write and the named launch asks on its own card, previewing its own input, and `task_list` asks nothing.

The lead is created through the store and moved to `hosted-workspace-shell/1` in the same transaction, because no public route creates a Shell-laned Session (the same declared step as the physical pass); everything after that goes through the public Session, Action and operation routes.

Support changes:
- `HostedDurableWorkers`: each Session's Broker worker is durable and outlives Spring, so the cleanup `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` used moves, unchanged, into a shared helper that both ITs call.
- `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`: the Hosted ITs share one 900 s failsafe fork. A new row pins that every case of this IT has a `@Timeout`, that all of them together fit beside the fork's healthy runtime even if every case stalls, and that no wait bypasses the helper that makes `@Timeout` effective. The healthy runtime both Hosted rows assume grows from 600 s to 650 s with this class, which tightens `HostedHarnessMySqlIT`'s row (240 + 650 ≤ 900).
- One validation bullet in the H4e-b1 design doc (English and Chinese).
- `HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT` and `HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` close their Spring test context after their class (`@DirtiesContext`). The first CI run of this PR failed two cases: Spring caches a `@SpringBootTest` context for the rest of the fork, and the burst IT's context, which has a fixture Harness but no Runtime Broker, kept scanning every tenant of the shared schema on a 50 ms dispatch scan. It claimed the team cases' close operations and could not close their Workspace Sessions (`This instance cannot verify the original worker stop`). A second `hosted-process-ci.test.js` row requires `@DirtiesContext` (by default `AFTER_CLASS`; `AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD` also passes) on every `Hosted*IT` whose class declares a Spring test context. Since that context now closes after its class, the burst IT ends the Turns and operations a stalled round left owed before it closes, so the next class's context cannot claim them.

## Why it's needed

#13846 enables the team domains after a one-off physical pass. Without a CI test, a later change to the relay, the coordinator, the close cascade or the team funnel can break the team flow with only unit tests watching. The parallel acceptance work for #13846 produced a throwaway version of this IT with SIGKILL hooks in production code; this keeps its passing cases, drops the hooks and the cases that need a second bundle or that fail today (the crash window tracked in #13847), and makes it fit the shared Hosted fork.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

CI's `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` job runs it with the other `Hosted*IT` classes, and `scripts/check-failsafe-reports.js hosted` requires its report. Locally (Linux; JDK 21; Node 22; MySQL 8.4):

```bash
npm run build && npm run bundle
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/pom.xml -DskipTests install
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Phosted-harness-mysql \
  test-compile failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify -Dit.test=HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT \
  -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" -Dqwen.cli.entry="$PWD/dist/cli.js" \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/hosted_team_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=…
npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js
```

Results on x86_64 Linux, MySQL 8.4.6 (tmpfs, binlog off), Node 22, at this head:
- The IT passed 4 consecutive runs at its final shape (about 69 s; cases about 21, 26 and 22 s), leaving no worker process behind.
- Negative controls, each on a patched copy of the bundle: with `team_state` and `team_task` removed from the enabled list, all three cases fail in about 13 s; with the finished-owner rule reverted, the team-flow case fails; with `team_create` removed from the input preview list, the approval case fails on that card.
- A case whose `@Timeout` was lowered to 12 s stops at 12.7 s with the helper's failure, where it used to run on to the sum of its waits.
- `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` passes 5/5 with the moved helper.
- The CI failure reproduced locally by running `HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT` and then this IT in one fork (all three cases failed, with the same log lines). With the fix, the burst IT, this IT and `HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` pass in that order (this IT in about 65 s), with no such line and no worker left behind.
- `hosted-process-ci.test.js`: 18 passed. The timeout row fails for a ceiling over budget, a missing `@Timeout` (also on a `@RepeatedTest` or `@ParameterizedTest`, fully qualified or not, and a commented-out `@Test @Timeout` does not count), and a raw `await()`. The context row fails when the annotation is removed (from either class), commented out, moved to a nested class or to a type declared before the class, or set to `BEFORE_CLASS`, and when a `/*` in a header line comment would swallow the class header. It accepts a bare `@DirtiesContext`, empty parentheses, `hierarchyMode` beside `classMode`, and `AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD`.
- Review: three rounds, each with an open-ended and an adversarial reviewer. Rounds 1 and 2 found vacuous or weak assertions (the close wait sampled once, "never revived" counting Turn rows that wake Turns never write, card checks matched on the whole JSON), leftovers picked up across cases, and a timeout budget that `@Timeout` could not enforce; all are fixed here. Round 3 found no Critical. The CI fix had its own open-ended and adversarial round: it confirmed the diagnosis from the CI log and corrected its description (the child result relay does not run without a Broker; the claims came from operation recovery), and found that the first guard missed Windows paths and nested or bare annotations; all fixed. A second round found no Critical or Major; its Minor (a stalled burst round's work would now reach the next class) and its guard Nits are fixed in the third commit. CI at the second commit passed the Hosted job, with the same class order as the failing run: this IT 3/3, failsafe 25 classes with no error, and none of the original log lines.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (test only). Before: no CI test drives a Hosted lead's team. After: the three cases above run in the Hosted MySQL lane.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

The IT relies on the durable local-process Broker default and `/proc`, as `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT`'s durable case does; the lane runs only on ubuntu-latest.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: about 70 s more in the shared Hosted fork, which used 437–546 s of test time on recent main runs. Each case has an 80 s ceiling that now really holds, and the CI row keeps all three inside the budget even if every case stalls.
- Each case closes its lead and waits until its tenant owes no operation, child result or Turn, because the operation recovery and the child result relay scan every tenant and the next Spring context in the fork would otherwise pick that work up. A failed case ends that work in its teardown. Spring test contexts are closed after their class for the same reason (see above).
- Not covered: the crash between a member's launch and its join, which blocks the lead today (#13847); a member launched with `isolation: "worktree"` (the lane does not enable child Workspaces); `send_message` to a member. Unit tests in #13846 cover those paths.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test and CI-script changes only.

## Linked Issues

Follows #13846 (H4e-b1 enablement, merged), part of #13745. The crash cases it leaves out belong to #13847.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增 `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT`，让 CI 运行 #13846 的实机验收手工检查过的 H4e-b1 团队流程。基于 MySQL 的真实 Spring 服务器通过自己的 HarnessConnector 驱动打包的 Hosted Harness，并带有嵌入式 Runtime Broker 与 child 结果 relay；只有模型是脚本化的。三个用例：

- **团队流程。** lead 建团队、按名字启动两个成员、维护任务板、读取名册；成员运行时 `team_delete` 被拒（拒绝不写任何 `team_state` 修订）。它收到每个成员带各自 `<teammate>` 标签的汇报，完成两个任务（一个 owner 在成员结束前就已设定并被保留，另一个只在成员结束后才设定，被拒的未完成 owner 设置不写任何内容），然后删除团队。
- **关闭等待。** 关闭 lead 会经 H4b 级联取消其运行中的成员。在四次被拒的级联尝试期间，关闭一直欠着，成员 Session 保持 active，其 Turn 持续运行。放行成员后它的 Turn 自行完成，团队记录保持原样；relay 处理完毕后，lead 没有该结果的 acceptance，也没有发出新的模型请求。
- **审批卡片。** 在 `default` 模式下，每个团队写操作与具名启动都在各自的卡片上请求审批，并预览各自的输入；`task_list` 不请求审批。

lead 通过 store 创建，并在同一事务中切到 `hosted-workspace-shell/1`，因为没有公共路由会创建带 Shell 通道的 Session（与实机验收申报的步骤相同）；之后的一切都经过公共的 Session、Action 与 operation 路由。

配套改动：
- `HostedDurableWorkers`：每个 Session 的 Broker worker 都是持久的，会在 Spring 停止后继续存活，因此 `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 原有的清理代码原样移入共享辅助类，两个 IT 都调用它。
- `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`：所有 Hosted IT 共用一个 900 秒的 failsafe fork。新的一行固定了：本 IT 的每个用例都有 `@Timeout`；即使所有用例同时卡住，它们加在一起也能放进 fork 健康耗时之外的预算；没有任何等待绕过让 `@Timeout` 生效的辅助方法。两条 Hosted 预算行假定的健康耗时随本类从 600 秒增加到 650 秒，这让 `HostedHarnessMySqlIT` 的那一行更严格（240 + 650 ≤ 900）。
- H4e-b1 设计文档（中英文）新增一条验证说明。
- `HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT` 与 `HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` 在类结束后关闭各自的 Spring 测试上下文（`@DirtiesContext`）。本 PR 第一次 CI 挂了两个用例：Spring 会把 `@SpringBootTest` 上下文缓存到 fork 结束，而 burst IT 的上下文只有 fixture Harness、没有 Runtime Broker，却以 50 毫秒的派发扫描持续扫描共享库里的所有租户。它抢走了团队用例的关闭操作，又无法关闭它们的 Workspace Session（`This instance cannot verify the original worker stop`）。`hosted-process-ci.test.js` 新增第二行：凡是类上声明了 Spring 测试上下文的 `Hosted*IT`，都必须带 `@DirtiesContext`（默认即 `AFTER_CLASS`；`AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD` 也可以）。由于该上下文现在在类结束后关闭，burst IT 会在关闭前结束卡住的轮次欠下的 Turn 与 operation，免得被下一个类的上下文抢走。

## 为什么需要

#13846 在一次性的实机验收之后启用团队 domain。没有 CI 测试的话，之后对 relay、协调器、关闭级联或团队 funnel 的改动可能破坏团队流程，而只有单元测试在看守。#13846 的并行验收工作产出过这个 IT 的一次性版本，在生产代码里加了 SIGKILL 钩子；本 PR 保留其中通过的用例，去掉钩子，以及需要第二个 bundle 或今天必然失败的用例（由 #13847 跟踪的崩溃窗口），并让它适配共享的 Hosted fork。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

CI 的 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` job 会与其他 `Hosted*IT` 类一起运行它，`scripts/check-failsafe-reports.js hosted` 要求它产出报告。本地运行方式（Linux、JDK 21、Node 22、MySQL 8.4）见上方英文部分的命令。

在本 head 上、x86_64 Linux、MySQL 8.4.6（tmpfs、关闭 binlog）、Node 22 的结果：
- 最终形态下连续 4 次通过（约 69 秒；各用例约 21、26、22 秒），没有残留 worker 进程。
- 负向对照，各自使用打过补丁的 bundle 副本：从启用列表中去掉 `team_state` 与 `team_task` 时，三个用例约 13 秒内全部失败；撤掉已完成成员规则时，团队流程用例失败；从输入预览列表中去掉 `team_create` 时，审批用例在那张卡片上失败。
- 把某个用例的 `@Timeout` 临时降到 12 秒，它在 12.7 秒处以辅助方法的失败停下；修改之前，它会一直跑到各段等待之和。
- 移动辅助类之后 `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 5/5 通过。
- CI 的失败在本地复现：在同一个 fork 里先跑 `HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT` 再跑本 IT，三个用例全部失败，日志与 CI 一致。修复后按 burst IT、本 IT、`HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` 的顺序全部通过（本 IT 约 65 秒），没有这类日志，也没有残留 worker。
- `hosted-process-ci.test.js`：18 个通过。超时那一行会因以下情况失败：超时之和超出预算；缺少 `@Timeout`（包括 `@RepeatedTest` 或 `@ParameterizedTest`，无论是否写全限定名；被注释掉的 `@Test @Timeout` 不计入）；直接调用 `await()`。上下文那一行在以下情况失败：从任一类上删掉注解、注释掉注解、把注解挪到嵌套类或类前声明的另一个类型上、改成 `BEFORE_CLASS`，以及类头行注释里的 `/*` 会吞掉类头时。裸写的 `@DirtiesContext`、空括号、`hierarchyMode` 与 `classMode` 并列、`AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD` 都可以通过。
- 评审：三轮，每轮一个无方向审计与一个对抗审计。第 1、2 轮发现了空转或偏弱的断言（关闭等待只采样一次、"从未复活"数的是唤醒 Turn 从不写入的 Turn 行、卡片检查匹配的是整段 JSON）、跨用例被捡走的残留工作，以及 `@Timeout` 无法生效的超时预算；都已在本 PR 修复。第 3 轮没有 Critical。CI 修复单独做了一轮无方向与对抗审计：根据 CI 日志确认了诊断，并纠正了描述（没有 Broker 时 child 结果 relay 不运行，抢活的是 operation 恢复）；还发现第一版守卫漏了 Windows 路径、嵌套类上的注解和裸注解；均已修复。第 2 轮没有 Critical 或 Major；其 Minor（卡住的 burst 轮次留下的工作现在会落到下一个类）与守卫的 Nit 已在第三个提交修复。第二个提交上的 CI 通过了 Hosted job，类的执行顺序与失败那次相同：本 IT 3/3，failsafe 25 个类无错误，原来的日志一条都没有出现。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（仅测试）。之前：没有 CI 测试驱动 Hosted lead 的团队。之后：上述三个用例在 Hosted MySQL 车道中运行。

### 测试平台

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

该 IT 依赖持久本地进程 Broker 的默认设置与 `/proc`，与 `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 的持久用例相同；该车道只在 ubuntu-latest 上运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：共享的 Hosted fork 多出约 70 秒，近期 main 上该 fork 的测试耗时为 437–546 秒。每个用例有 80 秒上限，现在确实生效；CI 那一行保证即使所有用例同时卡住，三者也都在预算之内。
- 每个用例都会关闭其 lead，并等到其租户不再欠任何 operation、child 结果或 Turn，因为 operation 恢复与 child 结果 relay 会扫描所有租户，否则 fork 中下一个 Spring 上下文会捡走这些工作。失败的用例在 teardown 中结束这些工作。出于同样的原因，Spring 测试上下文在类结束后关闭（见上文）。
- 未覆盖：成员启动与加入之间的崩溃，它今天会阻塞 lead（#13847）；以 `isolation: "worktree"` 启动的成员（该车道不启用 child Workspace）；发给成员的 `send_message`。这些路径由 #13846 的单元测试覆盖。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；只改动测试与 CI 脚本。

## 关联 Issue

接续 #13846（H4e-b1 启用，已合入），属于 #13745。它略去的崩溃用例归 #13847。

prs.title: fix(qqbot)!: restore per-group session isolation under thread scope
prs.body:
> **Migrated from #13250 on 2026-10-11 — identical code, identical head SHA.**
>
> `#13250` was stuck on a GitHub-side artifact, not a code problem: an invisible `CHANGES_REQUESTED` left behind by the now-deleted `qwen-code-ci-bot` account. That PR reports `reviews: 0`, `reviewThreads: 0` and zero review comments, its timeline contains no `reviewed` / `review_dismissed` event, and the account itself returns 404 — yet `reviewDecision` stayed `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, and because the `main` ruleset sets `dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push: false`, 90+ pushes never cleared it. A review that no longer exists cannot be dismissed by the author.
>
> Everything else on `#13250` was healthy: content CI was green (25 pass / 7 skipped; the only three failures were `CI_BOT_PAT` 403s from that suspended account), the branch was conflict-free against `main`, and the `main` ruleset declares no required status checks.
>
> This PR carries the **same commit** — `0851c08947d57c9323da7f518cbaafe3723ac5a3` — re-pointed through a new fork branch so it can start from a clean review state. Nothing was rebased, squashed or changed in the move, so the maintainer round-4 verification (`merge-ready` on correctness, 2554/2554 scripted assertions, head `0851c08947` against base `43a6e1e5e4`) still refers to exactly this code.

## What this PR does

Restores per-group session isolation for the QQ Bot channel. Removes the forced `sessionScope: 'single'` override that the constructor applied to its own copy of the config whenever `groupAllPolicy` was `keyword` or `all` (introduced during PR #6457 review); the channel now respects the configured scope and warns when a non-shared scope is combined with full-message group mode. Reply streaming keeps a per-session anchor and carries it across seal and cancel boundaries, so a cancelled or superseded turn still flushes against its own `msg_id` (per-message wire anchoring itself landed on `main` in #10145; what this change owns is the boundary machinery around it). Orphaned persisted routing entries from the old single-scope layout are purged on startup, and the QQ channel now declares `thread` as its default session scope so zero-config deployments get per-group shared context by default.

## Supersedes #8241

This is the same change as #8241, carried to a fresh PR after 22 review rounds and 83 blocker-signalling threads. The pipeline's own reports said each round re-read the entire diff (its incremental anchor was lost), so rounds spent their budget re-deriving earlier findings and the thread never converged; the newest round posted zero new findings, and every Critical posted across all rounds is fixed here with a pinning test and a mutation proof. No code changed in the move.

The branch is merged up to `main` at `1a933f7b5e`, which includes the QQ Bot inbound-media PR (#12850) that landed while #8241 was open. The only conflict was an additive stub in a test double in `events.test.ts` (`getResponseMessageId` from this change, `prepareThenHandleInbound` from the media work); both were kept. The package's suite is 540 tests green after the merge — the 499 this change adds and pins, plus the 41 the media PR brought to the same package. On the previous head, `Qwen Code CI` was fully green, including `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`, which had been red for every head since round 18 over `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts` (#10490), a host-gate flake that `main` fixed in #13094 and that merging `main` cleared.

## Why it's needed

The forced scope never reached the router. `start.ts` and `daemon-worker.ts` call `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)` with the *parsed* config, before `QQChannel`'s constructor rewrites its own copy — so the override changed what `QQChannel` believed, not how sessions were actually routed. That split brain produced two defects on `main`:

1. **Full-message group mode never actually got shared group context.** Routing stayed `user`-scoped, so group traffic was fragmented into one session per sender — the opposite of what the override existed to guarantee.
2. **`QQChannel` still believed it was `single`**, so every `sessionScope === 'single'` gate inside it fired against user-scoped routing — for example, a DM was treated as a shared session and `/clear` demanded an extra `confirm`.

The "everything collapsed into one `__single__` session, with context leaking across groups and into DMs" symptom is real, but it requires `sessionScope: "single"` to be set explicitly — which is what the docs recommended for `groupAllPolicy` users. The `replyMsgId` concurrency issue that motivated the override was never actually resolved by it, only hidden.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the unit suite: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 8 files, 540 tests pass (499 added and pinned by this change, plus 41 from the inbound-media work already on `main`).
- Config-level behavior: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"` and no explicit `sessionScope`, the channel must not emit the scope-forcing WARNING and must route group messages per group (`<channel>:<group_openid>`) and DMs per user (`<channel>:<user_openid>`).
- Concurrent streaming: two users messaging in the same group while the bot is mid-stream must keep their replies anchored to their own `msg_id` (no cross-threading) — covered by the new stream tests.
- Cancel behavior: interrupting a turn (`/cancel` or steer) must flush the buffered partial reply before tearing down stream state — partial output is not dropped (regression test pins this).
- The streaming-ownership invariants the review rounds converged on have their own acceptance block: a settling flush chain must not write shared per-session state once the session was torn down or the turn was superseded (`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal routing/session behavior, no user-visible UI change. Before: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"`, group traffic was fragmented per sender while `QQChannel` believed it was running one shared session. After: per-group shared sessions with cross-group isolation, and the channel's belief matches the router.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 540 passed; `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` (in the package) — clean; `eslint` on changed source — clean; `prettier --check` — clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Beyond the QQ channel this diff also touches two shared surfaces, both of which were needed to make the scope default usable: `parseChannelConfig` and the daemon's channel-settings store now share one `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)` helper, so saving a `multiSession` channel without a stored scope resolves `"user"` instead of tripping `ChannelBase`'s construction-time invariant; and the Web Shell channel editor no longer pre-fills a plugin's non-`user` default for a `multiSession` instance, which otherwise made that save fail (`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`). An explicitly stored or submitted non-`user` scope on a `multiSession` channel is still rejected.
- Main risk or tradeoff: the effective session scope for any QQ deployment that omitted `sessionScope` changes from the global `user` default to this plugin's `thread` default (`config-utils.ts` fills `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'`). This applies to **every** such config — not just `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` users — including plain `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` deployments, which go from per-sender contexts to per-group shared context. The tradeoff is deliberate (per-group context is what full-message group mode was always supposed to mean), and `sessionScope: "user"` restores the old behaviour per deployment.
- Not validated / out of scope: live end-to-end verification needs real QQ credentials and was not run in CI; macOS and Windows were not exercised in CI (Linux lanes only).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no config-format change. A group thread session is a shared session, so the commands that act on it (`/clear`, `/who`, `/status`, `/loop`, `/btw`) and the permission answers (`/approve`, `/approve-always`, `/deny`) are restricted to the members listed in the channel's `operators` (`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` reads only `operators`; `allowedUsers` and `senderPolicy` do not grant them). `operators` is unset by default, so a zero-config QQ group has no member who can run those commands and no one who can answer a permission request raised in it; set `operators` to the QQ user ids that should steer the group's session — the channel now warns at startup when group access is enabled on a shared scope with `operators` empty. Measured consequence of leaving it unset: a tool call that needs approval has no one who can answer it, so the requester and every other member are refused, the tool never runs, and the group's session is held by that pending prompt until `AcpBridge` times it out (300 s) — `/cancel` queues behind it too. Deployments that never show a permission prompt (for example `yolo`) are unaffected. (`!` host-shell stays disabled in every QQ group chat regardless of scope.) On startup the channel reports unroutable persisted routes: the `<channel>:__single__` entries left over from the forced single-scope era, and — whenever the effective scope is not `user` — this channel's own three-part `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` keys, which under `thread`/`chat_thread` can never resolve again and count against the bridge's per-workspace session cap on every restart. Deleting them is opt-in: with `purgeLegacySessions` unset (its default, `false`) the channel logs the count and removes nothing; with `purgeLegacySessions: true` it writes a rescue copy of the routes about to be removed (`qq-sessions-purged.json`) before the first deletion, so a legacy conversation can be rebuilt by hand. History behind them is not migrated in either mode (it cannot be split per group). Ownership is decided by each entry's recorded target channel, never by key prefix, so a sibling channel's routes are untouched, and the purge runs after restore so the first boot still re-attaches the entries once before releasing them. Cancelled turns now flush their buffered partial reply before the stream state is torn down, so partial output is no longer lost. Release note: the effective default session scope for QQ deployments that omit `sessionScope` changes from `user` to `thread`; group sessions are shared sessions, so `operators` must be configured for members to answer permission prompts or run session-control commands; the legacy-route purge is opt-in and removes nothing by default.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8238

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

修复 QQ Bot channel 的会话隔离：删除 `groupAllPolicy=keyword/all` 时构造器对自己那份配置强制写入 `sessionScope='single'` 的逻辑（PR #6457 review 期间引入），改为尊重配置，并在"非共享 scope + 全量群消息模式"组合下发出 WARNING。流式回复按 session 锚定 `msg_id`，同群并发用户不再互相串线。启动时清理旧的 single-scope 布局遗留的、已无法解析的持久化路由条目；QQ channel 声明默认 `sessionScope` 为 `thread`，零配置部署默认获得"每群共享上下文"。

## 承接 #8241

与 #8241 是同一份改动，迁移到新 PR：原线程已经历 22 轮评审、累计 83 个未决阻塞线程，而流水线自己的报告说明每轮都在重读整个 diff（增量锚点丢失），预算被用于反复重推既有发现，始终没有收敛；最新一轮已零新发现，而历轮提出的所有 Critical 在本树中均已修复，每一条都有固定行为的测试与变异证明。迁移过程未改动任何代码。

分支已与 `main`（`1a933f7b5e`）合并，其中包含 #8241 还开着时合入的 QQ Bot 入站媒体 PR（#12850）。唯一的冲突是 `events.test.ts` 里测试替身上的一处新增（本改动的 `getResponseMessageId` 与媒体改动的 `prepareThenHandleInbound`），两侧都保留。合并后该包 540 个测试全绿 —— 本改动新增并固定的 499 个，加上媒体 PR 带入同一个包的 41 个。上一个 head 上 `Qwen Code CI` 已全绿，包括 `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`：它自第 18 轮起一直红，原因是 `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts`（#10490）的 runner 门禁，`main` 已在 #13094 修复，合并 `main` 后即转绿。

## 为什么需要它

强制 scope 从未真正传到 router。`start.ts` 与 `daemon-worker.ts` 用**解析后的**配置调用 `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)`，而 `QQChannel` 的构造器只是改写了自己那份副本 —— 于是这个强制改变的是 `QQChannel` 的认知，而不是真实路由。这一"两个真相"在 `main` 上产生两个缺陷：

1. **全量群消息模式从未真正获得共享群上下文。** 路由仍是 `user` scope，群消息按发送者碎片化 —— 与该强制想要保证的完全相反。
2. **`QQChannel` 自认为 `single`**，于是它内部所有 `sessionScope === 'single'` 判定都作用在 user 路由上 —— 例如私聊被当成共享会话，`/clear` 会多要一次 `confirm`。

"所有群/私聊折叠进一个 `__single__` 会话、上下文互相泄漏"这个现象确实存在，但前提是显式设置 `sessionScope: "single"`（文档当时正是这样向 `groupAllPolicy` 用户推荐的）。当年为掩盖 `replyMsgId` 并发问题而引入的强制从未真正解决该问题，只是把它藏了起来。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

- 跑单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 8 个文件、540 个测试通过（本改动新增并固定的 499 个，加上已在 `main` 上的入站媒体工作的 41 个）。
- 配置层行为：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 且未显式设置 `sessionScope` 时，不得出现"强制 scope"的 WARNING，且群消息按群路由（`<channel>:<group_openid>`）、私聊按用户路由（`<channel>:<user_openid>`）。
- 并发流式：同群两个用户在 bot 流式输出期间发消息，各自回复必须锚定到自己的 `msg_id`（不串线）—— 由新增 stream 测试覆盖。
- 取消行为：中断一个 turn（`/cancel` 或 steer）必须先 flush 已缓冲的部分回复再清理流状态 —— 部分输出不丢（有回归测试固定）。
- 各轮评审收敛出的流式归属不变量有独立验收块：会话已被拆除或 turn 已被后继取代后，正在收尾的 flush 链不得再写共享的 per-session 状态（`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`）。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 属内部路由/会话行为，无用户可见的 TUI 变化。改动前：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 下群消息按发送者碎片化，而 `QQChannel` 自认为在跑一个共享会话。改动后：每群共享会话且跨群隔离，channel 的认知与 router 一致。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 540 通过；包内 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` —— clean；改动源码 `eslint` —— clean；`prettier --check` —— clean。

## 风险与范围

- 除 QQ channel 外，本 diff 还触及两个共享面，都是让新的 scope 默认值可用所必需的：`parseChannelConfig` 与 daemon 的 channel-settings store 现共用同一个 `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)`，因此保存一个未存 `sessionScope` 的 `multiSession` channel 会解析为 `"user"`，不再触发 `ChannelBase` 的构造期不变量；Web Shell 的 channel 编辑器也不再为 `multiSession` 实例预填插件的非 `user` 默认值（此前会使保存失败：`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`）。显式存储或提交的非 `user` scope 在 `multiSession` channel 上仍会被拒绝。
- 主要风险或取舍：任何省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效 scope 会从全局默认 `user` 变为本插件的 `thread` 默认（`config-utils.ts` 按 `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'` 填充）。这适用于**所有**这类配置 —— 不只是 `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` 用户 —— 也包括普通的 `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` 部署，它们会从"按发送者独立上下文"变为"按群共享上下文"。这个取舍是有意的（全量群消息模式本就应当意味着每群上下文），需要旧行为时按部署设置 `sessionScope: "user"` 即可。
- 未验证或超出范围：真实端到端验证需要真实 QQ 凭据，CI 未跑；CI 只在 Linux 通道跑，macOS 与 Windows 未覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：配置格式无变化。群聊线程是共享会话，因此作用于该会话的命令（`/clear`、`/who`、`/status`、`/loop`、`/btw`）与权限应答（`/approve`、`/approve-always`、`/deny`）仅限 `operators` 中列出的成员（`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` 只读 `operators`；`allowedUsers` 与 `senderPolicy` 不授予这些权限）。`operators` 默认未设置，因此零配置 QQ 群里没有任何成员可执行这些命令，群内发起的权限请求也无人可应答；需要时请把应当操作该群会话的 QQ 用户 id 填入 `operators` —— 群访问开启而共享 scope 下 `operators` 为空时，channel 现会在启动时告警。实测后果：一旦有工具调用需要审批，群里没有人能应答该请求（提问者本人与所有成员都会被拒），工具不会执行，且该待审批提示会占住群的会话，直到 `AcpBridge` 超时（300 秒）才释放 —— `/cancel` 同样会被排队。从不弹出权限提示的部署（例如 `yolo`）不受影响。（`!` 主机 shell 在所有 QQ 群聊中一律禁用，与 scope 无关。）启动时会检查无法解析的持久化路由：强制 single-scope 时代遗留的 `<channel>:__single__` 条目，以及生效 scope 非 `user` 时本 channel 自己的三段式 `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` 键 —— 在 `thread`/`chat_thread` 下它们永远无法再解析，且每次重启都会占用 bridge 的 per-workspace 会话上限。删除是可选开启的：`purgeLegacySessions` 未设置（默认 `false`）时只打印计数、不删除任何内容；设为 `true` 时会在首次删除前先把待删路由写入救援副本（`qq-sessions-purged.json`），以便手工恢复。无论哪种模式，其历史都不做迁移（无法按群拆分）。归属按条目记录的 target channel 判定，不按键前缀，因此不会误伤兄弟 channel 的路由；清理发生在 restore 之后，首次启动仍会先重新挂载一次再释放。取消的 turn 现在会先 flush 缓冲的部分回复再拆流状态，部分输出不再丢失。发布说明：省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效默认 scope 从 `user` 变为 `thread`；群会话即共享会话，成员需被列入 `operators` 才能应答权限请求或执行会话控制命令。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #8238

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add Send now for queued mid-turn messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a **Send now** action for messages typed while a turn is running. Typing during a turn keeps today's behavior: the message is queued, stays editable and deletable, and reaches the model at the next tool boundary, or as the next prompt when the turn ends. When the user decides a queued message is urgent, Send now delivers the queued messages within one round trip. If the model is streaming a response, the agent takes the user's queued messages, cuts that response short, keeps the part already streamed in the conversation, and continues the same turn with the messages.

The daemon exposes this as a new session route, `POST /session/:id/mid-turn-messages/send-now`, advertised by the `session_mid_turn_send_now` capability. Web Shell shows the action on queued rows the daemon owns, and both TypeScript SDK clients gain a method for it.

Guarantees:

- Running tools are never interrupted.
- A response that has already started a tool call is never cut. The messages are then delivered with the tool results, or promoted to the next prompt when a tool ends the turn.
- Internal queue-only steering is not taken early.
- A request applies only to the turn that received it.
- Input that a turn took and then could not send, because it was stopped or failed, is kept in that turn's conversation.

## Why it's needed

A message inserted while a turn runs waits for the response that is streaming and for its tool batch. Measured end to end, a correction typed 2 s into a 10 s answer reached the model 8.3 s later. The only faster path was Stop, which ends the turn and cancels running tools.

Other coding agents offer a way to interrupt and send:

- One keeps queueing as the default and adds an explicit send-now key.
- Codex interrupts by default and offers a separate key to queue instead.

This PR follows the first model. An aside never cuts a long answer short, and a typo can still be fixed before delivery.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run `qwen serve` with a model that streams a long answer and open Web Shell.
2. While the answer streams, type a second message and press Enter. Expect the row to show `Queued...` with Send now, delete and edit, and the answer to keep streaming.
3. Click Send now. Expect the answer to stop where it was, the message to appear after the partial answer, and a new answer to follow in the same turn. Reload the page and expect the same order.
4. Repeat while a long shell command runs. Expect the command to finish and the message to arrive with its result.
5. Against a daemon without `session_mid_turn_send_now`, expect no Send now action.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real runs: a local bundle of `main` and of this branch, `qwen serve` with an isolated HOME, a scripted OpenAI-compatible provider that timestamps every request, and Web Shell driven by Playwright (Chromium). In each run, a 10 s answer is streaming and the user types "Actually, use plan B instead" 2 s in.

The queued row: on `main` the message can only wait. With this PR the row gets a Send now action.

![Queued row before and after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/pr-assets/web-shell-send-now/queue-row.png)

The transcript afterwards. On `main` the answer runs to its end and the message runs as a new turn 8.5 s after Enter. With this PR, Send now cuts the answer, and the message reaches the model 47 ms after the click and is answered in the same turn.

![Transcript before and after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/pr-assets/web-shell-send-now/transcript.png)

Latency, from the raw REST harness output: the time from the mid-turn POST to the provider request that carries the message. Enter alone behaves exactly as on `main`. Send now brings it to 10–15 ms, except while a shell command runs, which is deliberately not interrupted.

![Latency A/B](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/pr-assets/web-shell-send-now/latency.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux. Type checks for acp-bridge, cli, sdk-typescript and web-shell. Full unit suites for acp-bridge, sdk-typescript and web-shell. The cli `acp-integration`, `serve` and `utils` suites, where the only failures are six tests that fail on `main` too because they rely on chmod-denied paths and this host runs as root. The serve routes integration test for the capability list. `prettier --experimental-cli --check` and eslint on every changed file.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:**
  - An interrupted response is billed for the tokens it produced, and the next request resends the context. Send now is an explicit action, and prompt caching keeps the resend cheap.
  - Send now applies to every user message waiting in the session's queue, not only the clicked row.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - A composer shortcut: Web Shell binds Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to a newline today.
  - Moving running tools to the background so Send now can skip them.
  - Channel, cron and background turns keep tool-boundary delivery.
  - A tool call can only be recognized once the provider announces it. A provider that announces a call only when its arguments are complete (the OpenAI Responses path today) can have a half-written call cut.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. Older agents answer the new request with method-not-found and keep tool-boundary delivery. Older daemons do not advertise the capability, so Web Shell hides the action.

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-send-now/docs/design/2026-10-08-send-mid-turn-messages-now.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-send-now/docs/design/2026-10-08-send-mid-turn-messages-now.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

为回合运行期间输入的消息新增 **立即发送（Send now）** 操作。回合中输入消息的行为保持不变：消息进入队列，在送达前可以编辑和删除，到下一个工具边界送达模型；如果回合先结束，则作为下一个 prompt 执行。当用户认为某条排队消息很紧急时，点“立即发送”可以让排队的消息在一次往返内送达。如果模型正在流式输出回复，agent 会取走用户排队的消息，截断这次回复，把已经输出的部分保留在对话中，然后带着这些消息在同一回合内继续。

daemon 新增会话路由 `POST /session/:id/mid-turn-messages/send-now`，并通过能力标记 `session_mid_turn_send_now` 声明。Web Shell 在 daemon 已接管的排队行上显示这个操作，TypeScript SDK 的两个客户端都新增了对应方法。

行为保证：

- 正在运行的工具永远不会被打断。
- 已经开始工具调用的回复不会被截断。此时消息随工具结果一起送达；如果某个工具结束了回合，消息会转为下一个 prompt。
- 内部的 queue-only steering 不会被提前取走。
- 请求只作用于收到它的那个回合。
- 回合取走了输入、但因为被停止或失败而没能发出时，这些输入会保留在该回合的对话中。

## 为什么需要

回合运行期间插入的消息，要等正在流式输出的回复结束，再等这次回复的工具批次结束。端到端实测：在一个 10 s 回答进行到第 2 s 时输入纠正，消息 8.3 s 后才到达模型。唯一更快的办法是 Stop，但它会结束回合并取消正在运行的工具。

其他编程 agent 也提供了“打断并发送”：

- 一种默认排队，另设一个显式的立即发送键。
- Codex 默认打断，另设一个排队键。

本 PR 采用第一种方式：补充说明不会截断长回答，打错的字在送达前也还能改。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 用一个会流式输出长回答的模型运行 `qwen serve`，打开 Web Shell。
2. 回答流式输出时输入第二条消息并按 Enter。排队行应显示 `Queued...`，带有立即发送、删除和编辑操作，回答继续输出。
3. 点立即发送。回答应在当前位置停止，消息出现在部分回答之后，随后在同一回合内给出新回答。刷新页面后顺序不变。
4. 在长时间运行的 shell 命令期间重复上述操作。命令应正常跑完，消息随命令结果一起送达。
5. 连接不支持 `session_mid_turn_send_now` 的 daemon 时，不应显示立即发送。

### 证据（改动前后）

均为真实运行：分别使用 `main` 和本分支的本地 bundle，`qwen serve` 使用独立 HOME，后端是会给每个请求打时间戳的脚本化 OpenAI 兼容 provider，Web Shell 由 Playwright（Chromium）驱动。每次运行都是一个 10 s 回答正在流式输出，用户在第 2 s 输入 "Actually, use plan B instead"。

排队行：在 `main` 上消息只能等待；本 PR 中排队行多了“立即发送”操作。

![排队行前后对比](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/pr-assets/web-shell-send-now/queue-row.png)

之后的 transcript：在 `main` 上回答一直输出到结束，消息在按 Enter 8.5 s 后作为新回合执行；本 PR 中点立即发送会截断回答，消息在点击后 47 ms 到达模型，并在同一回合内得到回答。

![transcript 前后对比](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/pr-assets/web-shell-send-now/transcript.png)

延迟，来自 REST 测试脚本的原始输出：从 mid-turn POST 到携带该消息的 provider 请求的时间。只按 Enter 的行为与 `main` 完全一致；立即发送把它降到 10–15 ms，只有 shell 命令运行期间除外，因为工具按设计不会被打断。

![延迟 A/B](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/pr-assets/web-shell-send-now/latency.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux。acp-bridge、cli、sdk-typescript、web-shell 的类型检查。acp-bridge、sdk-typescript、web-shell 的完整单元测试。cli 的 `acp-integration`、`serve`、`utils` 测试，其中只有 6 个测试失败，它们在 `main` 上同样失败：这些测试依赖 chmod 拒绝访问的路径，而这台机器以 root 运行。serve 路由集成测试中的能力列表用例。所有改动文件都通过了 `prettier --experimental-cli --check` 和 eslint。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：**
  - 被打断的回复仍按已产出的 token 计费，下一次请求会重新发送上下文。立即发送是用户的显式操作，prompt 缓存也让重新发送的成本较低。
  - 立即发送作用于会话队列里所有等待的用户消息，而不只是被点击的那一行。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 输入框快捷键：Web Shell 目前把 Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 绑定为换行。
  - 把正在运行的工具挪到后台，让立即发送不必等它。
  - channel、cron 和后台回合仍在工具边界送达。
  - 只有在 provider 宣告了工具调用之后才能识别它。只在参数完整后才宣告调用的 provider（目前的 OpenAI Responses 路径），写到一半的调用仍可能被截断。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。旧版 agent 会对新请求返回 method-not-found，继续在工具边界送达；旧版 daemon 不声明该能力，Web Shell 会隐藏这个操作。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-send-now/docs/design/2026-10-08-send-mid-turn-messages-now.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-send-now/docs/design/2026-10-08-send-mid-turn-messages-now.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): e2e runner and image robustness from the #12692 R2 review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes six R2 review follow-ups on #12692 against the current e2e runner (post-#13263) and the managed-agent server image: `waitUntil` swallowing predicate errors and not bounding iterations, `crashProcess` missing the by-signal death branch, an interrupted-after-last-poll run exiting 0 with success JSON, missing `--no-defaults` on the MySQL client invocations, the hardcoded packaged-jar version in both the runner and the Dockerfile, and the image defaulting to a loopback bind that makes a documented `docker run -p` refuse traffic.

## Why it's needed

A predicate that threw every poll for the full timeout surfaced nothing of its error (startup debugging goes blind), and a hung predicate outlived `timeoutMs` by ~4x; killing a child that already died by signal threw a raw `ESRCH` instead of the descriptive pre-exit diagnostic; a supervising script deciding on exit code recorded a clean pass for a run the operator explicitly stopped; a developer's `~/.my.cnf` died the run with `ERROR 1045` before the server under test even started (while both `mysqld` invocations already passed `--no-defaults` first); the hardcoded `0.1.0-alpha` jar name would break silently on the next version bump; and a published image whose app binds `127.0.0.1` turns `docker run -p 8080:8080` into a silent refusal.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `waitUntil`: two new cases — a predicate rejecting on every poll surfaces its message in the timeout error (`/wedged/`), and a never-settling predicate rejects near the deadline (< 2 s wall for a 300 ms timeout, was several-fold).
- `crashProcess`: a child that self-`SIGKILL`s before the call now yields "exited before the crash was injected" (was raw `kill ESRCH`); a healthy child still crashes cleanly.
- Signal exit: text pin — the success exit checks `receivedSignal` right after `if (failure) throw failure;`.
- MySQL options: text pin — exactly four `--no-defaults` occurrences (two `mysqld`, one `mysql` client, one `mysqladmin`), all first-argument (option-file interference is only disabled there).
- Jar lookup: the runner reads the project `<version>` from the pom and names the unclassified jar exactly (a wildcard would match three, since the pom repackages `workspace-bundle` and `operator-recovery` classifiers alongside it); the Dockerfile selects by classifier exclusion with a loud failure unless exactly one unclassified jar exists, and exports the fixed name `/tmp/qwen-managed-agent-server.jar`.
- Image bind: the runtime stage sets `ENV QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_SERVER_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0` and `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_RUNTIME_BROKER_HOST=0.0.0.0`; `application.yml`'s loopback defaults are untouched.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (script/image behavior; the new cases pin old red behavior as described).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

`npx vitest run scripts/tests/managed-agent-server-e2e.test.js`: 15/15 pass (6 existing + 9 new); ESLint clean on both files; Prettier applied. The review round added a loud no-glob guard, the published-bind warning (the API has no authentication — map `-p` only inside your own network policy), and `stallTimer.unref()`; pins assert both ENVs and the guard's message text.

### Environment (optional)

Node 22; no live MySQL needed for these cases (unit-level extraction of the changed functions, one real self-signalling child for crashProcess).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none — the runner's failure modes become stricter (errors surface instead of hiding); happy paths are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full e2e run itself requires MySQL/MariaDB and is exercised by CI lanes; a docker build of the image is not run locally. The T23 e2e cancel-race and remaining R2 areas ship in the web-test batch / other PRs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: an interrupted run now exits 1 (previously 0 with success JSON) — that was the bug.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to the post-merge R2 review on #12692. Design-level deferrals tracked by #13302.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 内容

对照当前 e2e 脚本（#13263 之后的版本）与 managed-agent 镜像，修复 #12692 合并后 R2 评审的 6 条跟进项：`waitUntil` 吞 predicate 错误且不限制单次迭代、`crashProcess` 漏检「被信号杀死」分支、末轮轮询后的中断仍以 0 退出并输出成功 JSON、MySQL 客户端调用缺 `--no-defaults`、打包 jar 版本号在两处硬编码，以及镜像默认绑回环导致按文档 `docker run -p` 静默拒连。

## 动机

predicate 连续报错布满整个超时时，最终错误里没有任何该错误内容（排障失明），挂起的 predicate 能超出 `timeoutMs` 约 4 倍；对已死于信号的子进程再 kill 抛出裸 `ESRCH` 而非语义清晰的预退出诊断；按退出码决策的外层脚本会把一次被操作员显式停止的运行记成干净通过；开发者的 `~/.my.cnf` 会让运行在受测服务启动前就死于 `ERROR 1045`（而两个 `mysqld` 调用早已以首参传 `--no-defaults`);`0.1.0-alpha` 硬编码 jar 名会在下次版本升级时静默坏掉；绑定 `127.0.0.1` 的发布镜像让 `docker run -p 8080:8080` 变成静默拒连。

## 评审者验证计划

### 如何验证

- `waitUntil`：两个新用例——每次轮询都报错的 predicate 其消息出现在超时错误里（`/wedged/`)；永不结算的 predicate 在截止点附近报错（300ms 超时实耗 <2s，原为数倍）。
- `crashProcess`：先自 `SIGKILL` 再调用的子进程得到「exited before the crash was injected」（原为裸 `kill ESRCH`)；健康子进程仍被正常 crash。
- 信号出口：文本钉——成功出口在 `if (failure) throw failure;` 后立即检查 `receivedSignal`。
- MySQL 选项：文本钉——全文恰四处 `--no-defaults`（两个 `mysqld`、一个 `mysql` 客户端、一个 `mysqladmin`)，均作首参（选项文件屏蔽只在首参生效）。
- jar 查找：脚本从 pom 读项目 `<version>` 精确命名未分类 jar（通配会撞上三份产物——pom 还 repackage 出 workspace-bundle 与 operator-recovery 两份分类器）;Dockerfile 按分类器排除选择产物，非恰一份未分类时大声失败，并以固定名 /tmp/qwen-managed-agent-server.jar 导出。
- 镜像绑定：运行时阶段写入 `ENV QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_SERVER_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0` 与 `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_RUNTIME_BROKER_HOST=0.0.0.0`;`application.yml` 的回环默认未动。

### 前后对比

N/A（脚本/镜像行为；新用例按上述描述钉住旧红行为）。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测：`npx vitest run scripts/tests/managed-agent-server-e2e.test.js` 15/15 通过（6 原有 + 9 新增）；两个文件 ESLint 干净、Prettier 已应用。评审轮另增补：glob 未命中时的大声守卫、`docker -p` 的身份后果警示（API 无 HTTP 认证，请只在自有网络策略内映射端口）、stallTimer.unref()；新增用例钉住两个 ENV 与守卫文案。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：无——失败模式变严格（错误浮出水面而非隐藏）；正常路径不变。
- 未验证/范围外：完整 e2e 运行需要 MySQL/MariaDB，由 CI 车道执行；镜像未在本机做 docker build。T23 e2e cancel 竞态与其余 R2 项在 web 测试批/其他 PR 中跟进。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：中断的运行现在退出 1（此前为 0 并输出成功 JSON)——那正是缺陷本身。

## 关联 Issue

#12692 合并后 R2 评审的跟进。设计级延缓项由 #13302 跟踪。

</details>
