prs.title: fix(managed-agent): reconcile approval delivery and concurrent session titles
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Recover accepted Workspace approval answers after dispatcher attachment-cache loss with the default recovery configuration. Keep Harness-disabled replicas from claiming pending deliveries, while allowing them to settle answers whose committed journal already proves a final outcome. Renew approval claims during slow attachment or answer delivery.

Keep public and Harness Session titles consistent under concurrent rename requests and ambiguous HTTP results. Each admitted attempt has a durable, increasing revision; the final journal write fences older attempts, and a stored delivery repairs a lost reply without appending a second title. A FAILED same-key retry remains usable after a newer rename succeeds. Both inline and recovery requests claim before remote I/O; expired owners cannot retire a replacement owner's receipt. Fresh disabled or unsupported Harness requests and Unicode-only titles are refused before admission. A named superseded conflict remains HTTP409 at the public boundary. Workspace migration counts unfinished title work even after the public command fails. Rename replay probes avoid missing-row gap locks while retaining tenant and Session serialization.

## Why it's needed

[wenshao's round-9 verification of #13163](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13163#issuecomment-6058011515) found accepted approvals stuck after cache loss, disabled replicas taking claims they cannot deliver, and concurrent renames leaving the public and private titles different. This PR handles these related follow-ups together. A SQL completion guard alone cannot prevent an older remote write from finishing last.

While an admitted write remains uncertain, recovery and lifecycle/migration barriers are retained. A permanently unavailable Harness is an explicit external blocker; a later refusal or retry count is not proof that an earlier remote write never committed. This is the owner-confirmed contract.

Current conflict repair: [`638b97984214`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/commit/638b979842143478966430c4489b9cedc1b7b4d3) additively merges main d35277c2, and [`ab1af693957b`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/commit/ab1af693957bd908157297f6e624a4e4a69d62cf) renumbers the rename-delivery migration from V66 to V67 because main's V66 is now the agent-definition digest (#13530). The upgrade history retains V67 rename delivery, V60 child workspace and upstream V62 task cancellation; rename SQL and both migration guards remain intact. The approval/rename patch scope is unchanged. Fresh focused verification and new-head CI are attributed separately in the [acceptance record](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13682#issuecomment-6075053575). Formal human approval and an authorized merge remain outstanding.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Answer a pending Workspace approval after losing the dispatcher attachment cache **while the Broker keeps running** (`verified-workspace-recovery-enabled=false`), e.g. the answer lands on another replica. Expect the original operation to complete, the Action to be decided, and the expected file effect to occur once. A Workspace READER remains refused; an authorized second OPERATOR can answer the owner’s approval, and same-responder replay returns the same operation. This item does **not** cover a dispatcher restart (TERM/SIGKILL), where the attachment cache and the embedded Broker restart together: there the answer is still delivered, but the Harness then logs `recovery blocked: Runtime Broker returned HTTP 404 (runtime_session_not_found)` and the Turn stays RUNNING until cancelled. That wedge is pre-existing — an unapproved plain tool Turn across the same restart wedges identically on base and head — so it is not a regression of this PR, and no open issue currently carries it; the adjacent tracked work is #12766 / #12670, and #13269 explicitly disclaims the restart case.
- Let a Harness-disabled replica recover a shared database. A requested answer keeps its claim and retry schedule; an answer whose journal Action has already ended can settle without a Harness call. Hold enabled delivery beyond its initial lease and confirm another replica cannot take over while the worker renews it.
- Hold an accepted rename before its final journal transaction, let its request time out after sending, and complete a different-key rename through another replica. Release the older request and expect both durable titles to remain the newer title. Retry the FAILED original key and expect a fresh revision that can become the latest title.
- Lose the reply after the latest private title is committed. Expect scheduled recovery to complete its public receipt without a manual retry or another title record. Verify this also works for the first rename of an empty bound or unbound Session. Replaying a completed key produces no new write; changed content under that key still conflicts.
- While the latest title delivery is unfinished, close, archive, delete, cwd change and Workspace migration refuse admission, even if the public command is FAILED. Once delivery completes, admission can proceed.
- Refuse a fresh rename on a disabled or old-protocol Harness before creating a command/delivery; the Session can still close. A healthy inline delivery cannot be claimed immediately by a peer. After lease expiry and takeover, stale or null-owner cleanup leaves the replacement receipt unchanged. An invalid reply after sending remains recoverable.

- Submit Unicode-only titles (NBSP, FEFF, U+2007 or U+202F). Expect 400 invalid_title, no rename command or delivery, and continued close admission. A title containing visible text preserves its exact Unicode content. A contract-valid Harness 409 session_mutation_superseded stays public409; unrelated conflicts and ambiguous failures keep the dependency error path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual source CLI tmux captures show the WriteFile permission, its real file effect and `/rename` updating display and isolated storage. Actual source WebShell UI allowed an approval after connector cache loss and a controlled private503; the real scheduler recovered the same operation without another first-action response. A second composer submission rejected WriteFile and Edit and left the file unchanged. API rename plus actual Refresh displayed the same durable title. See the [acceptance record](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13682#issuecomment-6075053575) for images and exact source/provider boundaries.

Before: round 9 recorded repeated attachment conflicts, claims by a disabled replica, and settled public/private title divergence. After: focused SDK, Core, Hosted route and Spring regressions cover the contracts above. Controlled real Spring/H2 + current Node Harness probes exercise cross-replica delayed writes, an actual SDK deadline with remote work still alive, automatic lost-reply recovery, and cache-loss approval delivery with a real worker file effect. The separate acceptance comment records the delivered commit, exact results, initial failed probes and negative controls.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Focused native checks and real local HTTP paths |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not locally tested; CI reported separately |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not locally tested; CI reported separately |

### Environment

Java 21, Node 22+, source CLI and current compiled Core/Java SDK, two Spring contexts sharing H2, independent local Brokers and an authorized mount. The approval provider and transport failures are controlled fixtures; the HTTP, journal, scheduler and worker paths are real. UI/TUI evidence remains attributed to61449726; later main integrations and this conflict repair have separately attributed focused verification and CI. It does not relabel the earlier runtime evidence as a new run.

## Risk & Scope

- The two stores are separate transactions. Titles may temporarily differ while delivery is pending; durable recovery establishes equality for the latest admitted attempt. Unfinished delivery blocks lifecycle sealing, cwd changes and Workspace migration. Admitted work stays pending when a later dependency/protocol refusal cannot prove that earlier requests never wrote; no retry cap discards ambiguous outcomes.
- Flyway V67 sits above main’s highest applied version (V66 managed session agent-definition digest), so a database already migrated by current main applies it in order instead of failing Flyway validation, and it adds one latest rename-delivery row per Session. The earlier colliding versions were unmerged; the table and delivery contract are unchanged. Fenced writes require Hosted title protocol 1. Deploy the updated Harness and SDK/server together; mixed old rename writers are outside the ordering guarantee. The SDK refuses an unsupported Harness before sending a versioned mutation.
- Actual source-browser and tmux acceptance is covered above. Local observations use H2 and a controlled provider; real-model, production-database and packaged-CLI acceptance are not claimed. The broader follow-up backlog in #13269 remains open; this PR addresses the approval and rename contracts described here.
- Linked, synchronized designs: [rename delivery](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/785dc863ebd0e633393021905751d2a335ddb9a3/docs/design/2026-10-08-managed-session-rename-delivery.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/785dc863ebd0e633393021905751d2a335ddb9a3/docs/design/2026-10-08-managed-session-rename-delivery.zh-CN.md), and [approval delivery](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/785dc863ebd0e633393021905751d2a335ddb9a3/docs/design/2026-09-30-managed-agent-actions.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/785dc863ebd0e633393021905751d2a335ddb9a3/docs/design/2026-09-30-managed-agent-actions.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #13163 and the approval/rename findings in #13269.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 改动

在默认恢复配置下，恢复调度器丢失附着缓存后已受理的 Workspace 审批答复。禁用 Harness 的副本不认领待投递任务，但能根据已提交 journal 证明的终态直接结算答复。附着恢复或答复投递缓慢时持续续租，防止正常投递被其他副本接管。

让并发改名和不确定的 HTTP 结果最终保持公共标题与 Harness 标题一致。每次受理拥有持久递增版本；最终 journal 写入拒绝旧版本，持久投递补齐丢失回包而不追加第二条标题记录。较新的改名完成后，原 FAILED 幂等键仍能以新版本重试。同步请求与恢复请求都先认领再执行远端 I/O，过期所有者不能退休新所有者的回执。新禁用或不支持协议的 Harness 请求以及纯 Unicode 空白标题在受理前被拒绝；带明确 superseded 错误码的冲突在公开接口保持409。Workspace 迁移在公共命令失败后仍统计未完成标题工作；改名重放探测移除缺失行的间隙锁，保留租户和 Session 串行化。

### 原因

[wenshao 对 #13163 的第九轮验证](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13163#issuecomment-6058011515)发现了缓存丢失后审批答复停滞、禁用副本抢占无法完成的投递，以及并发改名造成两侧标题不同。本 PR 一起处理这些相关后续问题。只在 SQL 完成时检查，无法阻止旧远端写入最后落盘。

### 审阅验证

- 默认 `verified-workspace-recovery-enabled=false`，**在 Broker 不重启的前提下**丢失附着缓存后回答待审批 Action（例如答复落到另一个副本）。预期原 operation 完成、Action 已决定、文件效果发生一次；Workspace READER 仍被拒绝；具备权限的第二位 OPERATOR 可以回答 owner 的审批，同一答复人的重放仍返回原 operation。本条**不**覆盖派发器真实重启（TERM/SIGKILL，附着缓存与内嵌 Broker 同时重启）：那种情况下答复仍会送达，但 Harness 随后记录 `recovery blocked: Runtime Broker returned HTTP 404 (runtime_session_not_found)`，Turn 一直 RUNNING 直到被取消。该卡死是既有问题——不带审批的普通工具 Turn 经历同样重启时，base 与 head 同样卡死——因此不是本 PR 的回归；目前也没有已开 issue 收录它，相邻的在跟踪项是 #12766 / #12670，而 #13269 已明确排除重启情形。
- 禁用 Harness 的副本恢复共享数据库时，requested 答复的认领和重试时间保持不变；journal 已证明结束的答复无需 Harness 即可结算。让可用副本的投递超过初始租约，续租期间其他副本不能接管。
- 将已接受的改名停在最终 journal 事务前，让请求在发送后超时，再通过另一副本完成新键改名。释放旧请求后，两侧持久标题应仍是新标题。重试原 FAILED 键，应获得新版本并能成为最新标题。
- 最新私有标题提交后丢失回包，预期定时恢复自动补齐公共回执，无需手动重试，也不新增标题记录。空的绑定或未绑定 Workspace 的 Session 首次改名也应如此。重放已完成键不写入，同键改换内容仍冲突。
- 最新标题投递未完成时，关闭、归档、删除、cwd 变更及 Workspace 迁移拒绝准入，包括公共命令为 FAILED 的情况；投递完成后恢复准入。
- 禁用或旧标题协议的 Harness 在新改名入库前被拒绝，不留下命令和投递，Session 仍可关闭。正常同步投递不能被同伴立即认领；租约到期接管后，旧所有者或空所有者清理不改变新回执。发送后回包无效仍继续恢复。

- 纯 Unicode 空白标题（NBSP、FEFF、U+2007、U+202F）返回400 invalid_title，不新增改名命令或投递，并仍允许 close 准入。包含可见文字的标题保留原 Unicode 内容；合法私有 superseded 409 在公开接口保持409，其他冲突和不确定失败维持原依赖错误路径。

### 前后证据

修复前，第九轮记录了重复附着冲突、禁用副本的任务认领，以及稳定后的公共与私有标题差异。修复后，SDK、Core、Hosted 路由和 Spring 定向回归覆盖这些契约。受控的真实 Spring/H2 与当前 Node Harness 探针验证跨副本迟到写入、SDK 真正超时后仍存活的远端工作、丢失回包的自动恢复，以及缓存丢失后的审批投递和真实 worker 文件效果。单独的验收评论记录交付提交、确切结果、初始失败探针及反向验证。

### 平台与环境

macOS 已运行定向原生检查和真实本地 HTTP 路径。Windows、Linux 未在本地验证，CI 结果另行记录。环境为 Java 21、Node 22 及以上、源码 CLI、当前编译的 Core 与 Java SDK、共享 H2 的两个 Spring context、独立本地 Broker 及已授权挂载。审批模型与传输故障是受控夹具；HTTP、journal、调度器与 worker 路径是真实实现。

### 风险与范围

两侧存储不是同一事务，投递尚未完成期间可能暂时不同；持久恢复保证最新受理尝试最终一致。未完成投递阻止生命周期封存、cwd 变更及 Workspace 迁移。受理后出现依赖或协议拒绝时，不能据此证明较早请求从未写入；不以重试次数上限丢弃不确定结果。Flyway V67 高于 main 当前最高的已应用版本（V66 managed session agent definition digest），因此已被当前 main 迁移过的数据库会按顺序应用它而不是在 Flyway 校验时失败，并为每个 Session 保存一行最新改名投递。原冲突版本尚未合并，表与投递契约保持不变。带围栏的写入要求 Hosted 标题协议 1，应一起部署更新后的 Harness 和 SDK/server；旧改名 writer 混用不在排序保证内。SDK 在发送带版本变更前拒绝不支持的 Harness。

已完成实际源码浏览器与tmux验收：审批允许及缓存丢失后的定时恢复、输入框再次发送、拒绝后文件不变，以及API改名后实际刷新显示；ANSI/plain capture与截图在验收记录中。本地使用H2与受控provider，不声称真实模型、生产数据库或打包CLI验收。#13269 的其他后续事项保持开放，本 PR 处理上述审批与改名契约。改名投递及审批设计的中英文文档已链接并同步。

关联 #13163 与 #13269 的审批和改名问题。

</details>

中文补充：用户已再次确认保留安全恢复与永久依赖不可用的外部阻塞边界，改名退休扩展已撤回。当前提交638b979842143478966430c4489b9cedc1b7b4d3追加合入实际main d35277c2，并由ab1af693957bd908157297f6e624a4e4a69d62cf将改名投递迁移V66重编号为V67（main的V66现为agent-definition digest），升级历史保留V67、V60、主线V62，改名SQL和两道独立迁移检查不变，范围仍38文件+1305/-72。此次定向验证及新head CI详见验收评论；原0f候选189项、65技术CI及614实际UI/TUI保持原提交归属。主线任务取消不代表本PR增加改名取消契约。正式人工批准及获授权的人合并仍待完成。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): unwedge Hosted stream close and bound task cancel attempts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes the first finding of the H4f real-stack acceptance (#13746): a task cancel that hung forever after a Hosted Harness restart behind a half-open connection.

- **Hosted event stream close.** Closing a Hosted Harness event stream no longer waits for the lock that its reader holds across the blocking SSE read. Closing the response body is what ends that read, so a close now returns at once, and the read it ends reports the stream as closed (the same `IllegalStateException` as a `next()` after close), not as the server ending it. Reading the stream's last event id no longer waits on the reader either. That read has no in-repo production caller; the change is defensive, because it is a public SDK method.
- **Bounded cancel attempts.** The task cancel coordinator runs each send on its own thread and waits for it for at most five minutes, or four Harness request timeouts when that is longer. A send still running then is logged as abandoned and treated as an unproven outcome, like a lost reply: the delivery reads the task's committed record, retries or parks, and stops renewing its lease. An abandoned send that lands later is judged by the record, as before, and it logs how it ended.
- **Approval-mode check on a cold attach.** The abandoned send is interrupted, and an interrupt can make the connector's approval-mode check throw after a cold attach has already cached its Harness ref. The connector now evicts the ref it just minted when that check throws instead of answering, both on the plain attach and on the runtime-recovery load, so no later call can use an unverified attachment.
- **Design doc.** The H4f design doc (EN and zh-CN) now records the real-stack round and its findings, states the bound as measured (608 s when attempts fail fast; about an hour and a half if every attempt hangs), and adds two follow-up rows: whether a parent close should physically stop its children, and a Hosted stream heartbeat.

## Why it's needed

On the real stack, a Harness restart with the client side of its SSE connections left open (what a network partition or a pod moved to another node looks like from Java) produced this chain:

- The first call to the new Harness got the generation `409`. `QwenHostedHarnessConnector.adoptGeneration` closed the stale client.
- `HarnessEventStream.close()` waited on the `ReentrantLock` held by a Turn's reader (`HarnessCoordinator.readStream` → `HarnessEventStream.next()`). That reader was blocked in an SSE read that never returns, because the Hosted transport has no idle watchdog.
- The cancel delivery that triggered the adoption hung inside it. `TaskCancelCoordinator` renewed the claim's lease every 20 s, so the operation sat `running/leased` and never retried or parked.
- The Session's operation slot stayed held, so close answered `409 session_operation_active`. The claim budget never advanced, which broke H4f's "16 claims, then park" bound.

The lock problem is older than H4f (it dates from the Hosted client in #12654, carried over to a `ReentrantLock` by #13388). Any `adoptGeneration` caller could wedge the same way; the cancel path is where the acceptance caught it. The attempt deadline is defense in depth: the record-driven design already treats an unknown send outcome as unproven, so a send that never returns no longer escapes the budget, whatever the cause.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode && mvn test -Dtest=HarnessEventStreamCloseTest`: a real JDK `HttpClient` against a local SSE endpoint that sends headers and then never sends a body. With a reader blocked in `next()`, both `client.close()` and `stream.close()` return, the reader ends with `HarnessEventStream is closed`, and `getLastEventId()` answers while the read is blocked. Each blocking call runs on its own thread with a bounded join, so a regression fails instead of hanging.
- `cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server && mvn test -Dtest=TaskCancelCoordinatorTest`: `aSendThatNeverReturnsIsAbandonedAtTheAttemptDeadline` wedges the send in a wait that ignores interrupts, like the real lock wait. The claim retries at the deadline, its lease renewals stop, and at the budget it parks `recovery_blocked`. `theAttemptDeadlineCoversFourHarnessRequests` pins the deadline under the default and a longer request timeout.
- Both new wedge tests passed 8 of 8 runs pinned to a single CPU.
- `HarnessEventStreamCloseTest` also covers a close racing a buffered frame and a close racing the end of the body. Both report the stream closed, and deleting the post-read check turns both red.
- `QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest.anUnansweredApprovalModeCheckEvictsTheRefItMinted`: the store's approval-mode check throws once, and the next call re-loads and re-verifies on both cold-attach routes. Removing the eviction turns it red.
- Full suites: qwencode `mvn checkstyle:check test` (221 tests, 9 skipped by design) and managed-agent-server `mvn checkstyle:check test` (1849 tests, 2 skipped), all green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Negative controls (local).**

| Change reverted | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Whole `HarnessEventStream` (main's version) | Both close tests fail: `getLastEventId() waited on the blocked reader`. |
| Only `close()` (it takes the lock again) | Both close tests fail: `close() waited on the reader blocked on a half-open stream`. |
| `sendWithinDeadline` calls `send` directly | The deadline test fails: `retryOperation` is never invoked within 10 s. |

**Real stack.** Same rig as the acceptance: an aarch64 Linux host running the packaged chain (MariaDB, Spring, a Hosted Harness from `dist/cli.js`), a scripted fake OpenAI model, and a tap in front of the Harness that keeps the client side of streams open when the Harness dies. The scenario: cancel a running child, SIGKILL the Harness as the cancel arrives, then restart it 12 s later.

| Build | Result |
| --- | --- |
| main `9763580b84`, run twice | The cancel stays `running/leased` with its lease renewed every 20 s. Close answers `409 session_operation_active` throughout. A thread dump shows the cancel thread parked in `HarnessEventStream.close` (via `adoptGeneration`) and two readers parked in `HarnessEventStream.next`. |
| this branch | Claim 1 triggers the kill, claims 2–4 are refused, and claim 5 gets the generation 409. The adoption's client close returns, and the child Turn's reader wakes in the same millisecond (retry with `IllegalStateException`). The child settles `child_failed`, so claim 6 settles the cancel `failed` / `task_already_settled` within 20 s of the restart. A thread dump shows no thread in `HarnessEventStream.close`/`next` or the cancel coordinator. The parent close is admitted (`202`) and completes in about 8 s. |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit suites on Linux x86_64 (JDK 25); real stack on Linux aarch64 (JDK 21).

### Environment (optional)

Real stack: the packaged Spring jar with JDK 21, the Hosted Harness from `dist/cli.js`, and a scripted model. No real model provider was used.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:**
  - A read ended by a local close now throws `IllegalStateException` instead of hanging. Every in-repo caller treats it like any other stream failure (`HarnessCoordinator` takes the transient-failure path).
  - An abandoned send keeps its thread until the send returns. With the stream fix, the known wedge is gone. At most one thread per attempt is abandoned, so a single cancel strands at most 16.
  - A healthy attempt slower than its deadline still lands, but it spends one claim of the budget. The deadline scales with the Harness request timeout to keep that rare.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - A Hosted stream that goes half-open without a generation change is still read forever. Nothing closes it, because the Harness sends no heartbeat that an idle bound could use. This is recorded as follow-up work.
  - The acceptance's second finding (a close right after a cancel does not physically stop the child) would change H4b's close semantics, so it is not changed here. It is tracked in #13875 and listed in the design doc's follow-up table.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** None. No schema, contract, or configuration change.

Both are updated in sync.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13746 (finding 1 of the acceptance). Finding 2 is tracked in #13875. Refs #12380.

## 这个 PR 做了什么

修复 H4f 实机验收（#13746）的发现 1：Harness 在半开连接后面重启后，任务取消会永远挂住。

- **Hosted 事件流的关闭。** 关闭 Hosted Harness 事件流时，不再等读线程在 SSE 阻塞读期间持有的那把锁。真正结束这次读的是关闭响应体，所以现在关闭会立即返回；被它结束的读报告为"流已关闭"（与关闭后再调 `next()` 相同的 `IllegalStateException`），而不是"服务端结束了流"。读取流的最后事件 ID 也不再等读线程。这个读取在仓库内没有生产调用方，改动是防御性的，因为它是公开的 SDK 方法。
- **取消尝试有上限。** 任务取消协调器把每次发送放到单独的线程上，最多等五分钟；Harness 请求超时的四倍更长时，按四倍计。届时仍未结束的发送会记一条"已放弃"日志，并按"结果未证实"处理，与丢失应答相同：投递读取任务的已提交记录，然后重试或停放，并停止续租。被放弃的发送之后若落地，仍由记录判定，与以前一致，并会记录它最终如何结束。
- **冷挂接时的审批模式校验。** 被放弃的发送会被中断，而中断可能让连接器的审批模式校验在冷挂接已缓存 Harness ref 之后抛错。现在校验抛错而没有给出答复时，连接器会移除它刚放入缓存的 ref；普通挂接与运行时恢复加载两条路径都如此，后续调用不会再用到未校验的挂接。
- **设计文档。** H4f 设计文档（中英文）记录了这轮真实栈验收及其发现，按实测写明上限（每次尝试都快速失败时为 608 秒；每次尝试都挂住时约一个半小时），并在后续工作中新增两项：父会话关闭是否应当物理停止 child，以及 Hosted 流的心跳。

## 为什么需要

在真实栈上，Harness 重启而 SSE 连接的客户端一侧仍保持打开（这正是网络分区、或 pod 换到另一节点时在 Java 看来的样子）时，出现了下面这条链：

- 对新 Harness 的第一次调用收到代际 `409`，`QwenHostedHarnessConnector.adoptGeneration` 去关闭旧客户端。
- `HarnessEventStream.close()` 等待一个 Turn 读线程（`HarnessCoordinator.readStream` → `HarnessEventStream.next()`）持有的 `ReentrantLock`。该读线程阻塞在一次永不返回的 SSE 读上，因为 Hosted 传输没有空闲看门狗。
- 触发这次接管的取消投递就卡在接管里。`TaskCancelCoordinator` 每 20 秒为这次认领续一次租，操作停在 `running/leased`，既不重试也不停放。
- Session 的操作位一直被占着，所以关闭回 `409 session_operation_active`。认领预算不前进，H4f "16 次认领后停放"的上限因此失效。

这把锁的问题早于 H4f：它从 #12654 的 Hosted 客户端就存在，#13388 改用 `ReentrantLock` 时原样保留。任何调用 `adoptGeneration` 的路径都可能以同样方式卡死，只是验收在取消路径上抓到了它。尝试时限是纵深防御：以记录为准的设计本来就把未知的发送结果当作未证实，所以无论原因是什么，永不返回的发送都不再能逃出预算。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- `cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode && mvn test -Dtest=HarnessEventStreamCloseTest`：真实 JDK `HttpClient` 对接一个本地 SSE 端点，它发出响应头后再不发送任何数据。读线程阻塞在 `next()` 中时，`client.close()` 与 `stream.close()` 都能返回，读线程以 `HarnessEventStream is closed` 结束，`getLastEventId()` 在读阻塞期间也能返回。每个可能阻塞的调用都在单独线程上执行并限时 join，所以回归时测试会失败而不是挂住。
- `cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server && mvn test -Dtest=TaskCancelCoordinatorTest`：`aSendThatNeverReturnsIsAbandonedAtTheAttemptDeadline` 让发送卡在一个忽略中断的等待里，与真实的锁等待一样。到时限时认领会重试、续租停止，预算用尽后停放为 `recovery_blocked`。`theAttemptDeadlineCoversFourHarnessRequests` 钉住默认请求超时与更长请求超时下的时限。
- 两个新的卡死测试绑定单核各跑 8 次，全部通过。
- `HarnessEventStreamCloseTest` 还覆盖关闭与已缓冲帧竞争、关闭与响应体结束竞争两种情况，都报告流已关闭；删掉读后检查，两者都会变红。
- `QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest.anUnansweredApprovalModeCheckEvictsTheRefItMinted`：存储的审批模式校验先抛错一次，下一次调用会在两条冷挂接路径上重新加载并重新校验。去掉移除逻辑，测试会变红。
- 全量套件：qwencode `mvn checkstyle:check test`（221 个测试，9 个按设计跳过）与 managed-agent-server `mvn checkstyle:check test`（1849 个测试，2 个跳过），全部通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

**负对照（本地）。**

| 回退的改动 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 整个 `HarnessEventStream`（main 上的版本） | 两个关闭测试都失败：`getLastEventId() waited on the blocked reader`。 |
| 只回退 `close()`（重新取锁） | 两个关闭测试都失败：`close() waited on the reader blocked on a half-open stream`。 |
| `sendWithinDeadline` 直接调用 `send` | 时限测试失败：10 秒内始终没有调用 `retryOperation`。 |

**真实栈。** 与验收相同的 rig：一台 aarch64 Linux 主机，跑打包好的整条链路（MariaDB、Spring、用 `dist/cli.js` 起的 Hosted Harness），脚本化的假 OpenAI 模型，Harness 前有一个在 Harness 死掉时保持流的客户端一侧不断开的 tap。场景：取消一个运行中的 child，在取消到达时 SIGKILL Harness，12 秒后重启。

| 构建 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| main `9763580b84`，跑了两次 | 取消一直停在 `running/leased`，每 20 秒续一次租。关闭期间一律回 `409 session_operation_active`。线程栈显示取消线程停在 `HarnessEventStream.close`（经由 `adoptGeneration`），另有两个读线程停在 `HarnessEventStream.next`。 |
| 本分支 | 第 1 次认领触发杀进程，第 2–4 次认领被拒，第 5 次认领收到代际 409。接管时的客户端关闭立即返回，child Turn 的读线程在同一毫秒被唤醒（以 `IllegalStateException` 重试）。child 结算为 `child_failed`，所以第 6 次认领在重启后 20 秒内把取消结算为 `failed` / `task_already_settled`。线程栈里没有线程停在 `HarnessEventStream.close`/`next` 或取消协调器中。父会话关闭被接纳（`202`），约 8 秒内完成。 |

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

单元套件在 Linux x86_64（JDK 25）上运行；真实栈在 Linux aarch64（JDK 21）上运行。

### 环境（可选）

真实栈：JDK 21 运行的打包 Spring jar，用 `dist/cli.js` 起的 Hosted Harness，脚本化模型。没有使用真实模型提供方。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：**
  - 被本地关闭结束的读，现在抛出 `IllegalStateException` 而不是挂住。仓库内所有调用方都把它当作普通的流失败处理（`HarnessCoordinator` 走暂时性失败路径）。
  - 被放弃的发送会一直占着自己的线程，直到发送返回。修了流之后，已知的卡死原因已经消除。每次尝试最多放弃一个线程，所以一个取消最多留下 16 个。
  - 比时限更慢的正常尝试仍会落地，但会消耗一次认领预算。时限随 Harness 请求超时放大，使这种情况很少发生。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 没有代际变化时变成半开的 Hosted 流仍会被一直读下去：没有任何东西去关闭它，因为 Harness 不发心跳，空闲上限无从设起。已记为后续工作。
  - 验收的发现 2（取消后紧接着关闭不会物理停止 child）会改变 H4b 的关闭语义，所以本 PR 不改。它由 #13875 跟踪，并已列入设计文档的后续工作表。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。没有 schema、契约或配置变更。

设计文档：[EN](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/h4f-hosted-stream-close-and-attempt-bound/docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-task-cancel.md) · [zh-CN](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/h4f-hosted-stream-close-and-attempt-bound/docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-task-cancel.zh-CN.md)，两者已同步更新。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13746（验收的发现 1）。发现 2 由 #13875 跟踪。Refs #12380。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): bound retry loops with terminal states
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Across the managed-agent stack, asynchronous retry loops had no terminal state, and in one case a permanently wedged projection. This change gives every loop a budget and a terminal state: the message projection heals past a provably permanent sequence gap instead of throwing on every scan — settling as failed any items whose turn's terminal event was in the skipped range — and the scanner itself backs off per session (exponential to a 60s cap, surfaced loudly once) so a deterministic failure can no longer flood the log at 10Hz; admitted turns converge to a bounded terminal failure once their retry budget is spent; lifecycle operations whose settle can never succeed terminate `failed` with the settle's failure code kept (the Session keeps its pending status — nothing certifies a completion that never happened) — except while a live journal writer means the close can still succeed, which keeps waiting; a blocked workspace close keeps its failure code through every attempt and through the terminal record; a failed action response whose Action is still waiting is re-admitted by the caller's retry under the same idempotency key instead of returning a stale failure receipt forever; a memory-blocked embedded scheduler arms its own recheck wake so a missed capacity notification can no longer starve queued work; transient store IO failures are retried within the lease window (renewals) or retried bounded before abandoning (releases), a consecutive-failure streak halts the worker loudly when a "transient" outage is really persistent, and a per-activation budget records a terminal outcome instead of re-running forever; session close seals the writer in a finally; and a failed HTTP seal throws loudly out of that finally while the grant lapses with the lease, so a takeover can proceed. There is deliberately no seal retry (issue #13182 item 6b): keeping the grant renewed was found in review to let a stale client seal the journal out from under a freshly re-attached session, so the bounded-retry cut was withdrawn and 6b is answered by the loud throw plus the grant lapse.

## Why it's needed

Audit of the retry loops (issue #13182) found: a single event-sequence gap wedged a session's projection forever while the scanner logged the same stack at 10Hz; an admitted turn failing transiently was rescheduled without bound; a close/delete whose settle can never succeed retried forever; a missed capacity notification starved queued activations silently; one transient renewal error bricked the embedded scheduler; and a failed close could leave a writer unsealed, blocking both clean resume and takeover. The fail-closed posture of the session authority is correct — the layers around it treated transient IO failures as indistinguishable from consistency damage. Review of the first cut found the remaining gaps this wave closes: the exhaustion arm used the success-path completion write (erasing the blocked failure code and certifying an unsettled close), the gap heal left orphaned items streaming forever, the materializer's other permanent failure modes still spun at 10Hz, the scheduler's transient retry had no escalation bound, the first cut's renewal-keeping seal retry let a stale client seal the journal under a re-attached session (withdrawn in favor of the loud throw), and a budget-terminated action answer could never be re-delivered.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The affected paths are not reachable from the CLI binary (the Java control plane needs a deployed broker; the embedded scheduler is hardened ahead of its first production wiring), so the evidence is the new regression suites, each verified to fail on the pre-fix code and pass after:

- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server`: `mvn test` — 2031 tests; the full suite is green except two pre-existing `ToolPublicationStoreTest` timing errors that reproduce identically on base, and one `ChildWorktreeGitTest` non-UTF8-name case that fails only on macOS's sh (identical on main). Key suites: `MessageProjectionGapHealTest` (real H2 + real transaction boundary: a gapped projection heals, the gap is logged once naming only the truly missing sequences, a lost `turn.completed` settles its orphaned items as failed, and a second-connection `FOR UPDATE` witness pins that the scan holds the session row lock the permanence premise rests on), `MessageMaterializerTest` (backoff + surface-once + reset on success), `AdmittedTurnRetryTerminalStateTest` (budget boundary 9 retries / 10 terminates, configured budgets honored, both the daemon-503 and broker arms), `OperationRetryTerminalStateTest` (budget boundary, configured budgets, the committed-decision arm, the live-writer gate, the blocked-code-preserving terminal, the bound-session workspace-close routing, the terminal-record-failure fallback), `ManagedActionStoreTest` (stage invariants + re-admission of a FAILED response while the Action is still requested), `SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest` (a blocked close stays blocked below the budget).
- `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime` — 3279 tests (one known under-load-only flake that passes in isolation). Coverage includes journal tail repair fault injection (torn write repaired, unrepairable write halts, first-write ENOENT is transient, vanished journal is fatal), the scheduler's claim/renewal/release retry policies, the transient-streak halt, per-activation budget convergence, dispose-race wake guards, the memory-blocked poll's decelerating cadence (one store scan per tick, doubling from 1s to a 30s cap, with a cancelled-queue tick clearing the block), and the seal failure path's loud throw with the grant left to lapse.
- `npm run build && npm run bundle` and `npm run typecheck` pass; `packages/web-shell` OpenAPI contract sync test passes (the generated client was regenerated after the contract description update).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit/integration-level verification only (H2 in-memory for the Java broker, fault-injection fs mocks for the TS store); the hosted paths are covered by the suites above rather than a live broker.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a turn/operation/action that keeps failing transiently now reaches a terminal failure instead of retrying forever — that is the intended change; budgets are configurable (`dispatch.max-post-admission-retries`, `dispatch.max-operation-retries`, both default 10) and validated at startup. A lifecycle operation that hits the budget now reads `failed` with a failure code instead of `completed` — the more honest answer, and the one the contract text now describes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the embedded scheduler has no production caller yet (hardened ahead of wiring, disclosed in test comments); the MySQL-backed `*IT` integration tests run in CI's Hosted process fault gates lane (locally they need Docker/MySQL); the materializer backoff is in-memory (a persisted terminal consumer-progress state is a possible follow-up if operators need it to survive restarts).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the startup validation now rejects `max-pre-admission-retries` greater than `max-post-admission-retries` — a combination that was accepted before (and silently stripped late-admitted turns of retries). Deployments with that combination in external config must align the two keys before upgrading; the error message names both values. Otherwise: two new optional config keys with safe defaults; one new turn failure code; new lifecycle/action failure codes (free-form string fields, no enum change).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13182

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

managed-agent 栈中的异步重试环路此前没有终态，其中一处会让投影永久卡死。本次改为给每个环路预算与终态：消息投影在遇到可证永久的事件序号缺口时自愈越过——并把终结事件落在缺口区间的 turn 的在途 item 置为 failed——不再每次扫描都抛错，扫描器自身也按 session 退避（指数退避封顶 60 秒，超预算后响亮上报一次），确定性失败不再以 10Hz 刷日志；已受理的 turn 在重试预算耗尽后收敛到有界终态；settle 永远无法成功的生命周期操作以 `failed` 终结并保留 settle 的失败码（Session 保持待定状态——不再为从未发生的完成出具凭证）——除非 journal writer 仍存活，此时 close 仍可能成功，operation 继续等待；被阻塞的 workspace close 在每次尝试与终态记录中都保留其失败码；Action 仍在等待应答的失败 action response 可被调用方按同一幂等键重试重新受理，而不是永远返回陈旧的失败回执；内存不足的嵌入式调度器会自行武装复检唤醒，错过容量通知不再让排队激活永久饥饿；瞬时存储 IO 失败在租约窗口内重试（续约）或有界重试后再放弃（释放），连续失败计数会在"瞬时"故障实为持续故障时响亮地 halt worker，按激活的预算则记录终态而不是无限重跑；会话关闭在 finally 中保证封存 writer；HTTP 封存失败会从该 finally 中响亮抛出，并让授权随租约失效，使接管得以进行。此处刻意不做封存重试（issue #13182 第 6b 项）：评审发现保持续约会让陈旧客户端在新会话重新挂载后从其手中封存 journal，因此有界重试方案被撤回，6b 由响亮抛错加授权失效来回答。

## 为什么需要

对重试环路的审计（issue #13182）发现：一个事件序号缺口会让该会话的投影永久停摆，扫描器以 10Hz 重复打印同一堆栈；瞬时失败的已受理 turn 被无上限重排；永远无法 settle 的 close/delete 无限重试；一次遗漏的容量通知会让排队激活静默饥饿；一次瞬时续约错误就让嵌入式调度器报废到进程重启；失败的 close 可能留下未封存的 writer，既不能干净恢复也不能被接管。会话 authority 的 fail-closed 姿态本身是对的——问题是外围各层把瞬时传输/IO 失败与一致性损坏混为一谈。对第一版实现的评审发现了本轮修复的剩余缺口：预算耗尽分支此前复用成功路径的完成写入（抹掉被阻塞的失败码，并为从未 settle 的关闭出具凭证）；gap 自愈让失去 turn 终结事件的 item 永远停在"流式"状态；materializer 的其他永久失败模式仍以 10Hz 空转；调度器的瞬态重试没有升级上限；第一版保持续约的封存重试会让陈旧客户端在新会话重新挂载后被其封存 journal（已撤回，改为响亮抛错）；预算耗尽的 action 应答永远无法再投递。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

受影响路径无法从 CLI 二进制触达（Java 控制面需要部署的 broker；嵌入式调度器在首次生产接线前完成加固），因此证据是新增的回归套件，每个都已在修复前代码上验证为红、修复后转绿：

- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server`：`mvn test` —— 2031 个测试；除两个在基线上同样复现的既有 `ToolPublicationStoreTest` 时序错误，以及一个仅在 macOS sh 上失败的 `ChildWorktreeGitTest` 非 UTF8 命名用例（在 main 上同样失败）外全绿。关键套件：`MessageProjectionGapHealTest`（真实 H2 + 真实事务边界：缺口投影自愈、缺口只记录一次且只命名真正缺失的序号、丢失 `turn.completed` 时其孤立 item 被置为 failed、第二连接 `FOR UPDATE` 见证钉住"扫描持有 Session 行锁"这一自愈前提）、`MessageMaterializerTest`（退避 + 一次性上报 + 成功后重置）、`AdmittedTurnRetryTerminalStateTest`（预算边界 9 重试 / 10 终结、配置预算生效、daemon-503 与 broker 两臂）、`OperationRetryTerminalStateTest`（预算边界、配置预算、已提交决定分支、存活 writer 闸门、保留失败码的终态、绑定 Session 的 workspace 关闭路由、终态写入失败的回退）、`ManagedActionStoreTest`（stage 不变式 + Action 仍在等待时 FAILED 行的重新受理）、`SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest`（预算内被阻塞的 close 保持阻塞）。
- `packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/managed-runtime` —— 3279 个测试（一个仅在负载下出现、单独运行通过的既有 flake）。覆盖含 journal 尾部修复故障注入（撕裂写入可修复、不可修复则熔断、首写 ENOENT 为瞬时、日志消失为致命）、调度器 claim/续约/释放重试策略、瞬态连续失败熔断、按激活预算收敛、dispose 竞态唤醒保护、内存阻塞轮询的减速节拍（每 tick 一次存储扫描，从 1 秒翻倍至 30 秒封顶，队列被清空的那一拍解除阻塞），以及封存失败路径的响亮抛错与授权失效。
- `npm run build && npm run bundle` 与 `npm run typecheck` 通过；`packages/web-shell` 的 OpenAPI 契约同步测试通过（契约描述更新后已重新生成客户端）。

### 前后对比证据

N/A —— 无用户可见的 UI 变更。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

仅单元/集成级验证（Java broker 用 H2 内存库，TS store 用故障注入 fs mock）；hosted 路径由上述套件覆盖，未跑真实 broker。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：持续瞬时失败的 turn/operation/action 现在会到达终态而不是无限重试——这正是预期变更；预算可配置（`dispatch.max-post-admission-retries`、`dispatch.max-operation-retries`，默认均为 10）并在启动时校验。命中预算的生命周期操作现在读作 `failed` 并带失败码，而不是 `completed`——这是更诚实的回答，也是契约文本现在描述的回答。

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one-shot system reminders out of the user's own message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One-shot reminders that the interactive terminal UI folds into the front of a prompt are no longer shown back to the user. The transcript line for a prompt, the entry written to the cross-session ↑-recall history, the text refilled into the composer after a cancelled turn, and the same prompt as rebuilt when a session is resumed now all show what the user typed. The request sent to the model still carries the reminder exactly as before, and the machine-readable sidecar mirror of the conversation is deliberately left untouched, because its job is to report what was actually sent.

Removal is leading-only: a reminder tag the user pasted into the middle of their own prompt stays visible, and a tag that is never closed is left in place rather than swallowed. If a prompt were nothing but an envelope, the transcript keeps showing it rather than rendering an empty bubble.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a session that still had paused background agents made the first prompt render as a block of internal instructions — how to list agents, and how to message one by task id — followed by the user's own words. The user never wrote that text and cannot act on it. Cancelling the turn put the same block into the editable input box, so resubmitting sent internal context to the model as literal user text, and resuming that session again replayed it from the recording. This was reported internally during token-consumption governance work.

None of it was needed to keep the user informed. Each of the three notices that can be injected this way already has its own user-facing signal: restored background agents and a restored worktree each add an info line to the transcript, and workflow keyword steering lights an indicator in the footer. The headless and ACP runtimes both attach the notice as a separate part alongside the prompt rather than folding it in, so the interactive terminal path was the only one mixing a model-only payload into the string it also renders, logs and restores. This separates the two roles again at the points where a prompt is read back, instead of restructuring how the notice is delivered — the delivery side is threaded through the submission queue, speculation matching and side-question routing, and rewriting it is a much larger change than the defect warrants.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, launch a background agent, leave it paused/recoverable, exit, then `qwen --resume` that session.
2. Type any first prompt. Before: the transcript shows a `<system-reminder>` block reading "1 background agent was restored from this session. Use list_agents to inspect it and send_message with a task_id to continue one.", a blank line, then the prompt. After: only the prompt, with the separate info line "Restored 1 background agent from this session. Open Background tasks to inspect it." still present above it.
3. Confirm the model still receives the reminder — ask it what it was told about restored agents, or inspect the request payload in an API trace. It should be unchanged.
4. Cancel path: on that first prompt press ESC before any output arrives. The composer should refill with the prompt only, not the envelope. Resubmit and confirm the transcript is still clean.
5. ↑-recall: exit, start a new session in the same directory, press ↑. The recalled entry should be the prompt without the envelope.
6. Resume again: `qwen --resume` the session from step 1 and confirm the earlier prompt now renders without the envelope (this is the recording-replay path, fixed separately from the live path).
7. Paste guard: submit `before <system-reminder>x</system-reminder> after` and confirm the transcript shows it verbatim.
8. The worktree and workflow-steering notices reproduce the same way through their own one-shot latches (`--worktree`, or a prompt containing the workflow keyword with the feature enabled); both should now render only the user's words while keeping their info line and footer indicator.

Automated:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx \
  src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/utils/historyUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx
# 554 passed
npx tsc --noEmit            # clean
npx eslint <changed files>  # clean
npx prettier --check <changed files>  # clean
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

No terminal recording for this one — evidence is at the unit level, and I'm flagging that explicitly rather than implying a TUI capture was done.

- After: two new cases pin the live path (model request keeps the envelope while the transcript and the recall log carry only the user's words; stacked envelopes strip, mid-message and unterminated ones do not) and two pin the resume path (an envelope-only record restores as the bare prompt; a pasted envelope survives).
- Before: three pre-existing cancel-path expectations pinned the old text — they asserted the envelope inside the value that is both compared for identity and written back into the composer. Those three had to be updated, which is the direct before/after evidence for the cancel-restore path.
- Not run locally to completion: the full `packages/cli` suite. Every test file that mentions the reminder tag was run individually and passes, no snapshot contains it, and CI covers the rest.
- Pre-existing and unrelated: `src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts` fails 8 tests with `this.config.setCurrentSessionScheduledTaskCreator is not a function`. Verified identical on the base commit `0ef35351e9` with this branch's changes absent — the test's mocked config lacks a method the ACP session now calls. Not touched here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, lint and format on the changed files. No manual TUI run and no Windows/Linux run — the change is string handling with no platform-specific branch, but the manual steps above are the ones worth walking on a real terminal.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): bound pending edit diffs to nearby context
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Edit approval dialogs and pending edit cards show changed lines with up to three unchanged lines on each side, with hunk headers retaining original line numbers. Common file ends are trimmed before diffing. Both diff-content blocks and projected tool arguments use the compact preview while tools are pending or in progress. Completed previews, confirmed failed-tool content and tool-supplied patches retain their existing behavior.

If the trimmed comparison or rendered output exceeds the preview budget, the preview explicitly says it was omitted rather than depicting a whole-file rewrite. A trailing-newline-only change is identified explicitly. Long files with small edits can show compact previews while the existing raw character budget remains.

## Why it's needed

A one-line edit in a 200-line file previously rendered 201 rows. The compact preview renders nine rows with correct line numbers. The first revision fixed the dialog and content-block path but missed the projected-argument path used by pending cards; this follow-up addresses that review finding and adds coverage for that actual input shape.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Request a one-line edit near line 100 of a 200-line file. The dialog and pending/in-progress card should show nine rows with lines 97–103 and +1/-1, including when the card has projected arguments and no diff content block.
- Append one line to a 2,000-line file: the dialog should show five rows, including the added line and three context lines.
- Make two distant changes in a large file whose trimmed comparison exceeds the budget: expect an explicit omitted notice, without a fabricated whole-file rewrite or hunk header.
- Add or remove only the final newline: expect an explicit newline-change notice. Byte-identical text remains empty.
- Check supplied patches, completed previews, failed tools with confirmed content, and failed argument-only previews: their prior behavior should be preserved.

### Evidence (Before & After)

At the reviewed first revision, the 200-line projected-argument case produced 201 rows, long-file compact edits were hidden by the raw line-count gate, and a trailing-newline-only edit produced an empty preview. Against that exact revision, the updated regressions fail **7 tests** (212 pass); with the fixes all **219 tests** in the three relevant suites pass. The failed-status regression also detects the one-line status-predicate mutation. Independent production-function probes verified the review examples, preserved behavior, resource boundaries and 200/200 deterministic patch reconstructions with an independent hunk application implementation.

Current local checks: full repository build and typecheck, Web Shell typecheck, and changed-file Prettier/ESLint passed. The follow-up commit uses the normal signing and pre-commit checks.

Latest review follow-up (`f925ed40e9893c20cdf45c8939821ec97c57e887`): the three focused Web Shell test suites pass (221 tests); changed-file ESLint and Prettier, Web Shell TypeScript typecheck, and `git diff --check` pass. The new-head GitHub Actions runs are `action_required` and await maintainer authorization. Full workspace tests and live-model/native Desktop E2E remain unverified on this head.

最新 review 跟进提交 `f925ed40e9893c20cdf45c8939821ec97c57e887`：三个 Web Shell 定向测试套件共 221 项通过；相关 ESLint、Prettier、Web Shell TypeScript 检查和 `git diff --check` 通过。新 head 的 GitHub Actions 当前为 `action_required`，等待维护者授权。完整工作区测试和 live-model/native Desktop E2E 本轮未运行。

Latest review follow-up (`77ef0fad716452d6d425b7de899bd2120f14a06a`): the bounded diff builder no longer embeds prose — it emits ASCII-safe markers that `parseUnifiedDiff` still classifies as headers — and `DiffView`, the sink all four diff consumers share, resolves them through the catalog and escapes each row plus the adjacent block path. Local results: `unifiedDiff` 17/17, `ToolApproval` 86/86, `ToolGroup` 121/121, together with `ArtifactPanel` 96, `TurnCallsPanel` 77, `messages/tools` 93 and `i18n.test.ts` 5; changed-file ESLint/Prettier and Web Shell `tsc --noEmit` are clean. Re-hardcoding either English sentence into the builder turns 6 tests red, and reverting the sink escaping turns the new bidi regression red (the raw override reaches the DOM). One correction to the review premise: on the approval path `extractPendingPermission` already escapes diff blocks at ingest, so the sink fix is defense-in-depth there and closes live rows for the other `DiffView` consumers instead. Escaping narrows the C0/C1/bidi surface only — zero-width and line/paragraph separators stay outside it. Full workspace tests, live-model and native Desktop E2E are left to CI.

最新 review 跟进提交 `77ef0fad716452d6d425b7de899bd2120f14a06a`：差分构建函数不再内嵌英文文案，改为输出仍被 `parseUnifiedDiff` 判为 header 的 ASCII 安全标记；四个差分消费方共用的出口 `DiffView` 负责按词条表还原，并对每一行及相邻的块路径做转义。本地结果：`unifiedDiff` 17/17、`ToolApproval` 86/86、`ToolGroup` 121/121，另有 `ArtifactPanel` 96、`TurnCallsPanel` 77、`messages/tools` 93、`i18n.test.ts` 5 全绿；相关 ESLint/Prettier 与 Web Shell `tsc --noEmit` 通过。把任一句英文重新硬编码进构建函数会让 6 项用例变红；移除出口转义会让新增 bidi 用例变红（原始 U+202E 会进入 DOM）。对 review 前提的一处更正：审批入口 `extractPendingPermission` 在摄入时已对差分块转义，因此出口修复在该处属纵深防御，真正关闭的是其余 `DiffView` 消费方。转义只收窄 C0/C1/bidi 字符面，零宽与行/段分隔符仍未覆盖。完整工作区测试与真实模型、原生 Desktop E2E 留给 CI。

The original before/after screenshots below came from a real-component Chrome fixture, not a live permission request or native Desktop. Its pending-card fixture exercised the content-block path; it did not establish coverage of projected arguments. The follow-up adds explicit projected-argument regressions and independent probes.

| ![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jayfeng7/qwen-code/66b71a6daddd44c703187876c346f0c8bc903bb2/docs/images/issue-13766-before.png) | ![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jayfeng7/qwen-code/66b71a6daddd44c703187876c346f0c8bc903bb2/docs/images/issue-13766-after.png) |

| :--: | :-- |

| Linux | Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.20.0, frozen pnpm lockfile installation, Vitest/jsdom component tests. No global Qwen CLI is available.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: compact previews omit distant unchanged lines; over-budget comparisons show an omitted notice.
- Not validated / out of scope: real model and native Desktop E2E. Full preflight is not claimed green. The earlier full preflight stopped on unchanged ACP bridge Windows symlink EPERM failures reproduced at the exact pre-fix parent; this follow-up does not modify those packages or repeat the full workspace test run. Upstream CI still requires maintainer authorization.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Permission protocol, execution logic and core packages are unchanged.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): H4 workflow child runtime
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Issue #13803 (stage H of the Managed Agent proposal #12380) delivers the managed workflow child runtime — the "Workflow runtime" follow-up the H4c design deferred. A managed Session can now launch a `workflow` child through a new Workflow tool declaration that mirrors the Agent tool's admission: inline deterministic workflow source, bounded structured args, foreground or background. The control plane's child result relay discovers the pending launch and creates exactly one child Session under retry, at the parent's precise Workspace binding, with lineage stamped in one transaction; the child's first Turn runs the workflow deterministically in-process (node:vm sandbox, in-process AgentHeadless subagents under ordinary per-run caps — not nested managed grandchildren), and its settled result flows back through the relay, acceptance, and consumption pipeline unchanged. Closing a parent cancels its non-terminal workflow children through the same funnel as child agents. Every launch pins its definition from revision 1 — the sha256 of the exact script bytes — and the child re-verifies the digest before spending anything, so a tampered copy can never execute.

This slice required one change outside the managed surface: a workflow launch block is the first prompt ever to carry fractional `args` across the daemon's `sha256(JSON.stringify(prompt))` admission digest, and the SDK's fastjson2 substrate renders fractional numbers in Java's scientific form where ECMAScript uses plain notation, so any fractional arg would wedge the child's first Turn with a deterministic `invalid_hosted_prompt`. The SDK's JSON digest substrate is now canonicalized to byte-fidelity with `JSON.stringify`, pinned by golden vectors derived from Node.

No Flyway migration, no OpenAPI or contract change, no legacy Workflow tool behavior change (managed admission is a separate declaration, inline-source only; saved/referenced workflows, script-level resume, and nested managed grandchildren are explicitly deferred).

## Why it's needed

The kind gate on `managed-child_run` fires on every revision commitment, so the four issue exit checks can only land together: widening the relay/cascade queries (K2) without lifting the gate (K4) would make every relay verb on a workflow row answer 409, while lifting the gate without widening the queries would leave workflow runs invisible to exactly the machinery that creates, settles, and cancels them — the isolation failure the issue forbids. With this slice the managed Agent and Workflow tools share the full child Session pipeline instead of the Workflow tool existing only outside the managed runtime.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit and integration: all suites touched by the change are green — core `managed-runtime` suites (290/290 in the five changed files; full suite green except one pre-existing timer flake that also fails on main), CLI serve suites including the new funnel/witness files (420/420 across the six workflow-adjacent files; full `hosted-harness-session` green at 344 tests), `managed-agent-server` surefire (all 71 tests in the five touched classes green; the only module failure is a pre-existing environment-dependent worktree-git test that fails identically on main), `qwencode` suite green including the new golden-vector digest tests. A physical acceptance run in the shape of #13532 drove the packaged stack (managed-agent-server + MariaDB + bundled daemon) on a real host: a foreground workflow launch completed end to end with exactly one child Session under retry; a background launch delivered and consumed its notification; a store-tampered pin refused execution with `Workflow launch pin does not match its script`; the packaged build admits workflow records by construction while a baseline build refuses the same commits. Parent-close cancellation of a workflow child is recorded blocked-with-reason (this macOS host cannot admit workspace close — capability refusal, re-confirmed on the final tree), and the mid-interruption re-claim behavior is partially observed with the boundary finding filed as issue #13838. The full behavior table with commands and outputs is in a follow-up comment.

Mutation discipline per project convention: every new guard was individually disabled and its named witness went red (digest encoder, kind gate, route gate, wake and close-drain predicates, batch exclusion, key derivation).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible surface; the managed workflow tool is declared only on private Hosted profiles — production enablement is its own gated follow-up)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

(Windows and Linux not exercised locally; the acceptance run notes a Linux re-run belongs to the production-enablement slice, as #13532 recorded for H3.)

### Environment (optional)

Unit/integration: `npm run build` + vitest per package; `mvn test` under JDK 21. Acceptance: packaged `dist/cli.js` daemon + built `managed-agent-server` jar + fresh MariaDB instance, driven by `.qwen/scripts/workflow-child-acceptance.mjs`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the managed Workflow tool admits inline script source only for v1 — saved workflows, `scriptPath`, `resumeFromRunId`, and `sourceRef` refuse with a named follow-up error rather than executing, keeping the launch pin honest (the digest binds the exact bytes that run). A script's `agent()` calls run in-process inside the workflow child under ordinary caps and are not managed grandchild Sessions.
- Not validated / out of scope: workspace-close cancellation of a workflow child is blocked on this macOS host's capability refusal (verified blocked-with-reason, Linux re-run deferred to the production-enablement slice); the relay's mid-interruption re-claim settles the run once but the restarted connector's load re-attachment answers 409 on non-durable host profiles (filed as issue #13838); Windows unexercised.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — no schema migration, no public contract change; production AgentBundle enablement is not part of this slice.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13803

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Issue #13803(Managed Agent 提案 #12380 的 H 阶段)交付了 managed workflow child 运行时——H4c 设计明确延后的「Workflow runtime」后续。managed Session 现在可以通过一个镜像 Agent 工具准入的新 Workflow 工具声明来启动 `workflow` child:内联确定性 workflow 源码、有界结构化 args、前台或后台。控制面的 child result relay 发现待处理的 launch 后,在重试下恰好创建一个 child Session,绑定到父 Session 的精确 Workspace,lineage 在同一事务里固化;child 的第一个 Turn 在进程内确定性地执行 workflow(node:vm 沙箱,agent() 分发到进程内 AgentHeadless 子代理,受普通每-run 上限约束——不是嵌套 managed 孙代),其结算结果经 relay、acceptance、consumption 流水线原样回流。关闭父 Session 会通过与 child agent 相同的 funnel 取消其未终态的 workflow children。每个 launch 从 revision 1 起 pin 住定义——脚本字节的 sha256——child 在执行前重验 digest,被篡改的拷贝永远不可能运行。

本切片在 managed 面之外需要一处改动:workflow launch 块是第一个携带分数 `args` 穿越 daemon 的 `sha256(JSON.stringify(prompt))` 准入 digest 的 prompt,而 SDK 的 fastjson2 基底把分数渲染成 Java 科学计数形式、ECMAScript 却用普通记法——任何分数 arg 都会让 child 的第一个 Turn 被确定性地以 `invalid_hosted_prompt` 拒绝。SDK 的 JSON digest 基底现在与 `JSON.stringify` 字节级一致,由 Node 派生的金色向量钉住。

无 Flyway 迁移、无 OpenAPI 或契约变更、无 legacy Workflow 工具行为变化(managed 准入是独立声明,仅内联源码;saved/引用 workflow、脚本级 resume、嵌套 managed 孙代均明确延后)。

## 为什么需要

`managed-child_run` 的 kind 门禁在每一条 revision 提交时生效,所以 issue 的四个出口检查只能一起落地:放宽 relay/cascade 查询(K2)而不放开门禁(K4),会让 relay 的每个动词打在 workflow 行上都得到 409;只放开门禁而不放宽查询,则会让 workflow run 对创建、结算、取消它的整套机制不可见——正是 issue 所禁止的隔离失败。本切片落地后,managed 的 Agent 与 Workflow 工具共享完整的 child Session 流水线,Workflow 工具不再只存在于 managed 运行时之外。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

单元与集成:改动触及的所有套件全绿——core `managed-runtime` 五个改动文件的套件 290/290(全套件除一个 main 上同样失败的既有定时器 flake 外全绿);CLI serve 套件含新增 funnel/见证文件(六个 workflow 相关文件 420/420;`hosted-harness-session` 全量 344 测试绿);`managed-agent-server` surefire 五个触及类的 71 个测试全绿(模块唯一失败是一个 main 上同样失败的、依赖主机环境的 worktree-git 测试);`qwencode` 套件绿,含新增的 digest 金色向量测试。一次按 #13532 形状的物理验收在真实宿主上驱动了打包栈(managed-agent-server + MariaDB + 打包的 daemon):前台 workflow launch 端到端完成且重试下恰好一个 child Session;后台 launch 送达并消费了通知;被篡改 pin 的 Turn 以 `Workflow launch pin does not match its script` 拒绝执行;打包构建放行 workflow 提交而基线构建拒绝同样的提交。关闭父取消 workflow child 记为受阻并注明原因(本 macOS 宿主不具备 workspace close 能力——能力拒绝,已在最终代码树上复验);中断重认领行为部分观测,边界发现已立为 issue #13838。带命令与输出的完整行为表见后续评论。

按项目惯例的变异纪律:每个新增守卫都单独禁用并确认其具名见证变红(digest 编码器、kind 门禁、路由门禁、wake 与 close-drain 谓词、批量排除、键派生)。

### 前后证据

N/A(无用户可见界面;managed workflow 工具只在私有 Hosted profile 上声明——生产启用是独立门禁的后续)

macOS ✅(Windows 与 Linux 本机未执行;按 #13532 为 H3 记录的惯例,Linux 重跑归入生产启用切片)

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:managed Workflow 工具 v1 只准入内联脚本源码——saved workflow、`scriptPath`、`resumeFromRunId`、`sourceRef` 以指名后续范围的拒绝而不执行,保证 launch pin 的诚实(digest 绑定实际运行的字节)。脚本的 `agent()` 调用在 workflow child 内部进程内运行,受普通上限约束,不构成 managed 孙代 Session。

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): H4e-b2 team mailbox design
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is the design for H4e-b2, the second runtime slice of the managed agent teams (#13745, Stage H of #12827). It decides how the lead's mailbox works on the Hosted path before any code is written, as #13817 did for H4e-b1. Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-agent-team-mailbox.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-agent-team-mailbox.zh-CN.md).

The design makes these decisions:

- **Messages between the lead and its members are H4d-b Session messages.** A member is a child run of the lead, so every lead-to-member message travels the lineage edge H4d-b already relays, and a member's message to the lead is its own `to_parent` entry. The receipt with its input, the settlement hold, H4f's stop over message turns, the close and the interrupted-call answers all apply unchanged, and `team_message` stays disabled. This answers H4e-a open questions 1 and 2.
- **A member is its continuation chain.** The roster names a member's first run, and the member's state is its chain head's. This lifts the refusal #13846 added until this slice, so a finished member takes more work and stays a member: it is labeled, counted by `team_delete`, and read by the owner rule. A continuation that never started is shown on the roster. This answers H4e-a open question 4 and H4e-b1 open question 3.
- **The lead addresses members by name and reaches all of them with `*`.** A name routes exactly as its first run's task id does. A broadcast commits one message or continuation per member, under ids in a namespace no single send or launch can reach, and a batch that broadcasts may not also change the roster.
- **Every run of a member's chain opens its instruction with a fixed preamble.** It names the member and its team, and says that only the answer to the last instruction reaches the leader. A replay accepts the committed instruction with or without a well-formed preamble block.
- **The lead sees who wrote.** A member's message and a continuation's result carry the `<teammate>` label. The reply hint stays H4d-b's task-id hint, because a name can be reused by a later team.
- **`task_update` delivers nothing.** Delivering from the board would rerun work a finished member did, or cost a running member the report of its current work, and a replay could not tell whether it owed a delivery. The lead gives a member its work with `send_message`, then records it on the board in the same batch.
- **Member-side commands move to H4e-b3.** Board tools for members and member-to-member messages move there, with plan approval and shutdown, on one member-to-lead command channel. Today nothing can carry such a command.
- **No record, rule, route, migration or Java change.**

The H4e-a, H4e-b1 and H4d-b designs gain pointers to the answers and to the re-scope.

## Why it's needed

H4e-b1 and its enablement (#13824, #13846) gave the lead a team of one-shot members. H4d-b (#13822) since gave parents durable messages and continuations, but a member cannot be continued without leaving its roster, members cannot be addressed by name, and a member does not know it is in a team. The H4e-b1 design planned a `team_message` relay for this. Its delivery would have been H4d-b's delivery again, with a second relay family and team twins of the settlement hold, the veto and the stop arm. This design reaches the same lead-side behavior on the runtime that already exists.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Read the design in both languages. The decisions, bounds, validation plan, acceptance criteria and open questions should match between them.
- Check the pointers in the H4e-a, H4e-b1 and H4d-b designs.
- `npx prettier --check docs/design/2026-10-1*.md` passes.
- Five review rounds ran on the design. Each round had an open-ended reviewer and an adversarial one, and every claim was checked against the code on #13846's head, which main now holds. The last round found no Critical issue.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (design only).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - The slice departs from the H4e-b1 design's plan in two ways. `team_message` stays unproduced, and `task_update` delivers nothing. Decisions 1 and 7 give the reasons, and open question 1 leaves the domain's fate to H4e-b3.
  - A running member that gets a message delivers only its last answer, because of H4d-b's result rule. The preamble asks the member to repeat what the lead still needs (open question 3).
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - The implementation and its physical pass on a real Hosted stack.
  - Member-side board tools, member-to-member messages, plan approval, shutdown and legacy import (H4e-b3).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The design builds on #13846, now merged, and lifts its interim refusal to continue a member of an active team.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13745 (H4e) and #12827 (Stage H) of #12380.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

这是 H4e-b2 的设计,即 managed agent team 的第二个运行时切片(#13745,#12827 的 Stage H)。它在写代码之前先定下 lead 在 Hosted 路径上的 mailbox 如何工作,做法与 #13817 之于 H4e-b1 相同。设计:[English](docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-agent-team-mailbox.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-agent-team-mailbox.zh-CN.md)。

设计做出以下决策:

- **lead 与成员之间的消息是 H4d-b 的 Session 消息。** 成员是 lead 的 child run,所以 lead 发给成员的每条消息都走 H4d-b 已在中继的血缘边;成员发给 lead 的消息是它自己的 `to_parent` 条目。带 input 的回执、结算保持、H4f 对消息回合的停止、关闭以及被中断调用的作答全部原样适用,`team_message` 保持关闭。这回答了 H4e-a 的开放问题 1 与 2。
- **成员就是它的续跑链。** 名册指向成员的第一个 run,成员的状态取其链头。这撤销了 #13846 在本切片之前加入的拒绝,已完成的成员因此可以接收更多工作,并且仍是成员:它带标签、被 `team_delete` 计入,也被 owner 规则读取。从未启动的续跑会显示在名册上。这回答了 H4e-a 开放问题 4 与 H4e-b1 开放问题 3。
- **lead 按名字寻址成员,并用 `*` 触达全体成员。** 名字的路由与其第一个 run 的 task id 完全相同。广播为每个成员提交一条消息或一个续跑,其 id 位于任何单次发送或 launch 都到达不了的命名空间;发起广播的批次不得同时改变名册。
- **成员链上每个 run 的指令都以固定前言开头。** 前言写明成员及其团队,并说明只有对最后一条指令的答复会到达 leader。重放时,已提交的指令带不带格式正确的前言块都会被接受。
- **lead 能看到是谁写的。** 成员的消息与续跑结果带 `<teammate>` 标签。回复提示保持 H4d-b 按 task id 的提示,因为名字可能被后来的团队复用。
- **`task_update` 不投递任何东西。** 从任务板投递,要么让已完成的成员重做已做完的工作,要么让运行中的成员丢掉当前工作的汇报;重放时也无法判断是否欠一次投递。lead 用 `send_message` 把工作交给成员,再在同一批次中把它记到任务板上。
- **成员一侧的命令移到 H4e-b3。** 成员的任务板工具与成员之间的消息移到那里,与计划审批、shutdown 一起,共用一条成员到 lead 的命令通道。目前没有任何东西能承载这样的命令。
- **没有记录、规则、路由、迁移或 Java 变更。**

H4e-a、H4e-b1 与 H4d-b 三份设计增加了指向这些回答与范围调整的指引。

## 为什么需要

H4e-b1 及其启用(#13824、#13846)给了 lead 一个由一次性成员组成的团队。H4d-b(#13822)此后给了父方持久消息与续跑,但成员一旦续跑就会离开名册,成员不能按名字寻址,成员也不知道自己在团队中。H4e-b1 设计原计划为此建一个 `team_message` 中继。它的投递只是把 H4d-b 的投递再做一遍,还要加第二套中继,以及结算保持、否决与停止分支的团队孪生版本。本设计在现有运行时之上达到相同的 lead 一侧行为。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 阅读两种语言的设计。决策、上限、验证计划、验收标准与开放问题应在两版之间一致。
- 检查 H4e-a、H4e-b1 与 H4d-b 设计中的指引。
- `npx prettier --check docs/design/2026-10-1*.md` 通过。
- 设计经过五轮评审。每轮都有一位开放式评审者和一位对抗式评审者,每条论断都对照 #13846 head 上的代码核实过,main 现已包含该代码。最后一轮没有发现 Critical 问题。

### 证据(前后对比)

N/A(仅设计)。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A  |

### 环境(可选)

N/A

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡:
  - 本切片在两处偏离 H4e-b1 设计的计划:`team_message` 不被产出,`task_update` 不投递任何东西。决策 1 与 7 给出理由,开放问题 1 把该 domain 的去留留给 H4e-b3。
  - 由于 H4d-b 的结果规则,运行中的成员收到消息后只交付它最后一次答复。前言要求成员重述 lead 仍需要的内容(开放问题 3)。
- 未验证/范围外:
  - 实现及其在真实 Hosted 环境上的实机验收。
  - 成员的任务板工具、成员之间的消息、计划审批、shutdown 与旧团队导入(H4e-b3)。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:无。本设计建立在已合入的 #13846 之上,并对 `active` 团队撤销它不续跑成员的临时拒绝。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #12380 的 #13745(H4e)与 #12827(Stage H)。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): support WebShell session cwd changes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds same-Workspace directory switching to Managed Sessions in WebShell and implements the Java BFF's explicit cwdChange capability in the same PR. The relative-path dialog preserves the Session, history and editable draft; sending and another switch wait for confirmed completion. Identity-scoped intent storage, original-key recovery, bounded polling and monotonic summary refresh handle lost acknowledgements and reordered events without treating an unknown outcome as failure. OpenAPI v1.42 supplies the optional generated client capability type.

## Why it's needed

The control plane already changes cwd durably, but users cannot request or recover that operation from WebShell. The entry requires server capability, provider support and a valid revision, so old servers, Daemon and Java hosts without tenant/account productScope remain compatible. The BFF computes support and permission from deployment opt-in, ACTIVE undeleted binding, the caller’s OPERATOR-or-above role and exact ACTIVE Registry generation/storage with a surviving OPERATOR/OWNER grant, matching existing cwd admission. This differs from workspaceTurns execution-profile requirements and does not promise an idle Session. Frontend and BFF now ship together; the entire draft remains gated on #13564's cwd instruction-cache fix and joint acceptance.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With an identity-scoped Java provider and an authorized bound Session advertising cwdChange, enter B relative to the Workspace root, or . for root, and submit with Enter. The old committed directory remains until operation completion and Session revision readback; the next task uses the changed cwd. Keep editing a draft, close the modal, and verify the card still tracks the operation while Send is blocked. Transcript, history pagination and draft stay intact.

Lose the 202 response and reload: Continue confirming must replay the original request/key only on user action. A saved operation ID queries automatically even if capability becomes false. A 30-second timeout, transport failure or recovery 403 keeps the result uncertain and the request locked. Initial storage refusal sends no POST; terminal failure preserves the target and explains its category. Reversed poll/event revisions and Session/account changes must not regress or cross-contaminate state. An open dialog requires acknowledgement when its revision changes.

An authorized OPERATOR can receive cwdChange=true even when agent/profile/Harness conditions make workspaceTurns=false. Closed/deleted/unbound Sessions, disabled execution, callers below OPERATOR, Registry generation/storage changes, non-ACTIVE Registry or revoked creator grants must not advertise true. Busy work may leave the capability true while admission refuses session_context_busy. Existing operation queries retain their independent read authorization. Listing one and twenty authorized Sessions should use the same five-query budget, including one grouped Registry-facts read; disabled/no-authorized-candidate pages skip that read. Public cwd_change and other reserved fields remain planned.
