prs.title: feat(core): Keep complete file reads on one opened source
prs.body:
## What this PR does Keeps an ordinary complete file read on one opened source, from metadata and type detection through text, images, notebooks, media, PDF processing and final result/cache handling. Inline reads on Linux and macOS retain the original descriptor until the whole operation finishes. PDF helpers inherit that descriptor, receive caller cancellation and join direct child closure before it is released. Existing Omni, Windows and delegated filesystem paths retain their current delivery choices. This extracts the ordinary read-source component from #13526 into a standalone feature based on current main. It includes PDF cancellation as part of the same source lifetime and does not depend on the separate CSI mount lifecycle PR #13772. ## Why it's needed If a file is replaced after metadata is observed, separate pathname reads can return the replacement's contents with the original file's metadata and cache identity. PDF work can also continue after the user cancels because the ordinary content pipeline does not pass its signal through every conversion stage. Holding one source and carrying cancellation through the complete operation makes the returned content, cache rights and resource cleanup consistent. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify - Replace a pathname after its original file has been opened. Text, SVG, notebook, image overview, media and native PDF reads should continue using the original file and its metadata; the owned descriptor should close only after the complete result has finished. - Cancel during PDF page counting, extraction and rendering. The operation should refuse the unreturned result and any further fallback. Descriptor helpers should stop and be joined before source release, including timeout and output-overflow paths; rendered output should be consumed/cleaned or expose an ownership/cleanup failure. - Confirm existing small-text encodings and line ranges, large-text scan budgets, missing-file errors and read-cache behavior. Omni and Windows should keep pathname delivery, delegated filesystems should retain their original text path, and pathname PDF consumers such as web fetch should remain usable. ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A for TUI screenshots. Deterministic compiled-product baseline observations reproduce metadata/content inode mismatch, actual read-tool replacement content and a PDF helper continuing after cancellation. Candidate compiled-product verification passes 37 checks (36 behavioral and one API check) plus two cleanup controls; it confirms original file identity, cancellation and actual helper/descriptor cleanup, including repeated real Poppler reads on one inherited source. Candidate observations and resource-cleanup evidence are posted in the separate E2E report. Fresh `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run bundle` pass; 12 focused Core test files pass all 773 tests, including the read tool, file utilities, PDF helpers, image/notebook processing, cache, read-many-files and web-fetch consumers. Scoped ESLint/Prettier and two clean full-diff self-audits pass; independent static review found no actionable defect. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested: native descriptors, controlled helper processes and real Poppler | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested: pathname selection covered with platform mocks only | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested: Linux execution and procfs remain for CI/maintainer validation | ### Environment (optional) Darwin arm64, Node v22.22.3, pnpm 11.24.0 and Poppler 26.07.0. The global CLI dry-run uses an isolated owned QWEN_HOME and reports its base installation 0.24.6; the user's normal managed installation reports 0.25.0. Product behavior is verified through fresh local compiled entries with real owned files/descriptors and child PIDs. Controlled helper and mock platform cases are explicitly separated from real Poppler execution; no model or cloud service is called. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: This changes the ordinary Core read path and needs maintainer review. One open descriptor preserves the original inode across pathname replacement, but is not an immutable snapshot of concurrent writes to that same inode. Captured extent bounds parent reads, not the inherited native helper's input length; direct child closure does not establish descendant termination. - Not validated / out of scope: Real Windows/Linux execution, CSI admission/confinement, retained file history, private workers, Hosted execution, Java/SQL, cold recovery, physical retirement and cloud qualification are outside this slice. String-source PDF callers keep their legacy runner; the new direct-child close guarantee belongs to descriptor calls. Temporary output identity checks do not provide atomic pathname cleanup. - Breaking changes / migration notes: No persistent format, runtime selector or database migration changes. Filesystems without the optional source callback retain their delegated read behavior. The complete synchronized design is available in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/39a05a857d42557743755a53f43ab3d760096931/docs/design/2026-10-09-file-read-source.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/39a05a857d42557743755a53f43ab3d760096931/docs/design/2026-10-09-file-read-source.zh-CN.md). ## Linked Issues Split from #13526. No issue is closed by this PR.
中文说明 ### 变更 让普通完整文件读取从元数据和类型识别，到文本、图片、Notebook、媒体、PDF 处理及最终结果/缓存记账，始终使用同一个已打开来源。Linux 与 macOS 的 inline 读取保留原描述符直到完整操作结束。PDF helper 继承该描述符、接收调用方取消，并在释放它之前等待直接子进程关闭。既有 Omni、Windows 和委托文件系统路径保留当前投递选择。 本 PR 从 #13526 拆出普通读取源组件，成为基于当前 main 的独立 feature。PDF 取消属于同一来源生命周期，一并包含；不依赖单独的 CSI 挂载生命周期 PR #13772。 ### 原因 文件在元数据观察后被替换时，分离的路径读取可能返回替换文件内容，却携带原文件元数据与缓存身份。普通内容链路没有把 signal 传递到每个转换阶段，用户取消后 PDF 操作也可能继续。持有同一个来源并沿完整操作传递取消，使返回内容、缓存权利和资源清理保持一致。 ### 维护者验证计划 #### 如何验证 - 原文件打开后替换路径。文本、SVG、Notebook、图片概览、媒体和原生 PDF 读取应继续使用原文件及其元数据；完整结果处理结束后才关闭自有描述符。 - 在 PDF 页数查询、提取和渲染中取消。操作应拒绝未返回结果及后续回退。描述符 helper 必须先停止并等待关闭，再释放来源，覆盖超时和输出超量；渲染输出应完成消费/清理，或暴露所有权/清理失败。 - 检查既有小文本编码与行范围、大文本扫描预算、文件缺失错误和读取缓存行为。Omni、Windows 保持路径投递，委托文件系统保留原文本路径，web fetch 等路径 PDF 消费者继续可用。 #### 前后证据 TUI 截图为 N/A。确定性的编译产物基线观察复现了元数据/内容 inode 不一致、真实读取工具返回替换内容，以及取消后 PDF helper 继续运行。候选编译产物验证通过 37 项检查（36 项行为和 1 项 API）以及两项清理检查，确认原文件身份、取消及实际 helper/描述符清理，包括真实 Poppler 重复读取同一个继承来源。候选观察和资源清理证据发布在独立 E2E 报告中。本轮 `npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle` 通过；12 个针对性 Core 测试文件的 773 项测试全部通过，包括读取工具、文件工具、PDF helper、图片/Notebook 处理、缓存、read-many-files 和 web-fetch 消费者。适用 ESLint/Prettier 和两次连续干净的全量 diff 自审通过；独立静态评审没有发现可操作缺陷。 #### 测试平台 | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试：真实描述符、可控 helper 进程及真实 Poppler | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试：仅通过平台模拟覆盖路径选择 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试：Linux 执行和 procfs 留待 CI/维护者验证 | #### 环境 Darwin arm64、Node v22.22.3、pnpm 11.24.0、Poppler 26.07.0。全局 CLI dry-run 使用隔离的自有 QWEN_HOME，报告基础安装 0.24.6；用户正常 managed 安装报告 0.25.0。产品行为通过本轮本地编译入口验证，使用真实自有文件/描述符和子进程 PID。可控 helper、平台模拟用例与真实 Poppler 执行明确分开，没有调用模型或云服务。 ### 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：改变普通 Core 读取链路，需要维护者评审。同一个已打开描述符在路径替换后保留原 inode，但不是同 inode 并发写入的不可变快照。捕获范围约束父进程读取，不约束继承描述符的原生 helper 输入长度；直接子进程关闭不能证明后代进程终止。 - 未验证与范围外：真实 Windows/Linux 执行、CSI 接纳/限制、保留文件历史、私有 worker、Hosted 执行、Java/SQL、冷恢复、物理退休和云资格验证均在范围外。字符串来源 PDF 调用保留原 runner；新增的直接子进程等待关闭保证属于描述符调用。临时输出身份检查不提供原子的路径清理。 - 破坏性变更与迁移：不改变持久化格式、runtime selector 或数据库迁移。不实现可选来源回调的文件系统继续使用委托读取行为。 完整同步设计提供[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/39a05a857d42557743755a53f43ab3d760096931/docs/design/2026-10-09-file-read-source.md)与[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/39a05a857d42557743755a53f43ab3d760096931/docs/design/2026-10-09-file-read-source.zh-CN.md)版本。 ### 关联事项 从 #13526 拆分，本 PR 不关闭任何 issue。

prs.title: fix(channels/email): re-register on a channel_disconnected answer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the control plane answers `submitInbound` or `claimDeliveries` with `409 channel_disconnected`, the email adapter now treats it as the same poll-level registration claim as `409 channel_generation_unregistered`: it forgets its registration, keeps the mail/delivery claimed, and lets the next poll's `ensureRegistered()` re-register — the only call that flips the instance back to `connected` — before the drive resumes. A `409 channel_generation_stale` stays out of the branch by design: the server holds a newer generation there, so re-registering cannot converge.

## Why it's needed

A `POST /disconnect` is keyed only on the channel identity, with no owner or generation fencing, so a co-owner's shutdown can flip the instance to `disconnected` under an adapter whose registration is still current. Before this fix, that answer fell into the per-message deterministic-refusal branch: every inbound mail was then dropped with only a stderr line (the mailbox's `lastUid` had already advanced, so nothing was left to re-drive), and every outbound pull re-threw from `pullOutbox()` while the claim lease kept proving aliveness — total, silent mail loss on the inbound side and a permanently stalled outbound side, both lifted only by restarting the process. Found by the review-bot's R3 round on the merged #13572 (thread `[Critical] R3-3`).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run src/managed-email-adapter.test.ts` in `packages/channels/email`. The two new witnesses pin one arm each:
- `re-registers when the control plane reports disconnected, keeping the mail (R3-3)`: a `submitInbound` rejection `{status: 409, code: 'channel_disconnected'}` leaves the event claimed, the next tick re-registers, and the mail is admitted — the deterministic-refusal log line never fires.
- `re-registers when the outbox claim reports disconnected, recovering the send (R3-3)`: a one-shot `claimDeliveries` rejection with the same shape skips the stuck pull (no throw, no drop), the next tick re-registers, and the delivery is sent.

Both were verified red before the fix (fail-first), and each stays green when only the other arm's condition is mutated — the acceptance criterion from the review thread holds per arm. Full package suite: 57/57 green; prettier/eslint/tsc clean on both touched files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — adapter internals only, no user-visible UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: re-registering heals `connected` more aggressively; the branch deliberately excludes `channel_generation_stale`, which can never converge, and `400/403` deterministic refusals, whose semantics are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live IMAP run against the real control plane — the fault path is exercised against the package's fake control plane, which models the exact status/code payloads the server produces (`ManagedChannelService.submitInbound` / `claimDeliveries`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; adapter-local classification change with no API or schema surface.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the `[Critical] R3-3` review thread on #13572 (merged).

<summary>中文说明</summary>

当控制面应答 `submitInbound` 或 `claimDeliveries` 返回 `409 channel_disconnected` 时，email 适配器现在把它当作与 `409 channel_generation_unregistered` 同类的 poll 级注册凭据处理：遗忘注册、保留邮件/投递的在途认领、让下一次轮询的 `ensureRegistered()` 先重新注册——唯一能把实例状态献回 `connected` 的调用——再恢复驱动。`409 channel_generation_stale` 刻意留在分支之外：服务器持有更新的 generation，重新注册不可能收敛。

动机：`POST /disconnect` 只按 channel 标识键控、无 owner/generation 栅栏，共同持有方的关闭动作会把实例在仍在运行的适配器脚下翻成 `disconnected`。修复前该应答落入逐条消息的确定性拒绝分支：每个入站邮件只留一行 stderr 便被丢弃（`lastUid` 已前进，无可重驱之物），而出站的每次拉取都从 `pullOutbox()` 重新抛出、claim 租约仍旧证明存活——入站全静默丢失、出站永久停滞，只有重启进程才能解除。来源为已合并 #13572 上 review-bot R3 轮的 `[Critical] R3-3` thread。

验证：`packages/channels/email` 下 `npx vitest run src/managed-email-adapter.test.ts`；两个新见证各自钉住一臂（inbound 保留邮件并在刷新后重新提交；outbound 跳过卡住的拉取、下一 tick 恢复发送），均 fail-first 验证为红、按臂变异各自变红；整包 57/57，prettier/eslint/tsc 干净。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): verify tool publications asynchronously
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves tool publication readback and stream verification to a durable, bounded background worker when both the server flag and client capability header are enabled. Uploads return HTTP 202 only after their inputs and readiness record are committed; callers keep awaiting verified receipts through the existing operation polling flow. Legacy clients retain synchronous responses.

The operation journal records execution mode, reconstructable inputs, readiness, retries, and safe terminal failures. Workers reuse journal-head authorization, leases, claim epochs, and the existing integrity checks. Accepted work survives restart without resending input, keeps publication ordering during retries, and continues draining when new async admission is disabled. The client recognizes permanent FAILED results without transport retries. Historical async success replays return their receipts without storage reads; finish, actual reads, receipt validation, and ACK still verify current bytes.

## Why it's needed

Large captured outputs currently hold an HTTP request open while stored bytes are read and hashed. This makes storage latency and whole-stream verification part of request latency even though the client already supports operation polling. Durable verification separates acceptance from completion while preserving the success conditions required before admission or settlement.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable journal-head authorization and async admission, then publish with the new capability header while object readback is blocked. Expect HTTP 202 and PENDING before readback finishes, followed by SUCCEEDED with the original receipt after release. Blocking PUT or readiness commit must delay acceptance.
2. Restart after acceptance without reposting input. Segment, inline/object resource, seal, prefix, and inline/object terminal operations should complete from persisted input. Competing workers, lease takeover, and late completion or corruption must never override the current claim.
3. Inject transient I/O, invalid digests or manifests, predecessor failure, CSI binding release or registration loss, and deadline expiry. Lost CSI authority should fail and leave the queue; a missing replica credential key should remain retryable for a healthy replica. Expect retries to keep ordering, permanent FAILED results to remain terminal after expiry or recovery requests, and explicit recovery to preserve input identity and accounting. Prefix must stay frozen during retry; recovering an expired seal after adding a segment must conflict.
4. Check older clients and disabled admission retain direct HTTP 200 receipts, while already accepted async operations still drain. Success replay should avoid readback, but a subsequent real read must detect changed storage bytes. Healthy-head heartbeats and status polling must not scan journal history.
5. Check the updated client still waits for a receipt and handles FAILED with 507 or 5xx as a permanent result rather than replaying the upload.
6. Complete and reference a publication after a permanent prefix failure, then retire the session. Verified objects should collect and release quota; pending operations, uncertain PUTs, live read leases, candidate objects and quarantined objects should remain protected.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for TUI screenshots; this changes publication HTTP behavior. An independent controller/storage observation reproduced the synchronous baseline and verified the asynchronous result:

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Block stored-object readback | Caller blocked until readback completes | Async HTTP 202 after durable input; worker blocked separately; status PENDING |
| Release readback | Direct verified receipt | Object VERIFIED and operation SUCCEEDED with receipt |
| Replay completed async input | Readback on request path | HTTP 200 historical receipt with no further readback |
| Legacy request | Direct HTTP 200 receipt | Direct HTTP 200 receipt |

The schema preserves all 56 current-main SQL/Java migration blobs and appends the unchanged async migration at V57; the existing guard confirms 57 unique versions. Upgrade coverage keeps the 47→56 control and the separate 56→57 history-preservation case. Latest repair `dc9e6abf92f93ca4b382b5eb8a5ebbf1a00d5963` moves that unchanged test block to remove the mechanical conflict: full Git ORT changes from exit1 on its parent to exit0 on this exact repair tree against main `5b1c7014`, with every assertion retained. Unrelated main production changes are not included, and a combined latest-main application pass is not claimed.

Fresh validation on the exact repair tree passed all six real MySQL migration cases, with zero failures/errors/skips, plus SDK/server Checkstyle and the namespace guard. JDK21 dependencies were rebuilt from exact source in a new isolated Maven cache; dependency tests were intentionally skipped during artifact installation and are not counted as passes. All 814 archived SDK/shared-contract files and the private JARs used by the test classpath were verified. The test-engineer independently reproduced the conflict and verified its removal; two clean self-audits and an independent repair review completed. Owned schemas and the private MySQL instance were cleaned and stopped. The same exact-head full run recorded 67/67 publication adapter cases passing. Earlier broader controller/storage, Java and MySQL evidence remains recorded in [prior repair reports](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13654#issuecomment-6085952106); it was not all rerun for this test-position change. This is disclosed test-script/MySQL evidence, not local Hosted/model/OSS E2E.

The required `npm run preflight` ran exactly once on clean committed `dc9e6abf92f93ca4b382b5eb8a5ebbf1a00d5963` with CI=true and the bundled Node PATH. It exited **1** after all 24 workspace suites: **98,816 passed /15 failed /274 skipped**, plus **7 unhandled Vitest onTaskUpdate RPC timeouts**. Install, format, lint, build and typecheck passed; HEAD, tree and worktree stayed unchanged. CLI has 13 failed cases and Core has two; test-engineer independently reconciled the actual failure assertions, JUnit elements and final summaries. Current causes remain unassigned except for limited historical symptom evidence, which does not prove this execution's cause or a green baseline. **R1-2 remains uncleared; this is not a green full gate.** Workspace failure prevented scripts and the final bundle check from running; neither was repeated. Older gate results remain historical records, not current-commit passes.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 24.19.0 (temporary bundled-runtime PATH), JDK 21, Maven 3.9.16, MySQL 8.4.11, and H2. Java validation used an isolated Maven repository rebuilt from this repository's dependencies to avoid a conflicting same-version local cache. Earlier feature validation confirmed the global CLI baseline and local bundle Shell smoke; the current repair evidence is the exact-source validation reported above.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: verification now spans process lifetimes and concurrent claims. Persisted input, database-time leases, epoch-fenced outcomes, and ordering barriers are essential; queue time consumes the verification deadline. Server and client changes ship together so the acceptance/completion contract is reviewable in one feature PR. The cross-package change needs maintainer review.
- Not validated / out of scope: a real Hosted/OSS deployment was unavailable locally, so HTTP publication behavior uses an independent controller/storage test-script fallback and real MySQL integration coverage. The maintainer independently verified the real Hosted/OSS path and reported that serial 1MiB uploads with the fixed 250ms initial status poll regress throughput: 512MiB reaches the 120-second Shell timeout. Changing the approved polling timing remains a pending user decision; async admission stays off by default. Further throughput and concurrency tuning still need deployment measurements. Admission preparation, writer-finished, receipt validation, ACK, and Shell execution are outside this async conversion.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: async admission defaults off; existing operation rows default to synchronous execution. Deploy additive migration V66 and all new server binaries before upgrading clients and enabling journal-head authorization plus async admission. On rollback, disable new admission and drain accepted work before downgrading binaries. Existing binding, grant, and installation schemas are unchanged.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-13242-async-verification/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-tool-publication-async-verification.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-13242-async-verification/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-tool-publication-async-verification.zh-CN.md). Both versions include matching decisions, constraints, rollout, and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13242.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当服务端开关和客户端能力请求头均启用时，将工具发布的存储读回及流校验移至持久化、有界的后台 worker。上传只有在输入和就绪记录提交后才返回 HTTP 202；调用方继续通过现有 operation 轮询等待已校验凭据。旧客户端保留同步响应。

操作日志记录执行模式、可重建输入、就绪标记、重试及安全的终态失败信息。worker 复用 journal-head 授权、lease、claim epoch 和现有完整性校验。已接受任务可在重启后无需重传输入继续处理，重试期间保留发布顺序，关闭新异步接收后仍会继续清空任务。客户端识别永久 FAILED 结果，不触发网络重试。异步成功重放直接返回历史凭据，不读取存储；finish、实际读取、receipt 验证和 ACK 仍校验当前字节。

## 为什么需要

较大的捕获输出目前需要在 HTTP 请求中等待存储字节的读回和散列。即使客户端已经支持 operation 轮询，存储延迟和全流校验仍会增加请求延迟。持久化校验将接受与完成分开，同时保留进入 admission 或 settled 状态前必须满足的成功条件。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启用 journal-head 授权和异步接收，携带新能力请求头发布，并阻塞对象读回。读回完成前应返回 HTTP 202 和 PENDING，放行后应得到 SUCCEEDED 及原有凭据。阻塞 PUT 或就绪提交时不得提前接受请求。
2. 接受后重启，不重新提交输入。segment、inline/对象资源、seal、prefix、inline/对象 terminal 应从持久化输入完成。多个 worker 竞争、lease 接管及迟到成功或损坏结果不得覆盖当前执行权。
3. 注入临时 I/O、错误摘要或 manifest、前驱失败、CSI binding 释放或注册失效及超期。CSI 授权失效应失败并退出队列；副本缺少凭据密钥时应允许健康副本继续处理。重试应保留顺序；永久 FAILED 在超期或请求恢复后仍保持终态；显式恢复应保留输入身份及计费。prefix 在重试期间必须冻结；seal 超期后新增段再恢复必须冲突。
4. 检查旧客户端和关闭异步接收时仍直接返回 HTTP 200 凭据，而此前接受的异步任务仍能完成。成功重放不得读回，后续实际读取仍须发现存储字节变化。健康 journal head 下，心跳和状态轮询不得扫描 journal 历史正文。
5. 检查新客户端仍等待凭据，并将带有 507 或 5xx 的 FAILED 视为永久结果，不重新执行上传。
6. prefix 永久失败后完成并引用 publication，再退役 session。已校验对象应回收并释放配额；待处理操作、结果不明的 PUT、活跃读租约、候选对象及隔离对象应继续受保护。

### 证据（变更前后）

TUI 截图不适用；本次改变发布 HTTP 行为。独立 controller/storage 观察复现了同步基线，并验证了异步结果：

| 场景 | 变更前 | 变更后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 阻塞存储对象读回 | 调用方等待读回完成 | 输入持久化后异步 HTTP 202；worker 独立阻塞；状态为 PENDING |
| 放行读回 | 直接返回已校验凭据 | 对象 VERIFIED，操作 SUCCEEDED 并携带凭据 |
| 重放已完成异步输入 | 在请求路径读回 | HTTP 200 返回历史凭据，无额外读回 |
| 旧客户端请求 | 直接 HTTP 200 凭据 | 直接 HTTP 200 凭据 |

schema 保留 main 全部56份 SQL/Java 迁移原字节，将内容不变的异步迁移追加为 V57；现有检查确认57个版本唯一。升级测试保留47→56对照及独立56→57历史保留用例。最新修复 `dc9e6abf92f93ca4b382b5eb8a5ebbf1a00d5963` 仅移动该测试块，保留全部断言，消除机械冲突：与 main `5b1c7014` 的完整 Git ORT 合并由父提交退出1变为准确修复树退出0。本轮未引入无关 main 生产改动，也不声称最新 main 整体应用合并验证通过。

本轮准确修复树的6个真实 MySQL 迁移用例重新通过，失败、错误、跳过均为0；SDK/服务端 Checkstyle 和版本唯一性检查通过。JDK21 使用准确源码重新构建依赖及新隔离 Maven 缓存；安装依赖制品时有意跳过其测试，不计作通过。归档的814份 SDK/共享 contract 文件及实际测试 classpath 使用的私有 JAR 均已核对来源。test-engineer 独立复现并验证了冲突修复，两轮连续自审和独立修复审查完成。自有 schema 和独立 MySQL 实例已清理关闭。同一次准确 head 全量运行中，67个发布 adapter 用例全部通过。更早的 controller/storage、Java 和 MySQL 广泛证据保留在[此前修复报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13654#issuecomment-6085952106)，没有为本次测试位置调整全部重跑。本轮范围是已说明的测试脚本和 MySQL，不声称本地 Hosted/model/OSS E2E 通过。

仓库要求的 `npm run preflight` 已在干净提交 `dc9e6abf92f93ca4b382b5eb8a5ebbf1a00d5963` 上，以 CI=true 和 bundled Node PATH 执行一次。全部24个 workspace 结束后退出码为 **1**：**98,816通过 /15失败 /274跳过**，另有 **7个 Vitest onTaskUpdate RPC 超时**。安装、format、lint、build、typecheck 均通过；HEAD、源码树和工作区保持不变。CLI失败13项，Core失败2项；test-engineer 独立核对了实际失败断言、JUnit failure元素及最终摘要。当前原因仍未确认，只有范围有限的历史症状证据，不能据此证明本次执行原因或基线全绿。**R1-2仍未清除，完整门禁不全绿。** workspace失败使scripts和最终bundle检查未执行，本轮没有重复运行；旧门禁结果仅保留为历史记录，不作为当前提交通过的证据。

### 测试系统

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 24.19.0（临时指定 bundled runtime PATH）、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.16、MySQL 8.4.11 和 H2。Java 验证使用由本仓库依赖重新构建的隔离 Maven 仓库，避免本地同版本缓存冲突。此前功能验证确认了全局 CLI 基线和本地 bundle 的 Shell 冒烟；本轮修复证据为上方列出的准确源码验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：校验现在跨越进程生命周期及并发执行权。持久化输入、数据库时间 lease、epoch 约束的结果提交和顺序屏障是必要条件；排队时间计入校验期限。服务端和客户端一起交付，使接受/完成契约能在同一个功能 PR 中审查。跨包改动需要维护者评审。
- 未验证或范围外：本地没有真实 Hosted/OSS 部署，因此 HTTP 发布行为采用独立 controller/storage 测试脚本替代验证，并辅以真实 MySQL 集成测试。维护者另行完成真实 Hosted/OSS 路径验证，并报告串行 1MiB 上传受固定首次 250ms 轮询影响而出现吞吐回归：512MiB 会触发 120 秒 Shell 超时。改变已批准轮询时序的选择仍待用户答复；异步接收继续默认关闭。后续吞吐和并发参数仍需部署测量。admission prepare、writer-finished、receipt 验证、ACK 和 Shell 执行不在本次异步转换范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：异步接收默认关闭；已有操作行默认同步执行。先部署增量迁移 V66 及所有新服务端，再升级客户端并开启 journal-head 授权和异步接收。回退时先关闭新接收，完成已接受任务后再降级二进制。binding、grant 和安装协议保持不变。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-13242-async-verification/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-tool-publication-async-verification.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-13242-async-verification/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-tool-publication-async-verification.zh-CN.md)。两版包含一致的决策、约束、部署步骤及验收标准。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #13242。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): admit public foreground Shell with mandatory approval
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a default-off deployment opt-in for authorized public REST and WebShell Workspace Sessions to use the existing foreground Shell profile. New bound Sessions persist `hosted-workspace-shell/1` with an asking approval mode (`default` or `auto-edit`); unbound and existing files Sessions keep their behavior. Startup and attachment validation prevent missing, blank, unknown or `yolo` Shell approval modes from silently permitting execution.

Closing only the Shell opt-in refuses fresh Shell Turns while preserving original-key replay and already accepted approval, cancellation and settlement when Workspace files remain enabled and persisted approval remains default/auto-edit. Files-off or invalid approval can refuse attachment; capabilities do not bypass those guards. Per-Session capabilities let WebShell disable fresh sending while retaining accepted cancellation under those prerequisites, including the upstream creator-only cancellation rules after new-creation authorization is withdrawn. workspaceTurns represents creator/grant permission; fresh Shell sending also requires foregroundShell=true. The optional foreground capability has no schema default and remains omitted for files/unbound Sessions. Non-executing W2 cwd changes retain their own admission. Shell close/archive/unarchive/delete are refused before creating a new durable lifecycle command or operation.

This is a default-off admission slice awaiting maintainer review. It keeps deployment enablement gated on the remaining public-path acceptance and independent Shell issues; it does not claim the whole #13271 release boundary is complete.

## Why it's needed

The merged persisted-profile and approval-preview work already supports private foreground Shell, but public creation still selects the files profile. This connects public creation to that existing execution path with an explicit operator choice and mandatory approval, while preventing a disabled deployment from accepting fresh work into an existing Shell Session.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. With the Shell opt-in unset or false, create an authorized Workspace Session through REST and WebShell. It should retain files/1 behavior and omit the optional foreground-Shell capability. A request-selected profile should remain unsupported.
2. In a trusted local-process, Session-isolated deployment with Workspace files enabled, turn on `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_WORKSPACE_SHELL_ENABLED` with `default` or `auto-edit` approval. Empty creation and creation with initial input should persist Shell/1 and that approval mode. Startup with an invalid/non-asking mode or missing prerequisites should fail.
3. Request a foreground Shell command through each public surface. Its Action should display the command; Allow should create exactly one Workspace effect and Deny none. Background Shell and Monitor requests should be refused before approval or execution, with no side effects in either the selected Workspace or the decoy root.
4. Close only the Shell opt-in for an existing Shell Session while keeping Workspace files enabled and the persisted asking approval mode valid. A fresh Turn should return `409 workspace_unavailable`; the original creation/Turn key should replay the same identity. Accepted Allow, cancellation and settlement should remain available. WebShell should disable fresh sending while keeping cancellation available.
5. Request Shell Session close/archive/unarchive/delete, including CLOSED/ARCHIVED records. Capabilities should be false and fresh requests should fail before creating lifecycle operations. Existing non-Shell L2 controls should retain their behavior.
6. Inject a receipt transaction failure and a committed-receipt/lost-response fault on the real public Shell path. Retries should be byte-identical, the command should dispatch and execute once, and uncertain acceptance should remain fenced as UNKNOWN rather than being reported as completed. A cold owner attachment after natural writer lease expiry should retain the stored profile and approval mode.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed global `qwen` 0.24.6 exits before listening because its Broker-backed Hosted mode is not implemented. That runtime baseline is **NOT_REPRODUCED**, not a passing control. Static inspection of the frozen implementation base confirms public creation selects files/1.

Historical validation at `9c5e2817`, after merging main bb66a52c: 181 focused Java tests, 30 WebShell provider tests and 341 CLI Harness/recovery tests pass. Six real Java/Broker/MySQL/Harness public integration cases pass: REST/WebShell Allow/Deny, two files controls and two portable receipt faults. Independent SQL reconstruction verifies stdout/stderr bytes, lengths, references and digests. A separate flag-off/cold probe passes; it constructs a fresh production Store/Service with the live Connector and does not restart the entire Java deployment. The separate E2E comment records exact observations and limitations. R1 at `8b9be6a45` adds strict omission coverage and migration documentation only; its complete Java admission file passes 35/35, with fresh build/typecheck/bundle, Java package/Checkstyle, focused formatting and byte-identical generator rendering. This changes API/provider behavior without adding a visual component, so there are no TUI screenshots.

R2 at `6cc5c923` removes only the two optional foreground capability schema defaults, adds lifecycle/false-wire/approval/Action replay/cancellation coverage, and narrows contract wording. Its five complete Java classes pass 145/145 with zero failures/errors/skips; Java package/Checkstyle (24.57s), fresh build (154.77s), typecheck (53.29s), bundle (2.83s), focused formatting and diff checks pass once on the committed tree. Independent test-engineer verification binds 15 isolated selected cases and source hashes to this commit, with 24 expected mutant failures kept separate; 24 schema arms and eight actual-provider arms verify omission/default materialization. Production runtime logic remains byte-identical to `8b9be6a45`. This H2/MockMvc/mock-Harness verification is not a rerun of the historical real MySQL/Shell E2E or deployment restart.

The conflict-resolution commit `6c65b07f` merges main `fbde5cf0` without rewriting the pushed history. New bound creation preserves upstream creator/owner initialization from the same authenticated actor and the Shell/files profile choice. The approval replay fixture now uses the upstream role representation; it retains creator-only response authority. The effective PR remains 22 paths, and all 205 incoming paths outside that scope match the merged main byte-for-byte. On this exact committed tree, 370 tests in eleven complete Java classes, 40 tests in five complete Broker classes and 30 WebShell provider tests pass (440 total, zero failures/errors/skips). Fresh build (143.23s), typecheck (55.25s), bundle (2.44s), both Java static/packaging gates, focused formatting and diff checks pass once; the hook and final gate leave the audited tree unchanged. Independent verification runs four focused H2/MockMvc cases and compiles an isolated owner-to-null control that fails the two new identity assertions as expected; those controls are not added to the 440 passing count. Both self-audits and independent static review are clean. This is merge interaction coverage, not new MySQL/Shell E2E, an existing-data MySQL upgrade, a whole Java deployment restart or Linux physical acceptance.

R3 at `767ef1830` hardens receipt/Action/cleanup test oracles, adds defensive projection/cached-attachment/cwd coverage, and synchronizes current and historical contract prose. On exact commit `767ef183025b076f48749bf947521f0239dc7448` / tree `e94b68499cbb7c515c21adcccd9e3d27a00ff54c`, six complete Java classes pass 198/198 with zero failures/errors/skips. Java verify/Checkstyle (39.75s), fresh build (142.18s), typecheck (51.50s), bundle (2.32s), focused formatting, diff checks and a fresh read-only generator comparison pass once; hook/final gates leave the audited tree unchanged. Independent test-engineer verification runs four real public Java/Broker/MySQL/Harness Shell cases (REST/WebShell Allow/Deny and both portable receipt faults) with fresh artifacts. The valid window passes 4/4; source/artifact fingerprints remain stable and owned resources are cleaned. Exact helper reproductions and isolated expected failures/mutants are recorded separately, not added to the 198 or four passing counts. Production runtime logic is unchanged from `6c65b07f`; this batch changes test oracles/fixtures and contract documentation only. No production duplicate execution or stdout loss was reproduced. The receipt barrier uses actual prompt inactivity/recovery blocking plus completed relay handlers, not an immediately passing size-three recheck. SQL NULL is forbidden; files-off/Shell-on and persisted Shell/2 are synthetic defensive coverage. The fixture properties are not deployment-binding proof. Darwin portable tests do not certify Linux publisher/worker-kill/physical quiescence, external providers or a whole Java deployment restart; the deployment switch remains default-off. Two initial windows failed before Shell assertions at owned MySQL TCP host authorization and Flyway system-table read permission; both environment windows are retained and excluded from green counts. Historical 9c5e/R1/R2/merge results retain their original commit bindings.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Java 21, Node 22, isolated MySQL 8.4.11; focused tests and six real public integration cases |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Parent `9c5e2817` Linux CI synthetic merge into `bb66a52c` passed public Allow/Deny and portable receipt tests; physical FG6f acceptance remains unverified |

### Environment (optional)

Fresh local CLI bundle and Java artifacts, a deterministic local model driving actual Shell processes, and a task-owned loopback MySQL instance. Artifact fingerprints remained stable during the final acceptance window. Build, bundle, typecheck, focused ESLint/Prettier, Java packaging/Checkstyle and the commit hook passed; two clean self-audits and an independent read-only review found no required changes. This is not external-provider acceptance.

New maintainer feedback [6078687662](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13674#issuecomment-6078687662) identified the H4b interactions. `486264e5` resolves them: public Shell lifecycle, including protocol-0, stays refused; internal child CLOSE uses the 8-argument admission; public create and load set `suppressChildAgents`, so the public tool list does not include `agent`. A private Shell lane that omits the flag keeps the child agent tool. `10e20706de` keeps Shell Action answers with the Session's recorded owner. Other Actions still admit a Workspace operator. Upgrade the Harness before enabling the flag.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this spans Java admission, persisted Session checks, the public contract and the WebShell provider. Maintainer review is requested for those downstream consumers. Keep the opt-in off until the deployment has the required enablement evidence.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux publisher/worker-kill and physical quiescence gates, a complete Java deployment restart with the flag off, signed-auth/CSI deployment acceptance, full G3 Step 3 recovery, Shell L4 lifecycle, background Shell/Monitor and public /2 search admission. Portable receipt tests are not substitutes for Linux physical failure tests. Existing recovery refusals and UNKNOWN fences remain in force.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: this feature adds no database migration; the branch incorporates upstream V53 actor-role and Session-owner storage while preserving both creation identities and the existing profile choice. The Shell capability is optional, has no schema default and is omitted for files/unbound Sessions. Upgrade all Session readers before creating Shell Sessions; older binaries must not reinterpret a stored Shell profile as files. W1c offline Workspace migration remains files/1-only: a persisted Shell definition causes `migration_profile_unsupported` for its storage. Plan W1c migration before creating Shell Sessions there; Shell migration is outside this slice.

Synchronized designs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/767ef183025b076f48749bf947521f0239dc7448/docs/design/public-hosted-shell-admission.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/767ef183025b076f48749bf947521f0239dc7448/docs/design/public-hosted-shell-admission.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Partially implements #13271, building on merged #13301 and approval-preview work #13400/#13407. Enablement remains gated on #12904, #13010 and public FG6f acceptance. This PR does not auto-close #13271.

## 本 PR 做什么

为已授权的公开 REST 和 WebShell Workspace Session 增加默认关闭的部署开关，接入已有前台 Shell profile。新的绑定 Session 持久化 `hosted-workspace-shell/1` 和需要询问的审批模式（`default` 或 `auto-edit`）；非绑定及既有 files Session 行为保持不变。启动与 attachment 校验防止缺失、空白、未知或 `yolo` Shell 审批模式静默放行执行。

仅关闭 Shell 开关，且 Workspace files 仍开启、持久化审批仍为 default/auto-edit 时，拒绝新的 Shell Turn，同时保留原键重放和已接受工作的审批、取消、收尾。files-off 或无效审批可拒绝 attachment，capability 不绕过这些守卫。WebShell 在这些前提下禁止新发送并保留已接受取消，沿用撤销新创建授权后仍允许 creator-only 取消的规则。workspaceTurns 表达 creator/grant 权限；Shell 新发送还要求 foregroundShell=true。可选 foreground 字段没有 schema 默认值，files/非绑定响应仍省略。非执行性 W2 cwd 变更保留其独立准入。Shell close/archive/unarchive/delete 在创建新的持久化生命周期 command 或 operation 前拒绝。

这是默认关闭、等待维护者审查的准入切片。部署启用仍受公开路径剩余验收和独立 Shell 问题约束，不宣称 #13271 的整个发布边界已经完成。

## 为什么需要

已合入的 profile 持久化和审批预览已支持私有前台 Shell，但公开创建仍选择 files profile。本次以明确的运维选择和强制审批将公开创建接入已有执行路径，并防止关闭开关的部署在既有 Shell Session 中接受新工作。

prs.title: fix(cli): settle Live call stops after failure
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change completes a failed Live call's pending stop through both the drain deadline and final-transcript persistence, even when the old call context is inactive. Cleanup remains limited to the active call, so an old completion cannot deactivate or close a newer call. The regressions exercise the actual synchronous host failure-to-stop wiring with offline injected collaborators.

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, regression tests, independent review, and PR preparation. Runtime validation used local CPU-only collaborators; no live voice, model/provider request, paid service, or credential change was used.

## Why it's needed

A fatal realtime failure can synchronously begin stopping and then deactivate the local call before its stop completion settles. The deadline and persistence paths previously returned without completing that inactive call's stop, leaving the host in `stopping` and unable to start another call. Completing the old stop separately from active-call cleanup restores recovery while protecting a later call that reuses the same backend session.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Start a call with offline injected bridge and realtime collaborators, leave accepted input awaiting transcription, and trigger a fatal realtime failure. Verify that the real host synchronously enters the stop path, the stop settles within its configured bound, and host status becomes `error` with a message.
- Hold final-transcript persistence during stopping, then release it before the deadline. Verify that stopping completes at release for both no pending input and a rejected final input commit.
- Reuse the same backend session ID for a newer call with a distinct realtime connection. Trigger the old deadline, or release old persistence after a later real-host call starts. Verify that the shared active marker remains true, no extra inactive write occurs, the newer connection stays open, audio is accepted, and the new call stays `listening`.
- Verify that ordinary final-input draining still completes successfully and closes its realtime connection once, leaving the host `idle`. Verify that a later call uses the updated voice setting.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On baseline `799758f93a06358ade4d25fb10cc3c3bd428a748`, the offline reproduction reached the real synchronous host failure-to-stop callback and failed all five new regressions. The host remained `stopping` after the configured 50 ms fake-clock deadline or after held transcript persistence was released before the deadline. The later-real-host-call case failed its old-stop-settlement prerequisite; its subsequent isolation assertions were not reached on baseline.

The six selected tests were run unchanged against baseline and fixed production code: baseline had five failures and one passing ordinary-drain control; fixed code passed all six. Each run skipped the other 45 tests in the existing test file. The complete focused coordinator, host, and realtime suites passed twice: 138/138 tests (51 coordinator, 50 host, 37 realtime). Those earlier CPU runs preceded the final addition of two test-only type annotations to correct TypeScript build errors. An esbuild comparison with a positive control confirmed unchanged emitted runtime JavaScript. Normal coverage-enabled preflight then directly passed all three Live suites on the final revision at 07:33 UTC: 138/138 tests with the same 51/50/37 split. CLI compilation, the full build, and typechecking also passed after the typing corrections.

After the fix, the failure cases settled and real host status became `error` with a message. Both isolation cases reused backend session ID `live-new` with a distinct newer realtime object: the replacement-call deadline scenario and old persistence released after a later actual-host call left the active marker true, caused no additional inactive writes, kept the new connection open, accepted audio, and left the newer call listening. The later call's injected voice was `Cherry`. Ordinary draining completed successfully. The exact original provider diagnostic was not an assertion; provider-specific diagnostics remain outside this fix.

The completed mutation matrix matched all six expected result patterns. Execution traces confirmed that the tested stop completion paths ran in every variant; regression assertions separately verify real-host reentry:

| Production variant | Same six selected tests |
| --- | --- |
| Baseline | 1 passed, 5 failed |
| Both completion paths fixed, with active-call cleanup guards | 6 passed |
| Deadline completion fixed alone | 4 passed, 2 failed |
| Persistence completion fixed alone | 3 passed, 3 failed |
| Both paths fixed, deadline cleanup guard removed | 5 passed, 1 failed |
| Both paths fixed, persistence cleanup guard removed | 5 passed, 1 failed |

The deadline-only variant failed the two early-completion assertions when persistence resolved before the deadline. Each removed cleanup guard failed its corresponding newer-call isolation assertion. Independent read-only review found no verified findings.

Repository formatting, strict CI lint, the full build, and typechecking passed. Normal preflight completed all 24 workspace test suites and exited 1. Workspace totals were 99,015 passed, 354 failed, and 206 skipped tests; file totals were 2,872 passed, 59 failed, and 3 skipped.

Failures were reported in ACP Bridge (2), Browser Use (58), CLI (61), Core (224), Channel Base (7), and External Context (2). There were also 6 unhandled errors: Browser Use 2, CLI 1, and Core 3. Preflight did not reach the downstream script tests or final bundle check.

The normal script suite was run separately and exited 1: 2,961 passed, 6 failed, and 12 skipped. The normal bundle closure check passed with exit 0. Normal commit hooks passed Prettier and ESLint with zero warnings, leaving the source and test bytes unchanged. Required local checks were run; the broad workspace and script suites remain red.

Isolated probes selected the exact 360 cases that failed in the workspace and script runs, across 62 files. BASE and HEAD each produced 357 failures and 3 passes, with zero asymmetry; exact test-case identities and multiplicities were verified in JSON. The probes retained built dependencies and did not run a full baseline preflight.

Three cases that failed in the broad runs passed in both isolated probes: CLI hosted-harness wake/park recovery, CLI authentication-dialog entry, and Core metadata migration with an explicit team root. Their broad-run causes remain unreproduced. Concrete observed failure mechanisms included filesystem ownership guards at `/tmp`, home-path `ENOENT`/`EROFS`, a missing npm fixture, and ambient Git state at `/tmp/.git`; other mechanisms remain unclassified.

Local evidence applies to base `799758f93a06358ade4d25fb10cc3c3bd428a748` plus committed fix `4329fd042b94311cf3d7f0818c810532a6a88a1f`. Newer main `fe2dd7f6d2f7f494e8ed8d384799736d40bf1f0e` changes shared CLI test-home setup by pinning `QWEN_HOME` to a fresh empty temporary directory per test file and also changes text utilities. Independent compatibility review found no verified findings and confirmed that the ANSI control-code escaping used by the Live path is unchanged. The combined current-main tree was not executed locally. Hosted CI and human review remain gates; the local broad-suite results describe the tested base-plus-fix checkout.

This is offline lifecycle evidence rather than a live browser or voice demo. No browser screenshot, live microphone/voice session, or model-backed E2E run was performed.

### Tested on

|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ local verification; broad-suite failures above |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node.js v22.23.3, Vitest 3.2.7, local source checkout with injected bridge, realtime, transport, and startup collaborators. The initial global `qwen --version` attempt exited 127 (`qwen: command not found`); reproduction used source-level offline tests instead. No live browser, voice, model/provider service, or paid service was used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Complete the old stop exactly once while limiting cleanup to the active call, especially when two calls reuse a backend session ID. The change is limited to two existing files, with 38 changed production lines and focused regressions.
- Not validated / out of scope: Execution combined with current main, a full baseline preflight, live browser and voice behavior, model/provider execution, macOS and Windows, provider-specific error diagnostics, and unrelated changes. Hosted CI and human review remain gates. Broad-run causes for the three isolated passing cases and other unclassified failure mechanisms remain unresolved.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. No public API, dependency, credential, or migration changes.

prs.title: fix(runtime): retain CSI mount identity through directory resolution
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extracts CSI mount identity and joined shutdown from #13526 as an independently reviewable fix for the existing boot-v3 worker. The worker retains the original root directory descriptor across mount observations, root lookup and normalized relative directory resolution, rejects uncertain identity, and releases it only after admitted operations finish. Nested resolution walks one component at a time without following symlinks and requires the original device.

Startup registration or listener failures and normal/error shutdown now close the mount owner. A narrow correction identified during extraction also keeps initial descriptor cleanup failures observable instead of reporting successful shutdown after an unclosed descriptor.

## Why it's needed

The current CSI observer checks mount metadata and root identity separately from pathname traversal; inherited root lookup can accept a replacement directory after a successful observation. Retaining one original owner prevents an altered parent pathname from redirecting the directory walk and gives descriptor lifetime a clear shutdown boundary. Separating this component lets reviewers assess and revert it without the private file execution, Java, database, recovery and retirement changes in the larger Draft.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Verify that repeated observation, root lookup and normalized nested resolution reuse the original root descriptor and return the original identity. Root, mount or serial replacement must permanently refuse later admission; symlinks, missing directories, non-directory leaves, non-normalized traversal and different devices must refuse resolution without falling back to an ordinary mount.

Hold initial metadata acquisition, root acquisition or a callback while beginning shutdown. New callbacks must be refused immediately, the original descriptor must remain usable until admitted work returns, and cleanup must occur once. An ordinary callback failure with unchanged identity must leave the mount usable. Failed initial or child descriptor cleanup must remain visible through the retained close promise.

Exercise the actual worker entry on setup failure, listener failure, normal shutdown and executor-close error. The mount owner must be closed on every owned exit, and the listener must stop even when executor shutdown rejects. Confirm existing boot-v1/v2/v3 routes and selectors remain compatible. The separate E2E comment records the baseline, final source pins, observed results and explicit fixture boundaries.

Local validation: build, typecheck and bundle; six focused CLI test files (970 passed, one Linux-only procfd test skipped on Darwin); scoped ESLint and Prettier; independent product-module verification and review; two complete diff self-audits.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI runtime fix). The separate E2E report records actual before/after descriptor, inode and loopback listener observations.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Darwin arm64, Node v22.22.3 and pnpm 11.24.0. The installed global CLI dry-run used Qwen Code 0.24.6; this internal CSI boundary was then exercised through the actual repository product modules. Files, FileHandles, replacement inodes and ephemeral loopback listeners are real owned resources. Linux platform, mountinfo, disk serial and procfs translation, plus explicit failure injection, are fixtures on Darwin.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Before/after checks cannot detect every replace-and-restore event or create an immutable filesystem snapshot. Callbacks must join their work before returning and must not retain or close the borrowed descriptor. A returned directory pathname is a verified selection, not a capability for future file I/O.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real Linux procfs/ext4/NVMe, Kubernetes CSI and cloud qualification remain open. This split excludes boot-v4/v5, private Read/Write/Edit and file history, native authorization, Java and SQL migrations, cold recovery, aggregate drain, physical retirement, NodeUnpublish and safe volume reuse. It reuses the existing CLI path validator and does not move it into core.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No public selector, wire format or database migration changes. Existing CSI resolution now requires the canonical Workspace-relative form, including `.` for the root; existing installed bindings already enforce that form.

Synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-mount-lifecycle-split/docs/design/2026-10-09-csi-mount-lifecycle-split.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-mount-lifecycle-split/docs/design/2026-10-09-csi-mount-lifecycle-split.zh-CN.md). Both include matching decisions, consumers, verification boundaries and remaining acceptance work.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13526, #13395, #12380. These remain open; this component does not complete the larger K2 acceptance gates.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 变更内容

从 #13526 拆出 CSI 挂载身份与等待操作完成后的关闭，作为既有 boot-v3 worker 的独立可评审修复。worker 在挂载观察、根目录查询与规范化相对目录解析期间持有原始根目录描述符，身份不确定时拒绝，并仅在已接纳操作结束后释放。嵌套目录解析逐个组件遍历、不跟随符号链接，并要求使用原始 device。

启动路由登记失败、监听失败，以及正常或错误退出现在都会关闭挂载 owner。拆分中发现并加入一项局部修正：首次描述符清理失败会保持可观察，避免描述符仍未关闭却报告退出成功。

## 为什么需要

当前 CSI observer 将挂载元数据与根身份检查和路径名遍历分开；继承的根目录查询可能在成功观察后接纳替换目录。持有同一个原始 owner 可防止被修改的父路径名重定向目录遍历，并明确描述符生命周期的关闭边界。拆出该组件后，评审者可独立评估和回滚它，无需同时处理大 Draft 中的私有文件执行、Java、数据库、恢复与退休变更。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

确认重复观察、根目录查询和规范化嵌套目录解析复用原始根描述符并返回原始身份。根目录、挂载或序列号被替换后，必须永久拒绝后续接纳；符号链接、目录缺失、非目录叶子、非规范化遍历和不同 device 必须拒绝解析，且不能回退到普通 mount。

在开始关闭时阻塞首次元数据获取、根目录获取或回调。新回调必须立即拒绝，原始描述符必须在已接纳工作返回前保持可用，并且仅清理一次。身份未变的普通回调失败必须仍保留可用挂载。首次描述符或子描述符清理失败必须通过保留的关闭 Promise 保持可见。

通过实际 worker 入口执行 setup 失败、监听失败、正常关闭和 executor-close 错误。每种自有退出路径都必须关闭 mount owner；executor 关闭拒绝时监听器也必须停止。确认既有 boot-v1/v2/v3 路由与选择入口兼容。单独 E2E 评论记录基线、最终源码 pin、观察结果和明确的 fixture 边界。

本地验证包括 build、typecheck、bundle；六个针对性 CLI 测试文件（970 通过，Darwin 跳过一个仅 Linux 的 procfd 测试）；范围内 ESLint 与 Prettier；独立产品模块验证与评审；两次完整 diff 自审。

### 证据（变更前后）

N/A（非 UI runtime 修复）。单独 E2E 报告记录真实描述符、inode 与 loopback 监听器的前后观察。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Darwin arm64、Node v22.22.3、pnpm 11.24.0。全局 CLI dry-run 使用已安装的 Qwen Code 0.24.6；之后通过实际仓库产品模块验证该内部 CSI 边界。文件、FileHandle、替换 inode 和临时 loopback 监听器为真实自有资源。Linux 平台、mountinfo、磁盘序列号、procfs 转换及明确的失败注入是 Darwin 上的 fixture。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：前后检查无法发现所有先替换再恢复事件，也不提供不可变文件系统快照。回调必须等待自身工作完成后返回，不能保留或关闭借用的描述符。返回的目录路径名是经验证的选择，不是未来文件 I/O 的能力凭证。
- 尚未验证或不在范围内：真实 Linux procfs/ext4/NVMe、Kubernetes CSI 和云环境资格仍开放。本拆分排除 boot-v4/v5、私有 Read/Write/Edit 与 file history、native 授权、Java 和 SQL 迁移、冷恢复、聚合 drain、物理退休、NodeUnpublish 和安全卷复用。复用既有 CLI 路径校验器，不将其移动到 core。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：没有公开选择入口、线协议格式或数据库迁移变更。既有 CSI 解析现在要求规范 Workspace 相对形式，根目录使用 `.`；既有安装 binding 已强制该形式。

同步设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-mount-lifecycle-split/docs/design/2026-10-09-csi-mount-lifecycle-split.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-mount-lifecycle-split/docs/design/2026-10-09-csi-mount-lifecycle-split.zh-CN.md)。两版包含一致的设计决策、消费方、验证边界和剩余验收工作。

## 关联问题

Refs #13526、#13395、#12380。这些保持开放；该组件不完成更大的 K2 验收门槛。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): execute pinned AgentDefinition revisions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stored AgentDefinitions now drive Session execution across D8b, D8c-1 and D8c-2. Creation pins the agent ID, revision and digest; an omitted revision resolves once, and a creation replay keeps the original pin. Approval mode, hosted tool profile, model and agent instructions take effect from that revision. Publishing a newer revision changes only newly created Sessions.

The Hosted Harness verifies the identity on resident and cold loads, selects one deployment-configured model route, and preserves core instructions followed by agent instructions and project context. Instructions are digest-addressed UTF-8 Session Store resources, limited to 64 KiB and included in the transaction and W1 recovery resource closure. Missing model credentials fail with `model_unavailable` before inference. Unsupported fields are refused with the field named in the error.

The branch includes main through `5ddd43815bf1` and later syncs. Conflict resolution preserves creator/owner identity and child Session lineage; the definition-digest migration is V66 because main has since taken V58/V60/V62/V64 and Flyway never applies a version below the applied maximum. A cleanup failure also preserves `model_unavailable`. The bilingual design and public contract notes are synchronized.

## Why it's needed

D8a stores immutable definition revisions, but previously they could not select an executable Session configuration. This change makes the stored configuration observable while keeping existing Sessions on their admitted revision. The built-in `qwen-code` path retains its deployment settings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Configure a selectable model with deployment credentials and the Java model allowlist. On a deployment that has completed the glob worker rollout, allow `files/2`, publish a definition with agent instructions and `default`, and create a Session. Glob should execute in its bound Workspace and a write should wait for approval.
- Publish revision 2 with a different model, instructions and `yolo`. The old Session should still use revision 1 and ask before a new write; a new Session should use revision 2 and write without creating an approval Action.
- Reload with the original identity, then with a changed digest. The original should load and the changed identity should return 409 on both resident and cold paths.
- Select an unallowlisted model, then an allowlisted model without credentials. The first should be refused at admission; the second should fail its Turn with `model_unavailable` and zero inference requests.
- Confirm design decisions 5 and 7 in section 7, covering profile semantics and the Harness ownership/review boundary.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, non-empty model and instructions were refused. After, both selected models and instruction markers reached actual model requests. The real WebShell displayed a write approval card; accepting it resumed the worker and wrote the expected file. The separate revision test confirmed that the old Session still asks and the new yolo Session writes with zero historical Action records.

![Actual WebShell write approval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/pr13530-approval-card-8e9cb574.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Prior real-stack acceptance passed on `0dab77d8cdf3`; current repair verification is reported separately |
| Windows | Not rerun locally for this candidate |
| Linux | Not rerun locally for this candidate; current-head CI is separate |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.22 and JDK 21, with isolated MySQL, Java server, Hosted Harness, Runtime Broker, worker, ordinary daemon and development WebShell. The prior acceptance candidate `0dab77d8cdf3` passed 600 distinct focused cases: Java server 121, Java SDK 1, Session Store 65 and CLI 413. Affected package builds/typechecks, changed-file ESLint, Java Checkstyle, bundle packaging and Flyway uniqueness passed. For that candidate, MySQL applied all migrations through its then-V54 definition-digest migration. The latest main-sync repair is verified separately below; the real-stack acceptance has not been repeated on the new head. The separate acceptance comment records controlled-provider and real-provider evidence, artifact identities and runner limitations.

Current main-sync repair: Core build, Core/CLI typecheck, changed TypeScript lint, 66 Session Store tests, 132 Java tests and all three Java Checkstyle checks passed. H2 Flyway applied main V54 then the definition-digest migration (V55 at the time; now V66 after main took V58/V60/V62/V64). The combined CLI run passed 387/388 tests; one existing cancellation handback case returned 404 once, then passed alone and in a three-neighbor batch. Its route and fixtures are unchanged from both main and the prior green head. The initial failure remains recorded and its exact cause is unverified; this is not a claim that the combined run passed. New-head CI is separate.

## Risk & Scope

- The Java model allowlist must match the Harness deployment's configured models and credentials. An unavailable or ambiguous route fails closed before inference.
- Tool profiles default to `files/1`; `files/2` requires draining old workers and upgrading provisioners. Shell requires an asking mode. Skills, MCP configuration, environment templates and per-definition approval timeout remain explicit refusals.
- A fresh MySQL W1 restore and distributed process-death recovery were not exercised for this candidate; focused W1 tests cover pin preservation and raw instruction resource closure.
- Migration V66 adds the nullable definition digest. Unknown stored agents or revisions return `404 agent_not_found`.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a01c0f53da12a0f1f25f73388a2cd3b2935ba8ec/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.md) / [Chinese](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a01c0f53da12a0f1f25f73388a2cd3b2935ba8ec/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-agent-definition-execution.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #12867 and #12380. Follows #13142.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

已存储的 AgentDefinition 现在通过 D8b、D8c-1 和 D8c-2 驱动会话执行。创建时固定 agent ID、revision 和 digest；省略 revision 时只解析一次，重放创建保留原固定值。审批模式、hosted 工具 profile、模型和 Agent 指令按该 revision 生效。发布新 revision 只影响新建会话。

Hosted Harness 在常驻和冷加载时验证身份，选择唯一的部署已配置模型路线，并保留核心指令、Agent 指令、项目上下文的顺序。指令存为基于 digest 寻址的 UTF-8 Session Store 资源，限制为 64 KiB，进入事务及 W1 恢复资源闭包。缺少模型凭证时以 `model_unavailable` 在推理前失败。不支持的字段被拒绝，错误中指出字段。

分支已合入 main 至 `5ddd43815bf1` 及后续同步。冲突处理保留 creator/owner 身份及 child Session 血缘；因 main 此后已占用 V58/V60/V62/V64，且 Flyway 不会应用低于已应用最大版本号的迁移，定义 digest 迁移现为 V66。清理失败时仍保留 `model_unavailable`。中英文设计和公开契约说明已同步。

## 为什么需要

D8a 已存储不可变的定义 revision，但此前无法用它选择可执行的会话配置。本修改让存储的配置实际生效，同时让已有会话继续使用准入时固定的 revision。内置 `qwen-code` 路径保留其部署配置。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 配置可选模型及部署凭证，并加入 Java 模型白名单。在完成 glob worker 发布的部署中允许 `files/2`，发布包含 Agent 指令和 `default` 权限的定义并创建会话。Glob 应在绑定 Workspace 内执行，写入应等待审批。
- 发布不同模型、指令及 `yolo` 权限的 revision 2。旧会话应仍用 revision 1，并在新写入前请求审批；新会话应使用 revision 2，写入时不产生审批 Action。
- 分别用原身份和更改后的 digest 加载。原身份应成功，更改后的身份在常驻及冷加载路径均应返回 409。
- 分别选择白名单外的模型和白名单内但无凭证的模型。前者应在准入时被拒绝；后者的 Turn 应以 `model_unavailable` 失败，并且没有推理请求。
- 确认设计第 7 节的第 5、7 项决策，涉及 profile 语义及 Harness 实现与评审边界。

### 证据（修改前后）

此前非空 model 和 instructions 被拒绝。现在两个指定模型及指令 marker 都已出现在实际模型请求中。真实 WebShell 显示写文件审批卡片，允许后 worker 恢复并写入预期文件。独立版本测试确认旧会话仍需审批，新 yolo 会话实际写入且历史 Action 记录为零。截图见上方。

### 测试平台

macOS：上一候选 `0dab77d8cdf3` 的真实栈验收通过，本轮修复的验证单独记录。Windows：本次候选未在本地重跑。Linux：本次候选未在本地重跑，当前 head 的 CI 单独确认。

### 环境

Node 22.22、JDK 21，以及隔离的 MySQL、Java server、Hosted Harness、Runtime Broker、worker、普通 daemon 和开发版 WebShell。上一轮验收候选 `0dab77d8cdf3` 合计通过 600 个不同 case：Java server 121、Java SDK 1、Session Store 65、CLI 413。所影响包的构建和类型检查、改动文件 ESLint、Java Checkstyle、bundle 打包及 Flyway 唯一性检查通过。该候选的 MySQL 已应用全部迁移至当时编号为 V54 的定义 digest 迁移。本轮主干同步修复的验证见下方，未在新 head 重跑真实栈验收。独立验收评论记录受控与真实模型证据、artifact 身份和脚本限制。

本轮主干同步修复：Core 构建、Core/CLI 类型检查、改动 TypeScript lint、66 个 Session Store 用例、132 个 Java 用例及三个模块 Checkstyle 通过。H2 Flyway 依次应用 main V54 与定义 digest 迁移（当时为 V55；main 占用 V58/V60/V62/V64 后现为 V66）。CLI 集中运行 387/388 通过，一个已有取消 handback 用例返回一次 404，随后单跑及三个相邻用例合跑通过。相关 route 和 fixture 与 main 及上一 CI 全绿 head 完全一致。原失败记录保留，具体根因仍未确认，不把集中运行表述为全绿。新 head 的 CI 单独确认。

## 风险与范围

- Java 模型白名单须与 Harness 部署的模型和凭证一致。不可用或有歧义的路线在推理前拒绝执行。

- 本次候选未执行新的 MySQL W1 恢复或分布式进程死亡恢复；针对性 W1 测试覆盖 pin 保留及原始指令资源闭包。

prs.title: feat(runtime-broker): add bounded retention for terminal JDBC history
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds opt-in, bounded JDBC cleanup for old terminal Runtime Broker history under retired bindings. Cleanup runs outside request handling on a dedicated single-thread scheduler, deletes executions before sessions and bindings, and preserves recovery, publication and storage authority evidence. Retired child bindings remain available while the parent still owes canonical child journal repair; this protection ends after exact canonical terminal settlement, without deleting lineage or journal authority records. Defaults are disabled, 30 days, a 100-row batch and a one-minute delay.

Each sweep bounds binding checks, child checks and total deletions, advances past protected rows, and resumes large families with a two-level keyset cursor. Deletions lock the tenant placement domain, slot, binding and children in order, then use database time and same-connection reference reads. Local publication writers now acquire the tenant placement guard, then lock and re-read the original binding and execution before creating references. This also preserves the session lifecycle lock order. Additive indexes support cleanup, placement and reference probes.

Placement admission now asks the database for an existence result instead of mapping and decrypting historical bindings. It preserves the local startup exception and tenant/storage/cwd/workspace blocking scopes, compares identities with exact byte semantics, and treats incomplete seed or lease metadata conservatively. This optimization applies even when cleanup is disabled.

## Why it's needed

Terminal bindings, sessions and executions currently accumulate without a retention boundary. Their encrypted history also adds work to placement admission. Cleanup needs a finite, bounded path that preserves physical-stop evidence and prevents a reference writer from racing deletion; lease expiry alone must never be treated as proof that a physical writer stopped.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm no retention task is created unless both Broker and retention are enabled. With both enabled, verify positive age/delay and a batch size of 1–1000, independent recovery scheduling, and next-tick retry after a rolled-back cleanup error.
- Age terminal records under retired bindings. Verify strict TTL boundaries use database time, managed bindings require matching drain or loss-plus-stopped-writer evidence, incomplete evidence and nonterminal children retain their family, and each sweep stays within all three budgets. Large families and fully protected first pages must still advance, including six-digit microseconds, equal-time ID ordering and one-row batches.
- Verify completed operator recovery, holders and CSI retirement pin the binding. Publication, including COLLECTED records, and CSI ACK pin the original execution and its parents while unreferenced siblings can be deleted. Verify raw UTF-8 publication/ACK hashes are distinguished from the Broker's length-prefixed hash.
- Race real reference writers against a sweep in both commit orders. A newly committed reference must be visible to the cleanup transaction; a writer waiting behind deletion must reject the missing original records without creating a dangling reference. Concurrent sweepers must delete each row once, and failures must roll back the current binding transaction. While session lifecycle holds the placement and publication tenant locks, a waiting publication writer must leave the original binding available to the lifecycle transaction.
- Warm and drain an ordinary child while its parent journal temporarily refuses dispatch/attach repair, then age its retired binding. Verify missing or unsettled canonical child state retains the binding, parent repair can finish, and canonical terminal settlement makes the binding collectible. Case-only identity mismatches must retain it, and uncommitted lineage on the cleanup connection must be visible. Lineage, parent projection and relay classification records must remain.
- After deletion, historical lookup, reconciliation and session release should return the existing non-retryable 404 responses without provisioning, dispatch or record recreation. Slots, generation counters, placement guards, harness drains and storage fences must remain.
- Compare placement decisions with the memory implementation, including case-insensitive database columns, and confirm zero historical credential decrypts. Verify the V65-to-V66 upgrade preserves existing terminal receipts and that the standalone schema and Flyway agree.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI evidence: this is a private Java/JDBC feature with no CLI retention entry point. The baseline recovery/drain contract passed 45 tests. The implementation has passed 1030 selected unit tests and 40 real MySQL tests, including direct cleanup/reference races and expired history APIs. Both Java module verification gates, Checkstyle and SpotBugs passed; repository build, typecheck and bundle passed. A separate E2E comment records the exact submitted revision and results.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Temurin 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.16 and MySQL 8.4.11. MySQL fixtures use isolated UUID-named databases, including case-insensitive collation. Query-plan probes confirmed the new candidate, tenant/state and reference indexes are usable; they are not production-scale latency benchmarks.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: retention makes historical receipts and idempotency guarantees finite. After deletion, callers must not reuse expired session IDs or idempotency keys; no permanent execution-key tombstone is added.
- Not validated / out of scope: MariaDB and Windows/Linux were not run locally. Active-binding history, worker/Pod retirement, physical files and publication metadata collection are outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing HTTP and business repository interfaces stay unchanged. Deploy the additive V66 migration after the existing V65 stream-capture migration and code with retention disabled; upgrade every publication writer before enabling cleanup. Disable cleanup before reverting to older writers. Disabling cannot restore deleted records.

Complete synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #13203.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为已退役 binding 下超龄的 Runtime Broker 终态历史增加可选的有界 JDBC 清理。清理在请求路径之外使用独立单线程调度，按 execution、session、binding 顺序删除，并保留恢复、publication 和存储权限所需的证据。父会话仍欠 canonical child journal 修复时，保留已退役 child binding；精确 canonical 终态结算后结束该保护，不删除 lineage 或 journal 权限记录。默认关闭，保留 30 天，每批 100 行，间隔一分钟。

每轮限制 binding 检查数、子行检查数和总删除数，受保护记录也推进游标，大 binding 通过两层 keyset 游标跨轮续扫。删除依次锁 tenant placement domain、slot、binding 和子记录，使用数据库时间及同连接引用检查。Local publication writer 先取得 tenant placement guard，再在创建引用前锁定并重新读取原 binding 和 execution，同时保持 session 生命周期的锁顺序。增量索引支持清理、placement 和引用查询。

Placement 接纳改为由数据库返回存在性结果，无需加载和解密历史 binding。保留 local startup 例外与 tenant/storage/cwd/workspace 阻塞范围，按精确字节语义比较身份，并保守处理不完整 seed 或 lease 元数据。清理关闭时，该优化仍然生效。

## 必要性

终态 binding、session 和 execution 当前没有保留边界，会持续累积。加密历史还增加 placement 接纳开销。清理需要有限且有界的路径，既保留物理停止证据，也防止引用 writer 与删除竞争；租约到期不能作为物理 writer 已停止的证明。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

- 确认只有 Broker 和 retention 同时开启才创建任务。两者开启时，验证保留期和间隔为正数、批量值为 1–1000、恢复调度独立，以及清理错误回滚后下轮重试。
- 将已退役 binding 下的终态记录设为超龄。验证严格 TTL 边界使用数据库时钟，managed binding 必须具有匹配的 drain 或 loss 加 stopped-writer 证据，不完整证据及非终态子记录保护整个家族，每轮遵守三项预算。大家族和全部受保护的首批记录仍须推进，包括六位微秒、同时间戳 ID 排序和单行批次。
- 验证已完成 operator recovery、holder 和 CSI retirement 保护整个 binding。Publication（包括 COLLECTED）与 CSI ACK 保护原 execution 及其父记录，无引用兄弟记录仍可删除。验证 publication/ACK 的原始 UTF-8 哈希与 Broker 带长度前缀的哈希不同。
- 按两种提交顺序让真实引用 writer 与 sweep 竞争。清理事务必须看到新提交的引用；等待删除完成的 writer 必须拒绝缺失原记录，不能创建悬空引用。双清理实例每行只删除一次，异常必须回滚当前 binding 事务。Session 生命周期持有 placement 与 publication tenant 锁时，等待的 publication writer 不得抢占生命周期事务需要的原 binding。
- 普通 child 已 warm/drain，但父 journal 暂时拒绝 dispatch/attach 修复时，将已退役 binding 设为超龄。验证缺失或未结算的 canonical child 状态保留 binding，父修复可以完成，canonical 终态结算后 binding 可回收。仅大小写不同的身份必须保留，同清理连接未提交的 lineage 必须可见。Lineage、父 projection 和 relay 分类记录仍保留。
- 删除后，历史查询、reconcile 和 session release 应返回现有的不可重试 404，不触发 provisioning、dispatch 或记录重建。Slot、generation 计数、placement guard、harness drain 和 storage fence 必须保留。
- 对照内存实现的 placement 决策，包括数据库列不区分大小写的情况，并确认历史凭据零解密。验证从 V65 升级 V66 保留原终态 receipt，独立 schema 与 Flyway 保持一致。

### 证据（Before & After）

UI 证据为 N/A：这是没有 CLI 清理入口的私有 Java/JDBC 功能。基线 recovery/drain 合同通过 45 项测试。实现已通过 1030 项定向单元测试和 40 项真实 MySQL 测试，包括实际清理与引用竞争、过期历史 API。两个 Java 模块的验证门禁、Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs 通过；仓库 build、typecheck 和 bundle 通过。独立 E2E 评论记录实际提交版本及结果。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Temurin 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.16、MySQL 8.4.11。MySQL fixture 使用独立 UUID 数据库，包括不区分大小写的 collation。查询计划确认新的候选、tenant/状态和引用索引可用；这不代表生产规模的延迟基准测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：清理后历史 receipt 和幂等保证具有有限保留期。删除后调用方不得复用过期 session ID 或幂等键；本次不增加永久 execution-key 墓碑。
- 未验证或范围外：本地未运行 MariaDB、Windows/Linux。活跃 binding 的历史、worker/Pod 退役、物理文件及 publication 元数据回收不在本次范围内。
- 接口及迁移：已有 HTTP 和业务 repository 接口保持不变。保持清理关闭，先在已有 V65 stream-capture migration 后部署增量 V66 migration 和代码；全部 publication writer 升级后才开启。回退旧 writer 前先关闭清理。关闭不能恢复已删除的数据。

完整同步设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #13203。

</details>
