prs.title: fix(managed-agent): recover original Hook sessions during Workspace retirement
prs.body:
Latest gate integration / 最新门禁同步 `a62f55b`: [validation / 验证](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13673#issuecomment-6064698885).

Latest recovery fix / 最新恢复修复 `6e2e151`: [validation / 验证](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13673#issuecomment-6064125967).

## What this PR does

Allows an idle local `hosted-workspace-files/1` Session with original command Hooks to finish retirement after Broker restart, original worker exit, or trusted same-machine reboot. Recovery verifies the saved original identity and drain fence. A stopped worker's matching receipt is persisted before its saved Sessions and exact storage holder are released atomically under the current claim.

## Why it's needed

A Broker restart loses its in-memory Session context, so a still-live original Hook worker cannot be detached. If the worker has exited, its settled Hook Session can retain a storage holder that prevents stopping it, while the only existing holder release waits for that absent worker. Both paths leave deletion blocked after End and Delete effects are durable. This follow-up fixes the failures reproduced after #13354 merged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use an idle files/1 Session with original command Hooks supplied through the existing authenticated private catalog. Persist End and Delete effects, then restart the Broker, crash the Broker and original workers while retaining the Harness, crash all original product processes, or reboot the same trusted machine. Confirm that recovery keeps the original binding, generation, handle, credentials and effect bytes; runs End and Delete once each; avoids model or replacement-worker replay; persists the original stop receipt; seals the writer; and commits exactly one retirement with shared files and the neighboring Session preserved.

Confirm that unknown Hook outcomes still block retirement. Also review refusal controls for unfenced or mismatched original identity, missing or foreign stop evidence, active/unknown executions, expired or replaced claims, malformed holders, and interrupted receipt persistence. Review standalone Broker and migrated Server holder-table schema parity.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a fresh native baseline at `21e060b` remains blocked after Spring restart with `runtime_reconciliation_required` and `managed_session_close_failed`. An intermediate candidate independently reproduced the absent-worker holder dependency.

After: the final frozen products completed all four recovery fault scenarios with one retirement each; a separate 35-second unknown-Hook observation remained safely blocked. One earlier OS preboot control phase timed out before any reboot because of a private readiness lookup error; its red evidence is retained separately. The corrected phase injected one real OS reboot and resumed the original checkpoint successfully, without changing the 180-second product deadline. Detailed execution attribution and limits are in the separate E2E report.

Build and typecheck passed once on `9126c218`. Targeted Server tests passed 39/39 on that commit. Targeted Broker tests passed 212/212 on `3253827b`; the entire Broker directory is byte-identical in the final commit. These counts describe selected tests, not full-suite coverage.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| macOS | Build, typecheck and targeted Java tests |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux | Alpine/aarch64 VM, Spring/Java 21, Node 24, MariaDB 11.4; four native fault scenarios and a bounded refusal control |

### Environment

Frozen products, authenticated private command-Hook catalog and an isolated native database. Actual Linux process, cgroup, mount and changed-boot identity evidence was captured.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: stopped-Session cleanup spans the Broker and managed storage-holder contract. The existing O(history) scan and tenant serialization remain and require maintainer architecture/load review.
- Not validated: bare-metal hosts, internal stop/tombstone crash cuts, full deployment/load acceptance, Windows, or a new public command-Hook producer.
- Scope: existing local files/1 retirement only. Server migrations and Shell/MCP/CSI/L4 lifecycle support are unchanged. Unknown outcomes continue to fail closed.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9126c218c974d1b83617149ba24c40b53544bb77/docs/design/2026-10-08-original-hook-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9126c218c974d1b83617149ba24c40b53544bb77/docs/design/2026-10-08-original-hook-recovery.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13164 (L3 only; L4 remains open). Follow-up to merged #13354.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 变更

使带原命令 Hook 的闲置本地 `hosted-workspace-files/1` Session 能在 Broker 重启、原 worker 退出或受信任的同机器重启后完成退役。恢复校验保存的原始身份和 drain 屏障。先持久化已停机原 worker 的匹配 receipt，再在当前 claim 下原子释放其保存的 Session 和精确存储 holder。

### 原因

Broker 重启会丢失内存中的 Session 上下文，使仍存活的原 Hook worker 无法 detach。如果 worker 已退出，已结算的 Hook Session 又可能保留阻止停机的存储 holder，而现有唯一 holder 释放路径等待这个已退出 worker 应答。两条路径都会在 End 和 Delete effects 已持久化后阻塞删除。本后续修复处理 #13354 合入后复现的这些故障。

### 评审核验

使用通过既有私有认证 catalog 配置原命令 Hook 的闲置 files/1 Session。持久化 End 和 Delete effects 后，分别重启 Broker、在保留 Harness 的同时令 Broker 和原 worker 崩溃、令全部原产品进程崩溃，或重启同一受信任机器。确认恢复保留原 binding、generation、handle、凭据和效果字节，End 与 Delete 各运行一次，不重放模型请求或替代 worker，持久化原停机 receipt、seal writer，并只提交一次退役，保留共享文件和邻居 Session。

确认未知 Hook 结果仍阻塞退役；同时检查未设置屏障或原身份不匹配、停机证据缺失或外来、活跃或未知执行、claim 过期或被替换、holder 损坏和 receipt 持久化中断的拒绝控制。检查独立 Broker 与迁移后 Server 的 holder 表结构一致。

### 前后证据

修复前：`21e060b` 的新原生基线在 Spring 重启后保持阻塞，返回 `runtime_reconciliation_required` 和 `managed_session_close_failed`。一个中间候选独立复现了 worker 已退出时的 holder 依赖。

修复后：最终冻结产物在四种恢复故障场景中均完成一次退役；独立的 35 秒未知 Hook 观察仍安全阻塞。此前一次 OS preboot 控制阶段因私有 readiness 定位错误，在未实际重启前超时，其红色证据单独保留。纠正后的阶段只注入一次真实 OS 重启，并成功恢复原 checkpoint，未修改产品 180 秒超时。独立 E2E 报告给出详细执行归属和边界。

`9126c218` 上的 build 和 typecheck 各一次通过，定向 Server 测试 39/39。定向 Broker 测试 212/212 在 `3253827b` 执行，其整个 Broker 目录与最终提交逐字节一致。这些数字描述选定测试，不是完整测试套件覆盖率。

### 平台和环境

macOS：build、typecheck 和定向 Java 测试。Windows：未测试。Linux：Alpine/aarch64 VM、Spring/Java 21、Node 24、MariaDB 11.4，四种原生故障场景和有界拒绝控制。

使用冻结产物、私有认证命令 Hook catalog 和隔离原生数据库，捕获真实 Linux 进程、cgroup、mount 和变化的 boot 身份证据。

### 风险和范围

已停机 Session 清理跨越 Broker 与 managed storage-holder 契约。既有 O(history) 扫描和 tenant 串行成本保留，仍需维护者进行架构和负载评审。未验证物理主机、停机与墓碑内部崩溃切点、完整部署或负载验收、Windows 或新的公开命令 Hook producer。

范围只含既有本地 files/1 退役；Server 迁移和 Shell/MCP/CSI/L4 生命周期支持不变，未知结果继续拒绝。双语设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9126c218c974d1b83617149ba24c40b53544bb77/docs/design/2026-10-08-original-hook-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9126c218c974d1b83617149ba24c40b53544bb77/docs/design/2026-10-08-original-hook-recovery.zh-CN.md)。

关联 #13164，仅 L3，L4 仍开放；接续已合入的 #13354。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): size reactive compaction against the server-reported context ceiling
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a provider rejects a request with a context-overflow error, qwen-code already parses the ceiling the server reported out of that error (`contextOverflow.limitTokens`) and forwards it into the omni-media degrade bookkeeping — then drops it on the floor for the reactive compaction path. Reactive recovery sizes the retry against `contextWindowSize`, the window inferred from the model id, which is exactly the number the error just contradicted.

This PR threads that server-reported ceiling through to the compression service and clamps the two reactive sizing sites against it, so a rejected request is retried against the limit the server actually enforces:

- `observedServerCeiling?: number` is added to `TryCompressOptions` (`llm-chat.ts`) and to `CompressOptions` (`chatCompressionService.ts`), and the reactive context-overflow handler passes `contextOverflow.limitTokens` through.
- `reactiveContextCeiling = Math.min(contextLimit, opts.observedServerCeiling)` is derived once and read at three sites: the `budgetWindow` initializer, `sharedRequestFits`, and its skip-reason debug string.

The distinct-compaction-model branch is deliberately **not** clamped against the observed ceiling:

```ts
budgetWindow = window;
```

which is the pre-existing #7960 behaviour. The ceiling was reported for the **main** request's model and route, and it arrives with no scope attached — `parseTokenCounts` returns only `{ actualTokens?, limitTokens? }`, so nothing records which route reported it, which model it belongs to, or whether it bounds the input or the whole window. Clamping a *different* model or route against it can floor the output budget at 1, which the truncation guard reads as definitionally truncated and drops; because the reactive call passes `force: true`, the `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES` breaker never gates it, so the session could never be compacted. An earlier revision of this PR hand-derived route identity at the consumer to narrow the clamp; that guard was removed because it only covered one of the four scope axes and was not witnessed by any test. Carrying the scope from the producer is tracked in #13876.

## Why it's needed

The failure mode is concrete. A llama.cpp server started with `-c 262144` that serves a model id resolving to the 1_000_000-token catalog row reports its own limit when it rejects an oversize request. Reactive sizing keeps using 1_000_000, so `sharedRequestFits` stays true, `canShareCache` holds, and the UNSLIMMED oversize history is re-posted to the endpoint that just rejected it — a recovery step guaranteed to fail, and one that also burns the cache-sharing path that exists to make compaction cheap. The reported symptom is that compaction never recovers on such a server.

The parse-then-drop is the bug: the information needed to size correctly is already in hand at the call site.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The `#13432` regression tests (two at the current head) live inside the existing `ChatCompressionService.compress cache sharing` describe (so they inherit its `makeFixture` / `expectCold` closures and its `afterEach(vi.restoreAllMocks)`), and route through `expectCold`, which already asserts `generateText` was not called — that gives the "cache-shared branch is not taken" half for free.

1. **Test 1 — cache sharing must not be taken.** Fixture: `contextWindowSize: 1_000_000` (inferred), `observedServerCeiling: 262_144`, prompt anchor `279_935`. Every other `canShareCache` conjunct still holds (main model, `enableCacheControl: true`, provider-reported non-estimated anchor), so only the ceiling makes the shared request not fit.
2. **Test 2 — the cold output budget must respect the ceiling.** The slimmed cold-path input estimate is asserted to sit above `262_144 − COMPACT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` first (a fixture guard, so the assertion below cannot pass vacuously), then `coldInputEstimate + maxOutputTokens <= 262_144`.

Red proof, measured at `8a966b03bb` (before the route-aware guard added in `80df365928`): revert **only** the clamp (`Math.min(contextLimit, opts.observedServerCeiling)` → `contextLimit`), leave the two tests that existed at that commit in place.

```
Tests  2 failed | 149 passed (151)     rc=1
  × keeps reactive overflow recovery off the shared request when the server reports a lower ceiling (#13432)
      AssertionError: expected "spy" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times
  × clamps the cold output budget to the server-reported ceiling (#13432)
      AssertionError: expected 266501 to be less than or equal to 262144
```

`266501` = the 246501 cold estimate plus the unclamped 20_000 output reserve. Green on the unmutated tree:

```
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run src/services/chatCompressionService.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  151 passed (151)           rc=0
```

Both counts above were measured at `8a966b03bb`, when this file carried two `#13432` tests. The head reviewed here carries two (`keeps reactive overflow recovery off the shared request…` and `clamps the cold output budget to the server-reported ceiling`); the two distinct-compaction-model cases were removed together with the clamp they witnessed. Re-measured at this head: `151 passed (151)`, rc=0.

Also run on the merged head: eslint on the three changed files (rc=0), `prettier --check` on the three changed files (rc=0), `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core run typecheck` with `--max-old-space-size=3072` (rc=0, 0 errors in the changed files).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-user-visible; unit-test evidence above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest, `packages/core`). No provider call was made; the server-reported ceiling is supplied through the fixture.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on the same-route arm the clamp is `Math.min`, so when the server reports a ceiling *higher* than the inferred window the inferred window still wins — reactive sizing never becomes more permissive than today. A side-query sent to a distinct compaction model is deliberately **not** clamped at all, so that arm can size above the observed ceiling; that is the intended trade, see above, and the scope work needed to clamp it correctly is #13876. Callers that do not pass `observedServerCeiling` keep the exact previous behaviour (`reactiveContextCeiling === contextLimit`).
- Not validated / out of scope: no live llama.cpp `-c 262144` end-to-end run was performed here; the symptom is covered by the four regression tests above, which fail without the clamp and pass with it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Both new fields are optional; no public signature changed.

Deliberate scope limits:

- `contextLimit` itself is left untouched, so the proactive `computeThresholds` gate still runs against the full inferred window. Clamping there would change when proactive compaction fires, which is a different decision from sizing a reactive retry.
- `reactiveOriginalTokenCountIsEstimated` is unchanged, as are `reactiveOriginalTokenCount` and its `contextOverflow.actualTokens ?? … .limitTokens ?? …` fallbacks — the fix is on the window side, not the count side.
- `COMPACT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` and `COMPACTION_BUDGET_SAFETY_MARGIN` are unchanged.
- The ceiling is deliberately **not** read back through `getObservedServerInputLimit`. That map has no production callers, and `recordObservedServerInputLimit` is only reached from the omni-media degrade path behind three early returns, so a plain-text session never populates it. Passing the parsed value directly is the only path that actually works for the reported case.
- No platform conditioning was added: the change is pure arithmetic plus two optional interface fields, with no `process.platform`, `fs`, `spawn`, or path-separator surface.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13432

Refs #13072 (closed unmerged on 2026-10-07 with no successor; it was the reason this sat parked). Thanks to @doudouOUC for the independent confirmation and the sketch this follows — with two corrections: the `TryCompressOptions` anchor is in `llm-chat.ts` rather than `chatCompressionService.ts:299`, and the clamp deliberately does not go at the `const contextLimit =` site.

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): connector and broker robustness from the #12692 R2 review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes eight managed-agent server follow-ups from the post-merge R2 review of #12692, and updates the design note that one of them changes.

- **Lifecycle fence that survives restarts.** The Runtime Broker refuses an unbound Session whenever its persisted status is closing, closed, archiving, archived, deleting or deleted. The refusal is `409 runtime_broker_session_closed` and is not retryable. Drain keeps an in-process entry only for a Session whose row has vanished, so close and delete no longer add an entry that stays forever.
- **No client after close.** Once the Hosted Harness connector is closed, a late use fails immediately. It no longer builds a client whose executors and heartbeat nothing would ever stop. Close also releases the client lock before the client shutdown, which can take several seconds, so other callers no longer wait behind it.
- **Base URL checked at startup.** An enabled Hosted Harness refuses to start unless its base URL is an absolute http(s) URL with a host. Before, values like `localhost:4170` or an empty string failed only at the first call.
- **Tool items keep their identity.** A tool update without a callId now gets an identity that no callId can spell. Before, a callId of the literal form `source:<n>` could land on the same item as an unrelated update that had no callId. Tool items that have a callId keep their version-1 id (`turnId:callId`). The stored event and the published tool result now compute that id from one shared rule.
- **Lease settings checked at startup.** The dispatch lease and the renew interval must each be at least 1 ms, which is the unit the scheduler uses. The renew interval must also be shorter than the lease.
- **Rename failures diagnosable.** When a Session rename fails at the Hosted Harness, the server logs `Hosted Harness rename failed` with the original exception. The `503 hosted_harness_unavailable` it returns now carries that exception as its cause.
- **Failing sessions back off.** The message materializer counts consecutive failures per Session. It retries a failing Session 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 passes after its first failure, then once every 64 passes, which is about every 6.4 s at the 100 ms schedule. Between retries the Session is moved behind fresher sessions, so it cannot hold one of the 32 slots each pass selects. If the store fails while moving it, only that Session is affected and the rest of the pass still runs. One success clears the count.
- **Kubernetes refusal wording.** Configuring the Kubernetes provisioner now fails with a message that lists the supported provisioners, instead of mentioning an internal review slice.
- **Design note updated.** Gate 3 of the review-corrections design ([EN](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-agent-r2-connector/docs/design/2026-09-25-managed-agent-review-corrections.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-agent-r2-connector/docs/design/2026-09-25-managed-agent-review-corrections.zh-CN.md)) now describes the durable fence. Both language versions changed together, in the same commit.

The attach concurrency fix that the first revision of this PR carried landed on `main` separately, in #13403. This PR now only adds a test that pins it.

## Why it's needed

- The old retirement fence lived only in process memory. After a restart, a closed, archived or deleted Session could be warmed back to a ready Runtime, and every close and delete added an entry that was never removed.
- A connector used after close could start executors and a heartbeat that nothing would ever stop.
- A schemeless base URL passed startup and then failed with an opaque error mid-request.
- A harness callId shaped like `source:<n>` could merge two different tool calls into one item.
- A renew interval of zero or below 1 ms made lease renewal fail on the worker thread. A renew interval equal to or longer than the lease lost the lease at the first renewal. Both showed up much later as `hosted_harness_unavailable`, not at startup.
- A failed rename returned a bare 503, with no log line and no cause.
- One Session whose materialization always fails logged a WARN about 10 times a second, indefinitely. Thirty-two such Sessions took every slot each pass selects, so healthy Sessions never materialized.
- The Kubernetes refusal pointed operators at an internal review slice instead of the supported options.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the classes this PR adds or extends (JDK 21; `managed-agent-server` resolves `qwencode` and `runtime-broker` from the local repository, so install those first):

```bash
(cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode && mvn -q -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install)
(cd packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker && mvn -q -DskipTests install)
cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server
mvn -B test -Dtest='EmbeddedRuntimeBrokerTest,QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest,HarnessEventProjectorTest,EventIdentityTest,HarnessCoordinatorTest,ManagedSessionLifecycleTest,MessageMaterializerTest,ManagedMaterializationDeferTest'
```

At `b5bf5b42` this reports `Tests run: 131, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0`. Re-run at `51a87ac9`: `Tests run: 202, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0` (EmbeddedRuntimeBrokerTest 36, QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest 57, HarnessCoordinatorTest 62, MessageMaterializerTest 7, ManagedSessionLifecycleTest 25, HarnessEventProjectorTest 9, EventIdentityTest 4, ManagedMaterializationDeferTest 2); the runtime-broker witness class at the same head reports 159 tests, 0 failures.

What each change is pinned by:

- **Lifecycle fence.**
  - `unboundLifecycleClosedSessionsAreFencedByTheDurableRow` covers all six statuses with no in-process entry.
  - `drainDuringSettleStillFencesTheWarm` covers drain reading a row that is still CLOSING.
  - `drainRetiresASessionWhoseRowIsGone`, `drainLeavesAnActiveSessionWarmable` and `drainStillRetiresAClosedSessionInProcess` cover the remaining drain cases.
  - `releaseStillSettlesAnUnboundClosedSession`, `reconcileStillAnswersAnUnknownExecutionOfAClosedSession` and `teardownReleaseStillResolvesTheScopeWhenAdmissionIsFenced` pin release and the unknown-outcome reconcile deliberately staying off the fence: each goes red if the fence moves onto a teardown route.
- **Close.**
  - `closesTheLazyClientAndRejectsLateUse` and `doesNotBuildAClientAfterClose` cover use after close.
  - `closeReleasesTheClientLockBeforeClosingTheClient` checks the lock is released before the slow shutdown.
- **Base URL.** `rejectsSchemelessBaseUrlsAtStartup` covers `localhost:4170`, empty, `ftp://host:21`, `http:///path`, credentialed (`https://user:token@127.0.0.1:4170`), query (`?v=1`) and fragment (`#frag`) URLs.
- **Tool identity.**
  - `sourcePrefixedCallIdDoesNotCollideWithTheNoIdFallback` covers the collision.
  - `toolCallIdentityMatchesTheStoredProjectionRule` checks the projector against the shared rule.
  - `EventIdentityTest` pins the rule itself.
- **Lease.** `rejectsInvalidLeaseRenewConfiguration` covers a zero, negative and sub-millisecond renew interval, a renew equal to the lease, and the defaults passing.
- **Rename.** `aFailedRenameLogsAndChainsTheRootCause`.
- **Backoff.**
  - `backsOffAndRotatesAFailingTarget` covers the 1/2/4/8 retries and the rotation.
  - `atTheCapRetriesOnceEveryMaxStreakPasses` covers the cap.
  - `aFailingDeferralDegradesOnlyItsOwnTarget` and `clearsTheStreakAfterASuccess` cover the failure and recovery paths.
  - `warnsWithTheStackOnlyDuringTheExponentialPhase` pins full-stack WARNs in the exponential phase and one-line WARNs once the cap takes over.
  - `anExactlyFullWindowDoesNotRotateOnTheSkipPath` pins the skip-path rotation to rows behind a full 32-slot window, so an exactly-full window is not rewritten.
  - `deferMovesUpdatedAtButNotTheCoveredSequence` and `deferralRotatesTheTargetBehindFresherRows` cover the store side.
- **Kubernetes wording.** `namesTheSupportedProvisionersInTheKubernetesRejection`.
- **Attach (pins #13403).** `loadsOnceForRepeatedFreeAttachCalls`.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** The fence only applies to unbound Sessions. It sits after the workspace-bound branch, so a workspace-bound Session resolves through its Workspace as before.
  - **Release after a restart.** Releasing the Runtime of a closing or closed Session after a restart still fails `503 runtime_reconciliation_required` (retryable), unchanged from the merge base. What this PR changes is admission: a `warm` or a fresh `acquire` of such a Session is now durably refused with `409 runtime_broker_session_closed`; release and the unknown-outcome reconcile deliberately stay off the fence so the binding can still be settled. The Runtime stays unreleased either way. This path is not reachable today, because unbound turns are given no tools.
  - **Backoff counters.** They live in process memory. A Session whose backlog is caught up by another server instance leaves its counter behind until restart. That is bounded by the number of distinct Sessions that ever failed. A closed or deleted failing Session keeps being selected and keeps its counter live.
- **Not validated / out of scope.**
  - The Session Store base URL gets no equivalent startup check: `localhost:4170` and `https://` still start, both on `main` and on this PR. That is a separate follow-up.
  - The MySQL- and MariaDB-profile tests were not reached in CI at this head, because of the `main` breakage above.
  - Worker teardown and full Broker access revocation on archive/delete remain out of scope (design gate 3).
  - The tombstoned-attach protocol is deferred to #13302.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** None, and there is no schema migration.
  - Tool items that have a callId keep their ids.
  - Only the fallback identity for updates without a callId changes. That fallback already gives each source event its own item, so the new separator neither merges nor splits anything.

## 这个 PR 做了什么

修复 #12692 合并后 R2 评审中 managed-agent server 的 8 项跟进，并同步修改了其中一项影响到的设计文档。

- **跨重启有效的生命周期围栏。** 未绑定工作区的 Session，只要持久化状态是 closing、closed、archiving、archived、deleting 或 deleted，Runtime Broker 就拒绝它，返回 `409 runtime_broker_session_closed`，不可重试。drain 只在 Session 行已消失时才写进程内条目，所以 close 和 delete 不再留下永不清除的条目。
- **关闭后不再构建 client。** Hosted Harness connector 关闭后，迟到的调用会立即失败，不会再构建一个其执行器和心跳永远没人停止的 client。关闭时还会先释放 client 锁，再关闭 client（关闭可能要几秒），其他调用方不再被堵在后面。
- **启动时校验 base URL。** 启用的 Hosted Harness，base URL 必须是带 host 的绝对 http(s) URL，否则拒绝启动。以前 `localhost:4170` 或空串要到第一次调用才失败。
- **工具项身份不再冲突。** 没有 callId 的工具更新，改用一个任何 callId 都拼不出来的身份。以前形如 `source:<n>` 的 callId 可能与另一条无关的、没有 callId 的更新落在同一个 item 上。有 callId 的工具项保持版本 1 的 id（`turnId:callId`），存储事件和已发布的工具结果现在用同一条共享规则计算这个 id。
- **启动时校验租约设置。** dispatch 租约和续约间隔都不能小于 1 毫秒（调度器使用的单位），并且续约间隔必须短于租约。
- **rename 失败可诊断。** Session rename 在 Hosted Harness 失败时，服务端会记一条带原始异常的 `Hosted Harness rename failed` 日志，返回的 `503 hosted_harness_unavailable` 也会把该异常作为 cause。
- **失败的 Session 会退避。** 消息物化器按 Session 统计连续失败次数：在首次失败后的第 1、2、4、8、16、32 轮重试，之后每 64 轮重试一次（按 100 毫秒调度约每 6.4 秒一次）。两次重试之间，该 Session 会被移到较新的 Session 后面，占不住每轮选出的 32 个名额。如果移动时 store 出错，只影响这一个 Session，本轮其余部分照常执行。一次成功即清零计数。
- **Kubernetes 拒绝文案。** 配置 Kubernetes provisioner 时，报错现在列出支持的 provisioner，不再提内部评审切片。
- **设计文档已更新。** 评审勘误设计文档的门禁 3（[EN](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-agent-r2-connector/docs/design/2026-09-25-managed-agent-review-corrections.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-agent-r2-connector/docs/design/2026-09-25-managed-agent-review-corrections.zh-CN.md)）现在描述持久围栏，中英两版在同一提交中一起修改。

本 PR 第一版带的 attach 并发修复已经通过 #13403 单独合入 `main`，本 PR 现在只为它加了一个测试。

## 为什么需要

- 原来的退休围栏只在进程内存里。重启后，已关闭、已归档或已删除的 Session 可以被重新 warm 成就绪的 Runtime；而且每次 close 和 delete 都会留下一个永不清除的条目。
- connector 关闭后再被使用，可能启动没人会停止的执行器和心跳。
- 没有 scheme 的 base URL 能通过启动，然后在请求中途报出难以理解的错误。
- 形如 `source:<n>` 的 harness callId 可能把两个不同的工具调用并成一个 item。
- 续约间隔为 0 或小于 1 毫秒会让租约续期在工作线程上失败；续约间隔等于或长于租约，会在第一次续约时丢掉租约。两种情况都要过很久才以 `hosted_harness_unavailable` 的形式暴露，而不是在启动时。
- rename 失败只返回一个光秃秃的 503，既没有日志也没有 cause。
- 一个物化总是失败的 Session 会以每秒约 10 次的频率无限期地记 WARN；32 个这样的 Session 会占满每轮选出的全部名额，健康 Session 永远得不到物化。
- Kubernetes 的拒绝信息把运维引向内部评审切片，而没有告诉他们有哪些可选项。

|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

- **Linux** 用 JDK 21（`eclipse-temurin:21-jdk`）本地测试过。
  - 在 `b5bf5b42` 上（x86_64）：上面的聚焦命令（131 个测试，0 失败）和运行中服务探针。
  - 在 `51a87ac9` 上（aarch64）：上面的聚焦命令重跑（202 个测试，0 失败）。
  - 在 `924484ef` 上（aarch64）：模块完整测试套件（1043 个测试，0 失败）。
- **macOS：** 本 PR 第一版在 macOS 上跑过 `mvn verify`（当时 562 个测试）。当前 head 没有在 macOS 上跑过。
- **Windows** 未测试。
- **CI 对本模块的覆盖。** `macos-latest` 和 `windows-latest` 的 Java 任务，以及 ubuntu 的 Java 11/17/21 任务，只跑 `qwencode` 和 `runtime-broker`，这些任务都是绿的。`managed-agent-server` 只在 Linux 的 MySQL 8.4 Hosted 车道和 MariaDB 车道里跑。
- **这两条车道在 `b5bf5b42` 上的 CI 状态。** 两条都因超时被取消。
  - `main` 从 `ac81c07dc8`（#13355）起就以同样方式失败，原因是 `main` 上的一个测试 fixture，由 #13542 跟踪。
  - 本 head 上 Hosted 车道的 surefire 汇总是 `Tests run: 1065, Failures: 0, Errors: 1`，唯一的 error 是 `ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest.holdsRestorePagesInsideThePerPageByteBudget`，即 #13542 那个用例。`main` 在 `b585508733` 上是 `1039, 0, 1`，error 相同。

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21（`eclipse-temurin:21-jdk`）和 Maven 3.9，H2 数据库。运行中服务探针所用的 CLI 从 PR head 构建并打包，作为 local-process Runtime worker。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍。** 围栏只作用于未绑定工作区的 Session。它位于 workspace 绑定分支之后，所以绑定了工作区的 Session 仍像以前一样通过其 Workspace 解析。
  - **重启后的释放。** 重启后释放一个 closing 或 closed Session 的 Runtime，仍然返回 `503 runtime_reconciliation_required`（可重试），与本 PR 的合并基线一致。本 PR 真正改变的是准入：`warm` 或全新 `acquire` 这类 Session 现在会被持久化地拒绝为 `409 runtime_broker_session_closed`；release 与未知结果对账刻意不走围栏，以便仍能结算 binding。两种情况下 Runtime 都释放不掉。这条路径目前走不到，因为未绑定的 turn 不会拿到任何工具。
  - **退避计数。** 计数保存在进程内存里。如果某个 Session 的积压被另一个服务实例追平，它的计数会一直留到重启，上限是曾经失败过的不同 Session 数。已关闭或已删除的失败 Session 会继续被选中，计数仍在使用中。
- **未验证/范围外。**
  - Session Store 的 base URL 没有同样的启动校验：`localhost:4170` 和 `https://` 在 `main` 和本 PR 上都能启动，这是另一个后续项。
  - 由于上面提到的 `main` 问题，本 head 上 MySQL 和 MariaDB profile 的测试在 CI 中没有跑到。
  - archive/delete 时停止 worker 和完全撤销 Broker 访问，仍在范围之外（设计文档门禁 3）。
  - tombstone attach 协议延后到 #13302。
- **破坏性变更/迁移说明。** 无，也没有 schema 迁移。
  - 有 callId 的工具项 id 不变。
  - 只有没有 callId 的更新所用的兜底身份变了。这个兜底本来就让每个源事件各自成为一个 item，所以换分隔符既不会合并也不会拆分任何东西。

## 关联 Issue

#12692 合并后 R2 评审的跟进。设计层面的延后项由 #13302 跟踪。MySQL 和 MariaDB 车道上 `main` 一侧的 CI 问题见 #13542。

</details>

prs.title: fix(lsp): route file queries to applicable servers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Default file-scoped LSP operations select applicable ready servers before opening or synchronizing a document and issuing a query. Selection uses declared extensions or languages and the freshly resolved physical workspace location. Primary-root instances cover registered directories; explicit non-primary roots remain bounded. Explicit server selection bypasses automatic applicability and server-root selection, never workspace containment. An absent or unready server is an explicit failure.

Equivalent file URI spellings use one canonical identity for notifications, requests, lifecycle tracking, scope deferral, restart replay and signed hierarchy items. Symlink alias paths are preserved; their physical targets are checked freshly. Workspace searches omit revoked/out-of-scope file results and disclose that filtering. External navigation remains visible with authorization advice; it does not authorize another file query. Scope and scan-limit failures are explicit.

The client advertises its existing document pull-diagnostic capability. Document and workspace diagnostic RPC failures or invalid reports are explicit failures rather than clean or complete partial results. Empty-string messages are valid and retained alongside real errors. Successful workspace null is protocol-allowed; successful document null is accepted as a compatibility policy, not claimed to be a protocol-valid document report. This tolerance does not accept missing results, malformed items or RPC errors. A later successful null report does not erase an earlier server's diagnostics.

## Why it's needed

Unfiltered dispatch delivers unrelated files to servers and can contaminate analysis. Separate raw URI spellings also reopen one file multiple times and reset its version. Ignored pull failures can make malformed source appear clean; rejecting protocol-valid empty messages can conversely discard genuine errors. The repair keeps routing, identity and diagnostic success/failure semantics consistent without adding a push cache or widening workspace authorization.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With multiple language servers, ordinary file queries reach only applicable servers. Nonempty extension maps remain exclusive, while absent/empty maps retain legacy extensionless dispatch. An explicit override still cannot escape registered directories.
- Add/remove an included directory and retarget a symlink: no content or query is sent after scope loss. Regrant closes an old buffer before reopening; restart does not duplicate documents. Canonical, single-slash, uppercase-scheme and equivalent percent-encoded file URIs share one lifecycle and monotonically increasing same-connection versions.
- Prepare hierarchy with a server-echoed noncanonical URI, then traverse returned/nested items. Canonicalized signed items remain valid; scope revocation, content changes and signature tampering are refused.
- Query malformed and valid source with a matching pull-capable server. Malformed source yields actual errors; a genuine empty report remains clean. Empty messages stay alongside real diagnostics. Successful null is empty under the stated policy; unsupported pulls, invalid reports and absent/unready servers remain explicit failures. Workspace pull requires separate backend support.
- Check platform-specific path displays using the host's separators. A win32 path model is supplementary evidence, not execution on Windows.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Historical and current evidence must be separated. Previous-source final verification passed 916 unit tests with one Windows-only skip, 84 real JSON-service observations, 10 actual CLI calls using a real JSON backend plus loopback mock model, and 24 scripted workspace-peer cases on macOS/native offline Linux. R5 baseline regressions were independently reproduced on actual built service/tool over stdio; the corrected new unit regressions produced 21 failures. 

Current R5 final validation passed 937 tests with one Windows-only skip, full build/typecheck/bundle and scoped lint/format. Independent audited-final verification passed 48 actual built-service/tool checks over a scripted stdio peer, 92 native macOS tool tests (also included in the parent's 937), and three win32 path-model controls. A real TypeScript backend returned hover and published TS2322; unsupported document/workspace pulls remained explicit failures. The independent full local/connected-PR review found no issue (OK with notes). An initial 30-minute verifier timeout occurred during report output after testing and cleanup; same-protocol retained-child recovery completed the report without pretending to rerun tests. These final results are bound to the unchanged audited diff; no remote CI or maintainer approval is claimed. 

A subsequent explicitly authorized authenticated CLI follow-up used the original project's existing deepseek-flash configuration: final bundle, real remote model and shipping TypeScript backend completed five direct LSP calls in four turns with exit0. Hover and canonical signed prepare-to-incoming hierarchy succeeded; unsupported diagnostic pulls explicitly failed. Real-model peer diagnostics covered empty/real, malformed and null results, but earlier bounded peer attempts failed and their hierarchy was confounded by a /var versus /private/var fixture alias. Two credential-free out-of-fixture peer evidence reads occurred before stricter final LSP-only restrictions. Original config/credentials and source remained unchanged, artifacts scanned credential-free, resources cleaned. A scripted peer is not language analysis; no real shipping-backend empty/null pull success or Windows execution is claimed. Exact aggregate billing across failed attempts is unknown.

| R5 scenario | Before at `628b402c2` | After at `f9decd552` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Empty diagnostic message beside real errors | Whole query rejected | Empty and real messages retained |
| Successful null response | Query rejected | Empty success under the documented policy; RPC errors still fail |
| Equivalent file URI spellings | Duplicate opens/lifecycles and version resets | One canonical lifecycle, monotonic same-connection versions and one restart replay |
| Windows-style display labels | POSIX-only assertions disagree | Platform-derived expectations; actual Windows remains untested |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Final R5 tests, protocol checks and authenticated real-model CLI; Darwin 27 ARM64 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not executed; three win32 path-model controls only |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Prior-source Debian 12 ARM64 verification only; final R5 not rerun on Linux |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.2; final bundled CLI with isolated writable fixture/home/runtime. Authenticated smoke used DeepSeek `deepseek-flash`, TypeScript language server 5.0.0 and TypeScript 5.9.3, with LSP-only tool restrictions. Protocol peers and earlier loopback mock-model checks are separate evidence, not shipping-server or real-model substitutions. Evidence is headless CLI/protocol output, not TUI rendering.

## Risk & Scope

- Automatic applicability follows declared configuration; explicit extension mappings are authoritative allowlists, not additive hints. URI normalization preserves alias paths instead of unifying distinct physical symlink paths. Physical membership is always freshly checked.
- Coordination with #13128: this PR now includes document pull capability negotiation and document/workspace diagnostic failure visibility, so these changes overlap and must be reconciled when integrating that PR. Diagnostic relevance/ownership and different partial-mapping policies remain separate work.
- Breaking changes / migration: document and workspace diagnostics surface rejected pulls, invalid reports and absent/unready servers as failures. File queries reject virtual/network documents. Workspace symbols and hierarchy continuations also surface unavailable servers; workspace results are current-scope filtered. No settings schema or public result-shape changes. Successful full-empty/null responses remain successful under the contract above.
- Out of scope / limits: push-diagnostic caching, full result-ID/cache support, broader structured tool-error metadata (existing is_error:false remains), full language-server capability coverage, real F#/shell servers, comprehensive real-model/backend coverage beyond the authenticated smoke and Windows execution. Existing filesystem race and asynchronous transport limitations remain. Other previously deferred Suggestions remain deferred; this round does not expand into them.

Designs (both languages are synchronized): [routing — English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-file-routing.md) / [中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-file-routing.zh-CN.md); [disk synchronization — English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-disk-document-sync.md) / [中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-disk-document-sync.zh-CN.md); [diagnostic failures — English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-diagnostic-failures.md) / [中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-diagnostic-failures.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #13383, #12467 and #13148; repairs dispatch and pull-failure visibility without claiming to close every relevance/ownership concern. Complementary/overlapping with #13128 and #12286; does not implement #3029/#3034 push-cache fallback.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

默认文件级 LSP 操作在打开／同步文档和查询前，依据声明的扩展名或语言及新鲜解析的物理工作区位置选择适用就绪服务器。主根覆盖已注册目录，非主根保持物理边界。显式服务选择只绕过自动适用性与服务根筛选，不绕过工作区包含性。服务缺失或未就绪明确失败。

等价 file URI 拼写在通知、请求、生命周期、范围延期、重启重放和签名层级项中使用同一规范身份。保留符号链接别名路径，新鲜检查其物理目标。工作区结果省略撤销／越界文件并披露过滤。外部导航结果保留授权提示，不自动授权后续文件查询；范围和扫描超限明确失败。

客户端声明已有文档拉取诊断能力。文档／工作区诊断 RPC 失败或报告无效时明确失败，而非干净或完整部分结果。空字符串消息合法，保留并列真实错误。工作区成功 null 符合协议；文档成功 null 作为兼容策略接受，不声称符合文档报告协议。该策略不接受缺失结果、畸形条目或 RPC 错误，后续服务的成功 null 不抹掉此前诊断。

## 为什么需要

无筛选派发会把不相关文件送往服务器并污染分析；不同原始 URI 拼写会重复打开同一文件并重置版本。忽略拉取失败会使非法代码看似干净，拒绝合法空消息又会丢弃真实错误。本修复统一路由、身份和诊断成功／失败语义，不增加推送缓存或扩大工作区授权。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 多服务普通查询只到适用服务器。非空扩展名映射保持排他；缺失／空映射保留无扩展名兼容投递。显式覆盖不能越过注册目录。
- 添加／移除目录及重定向符号链接后，撤销范围不再发送内容或查询。恢复后先关闭旧缓冲再打开，重启不重复文档。规范、单斜杠、大写 scheme 和等价百分号拼写共享生命周期及同连接单调版本。
- 服务回传非规范 URI 的层级准备和嵌套遍历仍使用有效规范签名；范围撤销、内容变化和签名篡改被拒绝。
- 匹配的真实拉取后端返回非法代码的真实错误及合法代码的空报告。空消息与真实诊断一起保留。成功 null 按既定策略为空；不支持请求、畸形报告、缺失／未就绪服务明确失败。工作区拉取需要后端独立支持。
- 显示路径按宿主系统分隔符检查。win32 路径模型只是补充证据，不是 Windows 执行。

### 前后对比证据

区分历史源码与当前源码。前轮最终验证通过 916 单测、跳过一个 Windows 用例；macOS／原生离线 Linux 共 84 个真实 JSON 服务观察、10 次真实 CLI＋真实后端＋回环 mock 模型调用，以及 24 个脚本化工作区 peer 案例。R5 基线由真实已构建服务／工具和 stdio peer 独立复现；纠正后的新增回归测试产生 21 项失败。

本轮最终验证通过 937 单测、跳过一个 Windows 用例，完整构建／类型检查／打包及定向 lint／格式检查通过。独立最终验证通过 48 项真实已构建服务／工具与脚本 stdio peer 检查、92 项原生 macOS 工具测试（已包含在父会话的 937 中），以及三个 win32 路径模型对照。真实 TypeScript 后端返回 hover 并推送 TS2322，不支持的文档／工作区拉取明确失败。独立本地完整 diff／关联 PR 审查没有发现问题（OK with notes）。验证代理在完成测试和清理后的报告输出阶段触及 30 分钟上限；同协议保留子代理恢复补齐报告，不声称恢复时重新执行测试。最终结果绑定未变更的自审快照，不声称远端 CI 或维护者批准。

随后经用户明确授权，使用原项目已有 deepseek-flash 配置，最终 bundle＋真实远端模型＋真实 TypeScript 后端在四轮中完成五次直接 LSP 调用，退出0。hover 和规范签名的 prepare-to-incoming 层级链路成功；不支持的诊断拉取明确失败。真实模型与 peer 验证了空／真实消息、畸形及 null 诊断；此前达到预算的 peer 尝试失败，其层级还受 /var 与 /private/var 夹具别名干扰。早期模型读取两个无凭据的夹具外 peer 证据文件；最终采用严格仅 LSP 限制。原配置／凭据及源码未改，产物扫描无凭据，资源已清理。脚本 peer 不是语言分析，不声称真实后端空／null 拉取成功或 Windows 执行。失败尝试的完整账单未知。

| R5 场景 | 修改前 `628b402c2` | 修改后 `f9decd552` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 空诊断消息与真实错误并列 | 整个查询拒绝 | 空消息与真实错误均保留 |
| 成功 null 响应 | 查询拒绝 | 按文档契约为空成功；RPC 错误仍失败 |
| 等价 file URI 拼写 | 重复打开／生命周期，版本重置 | 同一规范生命周期、同连接单调版本，重启只重放一次 |
| Windows 风格显示路径 | POSIX-only 断言不匹配 | 平台推导期望；Windows 实机仍未执行 |

### 已验证平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 最终 R5 测试、协议检查及认证真实模型 CLI；Darwin 27 ARM64 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未执行；仅三个 win32 路径模型对照 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 仅此前源码的 Debian 12 ARM64 验证；最终 R5 未在 Linux 重跑 |

### 环境

Node.js 22.23.2；最终 CLI bundle，隔离的可写夹具／HOME／runtime。认证 smoke 使用 DeepSeek `deepseek-flash`、TypeScript language server 5.0.0 和 TypeScript 5.9.3，并严格限制仅 LSP 工具。协议 peer 与此前回环 mock 模型检查是独立证据，不替代真实后端或真实模型。证据来自无界面 CLI／协议输出，不是 TUI 渲染。

## 风险与范围

- 自动适用性遵循声明配置，显式映射是权威的完整 allowlist，不是增量提示。URI 规范化保留别名路径，不合并不同物理符号链接路径；物理范围始终新鲜检查。
- 与 #13128 协调：本 PR 已包含文档拉取能力协商及文档／工作区诊断失败可见性，整合时需协调重叠实现。诊断 relevance／ownership 和不同部分映射策略仍是独立工作。
- 破坏性变化：诊断拒绝的拉取、无效报告、缺失／未就绪服务明确失败；文件查询拒绝虚拟／网络文档。工作区符号和层级续查也报告服务不可用，工作区结果过滤当前范围。没有设置 schema 或公开结果类型变化；成功空／null 响应按上述契约成功。
- 范围外／限制：推送缓存、完整 result-ID／cache 支持、更广泛结构化工具错误元数据（既有 is_error:false 不变）、完整后端覆盖、真实 F#／shell、超出认证 smoke 的全面真实模型／后端覆盖和 Windows 执行。文件系统竞态及异步传输限制不变。其他已延后建议继续延后，本轮不扩展处理。

设计文档（两种语言同步完整）：[路由 — English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-file-routing.md)／[中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-file-routing.zh-CN.md)；[磁盘同步 — English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-disk-document-sync.md)／[中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-disk-document-sync.zh-CN.md)；[诊断失败 — English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-diagnostic-failures.md)／[中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/f9decd55205bcce03c00f091fbe93a2fe3219cc8/docs/design/lsp-diagnostic-failures.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #13383、#12467、#13148；修复派发及拉取失败可见性，不声称关闭所有 relevance／ownership 议题。与 #13128、#12286 互补且存在重叠，不实现 #3029／#3034 推送缓存。

prs.title: fix(channels): preserve Markdown structure when splitting messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

DingTalk replies, proactive messages and ordinary-message fallbacks, together with WeCom Markdown messages, now split near a 3,800-unit target at Markdown structure boundaries. Complete links, tables and code blocks may exceed that target up to a 20,000-unit application ceiling. Oversized tables repeat headers; oversized code blocks close and reopen their fences; indivisible oversized elements are explicitly sent as plain-text code fragments without losing their content.

DingTalk measures UTF-16 units and WeCom measures UTF-8 bytes, including source labels, mentions and generated delimiters. DingTalk proactive messages additionally check the actual serialized JSON payload, including the title and escaped content, against 15,000 UTF-8 bytes. Delivery order and retry behavior remain unchanged. Regression data is fully synthetic: reserved example-domain URLs, fictional regions/document identifiers and generated citation metadata, with an allowlist assertion covering the fixture.

## Why it's needed

Fixed-length cuts can break percent-encoded citation links and detach table rows from their headers. Simply increasing the cutoff would also combine messages that should remain split. Structure-aware splitting preserves formatting while continuing to send multiple messages near the normal target.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Send the synthetic knowledge-search fixture through the covered DingTalk and WeCom paths. Expect multiple messages retaining all 12 exact synthetic URLs, both tables and all six data rows. The sixth and tenth links must remain intact, and the fifth row must stay in a table with a header.
2. Check paragraphs and headings around 3,800, complete structures between 3,800 and 20,000, and oversized tables, code, links and Unicode text. Expect intact structures where possible, repeated headers or closed/reopened fences where needed, and a visible plain-text fallback for an indivisible oversized element.
3. Include Chinese, emoji, source labels and mentions. Each actual payload, including all prefixes and generated delimiters, must fit its channel's 20,000-unit budget. A failed send must resume at the first unsent message.
4. Verify acceptance and rendering on actual DingTalk and WeCom test recipients, including messages above 3,800 and near 20,000. DingTalk proactive payloads should also be checked near their 15,000-byte JSON budget. Real-platform acceptance remains pending.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On the fully synthetic fixture, the previous DingTalk splitter produced only 10 parseable links out of 12; the previous WeCom splitter retained only five table data rows out of six. The updated built adapters preserve all 12 links, both tables and all six rows: three messages for DingTalk and four for WeCom with a source label.

662 related unit tests and 18 independent built-adapter send cases passed. Full build, typecheck, lint and formatting checks passed. Independent verification captures HTTP/SDK payloads in memory and parses/renders every message locally; it does not send messages to the platforms or establish platform acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ Local tests and build |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Node.js 22.17.0, built local CLI 0.25.0. Tests use built channel adapters and an independent Markdown renderer.

## Risk & Scope

- Known performance follow-up: very large GFM tables still parse synchronously; the short-message fast path and recursive-container depth bound are restored, but off-loop handling remains pending maintainer judgment.
- Main risk or tradeoff: preserving a complete structure can exceed the normal target. The 20,000 ceiling is an application budget, not a verified limit for every platform endpoint.
- Not validated / out of scope: real-platform acceptance/rendering, channel startup/authentication, inbound routing and live model-to-channel conversations. Interactive status cards, personal Weixin and media delivery are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new configuration or migration. An indivisible oversized link remains complete as plain text but cannot remain clickable across messages. Existing send error handling is preserved.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/markdown-message-chunks/docs/design/markdown-message-chunks.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/markdown-message-chunks/docs/design/markdown-message-chunks.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动内容

钉钉普通回复、主动推送、普通消息回退及企业微信 Markdown 消息现在优先在 Markdown 结构边界附近分段，常规目标为 3,800。完整链接、表格或代码块允许超过目标，但不得超过 20,000 的应用预算上限。超长表格重复表头，超长代码闭合并重开围栏，单个不可拆的超限元素会明确提示并转为纯文本代码片段，保留全部内容。

钉钉按 UTF-16 单元计量，企业微信按 UTF-8 字节计量；来源标签、@ 前缀及生成标记均计入预算。钉钉主动消息还单独检查实际序列化 JSON 载荷（含标题和转义内容）不超过 15,000 个 UTF-8 字节。保持发送顺序与重试行为。回归数据完全合成，使用保留的示例域名、虚构区域和文档标识、生成的引用元数据，并通过允许列表断言检查样本。

## 为什么需要

固定长度切分可能切断百分号编码引用链接，或使表格行脱离表头。单纯提高阈值又会把本应分段的消息合并为一条。按结构分段可以保留格式，同时继续在常规目标附近发送多条消息。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 通过覆盖的钉钉和企业微信路径发送合成知识检索样本。预期发送多条消息，原样保留 12 个合成 URL、两张表格和六个数据行。第六和第十个链接完整，第五个数据行仍在有表头的表格中。
2. 验证接近 3,800 的段落与标题、介于 3,800 和 20,000 的完整结构，以及超长表格、代码、链接和 Unicode 文本。能容纳的结构应保持完整，必要时重复表头或闭合并重开围栏，单个超限不可拆元素应显示纯文本降级提示。
3. 加入中文、emoji、来源标签和 @ 前缀。每条实际载荷连同前缀及生成标记均不得超过对应通道 20,000 的预算。发送失败后应从首条未发送消息恢复。
4. 使用真实钉钉和企业微信接收会话验证消息是否被接受且正确渲染，包括超过 3,800 及接近 20,000 的情况。钉钉主动消息还应验证接近 15,000 字节 JSON 预算的情况。真实平台验收仍待执行。

### 修复前后证据

对完全合成的样本，旧钉钉分段器只能解析出 12 个链接中的 10 个；旧企业微信分段器只保留六个表格数据行中的五个。修复后的构建产物保留全部 12 个链接、两张表格和六行数据：钉钉三条消息，带来源的企业微信四条消息。

662 个相关单元测试和 18 个独立构建产物发送案例通过。完整 build、typecheck、lint 和格式检查通过。独立验证在内存捕获 HTTP/SDK 载荷并逐条本地解析、渲染，不向平台发送消息，也不能证明平台接收结果。

### 已测试系统

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ 本地测试与构建 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

Node.js 22.17.0，本地构建 CLI 0.25.0。测试使用已构建的通道适配器和独立 Markdown 渲染器。

## 风险与范围

- 已知性能后续事项：超大 GFM 表格仍同步解析。已恢复短消息快速返回并限制容器递归深度，移出事件循环的处理仍待维护者判断。
- 主要风险或权衡：为保留完整结构，单条消息可能超过常规目标。20,000 是应用预算，尚未证明所有平台端点都接受该长度。
- 未验证或范围之外：真实平台接收与渲染、通道启动与认证、入站路由、真实模型到通道的完整对话。交互状态卡片、个人微信及媒体发送保持不变。
- 兼容性与迁移：不增加配置，无需迁移。超长不可拆链接以纯文本完整保留，但不能跨消息保持可点击状态。保持现有发送错误处理。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/markdown-message-chunks/docs/design/markdown-message-chunks.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/markdown-message-chunks/docs/design/markdown-message-chunks.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): read comma-grouped test counts in review test-plan
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The `/review` Test Plan check now reads comma-grouped thousands in test counts: "2,239 passed" is understood as 2239, both when extracting count claims from a PR's Test Plan and when parsing the pass counts that test runners printed. Grouped and ungrouped spellings of the same number compare equal.

## Why it's needed

The claim patterns anchored on `\b(\d+)`, and a word boundary exists between a comma and the digit after it, so "2,239 passed" matched as "239 passed"; the count parser then read only the first digit group. A PR whose Test Plan stated the real count got a false "239 passed / differs" note on its review — this actually happened on #12250, where the bot review carried "Test Plan (not a blocker): `239 passed`" for a description that said "2,239 passed". The comparison is advisory and never blocks, but a false note erodes trust in every real one.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Unit: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/test-plan.test.ts` — 102/102 pass, including new cases for `2,239 passed`, `expect 1,234 tests to pass`, `Tests: 12,345 passed`, a malformed grouping (`1,23 passed`) yielding no claim, a grouped count in a runner's failed segment, and a grouped claim comparing `reproduces` against an ungrouped observed count.
- E2E against the real instance: run `qwen review test-plan` for PR #12250 (whose Test Plan says "2,239 passed") with a build-test report observing 2239. Before: claim `239 passed`, verdict `differs`. After: claim `2,239 passed`, verdict `reproduces`, observed `2239 passed`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Extraction behavior on the pre-fix code (`5ddd43815b`):

```text
"2,239 passed"               → claim "239 passed"        → 239
"expect 1,234 tests to pass" → claim "234 tests to pass" → 234
"Tests: 12,345 passed"       → claim "345 passed"        → 345
```

After this PR, the same three read 2239 / 1234 / 12345, and the #12250-shaped run reports `reproduces` instead of `differs`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

The change is platform-independent regular-expression logic; CI covers Windows and Linux.

### Environment (optional)

Local `node dist/cli.js` bundle built from this branch for the E2E verification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the runner-output parser deliberately accepts grouped numbers without the mid-group lookbehind, because jest's `,` is also a segment separator (`Tests: 1 failed, 2,239 passed, 2,240 total`); ambiguity between a separator and a grouping comma is resolved by the trailing `\s+passed` anchor and covered by new tests.
- Not validated / out of scope: group separators other than the comma (e.g. space-grouped `1 234`) remain unread, matching the issue's scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the verdicts this check emits are advisory (`reproduces` / `differs` / `unchecked`) and never block a review.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13735

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

`/review` 的 Test Plan 检查现在能读懂带千分位分隔符的测试数:「2,239 passed」会被理解为 2239——无论是对 PR 测试计划里计数声明的提取,还是对测试运行器输出的通过数解析。同一个数字的分组与未分组写法比对相等。

## 为什么需要

声明匹配模式锚在 `\b(\d+)` 上,而逗号与其后数字之间存在单词边界,因此「2,239 passed」被匹配成「239 passed」;计数解析又只读取第一段数字。测试计划写了真实数字的 PR 会在评审里收到一条误报「239 passed / differs」——这在 #12250 上真实发生过:描述写的是「2,239 passed」,bot 评审却写了「Test Plan (not a blocker): `239 passed`」。该比对只是提示、从不阻塞评审,但误报会消耗读者对每一条真实提示的信任。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 单元测试:`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/test-plan.test.ts` —— 102/102 通过,新增用例覆盖 `2,239 passed`、`expect 1,234 tests to pass`、`Tests: 12,345 passed`、畸形分组(`1,23 passed`)不产生声明、运行器 failed 段中的分组计数,以及分组声明与未分组观测比对为 `reproduces`。
- 针对真实实例的 E2E:对 PR #12250(其测试计划写的是「2,239 passed」)运行 `qwen review test-plan`,观测计数为 2239。修复前:claim `239 passed`、判定 `differs`;修复后:claim `2,239 passed`、判定 `reproduces`、观测 `2239 passed`。

### 证据(前后对比)

修复前代码(`5ddd43815b`)的提取行为见上方英文区的三段示例;修复后三种写法分别读作 2239 / 1234 / 12345,#12250 形态的运行报告 `reproduces` 而非 `differs`。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅;Windows / Linux ⚠️(改动为平台无关的正则逻辑,CI 覆盖这两个平台)。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍:运行器输出解析器特意接受分组数字且不加分组中间 lookbehind,因为 jest 的 `,` 同时是段分隔符(`Tests: 1 failed, 2,239 passed, 2,240 total`);分隔符与分组逗号之间的歧义由结尾的 `\s+passed` 锚点消解,并有新增测试覆盖。
- 未验证/超出范围:逗号以外的分组符(如空格分组 `1 234`)仍不识别,与 issue 范围一致。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:无——该检查输出的判定均为提示性质(`reproduces` / `differs` / `unchecked`),从不阻塞评审。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #13735。
</details>

prs.title: feat(core): gate AutoSkill reviews on experience signals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

AutoSkill reviews use accepted experience instead of raw tool volume. A review becomes eligible after at least five accepted completed calls with same-tool failure/recovery or an accepted mid-turn user steer, or after at least twenty accepted completed calls with substantive work. Read-only exploration alone no longer qualifies.

Completion accounting uses structured execution outcomes and request-owned history acceptance. It excludes denied, unstarted, cancelled and dropped results, prevents duplicate counting and parallel sibling successes from manufacturing recovery, and preserves signals across compression. Review dispatch consumes its window; an in-flight review retains newly accumulated work. Local skill-modification protection remains active even when a PostToolUse hook stops the result after the file was changed.

AutoSkill remains opt-in. Confirmation, managed-skill write restrictions and memory-pressure checks remain unchanged. No settings, dependencies or shell lifecycle changes are introduced. ACP receives accounting compatibility without adding AutoSkill scheduling to its existing activation scope.

## Why it's needed

The count-only trigger spends a review on long read-only exploration but misses short debugging sessions and accepted user corrections. This change directs review opportunities toward observable experience while retaining a substantive-work backstop. It improves eligibility and timing; it does not claim improved skill quality or a measured overall token-cost reduction.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Enable AutoSkill without persistence confirmation in an isolated test project. Complete twenty-one distinct read-only calls and confirm no review is dispatched.
- Fail a read and then complete successful reads through the same tool. Four total calls should not trigger a review; five should. A failed read followed only by another tool's successes should not qualify as recovery.
- Complete twenty distinct shell executions and confirm the substantive-work backstop still schedules a review. Disable AutoSkill and confirm neither path dispatches a review.
- Queue a user correction while a turn is running after four tool completions. Confirm it appears in the model input and that the fifth completion permits a review. Automated teammate settlement without user input must not count as a correction.
- Let a retry-triggered review finish, then start a new turn with twenty-one read-only calls. Confirm there is still only one review across both turns.
- Confirm the review agent cannot overwrite a hand-authored skill. In a separate run, modify a project skill in the main session and confirm the current review opportunity is suppressed.
- Return one batch containing twenty distinct shell executions and a project skill write. Have a matching PostToolUse hook confirm the file already changed, then return `continue: false`. The result should remain an error, but no review should be dispatched. The allow-hook control should also suppress review after the local skill mutation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Observed real CLI/tool execution against a deterministic OpenAI-compatible provider; extractor requests were counted on the provider wire. Headless baseline used global Qwen Code 0.23.4. Fix verification used the locally built CLI. No terminal rendering was changed; interactive delivery was verified using PTY rather than screenshots or tmux.

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 21 read-only calls | 1 review | 0 reviews |
| Same-tool recovery, 4 total calls | 0 reviews | 0 reviews |
| Same-tool recovery, 5 total calls | 0 reviews | 1 review at 5 |
| Failed read, different tool succeeds | 0 reviews | 0 reviews |
| 20 distinct shell executions | 1 review | 1 review at 20 |
| AutoSkill disabled | 0 reviews | 0 reviews |
| Actual skill mutation followed by PostToolUse stop | 1 incorrect review on the pre-fix local build | 0 reviews on the fixed local build |

Additional after-change PTY checks verified accepted mid-turn steer and a two-turn fresh window. The original global version was not tested for the same mid-turn steer scenario. For the hook regression, both pre-fix and post-fix runs confirmed the actual mutation inside the hook and on disk, twenty successful shell results and one stopped skill result; the allow-hook control had zero reviews in both builds.

Focused verification passed: 654 core tests and 1,664 CLI tests, with one existing skip; build, typecheck, bundle, targeted lint/format checks and independent read-only review passed. The hook stop/allow replay, nine headless controls and two PTY controls passed against the final bundle. A separate E2E report is posted in a PR comment.

**Draft / full-check limitation:** `npm run preflight` was attempted against this exact commit in an isolated worktree. Clean/frozen install, format, lint, build and typecheck completed. The full CLI suite reported 10 failed, 40,154 passed and 191 skipped tests, plus five unhandled worker errors. The command then reached core tests and exceeded the 30-minute execution limit. The final script and bundle fast-path checks were not reached. Failure categories include timeouts, supervisor authentication, local-address attestation, user-skill discovery and temporary-directory cleanup. No base-commit comparison has been performed to attribute these failures; they are not presented as proven pre-existing issues. This PR remains Draft pending full-check triage and CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ targeted tests and CLI/PTY scenarios; ⚠️ full preflight not green |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 27.0.1, Node.js 22.23.2, local built CLI with isolated runtime artifacts and a deterministic local provider using a dummy credential. An earlier real-model connectivity-only smoke using authorized project configuration returned `SMOKE_OK` with zero tool calls; it was not rerun after the final hook fix and is not AutoSkill gate-quality evidence. Global Qwen Code auto-updated from 0.23.4 to 0.25.0 during early interactive baseline calibration; all final fix evidence uses the local build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: deterministic signals are heuristics. Shell and delegated read-only work can satisfy the substantive-work backstop; additional short-session reviews can offset savings from skipped exploration reviews. Pending results and deduplication IDs retain session-local memory. Newly accumulated evidence is intentionally preserved while an older review is running because that review's snapshot does not cover the new work.
- Not validated / out of scope: full preflight completion, Windows/Linux local execution, real-model AutoSkill quality, long-session memory pressure, E2E compression/confirmation/in-flight concurrency, and dynamic TUI/ACP hook-stop scenarios. The known macOS noncanonical `/tmp` skill-path scheduling limitation is not changed. ACP review activation and Auto Memory extraction cadence are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no user-facing settings or migration changes. Internal completion reporters now provide structured execution outcomes; all repository production consumers are updated.

The complete synchronized design is available in [English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/5c615d7d98b9e5547a92b9bd3d923c9181e66701/docs/design/auto-skill-experience-gates.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/5c615d7d98b9e5547a92b9bd3d923c9181e66701/docs/design/auto-skill-experience-gates.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9062

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

AutoSkill 评审从原始工具调用量改为依据已接受的经验：至少五次已接受的完成调用，加上同工具失败后恢复或已接受的中途用户 steer；或者至少二十次已接受的完成调用，加上实质工作。单纯只读探索不再获得资格。

完成记账使用结构化执行结果和请求所属的历史接受判定，排除被拒绝、未执行、取消和丢弃的结果，防止重复计数及并行兄弟成功制造恢复，并在压缩后保留信号。派发消耗当前窗口；已有评审运行时保留新增工作。即使 PostToolUse hook 在文件已改变后停止结果，本地 skill 修改保护也仍然有效。

AutoSkill 仍默认关闭。确认流程、managed skill 写入限制和内存压力检查保持不变。不新增设置或依赖，不改变 shell 生命周期。ACP 仅补齐记账兼容性，不在其原有启用范围中新增 AutoSkill 调度。

## 为什么需要

仅按调用量触发会为长时间只读探索消耗评审，却漏掉短调试会话和已接受的用户纠正。本改动把评审机会分配给可观察的经验，同时保留实质工作的兜底。它改善资格和时机，不宣称 skill 质量已提高，也未测量整体 token 成本下降比例。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在隔离项目中开启 AutoSkill、关闭持久化确认。完成二十一次不同的只读调用，确认不派发评审。
- 先让一次读取失败，再通过同一工具完成成功读取。累计四次不应触发，五次应触发。读取失败后仅有另一工具成功，不应视为恢复。
- 完成二十次不同的 shell 执行，确认实质工作兜底仍派发评审。关闭 AutoSkill，确认两条路径都不派发。
- 在回合运行且已有四次工具完成时排队输入用户纠正，确认它进入模型输入，第五次完成后获得评审资格。没有用户输入的自动队友结算不能算作纠正。
- 等恢复触发的评审完成，再开始一个包含二十一次只读调用的新回合，确认两个回合总共仍只有一次评审。
- 确认评审 agent 不能覆盖手写 skill。在单独的运行中，由主会话修改项目 skill，确认当前评审机会被抑制。
- 一批返回二十次不同的 shell 执行及一次项目 skill 写入。匹配的 PostToolUse hook 先确认文件已改变，再返回 `continue: false`。结果应仍为错误，但不派发评审；允许 hook 的对照组也应在本地 skill 修改后抑制评审。

### 证据（修改前后）

真实 CLI 和工具执行连接确定性的 OpenAI-compatible provider，评审请求以 provider wire 计数。Headless 基线使用全局 Qwen Code 0.23.4，修复验证使用本地构建 CLI。不改变终端渲染；交互投递通过 PTY 验证，而非截图或 tmux。

| 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 21 次只读调用 | 1 次评审 | 0 次评审 |
| 同工具恢复，累计 4 次 | 0 次评审 | 0 次评审 |
| 同工具恢复，累计 5 次 | 0 次评审 | 第 5 次时评审 1 次 |
| 读取失败、其他工具成功 | 0 次评审 | 0 次评审 |
| 20 次不同的 shell 执行 | 1 次评审 | 第 20 次时评审 1 次 |
| AutoSkill 关闭 | 0 次评审 | 0 次评审 |
| 实际 skill 修改后 PostToolUse 停止 | 修复前本地构建错误评审 1 次 | 修复后本地构建评审 0 次 |

额外的修改后 PTY 验证覆盖接受中途 steer 和跨两个回合的新窗口。未对原始全局版本测试相同的中途 steer 场景。hook 回归的修复前后均在 hook 内及磁盘上确认实际修改，并观察到二十个成功 shell 结果及一个停止的 skill 结果；允许 hook 的对照组在两个构建中均为零次评审。

定向验证通过：654 项 core 测试、1,664 项 CLI 测试，另有一项既有跳过；build、typecheck、bundle、定向 lint/格式检查和独立只读审查通过。hook 停止/允许回放、九个 headless 对照场景及两个 PTY 场景均以最终 bundle 通过。PR 下另有单独的 E2E 报告评论。

**Draft / 全量检查限制：**在此提交的隔离 worktree 中尝试了 `npm run preflight`。clean/冻结依赖安装、format、lint、build 和 typecheck 完成。CLI 全套测试报告十项失败、40,154 项通过、191 项跳过，并有五个未处理的 worker 错误。之后进入 core 测试时超过三十分钟执行限制，最终脚本测试和 bundle fast-path 检查未运行到。失败类别包括超时、supervisor 认证、本地地址证明、用户 skill 发现及临时目录清理。未对基线提交做对照，因此不将失败宣称为已证明的既有问题。此 PR 保持 Draft，等待全量失败归因与 CI。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 定向测试及 CLI/PTY 场景；⚠️ 全量 preflight 未绿 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 27.0.1、Node.js 22.23.2，本地构建 CLI，隔离运行工件，使用假凭据连接确定性的本地 provider。此前使用已授权项目配置的真实模型连通性 smoke 返回 `SMOKE_OK`，工具调用为零；最终 hook 修复后未重跑，不能作为 AutoSkill 门控质量证据。早期交互基线校准期间全局 Qwen Code 从 0.23.4 自行更新至 0.25.0，所有最终修复证据均使用本地构建。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：确定性信号只是启发式，shell 和委托的只读工作可能满足实质工作兜底；新增短会话评审可能抵消跳过探索评审的节省。待接受结果及去重 ID 占用会话内存。较早评审运行期间有意保留新增经验，因为其快照不包含新工作。
- 未验证及范围外：全量 preflight 完成、Windows/Linux 本地执行、真实模型 AutoSkill 质量、长会话内存压力、E2E 压缩/确认/运行中并发、TUI/ACP 的动态 hook 停止场景。不更改已知的 macOS 非规范 `/tmp` skill 路径调度限制。ACP 评审启用和 Auto Memory 提取频率不在范围内。
- 破坏性变更及迁移：无用户设置或迁移变更。内部完成报告现在提供结构化执行结果，仓库内全部生产消费者已更新。

完整且同步的设计：[English](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/5c615d7d98b9e5547a92b9bd3d923c9181e66701/docs/design/auto-skill-experience-gates.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/shenyankm/qwen-code/blob/5c615d7d98b9e5547a92b9bd3d923c9181e66701/docs/design/auto-skill-experience-gates.zh-CN.md)。

修复 #9062。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): Add workspace file browser and previews
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Files action to the Web Shell right panel. Before selection it shows a full-width workspace tree; selecting a file opens its content on the left and keeps the tree on the right. Users can render Markdown, HTML and images, inspect read-only source, resize or hide the tree, and retain selection, expansion, filters and scroll positions across panel tabs.

The file menu copies relative or absolute paths, downloads the file, opens a separate preview, or inserts the same file-reference tag as the composer’s `@` picker. Reference closes a floating drawer to expose the composer; the desktop dock stays open. The standalone page enables Files, and embedded hosts opt in through the existing right-panel item configuration.

## Why it's needed

The right panel can show file changes but cannot browse the workspace alongside the conversation. This adds that workflow without launching a separate editor. Directory reads retain workspace ownership and trust checks, including rejection of stale results after workspace changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the right panel and choose Files. Only the tree should appear initially; expanding a folder loads its immediate children. Select a file to reveal content beside the tree, with more initial space for content.
2. Open Markdown, HTML, an image and a source file. Markdown/HTML should render by default and offer a source toggle. Switch panel tabs and return: the selected file, source mode, expanded folders, filter and scroll positions should remain.
3. Filter loaded paths using mixed case and spaces; the input should preserve what was typed. An unmatched query should show no matches. Escape clears a nonempty filter before dismissing fullscreen/the drawer. Resize the separator with pointer or keyboard and horizontally scroll a deeply nested tree.
4. Right-click a file and check both copied paths, download, separate preview and Reference. Reference should add the composer chip without sending a prompt. On a narrow or fullscreen floating drawer it should expose and focus the composer; on desktop it should leave the dock expanded.
5. Confirm an unavailable/untrusted or replaced workspace owner cannot continue reading through an old Files tab. A stale tab must not prevent opening the currently valid workspace’s Files tab.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the right panel has no workspace browser. After: the Files entry opens the tree and preview workflow shown below. These are actual Chromium captures, with the daemon provenance stated for each image; they do not demonstrate Git operations.

Files entry in the right panel — simulated daemon.

![Files entry in the right panel — simulated daemon.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/entry.png)

Rendered Markdown beside the persistent tree — simulated daemon.

![Rendered Markdown beside the persistent tree — simulated daemon.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/markdown.png)

Read-only highlighted source beside the tree — simulated daemon.

![Read-only highlighted source beside the tree — simulated daemon.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/source.png)

430px Reference closes the drawer and exposes the chip and continued input — real daemon, no model request.

![430px Reference closes the drawer and exposes the chip and continued input — real daemon, no model request.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/drawer-reference.png)

Validation: after rebasing onto main, root build/bundle/typecheck passed, 725 focused unit tests passed (498 SDK, 160 component/entry/build-artifact, 67 App), and all 13 Files Chromium E2E cases passed with the simulated daemon. A separate real-daemon run passed four Reference layouts, with stable focus through two seconds, visible typing, actual chip clicks, zero page errors and zero model requests. The committed regression tests first failed on the original drawer behavior and then passed with the fix. Screenshot assets are isolated on the fork and pinned to a fixed commit; no images are included in the implementation branch.

CI follow-up (311df69f18): regenerated the missing dependency license notice and repaired isolated source-preview test mocks without changing production code or weakening assertions. All 423 Web Shell test files / 11,168 tests and 26 notice-generator tests pass locally; root build, bundle and post-build typecheck also pass. Existing UI captures remain representative because runtime/UI source is unchanged. The earlier triage automation exited with status 1 without a conclusive root cause in its logs; it is separate from the two reproduced and fixed code-check failures.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck, focused unit tests and Chromium browser verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested on Windows; path-format cases covered by tests |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22+, pnpm workspace, local Vite UI with the simulated daemon, plus the freshly built CLI bundle serving a real workspace without model requests. Published React 18.2 host installation/rendering and cold production lazy-loading were also verified before the main rebase; those fixtures were not rerun after the rebase.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Pierre Trees is beta and pinned. Directory filtering covers loaded paths only; this adds no whole-workspace index. Tree/source implementations load on demand. Their compatible highlighter is bundled separately from the existing host highlighter, and the published package retains its React 18/19 support range.
- Not validated / out of scope: Git state, editing, filesystem mutations, live watching and migration of the existing file-changes renderer. Pierre can later render file diffs, but current grouping, recorded snapshots/partial edits, downloads and ownership semantics must be retained; this PR records that assessment only. Full repository tests and other browser/OS combinations were not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API removal; Files is an optional right-panel item for embedded consumers. The standalone page enables it by default. Workspace-qualified SDK directory listing uses REST, including when the client’s general transport is ACP, so the response follows the existing directory-list contract.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dbb8fb574c814f96ad352853e28a9c62ec54448f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dbb8fb574c814f96ad352853e28a9c62ec54448f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 右侧拓展区新增「文件」入口。未选择文件时显示占满宽度的工作区目录树；选择后左侧展示内容、右侧保留目录树。支持 Markdown、HTML 和图片预览、只读源码、拖动列宽与隐藏目录树，切换面板页签保留选中、展开、筛选和滚动位置。

文件菜单支持复制相对或绝对路径、下载、独立预览，以及插入与输入框 `@` 选择器相同的文件引用标签。浮动抽屉中引用后关闭抽屉，露出输入框；桌面停靠面板保持展开。独立页面默认启用，嵌入宿主通过现有右侧面板配置显式开启。

## 为什么需要

右侧面板可以展示文件更改，但无法在对话旁浏览工作区。本次补齐这一流程，无需启动独立编辑器。目录读取保留工作区归属与信任校验，切换工作区后拒绝迟到结果。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开右侧面板并选择「文件」。初始应仅有目录树，展开目录读取直接子节点。选择文件后出现内容列，初始给内容分配更多空间。
2. 打开 Markdown、HTML、图片和源码文件。Markdown/HTML 默认渲染，可切换源码。切换面板页签再返回，选中文件、源码模式、展开目录、筛选和滚动位置应保留。
3. 使用大小写与空格筛选已加载路径，输入原文应保留；零匹配时明确展示无匹配。筛选非空时 Escape 优先清空筛选，不退出全屏或关闭抽屉。用鼠标或键盘调整分隔线，并横向滚动深层目录树。
4. 右键文件检查两种路径复制、下载、独立预览和引用。引用只插入标签，不发送请求；窄屏或全屏浮动抽屉应关闭并聚焦可见输入框，桌面停靠面板应保持展开。
5. 工作区不可用、不可信或归属替换后，旧文件页签不得继续读取；失效页签不得阻止重新打开当前有效工作区的文件页签。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：右侧面板没有工作区文件浏览入口。修改后：「文件」提供以下目录树与预览流程。均为实际 Chromium 截图，各图明确注明 daemon 来源，不作为 Git 操作验证。

[右侧拓展区「文件」入口，模拟 daemon。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/entry.png)

[渲染的 Markdown 与右侧目录树，模拟 daemon。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/markdown.png)

[只读高亮源码与目录树，模拟 daemon。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/source.png)

[430px 下引用后关闭抽屉，标签与继续输入可见，真实 daemon，未发送模型请求。](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/f584d9134da3377b60a89dc313a763251466a191/web-shell-files/drawer-reference.png)

验证结果：rebase 到 main 后，全量 build/bundle/typecheck 通过，725 个针对性单元测试通过（SDK 498、组件/入口/打包边界 160、App 67），模拟 daemon 下 13 个文件浏览器 Chromium E2E 全部通过。独立真实 daemon 验证四种引用布局，焦点至两秒稳定、输入可见、标签实际点击成功，零页面错误、零模型请求。已提交的回归测试先在旧抽屉行为上失败，再在修复后通过。截图独立保存在 fork 素材分支，使用固定 commit 链接，实现分支不包含图片。

CI 修复补充（311df69f18）：补齐依赖许可证清单与独立源码预览测试缺失的 mock，未修改生产代码或弱化断言。本地 Web Shell 全量 423 个测试文件／11,168 个测试，以及许可证生成器 26 个测试全部通过；根目录构建、bundle 与构建后的类型检查也通过。运行时／UI 源码未变，因此现有界面截图仍准确。此前 triage 自动分析进程以状态 1 退出，日志没有明确根因，与已复现并修复的两项代码检查失败分别记录。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、类型检查、针对性单元测试和 Chromium 浏览器验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在 Windows 上测试；测试覆盖平台路径格式 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 22+、pnpm workspace、本地 Vite UI 配合模拟 daemon，另用新构建 CLI bundle 对真实工作区验证，未发送模型请求。还在 main rebase 前验证了发布包的 React 18.2 宿主安装/渲染与生产页面冷启动按需加载；这些隔离夹具未在 rebase 后重跑。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Pierre Trees 仍为 beta，已固定版本。筛选仅覆盖已加载路径，不新增全工作区索引。目录树与源码实现按需加载；其兼容高亮器单独打包，保留现有宿主高亮器，发布包保持 React 18/19 支持范围。
- 未验证及范围外：Git 状态、编辑、文件系统修改、实时监听及现有文件更改渲染器迁移。Pierre 后续可承载 diff 展示，但须保留分组、历史快照/局部片段、下载与归属语义；本次仅记录评估。本地未跑全仓测试及其他浏览器/操作系统组合。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：未删除公开 API；嵌入使用方通过可选的右侧面板配置开启 Files，独立页面默认开启。具有工作区限定的 SDK 目录读取使用 REST，包括客户端整体采用 ACP 的情况，使返回形状遵循现有目录列表协议。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dbb8fb574c814f96ad352853e28a9c62ec54448f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dbb8fb574c814f96ad352853e28a9c62ec54448f/docs/design/web-shell-file-browser.zh-CN.md)，两版完整同步。
