prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): display declared Channel submissions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

For Channel-source sessions, use a nonblank original-text declaration as the display projection when the request has a text block and the turn has no channel-worker classification or worker display projection. Pending text, live user echoes, and durable recording use the original declaration verbatim, while the model still receives the complete prepared prompt.

Missing, invalid, empty, whitespace-only, and media-only submissions retain their content-derived display. An explicit worker projection keeps precedence, including an intentionally empty projection paired with a declaration. Add regression coverage for these boundaries and synchronize the [English design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md) and [Chinese design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

An external Channel gateway can submit model text such as `gateway instructions\nhello` and separately declare the original user text `hello` through the existing non-privileged `qwen.submittedPrompt` contract. The declaration reaches the bridge, but the user echo and transcript display the prepared wrapper. This change displays `hello` consistently without removing the instructions from model input or granting worker authority.

The declaration is a display contract, not authentication or proof of authorship. Native authenticated channel-worker history behavior and Qwen product wording remain unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Submit a prepared text prompt to a Channel-source session with a nonblank original-text declaration and no worker keys. Pending text and live user echo should match the raw declaration, including surrounding whitespace. The complete prepared prompt should still reach the model.
2. Complete the turn, stop the daemon, start a new process with the same isolated runtime, and load the session. Both load replay and transcript paging should show the declaration; persisted model content should retain the prepared text.
3. Omit the declaration or supply an invalid type, empty string, or whitespace-only string. Display should retain the prepared text. For an image-only request with a nonblank declaration, pending text should stay `[image]`, the echo should contain only the image, and private display metadata should be absent. Ordinary-source sessions should keep their original display.
4. Confirm caller-supplied private display metadata cannot select this fallback and worker-classified turns cannot acquire a declaration-based projection. An explicit worker projection should win over a declaration; an empty worker projection must still hide every text block and forward `''`.
5. Set a one-tool-call cap and use a controlled model to request another tool call from an ordinary declared Channel turn. Expect `turn_error` with `LOOP_DETECTED`, `errorKind: loop_detected`, and `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The review baseline reproduced three display regressions: an empty declaration erased the live echo and durable user display while the turn-result record retained the wrapper; whitespace-only declarations replaced the display with blank space; a media-only declaration changed pending/child display metadata without adding a live text echo.

After the correction, all ten bridge cases pass. Six real daemon text cases pass live pending/echo, durable user/turn-result recording, and cold-process load plus transcript replay: 18 assertions. A separate real loop-cap assertion also passes, for 19 daemon assertions total. Every complete prepared text was observed in the mock model request and persisted intact. The worker-empty-projection control passes normally and fails an actually executed isolated `??` to `||` mutation.

Local quality checks passed: all 2,639 ACP Bridge package tests, repository typecheck, changed-file lint and Prettier checks, build, and bundle. Independent read-only review found no actionable issue. Test reports and artifact fingerprints are retained locally under `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` and `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`; these ignored artifacts are not included in the PR. This is protocol/recording evidence, not a browser screenshot or deployed gateway acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local quality checks and real daemon with a mock model |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, and the rebuilt `node dist/cli.js`. The runtime test used synthetic prompts, isolated workspace/home/runtime directories, port-0 listeners, and a local mock OpenAI endpoint. The global `qwen` command was unavailable, so verification used the local bundle. Both daemon processes and the mock endpoint were stopped. CI for the newly pushed source revision must complete separately; earlier revisions do not validate this update.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an eligible Channel caller can choose the declared display text; that text does not authenticate the caller or prove human authorship. The model still sees the full prepared prompt.
- Not validated / out of scope: external gateway integration, real provider behavior, browser rendering, historical record rewriting, and deployment. Preexisting submission-provenance forwarding remains unchanged; Session already omits blank provenance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new API or privileged flag. Gateway producers must explicitly declare nonblank original text beside a text-bearing prompt and omit worker classification, authorization, and private display keys to use the existing non-privileged route.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13747.

## 此 PR 的改动

对于 Channel 来源会话，当请求包含文本块、当前回合没有 channel-worker 分类或 worker 显示投影时，将非空白原文声明用于显示投影。排队文本、实时用户回显和持久录制完整保留该声明，模型仍收到完整准备后的 prompt。

外部 Channel 网关可提交 `gateway instructions\nhello` 这样的模型文本，并通过既有非特权 `qwen.submittedPrompt` 契约单独声明用户原文 `hello`。声明已经到达 bridge，但用户回显和记录仍显示准备后的包装文本。本改动将展示统一为 `hello`，同时保留交给模型的指令，也不授予 worker 权限。

声明属于展示契约，不是认证，也不证明作者身份。原生授权 channel-worker 的历史展示行为和 Qwen 产品文案保持不变。

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 向 Channel 来源会话提交准备后的文本 prompt 与非空白原文声明，省略所有 worker 键。排队文本和实时用户回显应完整保留声明及其空白，模型仍应收到完整准备后的 prompt。
2. 完成回合后退出 daemon，以相同隔离 runtime 启动新进程并加载会话。load 重放与 transcript 分页都应显示声明，持久模型内容仍应保留准备后的文本。
3. 省略声明，或提供非法类型、空串、纯空白字符串，显示应保留准备后的文本。纯图片请求即使带有非空白声明，排队文本仍应为 `[image]`，回显只包含图片，且不附加私有显示元数据。普通来源会话保留原有展示。
4. 确认调用方自报的私有显示字段不能选择此回退，已分类的 worker 回合也不能取得声明投影。显式 worker 投影应优先于声明；空 worker 投影仍须隐藏所有文本块，并转发 `''`。
5. 设置单回合工具调用上限为一次，让受控模型在普通声明 Channel 回合继续请求工具调用。预期收到 `turn_error`，包含 `LOOP_DETECTED`、`errorKind: loop_detected` 和 `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`。

### 证据（修改前后）

评审基线复现了三项展示回归：空声明隐藏实时回显和持久用户展示，但回合结果记录仍保留包装文本；纯空白声明将展示替换为空白；纯附件声明改变排队项和子进程显示元数据，却没有增加实时文本回显。

修正后，十项 bridge 场景全部通过。六项真实 daemon 文本场景通过实时排队与回显、持久用户与回合结果录制、冷进程 load 与 transcript 重放，共十八项断言；独立执行的真实工具调用上限断言也通过，daemon 共十九项断言。模拟模型实际请求和持久记录都完整保留了准备后的文本。空 worker 投影控制用例正常通过，实际执行隔离的 `??` 改为 `||` 变异后则失败。

本地质量检查通过：ACP Bridge 包全部 2,639 项测试、仓库类型检查、改动文件 lint 与 Prettier 检查、构建及打包。独立只读评审未发现可行动问题。测试报告及制品指纹保留在本地 `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` 和 `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`，这些被忽略的制品不包含在 PR 中。上述属于协议与录制证据，不代表浏览器截图或已部署网关验收。

| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地质量检查与使用模拟模型的真实 daemon 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |

### 环境

Node 22.23.1、固定版本 pnpm 11.24.0，以及重新构建的 `node dist/cli.js`。运行时测试使用合成消息、隔离的 workspace/home/runtime 目录、自动分配端口的监听及本地模拟 OpenAI 服务。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，因此使用本地 bundle 验证。两个 daemon 进程和模拟服务均已停止。新推送 source revision 的 CI 须单独完成，旧 revision 的结果不能验证本次更新。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：符合条件的 Channel 调用方可选择声明的显示文本；该文本不认证调用方，也不证明内容由人撰写。模型仍会收到完整准备后的 prompt。
- 未验证或不在范围内：外部网关集成、真实 provider 行为、浏览器渲染、历史记录改写及部署。已有提交来源转发保持不变，Session 已经会省略空白来源。
- 兼容性与迁移：不新增 API 或特权标记。网关生产方须在包含文本的 prompt 之外显式声明非空白原文，并省略 worker 分类、授权和私有显示键，才能使用既有非特权路由。

prs.title: fix(sdk-java): Close Hosted Harness review criticals from #12654
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR lands the fixes for the 11 Critical and 2 Minor findings from the post-merge review of #12654 (the Hosted Harness private Java client), **plus the closures for the second review round filed against this PR itself**. #12654 merged before its review round was processed (all 62 threads were still open); every finding in scope was re-verified against current `main` before fixing. The remaining 49 Suggestion-level findings from the #12654 round are dispositioned in their threads and tracked as a backlog in #13313; #13313 also tracks the deferred remainder of this PR's own review round.

### Second round (addressing the CHANGES_REQUESTED review of this PR)

The second round execution-proved one real regression in the first commit — CI's fault-gates lane agreed — and five more critical defects around it:

- **Wire/digest mismatch (CI-confirmed)**: the digest was canonicalized but the wire `prompt` member was not, and the hosted route re-derives the digest from the received bytes — every `addText` submission drew `400 invalid_hosted_prompt`. `toJson()` now emits the canonical form, the digest reuses the `JsonSupport.encode` facade over that same value (one serialization entry point), and the pinning test asserts the wire bytes and the digest are literally the same value (byte-literal expectation plus the canonical digest constant).
- **Idle watchdog vs. silent hosted route**: the 45s bound was inherited from the stdio transport, whose server writes heartbeat comments; the hosted events route wrote nothing while no event was committed, so healthy silent streams — long tool calls, slow model phases, the ten-minute approval wait — were aborted and re-dispatched forever. The hosted route now mirrors the primary route's keepalive comment every 15s, and `Builder.sseIdleTimeout` accepts `Duration.ZERO` for callers that own the deadline. A new test keeps a consumer parked in `next()` for three idle budgets while the peer stays alive on keepalive comments alone; the pre-existing idle-timeout test still goes red when the watchdog is removed.
- **Idle abort surfaced outside the `DaemonException` family**: when the watchdog fired while the consumer was between `next()` calls, the closed guard threw `IllegalStateException`, contradicting the new javadoc and invisible to consumers classifying by `DaemonException`. The guard now distinguishes who closed the stream: idle abort → `DaemonTransportException('Hosted Harness SSE idle timeout')`, caller close → `IllegalStateException`.
- **Executor-rejection overreach**: the cause-chain scan certified any rejection-shaped `IOException` as "never dispatched", but response delivery also runs on the caller-supplied executor — a rejection surfacing after the server accepted a turn dropped the active-prompt marker for an admitted turn and reported it definitively not submitted. Now only a bare `RejectedExecutionException` (submit time) or a rejection with the executor already shut down classifies as saturated/known; mid-flight shapes stay outcome-unknown and keep the marker. This is pinned deterministically by staging a parked worker + a full queue + a delayed 202 answer through a package-private executor seam.
- **Boot-headerless 4xx misclassified as outcome-unknown**: the missing-header wrap treated the server's own pre-middleware refusals (413 body-too-large, 429) the same as a gateway's error page. All four mutation sites now re-derive: ambiguous (408/5xx) keeps outcome-unknown; a definitive unfenced refusal surfaces as `DaemonHttpException` with its status preserved.
- **Folded-in adjacent closures**: `detachSession` retires the local attachment on every definitive answer (not just 204/404), so a 403 after an auth revocation no longer leaks a heartbeat timer; a caller queued on `cursorLock` when the stream closes re-checks inside the lock and gets the closed-stream signal instead of a transport error; the `session_snapshot` comment now names the actual producer (the bridge's `withSnapshot` on the **primary** events route — the hosted route ignores the query parameter and stamps every frame with an id); the builder javadoc records the cursor-fallback precedence and that `snapshot(true)` is a primary-transport option; the README retry section and both design-doc languages now state the canonical digest as a cross-language wire contract and record that changing the digest algorithm requires quiescing (or rewriting) in-flight turn rows before upgrading; and two previously unpinned arms (an explicit cursor beating the ref watermark, and a definitive boot-headerless DELETE) got their own discriminating tests.

### First round (post-merge review of #12654)

- Stream lifecycle: `HarnessEventStream` no longer parks `close()` behind a consumer blocked in `next()` — the closed flag is atomic and the raw input is closed without any stream monitor, so `HostedHarnessClient.close()` always completes and a blocked `next()` fails with `DaemonTransportException` (the idle watchdog above completes this picture).
- Turn ledger correctness: a 409 rejection no longer retains an uncloseable marker keyed by the rejected promptId (it releases the slot and throws `PromptAlreadyActiveException`); a definitive non-409 failure on a same-identity retry releases the slot it retained for that retry; and `getStatus()` snapshots the active-prompt entry before the remote read and only ever removes that exact registration, so a stale `hasActivePrompt:false` can no longer delete a different prompt admitted while the read was in flight.
- Outcome classification (first-cut form, narrowed in the second round — see above): a response missing the `X-Qwen-Harness-Boot-Id` fence header on a mutation path is classified as outcome-unknown instead of a bare `DaemonProtocolException`, because a response that never passed the fencing middleware cannot prove the mutation did not execute; and a purely local executor rejection surfaces as `DaemonTransportException` instead of claiming the request may have reached the server.
- Lifecycle cleanup: `closeSession(HarnessSessionRef)` treats a definitive 404 as already-done and tears down the attachment and the active-prompt ledger, and `detachSession` tolerates 404 the same way for the attachment (it does not clear the active-prompt ledger — that asymmetry stays, tracked in #13313), so the heartbeat timer no longer keeps posting to a session the server has already reclaimed.
- Protocol interop: `streamEvents` falls back to the session ref's validated watermark when the builder omits the resume pair, so the epoch fence the README promises is actually enforced (and `Last-Event-ID` resumes from the ref's cursor), while a ref carrying no watermark keeps today's unfenced fresh-stream shape; and the shared SSE parser accepts the id-less synthetic `session_snapshot` frame produced by the primary transport's snapshot subscription.
- Digest and model invariants: `computePayloadDigest` hashes a canonical form (object keys sorted recursively, array order preserved) instead of process-random `Map` iteration order, so the dedup key is reproducible across JVMs and across map implementations (fastjson2's `MapSortField` was ruled out by probe: it does not sort maps nested inside a collection); and `HarnessRuntimeExecutionRecovery` enforces at construction that a `known` outcome carries its status map, instead of NPE-ing later inside `isContinuationReady()`.

Every finding is pinned by new tests whose mutation witnesses were run: reverting that finding's fix turns its test red (witness tables under "How to verify").

## Why it's needed

The Hosted Harness client is the Java control-plane transport for the private hosted profile, and its public contract promises fail-closed behaviour (bounded resources, outcome-unknown classification, single active prompt per session, epoch-fenced resume). The first review demonstrated each of these promises had a concrete violation; the second review then execution-proved that the first round's own fixes carried one cross-language regression (CI agreed) and four more fail-closed violations of the same class, in exactly the surfaces the stubs cannot see (the server re-deriving the digest, the hosted route's silence, the executor's dual dispatch/delivery role, and the closed guard's type). Working through both rounds before merge is cheaper than shipping the client with a broken prompt path and correcting it afterwards.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The behaviors are pinned by 23 new cases in `HostedHarnessClientTest`. Run:

```
cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode
mvn -o test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest     # 42 tests (19 pre-existing + 23 new)
mvn -o test                                    # full module: 189 tests, 9 env-gated skips
cd ../cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts   # 181 tests
```

All green locally on JDK 17; `clean test` green on JDK 11 (module targets release 11; two executor-rejection cases skip themselves on JDK 11, whose `HttpClient` parks a send to a struggling executor instead of surfacing the rejection — probed on 11/17/21).

Mutation witnesses, first round (revert the fix → the pinning test goes red):

| Fix | Reverted shape | Mutant result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 (null guard) | drop `requireNonNull(status)` for `known` outcomes | RED |
| R1-6 (digest order) | hash raw `promptContent` again | RED |
| R1-4 (stale getStatus) | unconditional `activePrompts.remove(key)` | RED |
| R1-2 + F2 (409 / retry slot) | restore retain-on-409 / retry-keeps-slot | RED (both tests) |
| R1-5 ×3 sites | bare `validateGeneration` | RED ×3 |
| R1-3 (close 404) | tolerance limited to `clientId == null` | RED |
| R1-46 (detach 404) | detach requires 204 unconditionally | RED |
| R1-47 (snapshot frame) | `session_snapshot` out of the id-less set | RED |
| R1-44 (ref watermark) | fence/cursor from the request only | RED |
| R1-1 (shared monitor) | `next()`/`close()` on one monitor again | RED (timeout arms the hang) |
| R1-43 (watchdog) | watchdog disabled | RED (timeout arms the hang) |
| R1-45 (rejection type) | wrap as `IOException` again | RED |

Mutation witnesses, second round:

| Fix | Reverted shape | Mutant result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wire = digest | `toJson()` emits the raw list again | RED (byte-literal asserts the type-first wire) |
| Idle-abort type | closed guard always `IllegalStateException` | RED |
| In-lock re-check | queued caller never re-checks | RED |
| Rejection gate | unbounded cause walk again | RED (mid-flight rejection certified as saturated) |
| Boot-header narrow ×2 | blanket outcome-unknown at the prompt and DELETE sites | RED ×2 |
| Detach finally | cleanup after `requireMutationStatus` only | RED (heartbeats keep beating) |
| Watchdog/keepalive pair | watchdog removed | RED on the idle case, GREEN on the keepalive case |
| Explicit cursor wins | ref-only resume fallback | RED |

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI protocol/transport fix; the mutation tables above are the before/after. CI's `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` lane was green at the merge base and red at the first commit — it is the integration-level evidence for the wire/digest regression and should return to green on this head.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A (CI) |

### Environment (optional)

Local: `JAVA_HOME=jdk17` (full suite) and `jdk11` (`mvn clean test`), Maven 3.9.11, in `packages/sdk-java/qwencode`; `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts` in `packages/cli`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the payload digest is now a canonical cross-language contract — digests computed by the previous release differ for the same content, which is the point of the fix (old values were JVM-random and could never be reproduced across processes). The design doc (both languages) now records that an upgrade altering the digest must quiesce or rewrite in-flight turn rows first; the coordinator-side one-time recompute fallback is deliberately not in this slice (it lives in the managed-agent-server module and is tracked in #13313). Consumers blocked in `next()` now also see `DaemonTransportException` on an idle abort — including the between-calls arm, which previously surfaced as `IllegalStateException`.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 49 Suggestion-level findings from the #12654 round (tracked in #13313). From this PR's own round: the code-carrying `Prompt*` exception redesign for per-`code` marker rules (needs route-semantics-level API work, tracked with the verified gate-order table), the coordinator's missing terminal escape for post-admission outcome-unknown (managed-agent-server slice, tracked), the remaining witness-table coverage items (three of six addressed here), and pinning the JDK-11 executor behavior rather than skipping it (the 11/17/21 difference is now disclosed in the tests, the builder javadoc, and the design doc). `closeSession(String)` still lacks its `ensureOpen()` guard (#13313's R1-50): the post-close executor-rejection test deliberately routes through that path on JDK 17+ and documents the coupling.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: digest change as above; `submitTurn` on a 409 now throws `PromptAlreadyActiveException` instead of `DaemonHttpException`; definitive unfenced 4xx on mutation paths now throw `DaemonHttpException` carrying the status instead of outcome-unknown types; `submitTurn`'s `toJson()` now emits key-sorted content blocks (the server accepts them — it validates shape and re-derives the digest).

## Linked Issues

Refs #12654 (post-merge review findings fixed here) and #13313 (backlog of the deferred remainder from both rounds).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 落地了 #12654(Hosted Harness 私有 Java 客户端)合入后评审的 11 条 Critical 与 2 条 Minor 修复,**以及针对本 PR 自身第二轮评审的闭环**。#12654 在评审处理前已合入(62 条 thread 全部开放);范围内每条发现都在当前 `main` 上重新核实后才修复。其余 49 条 Suggestion 级发现在各自 thread 中给出处置并汇总进 #13313;#13313 同时跟踪本 PR 评审轮次中推迟的剩余项。

### 第二轮(针对本 PR 的 CHANGES_REQUESTED 评审)

第二轮用执行证明了首个提交中的一处真回归——CI 的 fault-gates 车道结论一致——以及围绕它的另外 5 个关键缺陷:

- **线上字节与 digest 不一致(CI 实测确认)**:digest 被规范化而线上 `prompt` 字段没有,hosted 路由又按收到的字节重算 digest——每个 `addText` 提交都拿到 `400 invalid_hosted_prompt`。`toJson()` 现在输出规范形式,digest 经 `JsonSupport.encode` 门面处理同一个值(唯一序列化入口),钉住测试断言线上字节与 digest 是字面相等的同一个值(字节字面量断言 + 规范 digest 常量)。
- **空闲看门狗与静默 hosted 路由**:45s 上界继承自 stdio 传输,那一侧服务端每 15s 写心跳注释;hosted 事件路由在无新事件提交时一个字节都不写,于是健康的静默流——长工具调用、慢模型阶段、十分钟审批等待——被中止并无限重派。hosted 路由现在以与主路由相同的方式每 15s 写一次 keepalive 注释,且 `Builder.sseIdleTimeout` 接受 `Duration.ZERO` 供自管期限的调用方关闭。新测试让消费者停在 `next()` 里跨三个空闲预算、对端仅靠 keepalive 存活;既有空闲超时用例在移除看门狗后仍变红。
- **空闲中止的异常类型不属于 `DaemonException` 家族**:看门狗在消费者处于两次 `next()` 之间触发时, closed 守卫抛 `IllegalStateException`,与新增 javadoc 矛盾、且按 `DaemonException` 分类的消费者捕不到。守卫现在区分关闭由谁发起:空闲中止 → `DaemonTransportException('Hosted Harness SSE idle timeout')`,调用方主动 close → `IllegalStateException`。
- **执行器拒绝分类越界**:cause 链扫描把任何"拒绝形状"的 `IOException` 都认证为"从未派发",但响应投递也运行在调用方提供的执行器上——在服务端已受理之后才出现的拒绝,会把一个已被 admit 的轮次的活跃标记丢掉并报告为"确定未提交"。现在只有原始 `RejectedExecutionException`(提交时)或执行器已终止两种情形归为饱和/已知;中途形状一律保持 outcome-unknown 并保留标记。通过包级执行器测试缝以"停住 worker + 填满队列 + 延迟应答 202"的方式确定性钉住。
- **缺 boot 头的 4xx 被误分类为 outcome-unknown**:缺头 wrap 把服务端自身在中间件之前发出的确定性拒绝(413 body 过大、429)与网关错误页一视同仁。四个变更路径现在重新推导:歧义(408/5xx)保持 outcome-unknown;确定性无 fence 拒绝以携带状态码的 `DaemonHttpException` 呈现。
- **顺带闭环的同簇项**:`detachSession` 对任何确定性应答都拆除本地 attachment(不再只有 204/404),认证吊销后的 403 不再泄漏心跳定时器;流关闭时排在 `cursorLock` 上的调用方在锁内重检并得到"流已关闭"信号而非传输错误;`session_snapshot` 注释现在写明真实生产者(主事件路由上 bridge 的 `withSnapshot`——hosted 路由从不读取该查询参数且每一帧都带 id);builder javadoc 记录游标兜底优先级与 `snapshot(true)` 是主传输选项;README 重试段落与两份设计文档现在把规范 digest 写成跨语言线上契约,并记录"改变 digest 算法的升级必须先排空(或重写)在途 turn 行";另有两个此前未钉住的分支(显式游标压过 ref 水印、确定性缺头 DELETE)获得了有判别力的用例。

### 第一轮(#12654 合入后评审)

- 流生命周期:`HarnessEventStream` 的 `close()` 不再停放在阻塞于 `next()` 的消费者之后——关闭标志为原子量,原始输入在不取任何流监视器的情况下关闭,`HostedHarnessClient.close()` 总能完成,被阻塞的 `next()` 以 `DaemonTransportException` 失败(上面的空闲看门狗补全了这一图景)。
- 轮次台账正确性:409 拒绝不再保留以被拒绝 promptId 为键、永远无法清除的标记(释放槽位并抛 `PromptAlreadyActiveException`);同身份重试收到确定性非 409 失败时释放该重试保留的槽位;`getStatus()` 在远端读取前快照活跃 prompt 条目且只删除那一次注册,陈旧的 `hasActivePrompt:false` 不再能删掉读取在途期间准入的另一个 prompt 的登记。
- 结果分类(第一版形态,第二轮已收窄——见上):变更路径上缺少 `X-Qwen-Harness-Boot-Id` fence 头的响应被分类为结果未知而非裸 `DaemonProtocolException`,因为未经 fence 中间件的响应无法证明变更未执行;纯本地执行器拒绝以 `DaemonTransportException` 呈现,而不是谎称请求可能已到达服务端。
- 生命周期清理:`closeSession(HarnessSessionRef)` 把确定性 404 视为已完成并拆除 attachment 与活跃 prompt 台账,`detachSession` 对 attachment 同样容忍 404(它不清活跃 prompt 台账——该不对称保留,记入 #13313),心跳定时器不再向已被服务端回收的会话持续投递。
- 协议互操作:`streamEvents` 在 builder 省略续传对时回退到 session ref 上已校验的水印,README 承诺的 epoch fence 真正生效(`Last-Event-ID` 也从 ref 游标续传);不携带水印的 ref 保持无 fence 的全新流形态。共享 SSE 解析器现在接受主传输 snapshot 订阅产生的无 id 合成 `session_snapshot` 帧。
- digest 与模型不变量:`computePayloadDigest` 对规范形式(对象键递归排序、数组顺序保持)做哈希,而不是对进程随机的 `Map` 迭代序做哈希,去重键可跨 JVM、跨 map 实现复现(实测否决了 fastjson2 的 `MapSortField`:它不对集合内嵌套的 map 排序);`HarnessRuntimeExecutionRecovery` 在构造时强制 `known` outcome 必带 status map,而不是之后在 `isContinuationReady()` 里 NPE。

每条发现由新测试钉住,并已运行变异见证:单独还原该发现的修复,钉住它的测试即变红(见证表见“如何验证”)。

## 为什么需要

Hosted Harness 客户端是私有 hosted profile 的 Java 控制面传输,其公开契约承诺 fail-closed 行为(有界资源、结果未知分类、每会话单活跃 prompt、epoch-fenced 续传)。第一轮评审证明了每一项承诺都存在具体违例;第二轮又用执行证明第一轮自己的修复在 stub 看不到的那些面上带着一处跨语言回归(CI 结论一致)以及另外四处同类违例(服务端重算 digest、hosted 路由的静默、执行器的派发/投递双重角色、closed 守卫的异常类型)。在合入前处理完两轮评审,比带着断掉的 prompt 路径上线再返工便宜。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

这些行为由 `HostedHarnessClientTest` 的 23 个新用例钉住。运行:

```
cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode
mvn -o test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest     # 42 个测试(19 既有 + 23 新增)
mvn -o test                                    # 全模块:189 个测试,9 个环境门控跳过
cd ../cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts   # 181 个测试
```

本机 JDK 17 全绿;JDK 11 上 `clean test` 绿(模块目标 release 11;两个执行器拒绝用例在 JDK 11 上自行跳过——JDK 11 的 `HttpClient` 对挣扎中的执行器表现为停放 send 而不是抛出拒绝,已在 11/17/21 上实测)。

变异见证:第一轮表格 13 行、第二轮表格 9 行(见英文部分),每行为"还原形态 → 变异结果(全部 RED)";第二轮"看门狗/keepalive 对"一行同时记录空闲用例 RED 与 keepalive 用例 GREEN 的双向判别。

### 证据(Before & After)

N/A —— 非 UI 的协议/传输修复;上方变异表即为前后对照。CI 的 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` 车道在合并基为绿、在首个提交为红——它是线上字节/digest 回归的集成级证据,本 head 上应恢复为绿。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A (CI) |

### 环境(可选)

本机:`JAVA_HOME=jdk17`(全套件)与 `jdk11`(`mvn clean test`)、Maven 3.9.11,在 `packages/sdk-java/qwencode`;`packages/cli` 内 `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡:payload digest 现在是跨语言规范契约——旧版本对同一内容算出的 digest 会不同,这正是修复的目的(旧值是 JVM 随机值,跨进程本就复现不出)。设计文档(中英)现在记录了改变 digest 的升级必须先排空或重写在途 turn 行;协调器侧的一次性重算兜底刻意不在本切片(在 managed-agent-server 模块,记入 #13313)。阻塞在 `next()` 的消费者现在也会在空闲中止时看到 `DaemonTransportException`——包括"两次调用之间"这一臂,此前表现为 `IllegalStateException`。
- 未验证/范围外:#12654 轮的 49 条 Suggestion(记入 #13313)。本 PR 自身轮次中推迟的:按 `code` 决定标记规则的 `Prompt*` 异常重新设计(需要路由语义级的 API 工作,连同已核实的路由门顺序表一并记账)、协调器在 outcome-unknown 之后缺少终态出口(managed-agent-server 切片,记账)、见证表剩余覆盖项(六项中本 PR 处理了另外三项)、以及把 JDK 11 的执行器行为钉住而不只是跳过(11/17/21 的差异现在同时披露在测试、builder javadoc 与设计文档中)。`closeSession(String)` 仍缺 `ensureOpen()` 守卫(#13313 的 R1-50):JDK 17+ 的执行器拒绝测试刻意流经该路径并在注释中写明耦合。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:digest 变更见上;`submitTurn` 收到 409 时现在抛 `PromptAlreadyActiveException` 而不是 `DaemonHttpException`;变更路径上的确定性无 fence 4xx 现在抛携带状态码的 `DaemonHttpException` 而不是 outcome-unknown 类型;`submitTurn` 的 `toJson()` 现在输出按键排序的 content block(服务端接受——它只校验形状并重算 digest)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #12654(本 PR 修复其合入后评审发现)与 #13313(两轮评审推迟剩余项的 backlog)。

prs.title: fix(qqbot)!: restore per-group session isolation under thread scope
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores per-group session isolation for the QQ Bot channel. Removes the forced `sessionScope: 'single'` override that the constructor applied to its own copy of the config whenever `groupAllPolicy` was `keyword` or `all` (introduced during PR #6457 review); the channel now respects the configured scope and warns when a non-shared scope is combined with full-message group mode. Reply streaming keeps a per-session anchor and carries it across seal and cancel boundaries, so a cancelled or superseded turn still flushes against its own `msg_id` (per-message wire anchoring itself landed on `main` in #10145; what this change owns is the boundary machinery around it). Orphaned persisted routing entries from the old single-scope layout are purged on startup, and the QQ channel now declares `thread` as its default session scope so zero-config deployments get per-group shared context by default.

## Supersedes #8241

This is the same change as #8241, carried to a fresh PR after 22 review rounds and 83 blocker-signalling threads. The pipeline's own reports said each round re-read the entire diff (its incremental anchor was lost), so rounds spent their budget re-deriving earlier findings and the thread never converged; the newest round posted zero new findings, and every Critical posted across all rounds is fixed here with a pinning test and a mutation proof. No code changed in the move.

The branch is merged up to `main` at `1a933f7b5e`, which includes the QQ Bot inbound-media PR (#12850) that landed while #8241 was open. The only conflict was an additive stub in a test double in `events.test.ts` (`getResponseMessageId` from this change, `prepareThenHandleInbound` from the media work); both were kept. The package's suite is 540 tests green after the merge — the 499 this change adds and pins, plus the 41 the media PR brought to the same package. On the previous head, `Qwen Code CI` was fully green, including `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`, which had been red for every head since round 18 over `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts` (#10490), a host-gate flake that `main` fixed in #13094 and that merging `main` cleared.

## Why it's needed

The forced scope never reached the router. `start.ts` and `daemon-worker.ts` call `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)` with the *parsed* config, before `QQChannel`'s constructor rewrites its own copy — so the override changed what `QQChannel` believed, not how sessions were actually routed. That split brain produced two defects on `main`:

1. **Full-message group mode never actually got shared group context.** Routing stayed `user`-scoped, so group traffic was fragmented into one session per sender — the opposite of what the override existed to guarantee.
2. **`QQChannel` still believed it was `single`**, so every `sessionScope === 'single'` gate inside it fired against user-scoped routing — for example, a DM was treated as a shared session and `/clear` demanded an extra `confirm`.

The "everything collapsed into one `__single__` session, with context leaking across groups and into DMs" symptom is real, but it requires `sessionScope: "single"` to be set explicitly — which is what the docs recommended for `groupAllPolicy` users. The `replyMsgId` concurrency issue that motivated the override was never actually resolved by it, only hidden.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the unit suite: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 8 files, 540 tests pass (499 added and pinned by this change, plus 41 from the inbound-media work already on `main`).
- Config-level behavior: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"` and no explicit `sessionScope`, the channel must not emit the scope-forcing WARNING and must route group messages per group (`<channel>:<group_openid>`) and DMs per user (`<channel>:<user_openid>`).
- Concurrent streaming: two users messaging in the same group while the bot is mid-stream must keep their replies anchored to their own `msg_id` (no cross-threading) — covered by the new stream tests.
- Cancel behavior: interrupting a turn (`/cancel` or steer) must flush the buffered partial reply before tearing down stream state — partial output is not dropped (regression test pins this).
- The streaming-ownership invariants the review rounds converged on have their own acceptance block: a settling flush chain must not write shared per-session state once the session was torn down or the turn was superseded (`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal routing/session behavior, no user-visible UI change. Before: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"`, group traffic was fragmented per sender while `QQChannel` believed it was running one shared session. After: per-group shared sessions with cross-group isolation, and the channel's belief matches the router.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 540 passed; `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` (in the package) — clean; `eslint` on changed source — clean; `prettier --check` — clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Beyond the QQ channel this diff also touches two shared surfaces, both of which were needed to make the scope default usable: `parseChannelConfig` and the daemon's channel-settings store now share one `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)` helper, so saving a `multiSession` channel without a stored scope resolves `"user"` instead of tripping `ChannelBase`'s construction-time invariant; and the Web Shell channel editor no longer pre-fills a plugin's non-`user` default for a `multiSession` instance, which otherwise made that save fail (`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`). An explicitly stored or submitted non-`user` scope on a `multiSession` channel is still rejected.
- Main risk or tradeoff: the effective session scope for any QQ deployment that omitted `sessionScope` changes from the global `user` default to this plugin's `thread` default (`config-utils.ts` fills `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'`). This applies to **every** such config — not just `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` users — including plain `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` deployments, which go from per-sender contexts to per-group shared context. The tradeoff is deliberate (per-group context is what full-message group mode was always supposed to mean), and `sessionScope: "user"` restores the old behaviour per deployment.
- Not validated / out of scope: live end-to-end verification needs real QQ credentials and was not run in CI; macOS and Windows were not exercised in CI (Linux lanes only).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no config-format change. A group thread session is a shared session, so the commands that act on it (`/clear`, `/who`, `/status`, `/loop`, `/btw`) and the permission answers (`/approve`, `/approve-always`, `/deny`) are restricted to the members listed in the channel's `operators` (`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` reads only `operators`; `allowedUsers` and `senderPolicy` do not grant them). `operators` is unset by default, so a zero-config QQ group has no member who can run those commands and no one who can answer a permission request raised in it; set `operators` to the QQ user ids that should steer the group's session — the channel now warns at startup when group access is enabled on a shared scope with `operators` empty. Measured consequence of leaving it unset: a tool call that needs approval has no one who can answer it, so the requester and every other member are refused, the tool never runs, and the group's session is held by that pending prompt until `AcpBridge` times it out (300 s) — `/cancel` queues behind it too. Deployments that never show a permission prompt (for example `yolo`) are unaffected. (`!` host-shell stays disabled in every QQ group chat regardless of scope.) On startup the channel reports unroutable persisted routes: the `<channel>:__single__` entries left over from the forced single-scope era, and — whenever the effective scope is not `user` — this channel's own three-part `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` keys, which under `thread`/`chat_thread` can never resolve again and count against the bridge's per-workspace session cap on every restart. Deleting them is opt-in: with `purgeLegacySessions` unset (its default, `false`) the channel logs the count and removes nothing; with `purgeLegacySessions: true` it writes a rescue copy of the routes about to be removed (`qq-sessions-purged.json`) before the first deletion, so a legacy conversation can be rebuilt by hand. History behind them is not migrated in either mode (it cannot be split per group). Ownership is decided by each entry's recorded target channel, never by key prefix, so a sibling channel's routes are untouched, and the purge runs after restore so the first boot still re-attaches the entries once before releasing them. Cancelled turns now flush their buffered partial reply before the stream state is torn down, so partial output is no longer lost. Release note: the effective default session scope for QQ deployments that omit `sessionScope` changes from `user` to `thread`; group sessions are shared sessions, so `operators` must be configured for members to answer permission prompts or run session-control commands; the legacy-route purge is opt-in and removes nothing by default.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8238

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

修复 QQ Bot channel 的会话隔离：删除 `groupAllPolicy=keyword/all` 时构造器对自己那份配置强制写入 `sessionScope='single'` 的逻辑（PR #6457 review 期间引入），改为尊重配置，并在"非共享 scope + 全量群消息模式"组合下发出 WARNING。流式回复按 session 锚定 `msg_id`，同群并发用户不再互相串线。启动时清理旧的 single-scope 布局遗留的、已无法解析的持久化路由条目；QQ channel 声明默认 `sessionScope` 为 `thread`，零配置部署默认获得"每群共享上下文"。

## 承接 #8241

与 #8241 是同一份改动，迁移到新 PR：原线程已经历 22 轮评审、累计 83 个未决阻塞线程，而流水线自己的报告说明每轮都在重读整个 diff（增量锚点丢失），预算被用于反复重推既有发现，始终没有收敛；最新一轮已零新发现，而历轮提出的所有 Critical 在本树中均已修复，每一条都有固定行为的测试与变异证明。迁移过程未改动任何代码。

分支已与 `main`（`1a933f7b5e`）合并，其中包含 #8241 还开着时合入的 QQ Bot 入站媒体 PR（#12850）。唯一的冲突是 `events.test.ts` 里测试替身上的一处新增（本改动的 `getResponseMessageId` 与媒体改动的 `prepareThenHandleInbound`），两侧都保留。合并后该包 540 个测试全绿 —— 本改动新增并固定的 499 个，加上媒体 PR 带入同一个包的 41 个。上一个 head 上 `Qwen Code CI` 已全绿，包括 `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`：它自第 18 轮起一直红，原因是 `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts`（#10490）的 runner 门禁，`main` 已在 #13094 修复，合并 `main` 后即转绿。

## 为什么需要它

强制 scope 从未真正传到 router。`start.ts` 与 `daemon-worker.ts` 用**解析后的**配置调用 `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)`，而 `QQChannel` 的构造器只是改写了自己那份副本 —— 于是这个强制改变的是 `QQChannel` 的认知，而不是真实路由。这一"两个真相"在 `main` 上产生两个缺陷：

1. **全量群消息模式从未真正获得共享群上下文。** 路由仍是 `user` scope，群消息按发送者碎片化 —— 与该强制想要保证的完全相反。
2. **`QQChannel` 自认为 `single`**，于是它内部所有 `sessionScope === 'single'` 判定都作用在 user 路由上 —— 例如私聊被当成共享会话，`/clear` 会多要一次 `confirm`。

"所有群/私聊折叠进一个 `__single__` 会话、上下文互相泄漏"这个现象确实存在，但前提是显式设置 `sessionScope: "single"`（文档当时正是这样向 `groupAllPolicy` 用户推荐的）。当年为掩盖 `replyMsgId` 并发问题而引入的强制从未真正解决该问题，只是把它藏了起来。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

- 跑单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 8 个文件、540 个测试通过（本改动新增并固定的 499 个，加上已在 `main` 上的入站媒体工作的 41 个）。
- 配置层行为：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 且未显式设置 `sessionScope` 时，不得出现"强制 scope"的 WARNING，且群消息按群路由（`<channel>:<group_openid>`）、私聊按用户路由（`<channel>:<user_openid>`）。
- 并发流式：同群两个用户在 bot 流式输出期间发消息，各自回复必须锚定到自己的 `msg_id`（不串线）—— 由新增 stream 测试覆盖。
- 取消行为：中断一个 turn（`/cancel` 或 steer）必须先 flush 已缓冲的部分回复再清理流状态 —— 部分输出不丢（有回归测试固定）。
- 各轮评审收敛出的流式归属不变量有独立验收块：会话已被拆除或 turn 已被后继取代后，正在收尾的 flush 链不得再写共享的 per-session 状态（`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`）。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 属内部路由/会话行为，无用户可见的 TUI 变化。改动前：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 下群消息按发送者碎片化，而 `QQChannel` 自认为在跑一个共享会话。改动后：每群共享会话且跨群隔离，channel 的认知与 router 一致。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 540 通过；包内 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` —— clean；改动源码 `eslint` —— clean；`prettier --check` —— clean。

## 风险与范围

- 除 QQ channel 外，本 diff 还触及两个共享面，都是让新的 scope 默认值可用所必需的：`parseChannelConfig` 与 daemon 的 channel-settings store 现共用同一个 `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)`，因此保存一个未存 `sessionScope` 的 `multiSession` channel 会解析为 `"user"`，不再触发 `ChannelBase` 的构造期不变量；Web Shell 的 channel 编辑器也不再为 `multiSession` 实例预填插件的非 `user` 默认值（此前会使保存失败：`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`）。显式存储或提交的非 `user` scope 在 `multiSession` channel 上仍会被拒绝。
- 主要风险或取舍：任何省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效 scope 会从全局默认 `user` 变为本插件的 `thread` 默认（`config-utils.ts` 按 `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'` 填充）。这适用于**所有**这类配置 —— 不只是 `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` 用户 —— 也包括普通的 `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` 部署，它们会从"按发送者独立上下文"变为"按群共享上下文"。这个取舍是有意的（全量群消息模式本就应当意味着每群上下文），需要旧行为时按部署设置 `sessionScope: "user"` 即可。
- 未验证或超出范围：真实端到端验证需要真实 QQ 凭据，CI 未跑；CI 只在 Linux 通道跑，macOS 与 Windows 未覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：配置格式无变化。群聊线程是共享会话，因此作用于该会话的命令（`/clear`、`/who`、`/status`、`/loop`、`/btw`）与权限应答（`/approve`、`/approve-always`、`/deny`）仅限 `operators` 中列出的成员（`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` 只读 `operators`；`allowedUsers` 与 `senderPolicy` 不授予这些权限）。`operators` 默认未设置，因此零配置 QQ 群里没有任何成员可执行这些命令，群内发起的权限请求也无人可应答；需要时请把应当操作该群会话的 QQ 用户 id 填入 `operators` —— 群访问开启而共享 scope 下 `operators` 为空时，channel 现会在启动时告警。实测后果：一旦有工具调用需要审批，群里没有人能应答该请求（提问者本人与所有成员都会被拒），工具不会执行，且该待审批提示会占住群的会话，直到 `AcpBridge` 超时（300 秒）才释放 —— `/cancel` 同样会被排队。从不弹出权限提示的部署（例如 `yolo`）不受影响。（`!` 主机 shell 在所有 QQ 群聊中一律禁用，与 scope 无关。）启动时会检查无法解析的持久化路由：强制 single-scope 时代遗留的 `<channel>:__single__` 条目，以及生效 scope 非 `user` 时本 channel 自己的三段式 `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` 键 —— 在 `thread`/`chat_thread` 下它们永远无法再解析，且每次重启都会占用 bridge 的 per-workspace 会话上限。删除是可选开启的：`purgeLegacySessions` 未设置（默认 `false`）时只打印计数、不删除任何内容；设为 `true` 时会在首次删除前先把待删路由写入救援副本（`qq-sessions-purged.json`），以便手工恢复。无论哪种模式，其历史都不做迁移（无法按群拆分）。归属按条目记录的 target channel 判定，不按键前缀，因此不会误伤兄弟 channel 的路由；清理发生在 restore 之后，首次启动仍会先重新挂载一次再释放。取消的 turn 现在会先 flush 缓冲的部分回复再拆流状态，部分输出不再丢失。发布说明：省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效默认 scope 从 `user` 变为 `thread`；群会话即共享会话，成员需被列入 `operators` 才能应答权限请求或执行会话控制命令。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #8238

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): recover Hosted G3 parked turns
prs.body:
## What this PR does Implements the bounded native-file and main-model recovery paths of Hosted G3 Step 3 after Harness replacement. A parked permission request keeps its original Action, decision revisions, deadline, immutable batch plan and prepared-execution identities. Allow resumes the original batch; Deny, Cancel and expiry settle without dispatching unapproved work. Main-model requests prepared by the native Turn driver are saved at the pre-provider durability boundary and reissued under the original request, history, model route, round and budget pins. Recovery retracts only the orphaned output range before emitting replacement deltas. A final answer that is already committed receives terminal-only compensation rather than another inference request. Native Turns persist cleanup debt for their original Runtime owner before acquisition and confirm release after terminal settlement and file-history retirement. Cold attachment, resident recovery and lifecycle cleanup retry that debt. Storage version negotiation, a monotonic reader floor, recursive durable-reference closure and a versioned commit endpoint prevent older readers or Stores from silently accepting the new format. Interrupted channel settlement uses the same cleanup debt, and request-preparation failures keep admitted prompt and wake inputs parked for recovery. ## Why it's needed G3 Steps 1–2 made the Harness replaceable, but losing an in-memory approval waiter or model stream still leaves work that cannot safely be reconstructed as a new Turn. Recovery needs the original durable identities and request bytes to avoid duplicate file effects, replayed input, resurrected partial output and stranded Runtime leases. This PR supplies those boundaries for the supported Hosted paths while keeping unsupported recovery explicit. ## Reviewer Test Plan Verify that replacing only the Harness preserves the original Session, Turn, Action and Runtime identities. Allow must dispatch the original file operation once; Deny, Cancel and expiry must produce no execution or file effect. Continuation must reuse the already settled tool execution, send the same normalized provider request and remove the dead Harness's publicly visible partial text. Every path must produce one terminal for the original Turn, release its original Runtime, admit a subsequent Turn and complete Session close. Also verify that a failed request snapshot leaves the input admitted and unsettled, a failed original-owner release blocks new work until retry succeeds, and incompatible readers or Stores refuse new-format records. An already committed final answer must not cause a new model call. Unsupported producer state, changed pins and oversized snapshots must preserve an explicit refusal. ### How to verify Use the packaged Linux Harness-only failover fixture with a controlled OpenAI-compatible model server and real Java, MySQL, Broker and Runtime Worker. Run the approval modes Allow, Deny, Cancel and expiry, plus model continuation. Inspect public events, provider request bodies, SQL execution and Runtime rows, and actual file bytes; the runner also checks the next Turn and close operation. Focused route and journal regressions cover durability-barrier failures, cleanup retry, reference closure and reader compatibility. A separate local Spring probe combines bounded output retraction with the replay floor introduced on main. ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A for UI changes. Before: a replacement cannot resume the original pending approval or reproduce an uncompleted model request from the lost process's memory. After: all five scoped Linux packaged modes complete the original Turn with the asserted identities, effects, output retraction, cleanup, next Turn and close behavior. Build, typecheck, bundle, focused TypeScript tests, Java tests, source ESLint and Java Checkstyle passed. The repeated expanded CLI batch passed 781/782, with one temporary-directory teardown `ENOTEMPTY`; all eight tests in the affected unchanged suite passed separately, giving passing evidence for all 782 tests across scoped runs. The batch failure is retained. A separate PR comment records the exact packaged evidence and its limits. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ build, typecheck and scoped TypeScript/Java tests; packaged process-recovery acceptance not claimed | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ five scoped packaged Harness-only recovery modes | ### Environment (optional) Local validation: macOS arm64, Node 22.22.3, npm 10.9.8 and JDK 21.0.8. Packaged acceptance: Linux aarch64, Node 22.22.1, OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 and MySQL 8.4.11 in a dedicated Lima VM. The portable Node bundle and Java JAR were built on macOS and executed on Linux. Inference used a controlled local fixture; no real-provider acceptance is claimed. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: this is a coordinated change across the model request boundary, Hosted orchestration, durable Store readers and Runtime cleanup. The approval, model and cleanup records must preserve original ownership together. Review should pay particular attention to the reader floor, retraction bounds and partial-prepare reconciliation; this is a substantial core feature change for maintainer review. - Not validated / out of scope: approval production is restricted to native-file profiles without Hooks or MCP; cold model reissue requires no Hooks or MCP. The legacy Runtime-only continuation route keeps its existing recovery behavior. Unfinished prefix continuations and oversized snapshots retain explicit refusal. The five packaged modes do not certify first-request/no-tool crash recovery, repeated replacement, every partial-prepare/response-loss/cleanup fault, real providers, a real mixed-version cluster, full Java-owner restart, cross-host recovery, public Shell or two surviving control-plane owners. Q2 binding fencing and the broader G exit gate remain open. - Breaking changes / migration notes: no new Flyway migration. The first new-format transaction atomically raises the existing Session storage floor to 2; the floor stays monotonic, including restore. Upgrade the Store and compatible readers before emitting these records. An older reader cannot resume a floor-2 Session, and reverting source alone does not downgrade stored data. Public API semantics stay compatible; this does not enable an additional deployment profile. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and remaining work. The [earlier English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.md) and [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.zh-CN.md) link to this implementation. ## Linked Issues Refs #12952 (primary Stage G tracker) and #12380 (Managed Agent architecture proposal). Follows merged #13174. These trackers remain open because the broader acceptance gates are not completed by this scoped implementation.
中文说明 ## What this PR does 实现 Hosted G3 第三步中 Harness 替换后的限定范围原生文件与主模型恢复路径。停靠中的权限请求保留原 Action、决定 revision、截止时间、不可变批次计划和 prepared execution 身份。Allow 继续原批次；Deny、Cancel 和过期在不派发未批准工作的情况下结算。 原生 Turn driver 准备的主模型请求在发送到 provider 前的持久化边界保存，并按原请求、历史、模型路由、round 和预算 pin 重发。恢复先仅撤回孤儿输出范围，再输出替代方的 delta。已经提交最终回答时只补终态，不再发起推理请求。 原生 Turn 在 acquire 前持久化原 Runtime owner 的清理债务，在终态结算和 file-history 退役之后确认释放。冷 attachment、resident 恢复和 lifecycle 清理都会重试该债务。storage version 协商、单调 reader floor、完整递归 durable-reference 引用闭包与版本化提交入口，防止旧 reader 或 Store 静默接受新格式。渠道中断结算使用同一清理债务；请求准备失败时，已经准入的 prompt 和 wake 输入保持停靠，留待恢复。 ## Why it's needed G3 第一步和第二步使 Harness 可以替换，但丢失内存中的审批 waiter 或模型流后，剩余工作仍不能安全地重建为一个新 Turn。恢复需要原始 durable 身份和请求字节，才能避免重复文件副作用、重放输入、复活部分输出以及遗留 Runtime lease。本 PR 为支持范围内的 Hosted 路径补齐这些边界，并继续明确拒绝不支持的恢复情况。 ## Reviewer Test Plan 确认仅替换 Harness 后，原 Session、Turn、Action 和 Runtime 身份保持不变。Allow 必须只派发一次原文件操作；Deny、Cancel 和过期不得产生 execution 或文件副作用。模型续接必须复用已结算的原工具 execution，发送相同的 normalized provider 请求，并移除旧 Harness 已公开的部分文本。每条路径必须为原 Turn 产生一个终态、释放原 Runtime、准入后续 Turn，并完成 Session close。 同时确认：请求快照写入失败后，输入保持已准入但未结算；原 owner 释放失败后，在重试成功之前阻止新工作；不兼容的 reader 或 Store 拒绝新格式记录。已经提交最终回答时不得新增模型调用。不支持的 producer 状态、pin 变化和超限快照必须保留明确拒绝。 ### How to verify 使用 Linux 打包后的 Harness-only failover fixture，配合受控的 OpenAI 兼容模型服务和真实 Java、MySQL、Broker、Runtime Worker。运行审批 Allow、Deny、Cancel、过期以及模型续接模式。检查公开事件、provider 请求体、SQL execution 与 Runtime 记录和实际文件字节；runner 还会检查下一 Turn 和 close operation。定向路由与 journal 回归覆盖持久化屏障失败、清理重试、引用闭包和 reader 兼容性。另一个本地 Spring probe 将有界输出撤回与 main 新增的 replay floor 组合验证。 ### Evidence (Before & After) UI 变化为 N/A。之前：替代 Harness 无法恢复原停靠审批，也无法从丢失进程的内存中复现未完成的模型请求。之后：五种限定范围 Linux 打包模式均完成原 Turn，且身份、副作用、输出撤回、清理、下一 Turn 和 close 行为均有断言验证。build、typecheck、bundle、定向 TypeScript 测试、Java 测试、源码 ESLint 和 Java Checkstyle 通过。重复的扩展 CLI 批次通过 781/782，有一次临时目录清理 `ENOTEMPTY`；受影响且未修改的套件全部 8 条测试单独复跑通过，因此 782 条测试均有分次通过证据。保留该批次的失败记录。单独的 PR 评论记录准确的打包证据及其边界。 ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ build、typecheck 和定向 TypeScript/Java 测试；不声称完成打包进程恢复验收 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 五种限定范围打包 Harness-only 恢复模式 | ### Environment (optional) 本地验证：macOS arm64、Node 22.22.3、npm 10.9.8 和 JDK 21.0.8。打包验收：独立 Lima VM 中的 Linux aarch64、Node 22.22.1、OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 和 MySQL 8.4.11。可移植 Node bundle 和 Java JAR 在 macOS 构建后于 Linux 执行。推理使用受控的本地 fixture，不声称完成真实 provider 验收。 ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff：本次协调修改模型请求边界、Hosted 编排、durable Store reader 和 Runtime 清理。审批、模型和清理记录必须共同保持原所有权。请重点审阅 reader floor、撤回范围和 partial-prepare 对账；这是需要 maintainer 审阅的较大 core 功能改动。 - Not validated / out of scope：审批 producer 限定为不含 Hooks/MCP 的原生文件 profile；主模型冷重发要求不含 Hooks/MCP。旧 Runtime-only continuation 路由保留已有恢复行为。未完成的 prefix continuation 和超限快照继续明确拒绝。五种打包模式不证明首请求/无工具崩溃恢复、反复替换、全部 partial-prepare/丢响应/清理故障、真实 provider、真实混版本集群、完整 Java owner 重启、跨 host 恢复、公开 Shell 或两个存活控制面 owner。Q2 binding fencing 和更广的 G 退出门禁继续开放。 - Breaking changes / migration notes：没有新增 Flyway migration。首个新格式事务原子地把已有 Session storage floor 提升到 2；包括 restore 在内，floor 保持单调。输出新记录前，先升级 Store 和兼容 reader。旧 reader 无法恢复 floor-2 Session，单纯源码回滚不会降级持久数据。公开 API 语义保持兼容；本次不启用额外部署 profile。 设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.md) 和 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包含决策、约束、验收标准与剩余工作。[此前英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.md) 和 [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c2f448d1b5652321005c3f733d85f00aa5721f4e/docs/design/2026-10-02-hosted-replaceable-harness.zh-CN.md) 已链接本次实现。 ## Linked Issues 关联 #12952（主 Stage G tracker）和 #12380（Managed Agent 架构提案），承接已合入的 #13174。限定范围实现没有完成更广的验收门禁，因此这些 tracker 保持开放。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): close the critical R2 review findings on #12692
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes the eight Critical findings from the post-merge R2 review round on #12692, all of which were re-verified against current main (`eb0b79c5b8`) before patching: one InnoDB lock-order inversion across store methods, session-list keyset pagination walking the mutable `updated_at`, `recoveryDetailCode` accepted far wider than its `VARCHAR(128)` column, Spring dispatch errors (405/415) answered as 500 `internal_error`, default-locale `toLowerCase()` on protocol status tokens, idempotent replays gated on harness availability, completed-mutation replays 404ing after a later delete, and asymmetric title policies between create and rename.

## Why it's needed

Each finding has a demonstrated failure in production semantics: the deadlock order was reproduced 12/12 on MariaDB with the request-thread victim surfacing HTTP 500; a streaming session whose `updated_at` moved never appeared in a paged session list; a >128-char recovery code turned the one-way recovery fence into a 500 that recorded nothing; under a Turkish default locale a failed tool was persisted as still running; a replay of an already-recorded command returned 503 during a harness outage; and a stored 300-char title could not be written back through rename. This PR closes all of them with the minimal change each finding proposed, plus tests that pin the fixed behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Lock order: `recordAdmission`, `cancelBeforeAdmission` and `failTurn` now take the session-row lock before the turn-row update, matching the sibling `recordRecoveryAdmission` pattern; the existing MariaDB integration lanes and the full module suite confirm no behavioral drift.
- Pagination: the new IT `keepsPagingSessionsAcrossRowsWhoseUpdatedAtMoved` creates three sessions, renames the one not on page 1 (bumping its `updated_at` past the cursor), and asserts page 2 still returns it — this test is empty-page red with the old `updated_at` keyset.
- Recovery width: `rejectsAnOverlongRecoveryDetailCodeBeforeTheColumnDoes` asserts a 129-char code is a 400 (previously 500 with the block unrecorded) and a 128-char code still records `BLOCKED_EXECUTION`.
- Dispatch errors: `ApiExceptionHandlerTest` asserts 405 with `Allow`, 415, parameter-named messages for type mismatch and missing params, and a neutral 400 for `IllegalArgumentException`.
- Locale: `ManagedAgentStoreLocaleTest` persists a `FAILED` tool update under a `tr_TR` default and asserts the item is `failed` (was `in_progress`); `foldsSessionStatusesWithTheRootLocaleUnderATurkishDefault` asserts both session views emit `active`.
- Replay order: `replaysASubmittedTurnWhileTheHarnessIsUnavailable` and `replaysACreationWithInputWhileTheHarnessIsUnavailable` assert 202 `replayed: true` while the harness is down and a 503 for a genuinely new submission.
- Replay visibility: `replaysACompletedRenameAfterTheSessionWasDeleted` asserts the recorded rename success replays 200 with the replay header after the session was deleted (previously 404).
- Title policy: `rewritesAStoredLongTitleUnderOneTitlePolicy` stores a 300-char title and renames it back (previously 400), with 513-char and control-char inputs still rejected on both create and rename.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (server-side behavior; witness cases above go red on the pre-change code).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

`mvn verify` on `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server` (JDK 21, H2): 564 tests, 0 failures, checkstyle + spotbugs green. MariaDB-dependent lanes were exercised by CI in the referenced follow-ups; this change's lock-order fix mirrors the pattern already proven there.

### Environment (optional)

`JAVA_HOME` set to JDK 21; module verified standalone after same-source `mvn install` of `qwencode` and `runtime-broker`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the session-list ordering itself changes from `updated_at DESC` to `created_at DESC` (the finding's own blessed direction); cursor wire format `base64(<long>:<id>)` is unchanged, but a cursor minted across this deploy may shift pagination semantics for in-flight walkers.
- Not validated / out of scope: the six design-level findings (attachment resurrection protocol, progress-gated renewal, N+1 batching, SSE loop dedupe, snapshot write amplification, incremental web fold) are tracked in #13302 and deliberately not fixed here; the remaining R2 suggestions ship in follow-up PRs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: interim validation now rejects recovery codes of 129-4096 chars that previously 500'd; titles containing control characters are now rejected on create as well as rename.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the Critical half of the post-merge R2 review on #12692 (comment threads resolved with evidence against current main). Design-level deferrals tracked by #13302.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 内容

修复 #12692 合并后 R2 评审轮次中的 8 条 Critical 发现，全部在改动前对照当前 main(`eb0b79c5b8`）重新核实：store 方法间的 InnoDB 加锁顺序倒挂、会话列表以可变 `updated_at` 为游标的 keyset 分页、`recoveryDetailCode` 的校验宽度远超其 `VARCHAR(128)` 列、Spring 调度错误（405/415）被答成 500 `internal_error`、协议状态 token 的默认 Locale `toLowerCase()`、幂等重放被 harness 可用性拦截、已完成变更的重放在后续删除后返回 404，以及 create 与 rename 的标题政策不一致。

## 动机

每条发现都有可演示的生产语义故障：死锁顺序在 MariaDB 上 12/12 复现且请求线程受害者表现为 HTTP 500；`updated_at` 移动过的流式会话永远不出现在分页列表里；超过 128 字符的恢复码把单向恢复围栏打成 500 且未落库；土耳其语默认 Locale 下失败的工具被持久化为仍在运行；已落库命令的重放在 harness 故障期返回 503；已存的 300 字符标题无法经 rename 写回。本 PR 按各发现提出的最小改动全部修复，并附固定修复行为的测试。

## 评审者验证计划

### 如何验证

- 加锁顺序：`recordAdmission`、`cancelBeforeAdmission`、`failTurn` 现在先取会话行锁再做 turn 行更新，与姊妹方法 `recordRecoveryAdmission` 一致；MariaDB 集成车道与全模块套件确认无行为漂移。

prs.title: fix(session): reserve retained snapshot prompt identities on resume
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Resuming reserves prompt identities still owned by retained file snapshots, even when a conversation-only rewind removed every user turn. Non-finite or unsafe ordinals, and ordinals without a safe successor, are ignored. This uses the existing shared counter and ID format.

## Why it's needed

A retained file checkpoint can outlive its conversation turn. Reusing its identity for a text-only replacement can offer that old checkpoint as the replacement's code restore and undo unrelated edits. This is R53-2 from the deferred review ledger for #9466; legacy conversation mapping remains separate in #13737.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start with a no-edit turn, resume interactively, and ask for an edit to a disposable file.
2. Use the rewind selector to restore only the conversation to that editing turn. The edit and its file checkpoint should remain.
3. Exit, resume headlessly with a text-only replacement, and reopen the interactive rewind selector for that replacement. Its identity must not reuse the retained checkpoint, file restore must be unavailable, and the file must remain edited.
4. Check ordinary code-only restore in another editing turn; it must still work. Check the first-turn/no-surviving-user case and a genuinely empty history.
5. Foreign-session IDs, nonnumeric suffixes, overflowing numbers, unsafe integers and an ordinal with no safe successor must not poison a valid retained ordinal.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux keyboard rewind and restore, real CLI-created transcripts/backups, real read/edit tools, and a deterministic loopback model were used on both sides. The baseline is global Qwen Code 0.25.0; the executed candidate is `5d9b9a1f3bf0a006a8ce2ff4855effd10e330bdf`. Current PR head is `79a6d0141063a1555fafd993d696c81276e7a914`: the two subsequent commits add a core regression and correct a rationale comment, without changing runtime logic. The original runtime evidence is reused on that basis, not presented as a new run at the current head.

Before: after conversation-only rewind, the retained edit checkpoint had ordinal **2**. The no-edit replacement reused **2**, offered code-only restore, and executing it incorrectly changed `OLD_EDIT` to `BASELINE`.

After: the replacement received **3**, offered only conversation-only / Never mind, and kept `OLD_EDIT`. A separate actual keyboard code-only restore changed `NORMAL_EDIT` back to `OLD_EDIT` correctly. The pure interactive first-turn control minted **1** instead of reusing **0**; that variant's fresh checkpoint prevents the harmful rollback on both sides, so it is not the claimed damage reproduction.

The malformed-number regression failed before the parser fix and passes afterward. The last captured replacement request contains the retained no-edit turn and replacement, not the discarded edit or identity metadata. Detailed commands, captures and review results are in the verification comment.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, focused tests, actual Ink/tmux and wire checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2, independently installed/built worktree based on `5ddd43815bf141ad448a546aeba768b0bc90820d`, Ink at 180×48, isolated disposable workspace/runtime and loopback OpenAI-compatible mock. Current focused tests: 145 core reader tests and 66 CLI resume tests passed. Root build, bundle, typecheck and changed-file lint/format passed.

Local source review of the executed four-file candidate covered connected consumers and two consecutive dry reverse-audit rounds, with no substantiated in-scope Critical. The later core test and rationale-only change were also source-inspected; the operative runtime logic is unchanged. The native engine returned COMMENT, not APPROVE, because it retained a historical budget-stop marker and disclosed optional test-efficacy depth limits. This is ready for human review, not a claim of merge approval or full-suite success.

## Risk & Scope

- Prompt ordinals can skip discarded turns; they are opaque identities, not visible turn numbers. Metadata-only restored histories can start at 1 instead of 0.
- Six changed files (+113/-8): two runtime-logic files, one rationale-comment-only source file and three regressions. Runtime logic remains +20/-3; no transcript schema, public option, new identity counter or dependency. Shared snapshot-reader consolidation is tracked separately in #13794.
- Windows/Linux, OpenTUI, flicker/intermediate frames, exhaustive network auditing and every slash-command timing are not validated. The keyboard selector was reached using two Escape presses 200 ms apart.
- The earlier service-only verification and incomplete review attempts are historical, not passing full gates. No merge or release is requested here.
- General counter exhaustion near JavaScript's integer limit is not redesigned here; the numeric guard prevents malformed retained ordinals from entering the seed.

## Linked Issues

Refs #11408 (R53-2). #9437 is handled separately by #13737. No issue is auto-closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

恢复会话时会保留仍由文件快照占用的 prompt identity，即使仅回退对话后已没有用户轮次保留。非有限、不安全或没有安全后继的数字序号会被忽略。沿用现有共享计数器和 ID 格式。

## 为什么需要

文件检查点可能比对应的对话轮次保留更久。无编辑的替代轮次若复用了它的 identity，就可能提供旧检查点作为自己的代码恢复目标，进而撤销不相关的编辑。这是 #9466 延后审查清单中的 R53-2；旧历史的对话映射仍由 #13737 独立处理。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 先发一个不编辑文件的轮次，交互式恢复后，请求编辑一个可丢弃的文件。
2. 在回退选择器中，对该编辑轮次执行仅恢复对话。文件编辑及其检查点应保留。
3. 退出，headless 恢复后发一个仅含文本的替代轮次，再交互式打开它的回退选择器。它的 identity 不应复用保留的检查点，不应提供文件恢复，文件应保持已编辑状态。
4. 在另一个编辑轮次检查正常的仅恢复代码，确认仍可用。同时检查首轮／无保留用户轮次的情况，以及真正的空历史。
5. 外部 session ID、非数字后缀、溢出数字、不安全整数，以及没有安全后继的序号，都不应污染有效保留序号的恢复结果。

### 证据（修改前／后）

两侧都使用了真实 tmux 键盘回退和恢复、CLI 生成的记录与备份、真实 read/edit 工具，以及确定性的 loopback 模型。基线是全局 Qwen Code 0.25.0，实际执行候选是 `5d9b9a1f3bf0a006a8ce2ff4855effd10e330bdf`。当前 PR head 为 `79a6d0141063a1555fafd993d696c81276e7a914`：后续两个提交只补 core 回归并纠正原因注释，没有修改运行逻辑。据此复用原运行证据，不冒充当前 head 的新执行。

修改前：仅回退对话后，保留的编辑检查点序号为 **2**。无编辑替代轮次复用 **2**，提供仅恢复代码，执行后错误地把 `OLD_EDIT` 改回 `BASELINE`。

修改后：替代轮次使用 **3**，只提供仅恢复对话／Never mind，文件保持 `OLD_EDIT`。独立的真实键盘仅恢复代码操作，仍正确把 `NORMAL_EDIT` 恢复为 `OLD_EDIT`。纯交互首轮控制改为使用 **1** 而非复用 **0**；该变体两侧都有新鲜检查点，因此不把它描述成文件损坏复现。

畸形数字回归在 parser 修复前失败，修复后通过。最后捕获的替代轮次请求保留了最初的无编辑轮次和替代轮次，不包含已丢弃的编辑轮次或 identity 元数据。详细命令、capture 和审查结果见验证评论。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、bundle、typecheck、定向测试、真实 Ink/tmux 和 wire 检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.2，独立安装并构建的 worktree，基于 `5ddd43815bf141ad448a546aeba768b0bc90820d`，Ink 180×48，隔离的可丢弃 workspace/runtime 和 loopback OpenAI-compatible mock。当前定向测试为 145 个 core reader 测试和 66 个 CLI resume 测试，全部通过。根目录构建、bundle、typecheck 和修改文件的 lint/format 通过。

实际执行的四文件候选已完成关联消费者审查和连续两轮干净反向审查，没有已证实的范围内 Critical。后续 core 测试及仅注释的变更也已静态核对，运行逻辑未变。原生引擎仍返回 COMMENT，而非 APPROVE，原因是保留的历史 budget-stop 标记及未补跑的额外测试敏感性深度验证。这表示可以提交人工 review，不表示已获合并批准或全量测试通过。

## 风险与范围

- Prompt 序号可能跳过已丢弃的轮次；它们是不透明的 identity，不是可见轮次数。仅有元数据的恢复历史可能从 1 而非 0 开始。
- 六个修改文件（+113/-8）：两个运行逻辑文件、一个仅修改原因注释的源码文件、三个回归测试。运行逻辑仍为 +20/-3，不新增 transcript schema、公开选项、identity 计数器或依赖。快照读取逻辑统一另由 #13794 跟踪。
- 未验证 Windows/Linux、OpenTUI、闪烁／中间帧、全面网络审计或每一种 slash-command 时序。键盘选择器通过间隔 200 ms 的两次 Escape 打开。
- 早期仅服务层的验证及未完成的审查尝试属于历史记录，不作为通过的完整门禁。本次不请求合并或发布。
- 本次不重设计 JavaScript 整数上限附近的通用计数器耗尽处理；数字 guard 阻止畸形保留序号进入恢复 seed。

Refs #11408（R53-2）。#9437 由 #13737 独立处理。不自动关闭 issue。

prs.title: fix(serve): stop renewing settled Hosted Shell grants
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stops renewing a Hosted Shell publication once the original execution has authoritatively settled, while retaining its binding until receipt acceptance so failure cleanup still works. Each renewal pass attempts all live bindings before reporting failures with their publication IDs. A renewal already in flight when settlement is observed can finish without producing a misleading warning; genuine renewal failures still block dispatch.

## Why it's needed

A slow Session receipt leaves the settled execution in the batch's bookkeeping. The publication service correctly rejects renewal of settled executions, but the client previously kept renewing them and logged a misleading warning. The first rejection also prevented queued publications later in the same pass from being renewed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the first Shell execution open in a two-call batch and advance the renewal timer. Both its running publication and the queued second publication should renew.
2. Settle the first execution, hold its receipt commit across two timer ticks, and check that only the queued publication renews. Release the receipt: both calls should complete, ownership should release normally, and no publication-renewal warning should appear. Repeat for original-finished-publication recovery and a proven not-started execution.
3. Let an already-running renewal reject after settlement is observed. It should not warn or prevent renewal of the queued publication.
4. Reject an unsettled timer renewal with HTTP 503. The same tick should still renew the queued publication and log exactly one warning naming the failed publication. The next successful tick should retry both live publications. HTTP 400 or 503 during pre-dispatch renewal must still block dispatch after attempting all bindings.
5. Return cancelled-before-dispatch with no capture, then reject the finished-publication lookup. Recovery must cancel the original execution and send close_not_started with the original publication ID and token, without releasing uncertain ownership.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for visual evidence: internal Hosted lifecycle behavior, no TUI layout change. With the final regression tests on unchanged base 8eaaa1355cafbd0ae2716331b0eca57dec54b2e6, seven cases fail and the cleanup-preservation case passes. Settled publications are renewed, delayed receipts produce spurious warnings and skip queued grants, and genuine per-binding errors stop the renewal pass. The exact same eight cases all pass with the fix. After the fix, all 581 Hosted CLI tests (15 files) and 1,927 managed-runtime core tests (34 files) pass, 2,508 in total. Full build, full typecheck (4 GiB Node heap), bundle, repository-wide lint:ci, changed-file Prettier, diff whitespace checks, and the serve-fast-path bundle closure check also pass.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 210 scoped Hosted-turn tests on current head (2026-10-07) |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ deterministic component tests |

### Environment (optional)

Debian 13, Node.js 24.19.0, repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Usage statistics and OTel are disabled with QWEN_USAGE_STATISTICS_ENABLED=false and QWEN_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false. The component tests exercise the actual Hosted turn coordinator and local Session/harness persistence with controlled Broker and publication-service fixtures. Only interval timers are advanced. The global qwen CLI is unavailable in this environment.

Latest upstream-merge validation (2026-10-07, head b6ee9a1ac6a8): 210 Hosted-turn tests, changed-file Prettier/ESLint, CLI typecheck, and full build/bundle passed on Windows. The wider Linux counts above describe the original fix validation, not a new full-suite run on this head.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: renewal eligibility must not erase the original binding needed by failure cleanup; the regression suite pins both paths. Review remains important for this Hosted lifecycle code.
- Not validated / out of scope: full npm run preflight did not complete. Its default 2 GiB integration-typecheck heap exhausted memory; a separate full typecheck passes with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096. The repository-wide unit-test run then encounters EPERM when browser-use tests bind Unix-domain sockets in this environment. The scoped Hosted suites reported above pass; no full-suite pass or real Java Broker, Session Store, database/OSS E2E is claimed. Tenant-wide reservation-expiry races remain outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no protocol, server, ownership, or public-interface changes.
- AI assistance: implementation and tests were produced with OpenAI Codex. Technical self-audit is complete; ready for maintainer review.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12957. Follow-up to merged #12894.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在原始执行被权威地确认 settled 后，停止续期对应的 Hosted Shell publication，同时保留其 binding 直到回执接纳完成，确保失败清理仍能工作。每轮续期都会尝试所有仍有效的 binding，然后携带 publication ID 报告失败。在观察到 settled 时已经发出的续期请求，即使随后失败也不会产生误导性告警；真实的续期失败仍会阻止派发。

## 为什么需要

Session 回执提交缓慢时，已 settled 的执行仍保留在批次的记录中。publication 服务按设计拒绝对已 settled 执行续期，但客户端此前仍持续请求续期并输出误导性告警。第一次拒绝还会阻断本轮后续排队 publication 的续期。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在包含两个 Shell 调用的批次中，让第一个执行保持运行并推进续期定时器。预期正在运行的第一个 publication 与排队中的第二个 publication 都得到续期。
2. 让第一个执行 settled，将回执提交阻塞两个定时器周期，并确认仅排队中的 publication 继续续期。释放回执后，两个调用都应完成、正常释放归属，且不出现 publication 续期告警。对通过原始 finished publication 恢复以及已证明未启动的执行重复验证。
3. 让一个已发出的续期请求在客户端观察到 settled 后才拒绝。预期不会告警，也不会阻止排队 publication 的续期。
4. 让尚未 settled 的 publication 在定时续期时返回 HTTP 503。该轮仍应续期排队的 publication，且只输出一条包含失败 publication ID 的告警。下一轮成功续期应再次尝试两个仍有效的 publication。派发前续期遇到 HTTP 400 或 503 时，仍必须在尝试所有 binding 后阻止派发。
5. 返回无 capture、派发前取消的执行结果，再拒绝 finished publication 查询。恢复路径必须取消原始执行，并使用原始 publication ID 和 token 发送 close_not_started，且不能释放尚不确定的归属。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

不适用可视化证据：这是内部 Hosted 生命周期行为，不涉及 TUI 布局变化。将最终回归测试运行在未修改的基线 8eaaa1355cafbd0ae2716331b0eca57dec54b2e6 上，七项失败、清理行为保留测试通过。已 settled 的 publication 仍被续期，延迟回执产生误报告警并跳过排队 grant，而单个 binding 的真实错误也会终止本轮续期。相同的八项测试在应用修复后全部通过。修复后，581 项 Hosted CLI 测试（15 个文件）和 1,927 项 managed-runtime core 测试（34 个文件）全部通过，合计 2,508 项。完整 build、完整 typecheck（4 GiB Node 堆）、bundle、全仓 lint:ci、变更文件 Prettier 检查、diff 空白检查以及 serve-fast-path bundle 闭包检查均通过。

### 已测试的平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 当前 head 的 210 项限定范围 Hosted-turn 测试（2026-10-07） |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 确定性组件测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Debian 13、Node.js 24.19.0、仓库固定版本 pnpm 11.24.0。测试通过 QWEN_USAGE_STATISTICS_ENABLED=false 和 QWEN_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false 关闭使用统计与 OTel。组件测试使用真实的 Hosted turn 协调器和本地 Session/harness 持久化，Broker 和 publication 服务由可控 fixture 提供。只推进 interval 定时器。此环境没有全局 qwen CLI。

最新上游合并后的验证（2026-10-07，head b6ee9a1ac6a8）：Windows 上 210 项 Hosted-turn 测试、变更文件 Prettier/ESLint、CLI typecheck、完整 build/bundle 通过。上方较大规模的 Linux 测试数字属于初次修复验证，不代表在当前 head 重跑了全量套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：续期资格变化不能删除失败清理仍需使用的原始 binding；回归测试同时约束这两条路径。此 Hosted 生命周期代码仍需仔细评审。
- 未验证或范围外：完整 npm run preflight 未完成。集成类型检查使用默认 2 GiB 堆时耗尽内存；以 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 单独重跑完整 typecheck 后通过。随后全仓单元测试中的 browser-use 测试在此环境绑定 Unix-domain socket 时遇到 EPERM。下述限定范围的 Hosted 测试均通过；未声称全量测试或真实 Java Broker、Session Store、数据库/OSS E2E 通过。租户级 reservation 过期竞争仍不在本次变更范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；协议、服务端、归属和公共接口均无变更。
- AI 辅助说明：实现与测试由 OpenAI Codex 辅助完成。技术自审已完成，现准备进入维护者正式评审。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12957。作为已合入 #12894 的后续修复。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): harden the managed panel failure lifecycle and worker path containment
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Three small robustness fixes for the hosted Managed session path, each pinned by new unit tests:

1. The managed runtime worker now rejects relative file paths that resolve outside the registered workspace. Only the resolve-and-admit decision changed; the shell working-directory argument already enforced the identical check, so this removes an asymmetry in the worker's own defense layer (the harness boundary validation is unchanged). A traversal-written file is rejected and nothing lands outside the workspace; legitimate relative writes keep working.
2. The managed panel's three polling/reconnect loops (bootstrap snapshot, event-stream reconnect, summary poll) now share one backoff policy: a three-second floor preserved exactly for the first failure (keeps the documented gap-recovery cadence), exponential growth to a 30-second cap with jitter for repeated failures, and a hard stop when the service gives a definite 4xx answer (e.g. deleted session or unauthorized) instead of polling it forever.
3. Merging newly streamed events no longer rebuilds and re-sorts the entire transcript per delta: a strictly-newer tail is appended directly, and the general dedupe-and-sort path still handles overlapping or disordered input with identical semantics.

## Why it's needed

These paths turn ordinary disturbances into lasting damage or nuisance: the worker resolved file paths with no containment of its own, leaving a single validation layer between tool input and the host filesystem; a broker outage or a misconfigured token made every open panel poll two endpoints every three seconds forever, and rejoin in lockstep on recovery (thundering herd); and per-event full re-sorting made long sessions progressively slower on the UI thread. None changes any success-path behavior; all are exercised by tests that fail without the fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the two affected suites from their package directories and confirm the new cases pass and all pre-existing cases (including the panel's 2999ms gap-recovery boundary) stay green:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/managed-runtime-file-history.test.ts src/serve/managed-context-worker.test.ts src/serve/managed-runtime-tool-v3-routes.test.ts src/serve/remote-shell-result-publication.test.ts src/serve/managed-mcp-runtime.test.ts
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/managed
```

Key behaviors to look at in the new tests: a relative file path escaping the workspace is rejected and nothing is written outside it, while a path inside still succeeds; after a 404 the panel makes exactly one attempt and stops, and after a 500 it retries with backoff and recovers; a strictly-newer event tail merges without rewriting prior event identity, while an overlapping or disordered tail is still re-sorted and deduplicated.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — robustness paths, no user-visible happy-path change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (run `npm run build` first for dist prerequisites): 888 cli managed-serve tests + 204 web-shell managed tests pass; `tsc --build` and eslint/prettier clean on the touched files.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the worker's containment check uses the same admitted-workspace predicate as the shell directory argument. Absolute file paths remain caller-trusted at this layer (the harness boundary rejects absolute incoming paths); symlink escapes resolved through relative paths are out of scope here.
- Not validated / out of scope: a broader packaged change — retrying the plain journal commit on uncertain failures — was prepared and then deliberately dropped here: the hosted fault-gate drivers currently pin a single commit attempt, so that retry must land together with a driver restatement of bounded, byte-identical, effect-once retry semantics. It is tracked in #13182. Real-broker failover soak and the remaining audit items (broker authentication, DB amplification) are likewise out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None closed — follow-up audit items are tracked in #13180–#13185.

1. managed runtime worker 现在拒绝解析后落在注册工作区之外的相对文件路径。只改了解析加准入这一个判断——shell 的 directory 参数早已执行同样的检查，本次消除 worker 自身防线的不对称（harness 边界校验不变）。逃逸写入被拒绝且区外不落盘；合法相对写入不受影响。

说明：普通事务提交的不确定失败重试曾随本 PR 准备，随后刻意撤出——hosted 故障闸门 driver 目前钉死「commit 恰好尝试一次」，该重试必须与「有界、字节级一致、effect-once」的 driver 语义重写一同落地，已在 #13182 跟踪。
