prs.title: feat(managed-agent): Collect retired stream-capture tool outputs (#13534)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Implements **P1 of #13534** — stream-capture output collection, extending the O4 Session-rooted retention lifecycle to the remaining Shell output producer family. Background Shell stream captures (introduced by #13265) and foreground Shell leftovers publish their segments, pages and manifests as `PUBLISHED` `MYSQL_INLINE` rows of the `managed-tool-result-{content,page,manifest}` kinds, and nothing ever deleted those bytes: even with `gc-enabled` on, the existing collector only walks `qwen_tool_publication`.

The new pass collects those rows after permanent Session deletion under the same policy as O4 publications: the existing retirement tombstone proves the writer is closed, the same `deletion-grace` (default 24h) applies, and a per-Session claim ledger (new migration table `qwen_managed_session_resource_collection`) drives bounded, crash-atomic pages (≤100 rows / ≤32 MiB each). Claim fencing mirrors the publication collector (owner UUID + generation + 60s claim budget); a live claim cannot be stolen, an expired one is handed off through the generation fence, and a stale deferred-retry write cannot clobber a takeover. Byte accounting is exact once per row; completed ledgers keep a permanent audit row with `collected_bytes` but drop out of the claim scan (`gc_next_at = -1`). Eligibility is conservative: live-`REFERENCED` rows, other kinds, externally stored rows, journal-referenced rows (CSI snapshot safety), over-bound or unknown-layout rows (corruption evidence the fail-closed readers protect) are all pinned permanently.

Outcome surfaces: Session read/write endpoints stay fenced with `tool_output_session_retired` exactly as before (unchanged code); a workspace-recovery read that physically reaches a collected byte copy now fails the named check `resource_collected` instead of the generic `resource_layout_unsupported`. Rollout reuse the existing `gc-enabled` flag with no new config; the first upgraded broker starts collecting immediately when it is on, and mixed fleets are told to hold the flag off until every broker runs V48 (both operations docs explain why, in both languages). P2 (MCP) and P3 (media/shared outputs) remain open as separate slices of #13534.

## Why it's needed

A long-running background Shell produces output continuously, and today nothing ages it out: the bytes sit inline in MySQL for the life of the deployment even behind `gc-enabled`. A retention adapter written without the producer's recovery path in view would also break recovery, which is exactly the constraint the foreground Shell's O4 slices handled — this pass preserves both the recovery path (recovery reads get the named `resource_collected` outcome) and the reference closure (journal-referenced and CSI-visible rows are never collected).

## Risk & Scope

- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** adds Flyway migration `V48` (new table `qwen_managed_session_resource_collection` + `retired_at` index on `qwen_output_session_retirement`). When `gc-enabled` is already true in a fleet, the first upgraded broker starts collecting immediately — there is no version handshake, and pre-V48 brokers misname legitimately collected rows as `resource_layout_unsupported`; mixed fleets that may roll workloads during the upgrade should hold the flag off until every broker runs V48 (documented in both operations documents). Defaults are unchanged, so existing deployments see no behavior change (`gc-enabled` defaults to false).
- **Main tradeoff:** permanence-by-default. Live `REFERENCED` rows, journal-referenced rows (CSI snapshot safety), over-bound or unknown-layout rows (corruption evidence the fail-closed readers protect) are pinned **permanently**; only ordinary stream-capture PUBLISHED rows are collected. This is deliberate conservative behavior, not a bug — storage-growth from those excluded classes is accepted and documented.
- **Not validated / out of scope:** P2 (MCP results) and P3 (media and shared outputs) remain open as separate slices of #13534 — this PR intentionally does not close it. The pre-existing `ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest.holdsRestorePagesInsideThePerPageByteBudget` error is measured identical at base (`ac497aeed9` and `f338578520`) with byte-identical payloads, i.e. pre-existing on main and unrelated. Real-MySQL O4 deployment gates are not extended in this slice; the byte drop is SQL-local, so the existing H2 harness suffices for unit evidence.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The change is broker-internal Java with H2-backed unit/integration evidence (same harness as the O4-2 collector suite). A reviewer should confirm:

1. The eligibility boundaries hold: retired+grace-elapsed Sessions collect byte-exact; each blocker (`recovery_protected`, `grace_period`, live head, active read lease) holds everything with the documented back-off; per-row exclusions (REFERENCED, wrong kind, external storage, journal-referenced, over-bound, wrong schema version, non-NULL layout columns) keep their bytes, and an all-excluded Session completes with `collected_bytes = 0`.
2. Fencing: two collector instances cannot hold a Session's ledger simultaneously; an expired claim is handed off once with byte-exact completion and no double counting across the 100-row/32 MiB page boundaries; a stale defer cannot clobber an active takeover.
3. Outcome surfaces: post-collection reads answer the pre-existing `tool_output_session_retired`; the recovery reader answers `resource_collected`; a tampered non-collected row still fails closed as `managed_session_resource_corrupt`.

Local evidence (JDK 21, Maven 3.9.11, H2 MySQL-mode via Flyway):

```
packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server $ mvn test -q
Tests run: 1083, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 1
# the single error is ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest.holdsRestorePagesInsideThePerPageByteBudget,
# measured identical at base HEAD ac497aeed9 and f338578520 — pre-existing, NOT introduced by this PR.

mvn test -Dtest=SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest
Tests run: 44, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0

mvn checkstyle:check   # clean
```

A `checkstyle`-clean run plus the 44 new collector tests cover every acceptance item in `docs/design/managed-stream-capture-collection.md` (both languages).

Design: `docs/design/managed-stream-capture-collection.md` (+ `.zh-CN.md`); operational coverage paragraph added to `managed-tool-output-retention-operations.md` (+ zh-CN).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — broker-internal change with no user-visible surface; test output above is the evidence.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13534 — intentionally does not close it (P2 MCP and P3 media/shared outputs remain as separate slices).

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

实现 **#13534 的 P1** —— 流式捕获输出的回收，把 O4 的「Session 为保留根」生命周期扩展到剩余的 Shell 输出生产者家族。#13265 引入的后台 Shell 流式捕获与前台 Shell 遗留输出，把分段、页与 manifest 发布为 `managed-tool-result-{content,page,manifest}` 三个 kind 的 `PUBLISHED` `MYSQL_INLINE` 行；此前没有任何东西会删除这些字节：即便 `gc-enabled` 已开，既有回收器只走 `qwen_tool_publication`。

新的通道在 Session 被永久删除后，按与 O4 发布物相同的策略回收这些行：既有退役墓碑证明写者已关闭、复用同一个 `deletion-grace`（默认 24h），并按 Session 的 claim 账本（新迁移表 `qwen_managed_session_resource_collection`）驱动有界、崩溃原子的分页（每页 ≤100 行 / ≤32 MiB）。claim 防护镜像发布物回收器（owner UUID + generation + 60 秒预算）：存活 claim 不可被窃取，过期 claim 经由 generation 防护交接一次，陈旧 defer 写无法抹掉合法接管。每行字节记账恰好一次；已完成的账本保留永久审计行（`collected_bytes`），但退出 claim 扫描域（`gc_next_at = -1`）。谓词保守：存活的 `REFERENCED` 行、其它 kind、外存行、带 journal 引用的行（CSI 快照安全）、越界或未知布局的行（fail-closed 读方所保护的损坏证据）全部永久钉住。

结果面：Session 的读写端点与之前完全一致地以 `tool_output_session_retired` 拦截（代码未变）；工作区恢复读取在物理触达已回收字节副本时，以新增的命名检查 `resource_collected` 失败，而不是笼统的 `resource_layout_unsupported`。发布复用既有 `gc-enabled` 开关、不新增配置：`gc-enabled` 已为 true 时第一台升级的 broker 立刻开始回收；会在升级期间滚动工作负载的混部集群，被明确要求在所有 broker 都跑上 V48 之前保持该开关关闭（两份运维文档均双语说明）。P2（MCP）与 P3（media/共享输出）作为 #13534 的独立切片保持开放。

## 为什么需要

长时间运行的后台 Shell 会持续产生输出，而今天没有任何机制让它老化淘汰：即使 `gc-enabled` 已开，字节也以 MEDIUMBLOB 形式在 MySQL 里躺到部署退役。而没有把该生产者的恢复路径纳入考虑的适配器会破坏恢复——这正是 O4 切片为前台 Shell 小心处理过的事。本通道同时保留恢复路径（恢复读取得到命名准确的 `resource_collected` 结果）与引用闭包（带 journal 引用与 CSI 可见的行永远不被回收）。

## 风险与范围

- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 新增 Flyway 迁移 `V48`（新表 `qwen_managed_session_resource_collection` + `qwen_output_session_retirement` 的 `retired_at` 索引）。当机群已开启 `gc-enabled` 时，第一台升级的 broker 立即开始回收——没有版本握手；低于 V48 的 broker 会把合法回收的行误报为 `resource_layout_unsupported`。升级期间可能滚动工作负载的混部集群应保持该开关关闭，直到全部 broker 跑上 V48（双语运维文档均有说明）。默认值不变，既有部署无行为变化（`gc-enabled` 默认 false）。
- **主要权衡：** 默认永久钉住。存活的 `REFERENCED` 行、带 journal 引用的行（CSI 快照安全）、越界或未知布局的行（fail-closed 读方所保护的损坏证据）全部**永久**钉住；只有普通的流式捕获 PUBLISHED 行被回收。这是有意的保守行为而非缺陷——这些被排除类别的存储增长被接受并已记录。
- **未验证 / 范围外：** P2（MCP 结果）与 P3（media 与共享输出）作为 #13534 的独立切片保持开放——本 PR 有意不关闭它。既有的 `ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest.holdsRestorePagesInsideThePerPageByteBudget` 报错在 base（`ac497aeed9` 与 `f338578520`）上实测字节级一致，属 main 上既有问题、与本 PR 无关。本切片不扩展真实 MySQL 的 O4 部署门禁——字节丢弃是 SQL 本地的，既有 H2 套件足以提供单元证据。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

改动为 broker 内部 Java，证据基于 H2 单元/集成套件（与 O4-2 回收器同一套测试基建）。评审需确认：

1. 合格性边界成立：已退役、超过 grace 的 Session 被按字节精确回收；每个 blocker（`recovery_protected`、`grace_period`、存活 head、未到期读租约）都让字节保持不动且 backoff 正确；逐行排除（REFERENCED、kind 不符、外存、journal 引用、越界、schema_version 错、布局列非空）都保留字节，全部被排除的 Session 以 `collected_bytes = 0` 完成。
2. 防护：两个回收器实例无法同时持有同一 Session 的账本；过期 claim 被一次性接管且字节精确完成、100 行/32 MiB 页界无重复计数；陈旧 defer 无法抹掉存活接管。
3. 结果面：回收后读取得到既有 `tool_output_session_retired`；恢复读取得到 `resource_collected`；被篡改的非已回收行仍 fail-closed 为 `managed_session_resource_corrupt`。

mvn test -Dtest=SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest
Tests run: 44, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0

checkstyle 干净 + 44 个新回收器测试覆盖 `docs/design/managed-stream-capture-collection.md`（双语）全部验收项。

设计：`docs/design/managed-stream-capture-collection.md`（+ `.zh-CN.md`）；`managed-tool-output-retention-operations.md`（+ zh-CN）新增运维覆盖段落。

### 证据（变更前后对照）

prs.title: fix(core): close Managed session correctness gaps from #12693 post-merge review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Durable Managed Session journal and failover landed in #12693 and received two post-merge review rounds (R1 on 2026-09-30, R2 on 2026-10-03). This PR closes every correctness finding from those rounds that still stands on current `main` — each one verified against `main` first, then fixed with a failing test or a mutation witness:

- The cold projection crashed with a raw `TypeError` when a schema-legal null `resultRef` arrived on `turn.settled`; refs entering the read-back path are now validated and fail as typed `ManagedSessionRecordError`s naming the event.
- A renewal committed behind an in-flight release revived the activation at the same epoch; the live-activation check now runs inside the serial queue, so a renewal that lands after a release writes nothing.
- The HTTP session store silently re-baselined a writer's grant onto a regressed server head; a head behind the writer's committed position now fails closed instead of causing the writer to forget its own commits.
- Ref discovery duck-typed any object carrying the five ref field names, so a schema-valid free-form payload (e.g. a `cancel.requested` `target`) could reject a whole transaction or bind a phantom resource; refs are now collected only at schema-declared positions (`EVENT_SCHEMAS` / the header parser), while resource-body closures keep the deep walk they need.
- `isManagedSessionTranscriptSync` matched the header marker by substring, so a legacy line merely quoting it (glued or torn appends) identified as Managed; the marker must now parse as a record carrying the header subtype.
- Managed navigation turns dropped `promptId` entirely and overwrote it on turn results; they now mirror the physical index builder (`daemonPromptId` fill, first-wins on duplicates), so a session navigates identically whichever engine produced its index.
- `commitTurnComplete` accepted result bodies the cold projection would reject for the whole session; the published body is read back and validated as a reader-facing record before the transaction commits. Test helpers in three core suites and three CLI suites published exactly the rejected pattern and were corrected.
- `commitDomainRecord` spread caller content after the envelope keys, letting a colliding key forge `operationId`/`revision`/`previousRecordRef` in the durable body; the envelope now composes after content.
- `takeOverSealed` let an older binary adopt a newer-format seal and downgrade the lock (an aborted takeover then deleted the barrier entirely); it now rejects a sealed format newer than the acquirer's, and acquire validates `lockSchema.formatVersion` before any lock record exists.
- The embedded scheduler dropped the armed recovery wake on its memory-blocked pump exit, so reclaimable leases could wait forever; it now re-arms the wake, clamping an already-expired lease to a 1 s poll rather than a zero-delay spin.
- Activation store mutators other than `cancelQueued` read the caller's live objects inside the serial queue; `enqueue`/`claim`/`renew`/`release` now snapshot inputs at the boundary.
- Restoring a Managed projection crashed on a malformed `file_history_snapshot` body where the Legacy dispatch skips it; the Managed path now skips with the same warn-skip.
- The inbox fatal-error latch had no coverage driving a persist failure; one now latches and verifies memory/disk consistency across reopen.

Deferred by design: the HTTP `abort()`-seals-instead-of-release finding (R2-3) needs a writer-release route the server does not have — a cross-stack contract addition that merits its own change rather than a bundled workaround.

## Why it's needed

These are latent correctness defects on `main` in paths the Managed engine will hit under failover: a hostile or malformed journal crashing restore with untyped errors, an activation coming back from the dead after release, a server hiccup erasing a writer's own commits, a misclassified legacy transcript refusing Legacy operations, and downgrade takeovers deleting the only write barrier. Each was reviewed and verified twice (the R2 review re-confirmed the R1 set) before this fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Every fix carries a dedicated test, most with a mutation witness (the new test goes red when the fix is removed). Run the touched suites:

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run \
  src/managed-runtime/managed-session-message-projection.test.ts \
  src/managed-runtime/managed-session-authority.test.ts \
  src/managed-runtime/managed-session-metadata.test.ts \
  src/managed-runtime/managed-session-record-sink.test.ts \
  src/managed-runtime/managed-activation-store.test.ts \
  src/managed-runtime/managed-session-inbox.test.ts \
  src/managed-runtime/embedded-harness-scheduler.test.ts \
  src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts \
  src/config/managed-session-log.test.ts \
  src/services/session-legacy-execution-refusal.test.ts \
  src/services/session-writer-lease.test.ts
cd ../cli && npx vitest run src/serve/managed-runtime-tool-v3-routes.test.ts src/serve/hosted-shell-publisher.test.ts
```

Full `packages/core` suite on this branch vs `origin/main` baselined locally: the failure sets match except one timing-flaky SSH file that passes in isolation (the workspace-agents suites and four macOS ACP lease tests fail identically on both — pre-existing environment issues on this machine, unrelated to this diff). The Stage H golden fixture diff was verified to be a pure resource-ordering reorder (Java replay ingests resources as a set; the Java integration suite replays the same updated fixture in CI).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (all changes are correctness logic and tests; no user-visible surface)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local run of the suites above plus `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` (all clean).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the write-side validation in `commitTurnComplete` now rejects result bodies that are not reader-facing records; any out-of-tree producer relying on storing arbitrary turn-result bodies will be refused at commit rather than breaking restore later. The Stage H golden fixture was regenerated (pure ordering reorder, same resource set).
- Not validated / out of scope: the R2-3 HTTP `abort()`-vs-release contract change (needs a server route); review-round Suggestions that are test-coverage-only or documentation items are handled in a separate follow-up batch.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #12693 (post-merge review findings).

## 本 PR 内容

Durable Managed Session journal（#12693）合入后有两轮 post-merge review（R1：2026-09-30，R2：2026-10-03）。本 PR 关闭这两轮里在当前 `main` 上仍然成立的全部正确性发现——先在 `main` 上复验，再以失败测试或变异见证修复：

- 冷投影遇到 schema 合法的 null resultRef（turn.settled）时抛裸 TypeError；现在读回路径上的 ref 先做校验，按类型化的 ManagedSessionRecordError 报错并指名事件。
- 续期排在在途 release 之后提交时会以相同 epoch 复活 activation；活体检视现在移入串行队列内，release 之后落地的续期不再写入。
- HTTP store 会把 writer 的 grant 静默重基线到回退的服务端 head；现在 head 低于本 writer 已提交位置即 fail-closed，不再静默遗忘自己的提交。
- ref 发现原先用鸭子类型收编任何带五个 ref 字段名的对象，schema 合法的自由载荷（如 cancel.requested 的 target）会导致整个事务被拒或绑入幻影资源；现在只按 schema 声明位置（EVENT_SCHEMAS / header parser）收集，资源体闭包仍保留所需的深查。
- isManagedSessionTranscriptSync 用子串匹配 header marker，仅仅引用它的 legacy 行（glued/torn append）会被误判为 Managed；现在必须能解析为带 header 子类型的记录才算。
- Managed 导航 turn 完全不带 promptId 且覆盖式赋值；现在与物理 index builder 一致（daemonPromptId 填充、重复时首赢），同一 session 不管索引由哪个引擎产出导航都一致。
- commitTurnComplete 接受会让整个 session 冷投影拒绝的 result body；现在提交前读回已发布 body 并校验为读者可读记录。三个 core 套件和三个 CLI 套件中恰好发布被拒样式的测试 helper 已一并更正。
- commitDomainRecord 先写信封再展开调用方 content，同名键可伪造 durable body 中的 operationId/revision/previousRecordRef；现在信封在 content 之后合成。
- takeOverSealed 曾允许旧二进制接管新格式的 seal 并降级锁记录（中止的接管随后会把屏障整个删掉）；现在格式高于接管方即拒绝，acquire 在任何锁记录落盘前校验 lockSchema.formatVersion。
- 内嵌调度器在 memory-blocked 的 pump 出口丢弃已武装的恢复唤醒，可回收的租约可能永远无人认领；现在重新武装，已过期租约钳制为 1 秒轮询而非零延迟自旋。
- activation store 中除 cancelQueued 外的 mutator 在串行队列内读调用方活对象；enqueue/claim/renew/release 现在在边界快照输入。
- Managed 恢复投影遇到畸形 file_history_snapshot body 会整体崩溃，legacy 分发路径是跳过的；现在 Managed 路径按同样的 warn-skip 跳过。
- inbox 致命错误闩此前没有持久化失败的用例；现在有用例锁存并跨重验内存/磁盘一致性。

按设计延后：HTTP abort()=seal（R2-3）需要服务端目前没有的 writer-release 路由——这是跨栈契约新增，应单独成 PR，不在本批中打包绕过。

## 为什么需要

这些都是 main 上 Managed 引擎故障转移路径会真实踩中的潜伏正确性缺陷：恶意或畸形日志让 restore 以非类型化错误崩溃、activation 在 release 后复活、服务端抖动抹掉 writer 自己的提交、被误判的 legacy 转录拒绝 Legacy 操作、降级接管删掉唯一的写屏障。每一条在修复前都经两轮 review 复核（R2 已对 R1 集合做过再确认）。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

每个修复都有专测，多数带变异见证（去掉修复后新测试应变红）。运行受影响套件（命令与英文正文相同）。本分支全量 `packages/core` 与 `origin/main` 基线对比：失败集合一致，唯一差异是一个单独复跑即通过的时间型 SSH 用例（workspace-agents 套件与四个 macOS ACP lease 测试在两边同样失败——本机预存环境问题，与本 diff 无关）。Stage H golden fixture 的差异已验证为纯 resources 顺序重排（Java replay 按集合摄取，Java 集成套件在 CI 里 replay 同一份更新后的 fixture）。

### 前后对比（证据）

N/A（全部为正确性逻辑与测试，无用户可见面）

### 测试平台

macOS ✅ 已测；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：commitTurnComplete 写侧校验现在拒绝非读者可读的 result body；任何树外生产者若依赖写入任意形状 body，会在提交时被拒，而不是在之后 restore 时才坏。Stage H golden fixture 已重新生成（纯顺序重排，资源集合相同）。
- 未覆盖/范围外：R2-3 的 HTTP abort/release 契约改动（需要服务端路由）；纯测试覆盖类或文档类的 review 建议由单独的后续批次处理。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): enable the H4e-b1 team domains after the physical pass
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This turns on the Hosted lead's agent teams. #13824 landed the lead-side team runtime (the five team tools, the Agent tool's `name`, the `<teammate>` label, the board, the close cascade) with `team_state` and `team_task` disabled, and its design asked for a physical acceptance pass on a real Hosted stack before enabling them. This PR is that pass and the enablement: both domains join `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_DOMAINS`, so a Shell-laned root Session now declares the team tools wherever it declares the Agent tool. `team_message` and `team_plan` stay disabled (H4e-b2, H4e-b3).

The pass changed one rule. A one-shot member usually completes before the lead's next `task_update` lands, and a member must already be on the roster to be named, so the old rule (an owner must be a member whose run has not ended) left a fast member no way to own its task. A member whose run completed may now be set as the owner of a task the call leaves `completed`, so the board records who did the work. A member that failed or was cancelled is still refused. A call that moves a task to another open status checks the owner it keeps the same way, so a member that ended never lands on open work in two steps, and the refusal tells the model to complete the task only if the member did its work. The `task_update` description says so. Two answers follow the enabled state: the "was not notified" note now follows only a running member, and the Agent tool's unsupported-argument refusal stops listing `name` as a legacy argument once the team tools are declared.

Since the pass, main merged #13841 (worktree isolation for child agents) and #13822 (Session messages), and this branch is rebased on both. One combination needed a fix. #13822 continues a finished child as a new run when its parent messages it; for a team member that run would sit off the roster, so `task_list` would keep showing the member `completed`, `team_delete` would pass while it ran, and its result would arrive unlabeled. Until H4e-b2 lets the roster follow a continuation, `send_message` refuses to continue a member of an open team (a member of a deleted team continues as a plain child); a running member still takes messages within its run. The `task_list` roster now ends a running member's line with the task id `send_message` takes (an ended member shows none, since it cannot be messaged), and a failed or cancelled member's line with its stop reason, so a member the host never started (`creation_failed`, such as an isolated member whose Workspace was not prepared) reads apart from one that failed its work. With a team, `send_message`'s description and its refusal of a name point at those task ids. An isolated member counts as running until its merge records an outcome, so `team_delete` waits for it; a new test pins that and both of its labels.

The tests that pinned the disabled state flip deliberately: the core suites now commit `team_state` and `team_task` through the real gate and keep refusing `team_message` and `team_plan`; the CLI suites close the real gate per test instead of lifting a closed one, and the gate lifts that only the disabled state needed are removed. The exact declared-tool lists of a Shell-laned Session gain the five team tools (beside #13822's `send_message`), in the Harness suite and in the integration driver behind `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT`. One of the Harness suite's lists sat inside the model mock, where a failure only failed the Turn, and it had been missing `monitor` on main; it is now asserted after the Turn.

The design doc (status, decision 5, the close wait in decision 8, the pass results, open question 5) and the E2E plan record the pass; decisions 3, 6 and 7 and the follow-up table now also cover #13841, #13822 and H4f's public cancel (#13823), and H4d-b's routing decision notes the member exception.

## Why it's needed

The team runtime merged inert. The design (decision 10, and the ordering #13803 adopted after #13532) requires a physical pass before the gate lifts, because a gate lifted without one is how a merged runtime turns out not to run on a real host. The pass found one real defect in the runtime (the owner rule above), and it found nothing that blocks the enablement.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Physical acceptance, 2026-10-10, on an aarch64 Linux host. The chain under test is the packaged `qwen-managed-agent-server` jar (Session Store, Runtime Broker, child result relay, Session coordinator), the bundled CLI as `serve --profile hosted-harness`, durable local workers, a private MariaDB, and a real model (`qwen3.8-max`). Spring runs in the `default` approval mode, and a driver answers every Action through the public Action API. Driving uses only the public `/v1/agents/sessions` API, with one declared rig step: a fresh Session is moved to the private `hosted-workspace-shell/1` profile by SQL before its first Turn, because no public route opens a Shell profile (see Risk & Scope). A proxy in front of the Session Store SIGKILLs the Harness on the commit whose command id ends with `:join`. Evidence is read back from every committed revision of `team_state`, `team_task`, `child_run` and `child_acceptance`, the relay ledger, Session and Turn states, and the proxy's commit log. The final runs used the head of this branch, rebased on #13829 and #13823. The pass predates #13841 and #13822, so the combinations they add (an isolated member, a message to a running member, the refused continuation) are covered by unit tests; #13867 adds a Hosted IT that runs the team flow in CI.

| # | Behaviour | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Lead creates a team, spawns two named members, assigns tasks, gets both labeled reports, completes the tasks, deletes the team | **Observed.** The `team_state` chain is the opening, two joins, `closing`, `deleted`. Both notifications carry `<teammate>counter</teammate>` / `<teammate>reverser</teammate>`, consumed inside the running Turn in one run and as wake Turns in others. The first run hit the owner race (`Member "counter" has finished and cannot own a task.`); with the fix, the lead's wake Turn records `counter` and `reverser` as the owners of their completed tasks. |
| 2 | Lead closes with a member running | **Observed.** The member's `child_run` ends `cancelled` with its stop request, its Session closes, the team records are byte-identical before and after, and the lead gets no new Turn. The close waits for the member's Turn to end, including an approval the member is waiting on (decision 8). |
| 3 | Harness killed between a member's launch and its join | **Observed for the records.** Kill before the join commits: one `child_run`, no roster entry. Kill after the join commits: one `child_run`, one roster entry. The member Session runs in both arms, but the lead Turn fails `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` and the lead stays blocked (open question 5, below). |
| 4 | `team_delete` while a member runs | **Observed.** `Team "longrun" still has running members: sleeper. …`, and no `team_state` revision. |
| 5 | Approvals in `default` mode | **Observed.** `task_list` runs without a card; the `team_create`, `task_create`, `task_update` and Agent cards show their input previews (the Agent card shows `name`); `team_delete` has none. |
| Control | Same bundle with only the two domains removed from the enabled list | The model sees `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit`, `run_shell_command`, `monitor`, `agent`, with no `name` on `agent`. A forced `name` is refused (`Hosted child agent received unsupported argument "name"…`), and nothing is committed. |

Unit and suite level:
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/`: 3194 passed (at head 9909df4523 on main a7e26adde7).
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve`: everything passes except five cases, none in team code. Three are filesystem-permission cases that cannot fail as root, which this host runs as. `hosted-harness-session.test.ts` "wake-park probe let the pump block" fails by test order, and fails the same way with this commit's changes removed. `managed-runtime-session-worker.test.ts` failed once under load and passes when rerun alone.
- Negative controls: removing each owner-rule condition (the completed-member admission, the kept-owner re-check and its two guards), the running-member notice condition, the enabled-state argument text, the member-continuation refusal, its deleted-team filter (or widening it to every child), the roster's stop reasons (failed and cancelled), the team-aware `send_message` refusal, the roster's task id for ended members, `closing` counted as not open, the open-team filter, the label reading only open teams, the board notice and refusal wording, or the team `send_message` description makes a test fail; so does a wrong entry in the first-turn tool list that the Harness suite now really asserts.
- `tsc --noEmit` for cli and integration-tests; ESLint (`--max-warnings 0`) and Prettier on the changed files: clean.
- Review before the rebase: four rounds, each with an open-ended and an adversarial reviewer. Rounds 1 and 2 found no Critical and drove the reopen re-check, the answer texts, the moved tool-list assertion and the doc corrections above. Rounds 3 and 4 found no Critical.
- Review after rebasing onto #13841 and #13822, over the combined result: round 1 (an open-ended and an adversarial reviewer per merge) found one Major, the member continuation above, and doc gaps; round 2 found one Minor, the refusal also covering deleted teams; both are fixed here. Round 3 found no Critical. The remaining notes of every round are listed in a PR comment.
- Automated review at 89086c15d0 left seven suggestions: stale H4e status rows, the claim that nothing reads a deleted team's roster, routing statements without the member exception, a hand-rolled open-team check, task ids on ended members and a refusal that hid the cost of deleting the team, "task id" read as the board number, and a duplicated task-id derivation. All are fixed in 9909df4523, reviewed in two more rounds (Minors and Nits, all fixed).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for screenshots (no UI). Before: no Session declares a team tool, and `name` is refused. After: see the table above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

The rig above (aarch64 Debian 13, Node 24, JDK 21, MariaDB 11.8). Unit suites on x86_64 Linux, Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the team tools become declared on every Shell-laned root Session whose child kind gate is open, so the model can now create teams and board tasks there. Every team write is the lead's own journal; `team_message` and `team_plan` stay disabled.
- Pre-existing limit, not fixed here (design open question 5): a Harness that dies after a background launch commits and before the Turn's next checkpoint leaves the Turn parked at `model_output_committed`. A replacement Harness declines it (`model_start`), the coordinator fails the Turn `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked`, and every later load of the lead answers `hosted_turn_recovery_required`: the child runs, but its result never arrives, and every later Turn fails the same way. The same run with an unnamed background launch and no team ends identically, so this is H4b's recovery, and teams only add a commit inside the window. Open question 4 (from #13829) is the same window on a Hooks Session. Declaring no team tools would not close it for H4b's launches, so the enablement accepts it; the fix is tracked in #13847.
- User reach: no Java route creates a Shell-laned Session today. A public Workspace Session gets `hosted-workspace-files/1`, the public create refuses a profile override, and a child copies its parent's profile. So, like H4b's Agent tool, the team tools reach users only once a public route opens a Shell profile.
- Not validated / out of scope: the channel Turn's interrupted settlement (the rig has no channel adapter; covered by unit tests in #13824 and #13829); macOS and Windows hosts.
- Beside #13822: `send_message` no longer continues a finished member of an open team (its refusal says when a new member can be launched, and that deleting the team lets it continue but gives up the board); continuing members is H4e-b2's. A plain child, and a member of a deleted team, continue as before.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Java already validates the team bodies (H4e-a), so the server-first order holds.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-agent-team-lead-runtime.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-agent-team-lead-runtime.zh-CN.md), both updated together.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13745 (H4e), stage H of #12380 under #12827. Follows #13824 and #13829. Open question 5 is tracked in #13847. Follow-up: #13867 (the team flow as a Hosted IT in CI).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 为 Hosted lead 开启 agent 团队。#13824 已落地 lead 侧团队运行时（五个团队工具、Agent 工具的 `name`、`<teammate>` 标签、任务板、关闭级联），当时 `team_state` 与 `team_task` 仍关闭，其设计要求先在真实 Hosted 环境上完成实机验收再启用。本 PR 就是这次验收加上启用：两个 domain 加入 `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_DOMAINS`，带 Shell 通道的根 Session 在声明 Agent 工具的地方同时声明团队工具。`team_message` 与 `team_plan` 保持关闭（H4e-b2、H4e-b3）。

验收改动了一条规则。一次性成员通常在 lead 的下一次 `task_update` 到达之前就已完成，而成员必须先进入名册才能被指名，所以旧规则（owner 必须是 run 尚未结束的成员）让快速完成的成员永远无法成为其任务的 owner。现在，run 已成功完成的成员可以被设为在该调用之后处于 `completed` 的任务的 owner，任务板因此能记下是谁完成的。失败或被取消的成员仍被拒绝。把任务改到另一个未完成状态的调用，会以同样方式检查它保留的 owner，因此已结束的成员不会经两步落到未完成的工作上；拒绝提示也会告诉模型，只有成员确实做完了这项工作才把任务标为完成。`task_update` 的描述同步说明了这一点。另有两处回答随启用状态调整："was not notified" 提示现在只跟在运行中的成员之后；团队工具声明之后，Agent 工具的不支持参数拒绝不再把 `name` 列为 legacy 参数。

验收之后，main 合入了 #13841（child agent 的 worktree 隔离）与 #13822（Session 消息），本分支已 rebase 到两者之上。其中一种组合需要修复。父 Session 给已结束的 child 发消息时，#13822 会把它续跑为一个新的 run；对团队成员而言，这个 run 不在名册上，于是 `task_list` 仍显示该成员 `completed`，`team_delete` 会在它运行时放行，其结果也不带标签。在 H4e-b2 让名册跟随续跑之前，`send_message` 拒绝续跑未删除团队的成员（已删除团队的成员作为普通 child 续跑）；运行中的成员仍可在同一个 run 内接收消息。`task_list` 的名册现在在运行中成员的行末附上 `send_message` 所需的 task id（已结束的成员无法接收消息，不附 id），失败或被取消的成员还附上停止原因，因此主机从未启动的成员（`creation_failed`，例如 Workspace 没有准备好的隔离成员）与自身工作失败的成员可以区分。有团队时，`send_message` 的描述及其对按名字寻址的拒绝都会指向这些 task id。隔离成员在其 merge 记录结果之前都算作运行中，`team_delete` 会等待它；新增的测试固定了这一点以及它的两个标签。

固定禁用状态的测试被有意翻转：core 套件现在经由真实门禁提交 `team_state` 与 `team_task`，并继续拒绝 `team_message` 与 `team_plan`；CLI 套件改为按测试关闭真实门禁，而不再放开一个关闭的门禁，只为禁用状态存在的门禁放开被删除。带 Shell 通道 Session 的精确声明工具列表加入了五个团队工具（与 #13822 的 `send_message` 并列），包括 Harness 套件和 `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT` 所用的集成驱动。Harness 套件里有一处列表写在模型 mock 内部，失败只会让该 Turn 失败，而且它在 main 上一直漏了 `monitor`；现在改为在 Turn 之后断言。

设计文档（状态、决策 5、决策 8 中的关闭等待、验收结果、开放问题 5）与 E2E 计划记录了这次验收；决策 3、6、7 与后续工作表现在也覆盖 #13841、#13822 与 H4f 的公开取消（#13823），H4d-b 的路由决策也注明了成员例外。

## 为什么需要

团队运行时合入时是惰性的。设计（决策 10，以及 #13803 在 #13532 之后采用的顺序）要求门禁放开之前先做实机验收，因为不经实机验收就放开门禁，正是已合入运行时在真实主机上跑不起来的原因。这次验收发现了运行时的一个真实缺陷（上面的 owner 规则），没有发现阻碍启用的问题。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

实机验收于 2026-10-10 在 aarch64 Linux 主机上进行。被测链路为打包的 `qwen-managed-agent-server` jar（Session Store、Runtime Broker、child 结果 relay、Session 协调器）、以 `serve --profile hosted-harness` 运行的打包 CLI、持久本地 worker、私有 MariaDB，以及真实模型（`qwen3.8-max`）。Spring 运行在 `default` 审批模式，驱动通过公共 Action API 应答每个 Action。驱动只使用公共 `/v1/agents/sessions` API，外加一个申报过的环境步骤：新建的 Session 在第一个 Turn 之前用 SQL 切到私有的 `hosted-workspace-shell/1` 档位，因为没有公共路由能打开 Shell 档位（见风险与范围）。Session Store 前的代理会在命令 id 以 `:join` 结尾的提交上 SIGKILL Harness。证据读自 `team_state`、`team_task`、`child_run` 与 `child_acceptance` 的每个已提交修订、relay 账本、Session 与 Turn 状态，以及代理的提交日志。最终几轮使用本分支 head（已 rebase 到 #13829 与 #13823 之上）。验收早于 #13841 与 #13822，因此它们带来的组合（隔离成员、给运行中成员的消息、被拒绝的续跑）由单元测试覆盖；#13867 加了一个在 CI 中运行团队流程的 Hosted IT。

| # | 行为 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | lead 建团队、按名字拉起两个成员、分配任务、收到两份带名字的汇报、完成任务、删除团队 | **已观察到。** `team_state` 链为开启、两次加入、`closing`、`deleted`。两条通知分别带 `<teammate>counter</teammate>` / `<teammate>reverser</teammate>`，一次运行中在进行中的 Turn 内被消费，其他运行中作为唤醒 Turn 到达。第一次运行遇到了 owner 竞态（`Member "counter" has finished and cannot own a task.`）；修复后，lead 的唤醒 Turn 把 `counter` 与 `reverser` 记为各自已完成任务的 owner。 |
| 2 | 仍有成员运行时 lead 关闭 | **已观察到。** 成员的 `child_run` 带着停止请求以 `cancelled` 结束，其 Session 关闭，团队记录关闭前后逐字节相同，lead 没有新的 Turn。关闭会等待成员的 Turn 结束，包括成员正在等待的审批（决策 8）。 |
| 3 | 在成员启动与加入之间杀掉 Harness | **记录层面已观察到。** 加入提交之前杀掉：一个 `child_run`，没有名册条目。加入提交之后杀掉：一个 `child_run`，一个名册条目。两种情况下成员 Session 都会运行，但 lead 的 Turn 以 `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` 失败，lead 持续被阻塞（见下文开放问题 5）。 |
| 4 | 有成员运行时 `team_delete` | **已观察到。** `Team "longrun" still has running members: sleeper. …`，且没有 `team_state` 修订。 |
| 5 | `default` 模式下的审批 | **已观察到。** `task_list` 不弹审批卡；`team_create`、`task_create`、`task_update` 与 Agent 的审批卡都显示输入预览（Agent 卡显示 `name`）；`team_delete` 没有预览。 |
| 对照 | 同一个包，只从启用列表中去掉这两个 domain | 模型看到的是 `read_file`、`write_file`、`edit`、`run_shell_command`、`monitor`、`agent`，`agent` 没有 `name`。强行传 `name` 被拒（`Hosted child agent received unsupported argument "name"…`），且不提交任何记录。 |

单元与套件层面：
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/`：3194 个通过（head 9909df4523，main a7e26adde7）。
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve`：除五个用例外全部通过，五个都不在团队代码里。其中三个是文件权限用例，本机以 root 运行时无法触发失败；`hosted-harness-session.test.ts` 的 "wake-park probe let the pump block" 因测试顺序失败，去掉本提交的改动后同样失败；`managed-runtime-session-worker.test.ts` 在高负载下失败过一次，单独重跑通过。
- 负向对照：分别去掉 owner 规则的每个条件（已完成成员的放行、保留 owner 的复查及其两个前提）、只对运行中成员给出提示的条件、随启用状态变化的参数文案、成员续跑拒绝、其已删除团队过滤（或把它放宽到所有 child）、名册的停止原因（失败与取消）、有团队时的 `send_message` 拒绝文案、已结束成员的名册 task id、把 `closing` 当作未开启、未删除团队过滤、标签只读未删除团队、任务板提示与拒绝的措辞、有团队时的 `send_message` 描述，都会有测试失败；Harness 套件中那处现在真正生效的首轮工具列表，只要写错一项也会失败。
- cli 与 integration-tests 的 `tsc --noEmit`；变更文件的 ESLint（`--max-warnings 0`）与 Prettier：干净。
- rebase 之前的评审：共四轮，每轮一个无方向审计、一个对抗审计。第 1、2 轮没有 Critical，推动了上文的重开复查、回答文案、移出的工具列表断言与文档修正。第 3、4 轮没有 Critical。
- rebase 到 #13841 与 #13822 之后，对合并结果重新评审：第 1 轮（每个合入各一个无方向审计与一个对抗审计）发现一个 Major，即上文的成员续跑，以及文档缺口；第 2 轮发现一个 Minor，即拒绝也覆盖了已删除的团队；两者都已在本 PR 修复。第 3 轮没有 Critical。各轮剩余意见列在 PR 评论里。
- 89086c15d0 上的自动评审提出七条建议：过时的 H4e 状态行、"团队删除后无人读取名册"的说法、缺少成员例外的路由陈述、手写的未删除团队判断、已结束成员的 task id 以及没说清删除团队代价的拒绝文案、"task id" 会被读成任务板编号、重复的 task id 推导。全部在 9909df4523 修复，并又经过两轮评审（Minor 与 Nit 均已修复）。

### 证据（前后对比）

截图不适用（无 UI）。之前：没有 Session 声明团队工具，`name` 被拒。之后：见上表。

### 测试平台

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

上述验收环境（aarch64 Debian 13、Node 24、JDK 21、MariaDB 11.8）。单元套件在 x86_64 Linux、Node 22 上运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：凡 child kind 门禁打开的带 Shell 通道根 Session 都会声明团队工具，模型在那里可以创建团队和任务板任务。每次团队写入都只写 lead 自己的 journal；`team_message` 与 `team_plan` 保持关闭。
- 既有限制，本 PR 不修（设计开放问题 5）：Harness 若在一次后台启动提交之后、Turn 的下一个检查点之前死掉，该 Turn 会停在 `model_output_committed`。替代 Harness 拒绝接管（`model_start`），协调器以 `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` 让该 Turn 失败，之后每次加载 lead 都回答 `hosted_turn_recovery_required`：child 会运行，但结果永远到不了 lead，之后的每个 Turn 也以同样方式失败。不建团队、改用不带名字的后台启动做同样的运行，结局完全相同，因此这属于 H4b 的恢复，团队只是在这个窗口里多了一次提交。开放问题 4（来自 #13829）是同一窗口在 Hooks Session 上的形态。不声明团队工具也无法为 H4b 的后台启动关上这个窗口，因此启用接受它；修复由 #13847 跟踪。
- 用户可达性：目前没有 Java 路由会创建带 Shell 通道的 Session。公共 Workspace Session 得到 `hosted-workspace-files/1`，公共创建接口拒绝覆盖档位，child 复制父 Session 的档位。因此与 H4b 的 Agent 工具一样，团队工具要等某条公共路由开放 Shell 档位之后才能触达用户。
- 未验证或不在范围内：channel Turn 的中断收尾（该环境没有 channel 适配器；由 #13824 与 #13829 的单元测试覆盖）；macOS 与 Windows 主机。
- 与 #13822 并存：`send_message` 不再续跑未删除团队中已结束的成员（拒绝文案说明何时可以启动新成员，以及删除团队后可以续跑、但会放弃任务板）；成员续跑属于 H4e-b2。普通 child 与已删除团队的成员照常续跑。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。Java 自 H4e-a 起已校验团队记录体，因此 server 先行顺序成立。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-agent-team-lead-runtime.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-agent-team-lead-runtime.zh-CN.md)，两者同步更新。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #13745（H4e），即 #12827 下 #12380 的 H 阶段。接续 #13824 与 #13829。开放问题 5 由 #13847 跟踪。后续：#13867（把团队流程作为 Hosted IT 放进 CI）。

prs.title: fix(core): fill empty signature on unsigned thinking blocks for strict Anthropic-compatible proxies
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When history contains assistant `thinking` blocks that carry no signature — which happens with cross-provider history, where the upstream generator set `thought: true` without a `thoughtSignature` — and that history is replayed against a non-native Anthropic-compatible proxy, the request now sends those blocks with an empty `signature` key (`signature: ''`) instead of shipping the block with no `signature` key at all. The thinking text itself is preserved. The fill is scoped to non-4.6 (or unparseable) model ids and does not depend on the outgoing request's `thinking` configuration within that scope: the blocks being repaired come from history, and the affected consumers fork with thinking disabled (see below). The 4.6+ adaptive-model quadrant is owned by the existing drop pass and is byte-identical to main in both directions — with thinking on it drops the unsigned blocks as before, and with thinking off nothing runs, so the block ships exactly as `main` did — which keeps fill and drop disjoint by construction. The other quadrants are unchanged: DeepSeek requests still go through normalization, and history replayed against the native Anthropic API is left untouched.

## Why it's needed

I run Qwen Code against a strict Anthropic-compatible backend (verified against SGLang v0.5.19; llama.cpp- and vLLM-backed proxies are expected to behave the same, not independently verified). Those backends require the `signature` key to be present on every assistant `thinking` block: a block without the key is rejected with HTTP 400 (e.g. SGLang's `thinking.signature` error), while the same block is accepted once `"signature": ""` is added. The key goes missing whenever cross-provider history contains thinking that an upstream generator produced without a signature — for example an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, which has no signature concept. The failing requests are the forked consumers (managed auto-memory extraction, prompt suggestions, skill review): they replay the main history with `thinkingConfig: { includeThoughts: false }`, so the outgoing request carries no `thinking` parameter at all while still shipping the unsigned history blocks — a deterministic 400 per turn before this PR, silent on their best-effort paths, easy to miss.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Focused unit tests for the changed directory: `npm run test -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core -- src/core/anthropicContentGenerator` — 3 files / 327 tests, all pass, including the five new cases: with the fill option on, a `thought` part without a signature replays as `signature: ''`, and with it off the block stays unsigned (converter); a pre-4.6 model through a non-native proxy sends the block with `signature: ''` — filled, not dropped as on 4.6+ and not left unsigned as against the native API — while the native-API case stays unchanged (generator); the #11772 repro shape — the same proxy with `thinkingConfig: { includeThoughts: false }` (no `thinking` parameter on the wire) — still gets the history block filled, proving the fill is independent of the outgoing thinking config (generator); a 4.6 model through the same proxy with thinking off ships the block byte-identical to `main` — the fill is out of scope for 4.6+ and the drop does not run without the outgoing `thinking` (generator). The other three quadrants (DeepSeek normalize, 4.6+ proxy drop, native untouched) are covered by the pre-existing tests in the same files.
- Full workspace suite: `npm run test -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` (35,693 tests) — the Anthropic converter/generator suites pass; the only failures are pre-existing environment-sensitive flakes (git index-lock and timing-budget tests in unrelated files) that reproduce identically on a pristine `main` baseline under the same load.
- Typecheck and lint: `npm run typecheck -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` and `npm run lint -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` — expected: `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a non-user-visible core change (request-shape fix in the Anthropic history converter, no UI); see How to verify for the focused unit tests and expected outcomes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested (UTM Win11 ARM VM) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (Docker, node:22-bookworm) |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests, `tsc --noEmit`, and `eslint` only; no live backend involved (the new tests are unit-level; the wire-level 400/200 repro from #11772 was done separately against a self-hosted SGLang).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fill reuses the exact pass the DeepSeek normalization already uses (`fillMissingThinkingSignatures`), whose semantics — add `signature: ''` only when the key is missing, preserve the thinking text — are already validated on that path; the new gate is non-DeepSeek + non-native base URL, deliberately independent of the outgoing `thinking` config (the repaired blocks come from history). The only behavior change is on the non-4.6 (or unparseable) model quadrant: requests through such proxies now ship the history blocks with `signature: ''` instead of with no key, in both thinking-on and thinking-off requests — strictly the shape the strict backends already require (verified 200 in #11772). The 4.6+ quadrant is byte-identical to `main` in both directions: with thinking on the drop pass deletes the blocks as before, and with thinking off nothing runs at all.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live wire replay in this PR (the 400 → 200 repro against SGLang v0.5.19 from #11772 remains the wire-level evidence; llama.cpp and vLLM not independently verified); unsigned thinking on tool-use turns still fails closed before sending — pre-existing behavior, unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — strictly additive (a new optional converter option, default off, plus the generator gate); no config or API surface changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11772.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当历史中包含没有签名的助手 `thinking` 块——这种情况出现在跨提供方历史中，上游生成器设置了 `thought: true` 但没有 `thoughtSignature`——并且该历史被重放到非原生 Anthropic 兼容代理时，请求现在会为这些块带上空的 `signature` 键（`signature: ''`），而不是像以前那样发出完全没有 `signature` 键的块。thinking 文本本身保持不变。该补全限定在非 4.6（或无法解析的）模型 id 上，且在该范围内不依赖出站请求的 `thinking` 配置：被修复的块来自历史，而受影响的消费者是在 thinking 关闭的状态下 fork 的（见下文）。4.6+ 自适应模型的象限归既有丢弃路径所有，两个方向都与 main 逐字节一致——thinking 开启时照旧整体丢弃无签名块，thinking 关闭时什么都不运行、块按 main 原样发出——补全与丢弃按构造互不相交。其余象限保持不变：DeepSeek 请求仍走规范化路径；重放到原生 Anthropic API 的历史保持不动。

## 为什么需要

我在严格的 Anthropic 兼容后端上运行 Qwen Code（已在 SGLang v0.5.19 上验证；基于 llama.cpp 和 vLLM 的代理预期行为相同，未独立验证）。这些后端要求每个助手 `thinking` 块都必须带有 `signature` 键：缺少该键的块会被以 HTTP 400 拒绝（例如 SGLang 的 `thinking.signature` 错误），而一旦给同一个块加上 `"signature": ""`，请求就会被接受。当跨提供方历史中包含上游生成器产出的无签名 thinking 时（例如没有签名概念的 OpenAI 兼容端点），这个键就会缺失。失败的请求正是 fork 消费者（托管 auto-memory 提取、提示建议、skill 审查）：它们以 `thinkingConfig: { includeThoughts: false }` 重放主历史，因此出站请求根本没有 `thinking` 参数，却仍然携带无签名的历史块——在本 PR 之前每个回合都是确定性的 400，在其 best-effort 路径上静默失败，很容易漏掉。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 改动目录的聚焦单元测试：`npm run test -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core -- src/core/anthropicContentGenerator` — 3 个文件 / 327 个测试，全部通过，包括五个新用例：开启补全选项时，没有签名的 `thought` 部分重放为 `signature: ''`；关闭选项时该块保持无签名（converter）；经非原生代理的 4.6 之前模型发送的块带 `signature: ''`——是被补全，不像 4.6+ 那样被丢弃，也不像对原生 API 那样保持无签名——而原生 API 用例保持不变（generator）；#11772 的复现形状——同一代理但 `thinkingConfig: { includeThoughts: false }`（线上没有 `thinking` 参数）——历史块照样被补全，证明补全不依赖出站 thinking 配置（generator）；4.6 模型经同一代理、thinking 关闭时，块按 `main` 原样逐字节发出——补全对 4.6+ 不生效，丢弃在没有出站 `thinking` 时也不运行（generator）。其余三个象限（DeepSeek 规范化、4.6+ 代理丢弃、原生保持不动）由同一批文件中的既有测试覆盖。
- 完整 workspace 测试套件：`npm run test -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core`（35,693 个测试）——Anthropic converter/generator 套件通过；仅有的失败是既有的环境敏感 flake（不相关文件中 git index-lock 与计时预算测试），在同样的负载下于干净的 `main` 基线上同样复现。
- 类型检查与 lint：`npm run typecheck -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` 和 `npm run lint -w @qwen-code/qwen-code-core` — 预期：`tsc --noEmit` 和 `eslint` 干净。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A — 这是不可见的核心改动（Anthropic 历史转换器中的请求形状修复，无 UI）；聚焦单元测试及其预期结果见「如何验证」。

### 测试平台

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 已测试（UTM Win11 ARM 虚拟机） |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试（Docker，node:22-bookworm） |

### 环境（可选）

N/A — 仅单元测试、`tsc --noEmit` 和 `eslint`；不涉及真实后端（新测试为单元测试级别；#11772 中 400/200 的线上复现是单独对自建 SGLang 完成的）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：该补全复用了 DeepSeek 规范化已在使用的同一条处理（`fillMissingThinkingSignatures`），其语义——仅在键缺失时添加 `signature: ''`、保留 thinking 文本——已在那条路径上得到验证；新门控为「非 DeepSeek + 非原生基础 URL」，刻意不依赖出站 `thinking` 配置（被修复的块来自历史）。唯一的行为变化在非 4.6（或无法解析的）模型象限：经此类代理的请求现在携带 `signature: ''` 的历史块，而不是完全没有键，thinking 开关两个方向都如此——这正是严格后端已经要求的形状（#11772 中验证为 200）。4.6+ 象限两个方向都与 `main` 逐字节一致：thinking 开启时丢弃路径照旧删除块，thinking 关闭时什么都不运行。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：本 PR 未做真实线上重放（#11772 中对 SGLang v0.5.19 的 400 → 200 复现仍是线上层面的证据；llama.cpp 与 vLLM 未独立验证）；工具使用（tool-use）回合上的无签名 thinking 仍会在发送前以 fail-closed 方式拒绝——既有行为，未变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无——纯增量（新增可选的 converter 选项，默认关闭，外加 generator 门控）；配置与 API 表面均无变化。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #11772。

</details>

prs.title: fix(serve): name Hosted recovery-refusal branches in cold-load 409s
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Eighteen refusal sites across the Hosted Harness daemon routes, plus the approval-resolution route's four recovery refusals, all answered 409 with the single code `hosted_turn_recovery_required`. Two recurring CI flakes of `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT.packagedHarnessUsesSavedWorkspacesThroughRealBrokerWorkerAndSqlStore` failed on exactly that code at the cold load right after an error turn + `detach` (driver `javaLoad` at `hosted-workspace-tool-turn-driver.ts:836`), and neither the response body nor the daemon log could say which gate rejected. This PR makes every refusal distinguishable: each site now adds a `reason` next to `error`/`code` in the response body, daemon access-log lines for status >= 400 now record the response `code` and `reason`, and the previously silent refusal arms — the cold-load restore-verification and workspace-writable catches, plus the authorization reads on the continue/cancel routes — log the refusing cause to stderr with the session id. Review round 1 sharpened the taxonomy from coarse tokens to one reason per branch: incomplete publications split from unsettled turns (`publication_incomplete`), both identical `assertWritable` calls named uniformly (`workspace_not_writable`), the four-way prompt/MCP/rewind gates decomposed through one shared helper (`turn_blocked` → `activation_inactive` → `mcp_operations_pending` → `hook_operations_pending`), unreadable authorizations distinguished from genuinely non-runnable ones and from runnable-but-unready continuations (`authorization_unreadable` vs. `not_runnable` vs. `continuation_not_ready`), and the approval route differentiating a stopped writer (`writes_stopped`) from a blocked session. Review round 2 then carried the in-hand sub-cause at every refusal: the file-history settle conjunct lands on stderr (live-witnessed `phase_await_runtime`), a blocked restore logs its basis, a not-runnable authorization names its blocked reason, the approval route shares the harness routes' `turn_blocked` with blocked-ness passed in explicitly, and the whole vocabulary is a closed `HostedRefusalReason` union type across the two modules, so any label outside the list is a compile error.

This is the triage-approved diagnosis step (issue #13255, stage-2 steps 1–2). No gate semantics change: HTTP statuses and `error`/`code` values are untouched, and the `reason` field is purely additive, so the Java daemon client (raw-body `DaemonHttpException`) and every integration driver that asserts on `.error`/`.code` are unaffected. Covering all 18 sites rather than only the two the narrowing points at is deliberate, not incidental: if the next occurrence lands on a branch the analysis marked unreachable, the wide sweep falsifies the narrowing itself from the same CI evidence instead of leaving us blind again — please keep the labels when touching nearby code rather than trimming them back.

## Why it's needed

Both observed failures (runs 37078701187 and 37086759282, attempt 1) carry the identical assertion `{"error":"hosted_turn_recovery_required","code":"hosted_turn_recovery_required"}` at the cold-load call site, with the surrounding daemon log showing only the *expected* rewind conflict 409. Static narrowing over the cold-load path shows that after an awaited, settled error turn, only two branches can fire on the same committed state — the two formerly-silent catches — yet proving that needs one more CI occurrence with branch identity. With this PR, the next occurrence pins the branch in three places at once (driver assertion body, daemon access log, stderr cause line), which is the precondition for the stage-3 decision: whether the cold-load verify catch should treat a transient store failure as retryable instead of refusing, or tighten its invariant. That semantic decision is deliberately not in this PR.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the taxonomy holds: (1) `packages/cli` unit tests `src/serve/server/access-log.test.ts` (12/12), `src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts` (196/196) and `src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` (143/143) — every reason literal is asserted at every emission site, including sixteen refusal scenarios added across rounds 1–2 (cold-load gate splits, takeover/continue/cancel authorization branches with per-route lease asymmetry, prompt/MCP-operations/refusal gates for inactive activation and pending MCP/Hook operations, the daemon access-log seam, the undo-worker's `undo_unsettled`, and the sub-cause stderr witnesses); (2) the packaged cross-process IT: on this machine with JDK 21, Node 22 and an isolated Maven repo, `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT#packagedHarnessUsesSavedWorkspacesThroughRealBrokerWorkerAndSqlStore` ran 14 times against the H2 MySQL-mode store (1 baseline + 12-loop + 1 final on the rebased bundle), all green, flake not reproduced — expected at its observed CI rate and local profile differences (H2 vs MySQL 8.4, macOS vs Linux, no physical workspace guards). A reviewer mainly needs to confirm the `reason` labels honestly describe each branch and that response/`code` compatibility is preserved.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no UI). Before: cold-load 409 body `{"error":"hosted_turn_recovery_required","code":"hosted_turn_recovery_required"}`, access-log line `... status=409 request completed` with no branch identity. After: body adds e.g. `"reason":"restore_verification_failed"`, access-log warn line gains `code=hosted_turn_recovery_required reason=restore_verification_failed`, and the silent catches emit `qwen serve: Hosted Session <id> restore verification refused: <cause>` / `... workspace writable check refused: <cause>`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

Local: JDK 21.0.11 (Zulu), Maven 3.9.11 with isolated repo `m2-13255`, Node v22.22.2, H2 in MySQL mode for the IT. Unit suites via vitest.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: additive-only response/log surface; the risk is label accuracy — after two review rounds every `HostedRefusalReason` literal is pinned by type and test at every emission site, the daemon access-log seam is covered end-to-end (mutation-verified: deleting the two locals writes turns its test red; deleting the cancel cause line or the continue handback turns theirs red), and the refusal sub-causes land on stderr with live witnesses (`phase_await_runtime`, `missing_checkpoint`, the writer-loss causes). The public `reason` vocabulary stays closed literals only; store-derived free text never enters the body or the log field.
- Not validated / out of scope: the transient branch itself is not reproduced and the semantic question (retry vs. refuse on transient store failure) is intentionally deferred until one CI occurrence names the branch. One coverage gap disclosed: the cancel route's `recovery_unsupported` arm is not separately driven (it needs an incoherent parked state); the literal is pinned on the continue route.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — HTTP statuses and `error`/`code` values unchanged; `reason` is additive.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13255 — diagnosis-enabling step; please do not close the issue on merge until a CI occurrence identifies the rejecting branch and the stage-3 semantic decision lands.

prs.title: fix(hosted): Count future result-hook mounts at child admission
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Hosted child-agent admission now counts enabled, trusted command hooks on PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure and PostToolBatch as potential Session-owned Workspace mount holds. Both foreground and background requests refuse before creating a child task. The refusal explains the Session owner constraint instead of suggesting a background launch or fresh turn would release it.

Admission uses the existing Hook execution eligibility rules, so a consumed once hook or an ineligible owner/agent scope cannot cause a false future-hold refusal.

## Why it's needed

A restored hook catalog can begin without a mount. Previously, that allowed a child launch even though result hooks could acquire the parent's mount afterward and retain it past turn finish. Checking only the current hold misses this lifecycle transition.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Restore a catalog containing one enabled, trusted result command hook with no current mount, then request a child in each mode. Verify the request refuses without a durable child task. Repeat for all three result events. Execute a once hook, close its owner and restore the same Session: both child modes must then admit without executing the hook again. Existing Hook/MCP owner holds must still refuse; HTTP/function/prompt hooks, disabled or untrusted command hooks, and a command hook on an unrelated event must retain their admission behavior. A background child without a Hook owner must still start normally.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Restored PostToolUse command, foreground | Child admitted; parent hook mount survives turn finish | Refusal, no child task |
| Restored PostToolUse command, background | Child admitted; parent hook mount survives turn finish | Refusal, no child task |
| Existing Hook hold, either mode | Refusal | Refusal |

The same real Session/Hook/ToolTurn rig reproduced both gaps and passed all five post-fix probes. A supplemental consumed-once probe reproduced false refusal in both modes before the eligibility correction. The final child-agent suite passed 62 tests, the nearby HookSession suite passed 86, and reverting the initial production change made six regressions fail (the three result events in both modes). Build, bundle, full typecheck, changed-file ESLint and Prettier passed. Only the two related test files ran; no full test suite ran. Independent review and a bounded Qwen source review found no owned correctness finding. The automated Qwen medium build/test expansion was stopped to keep local validation focused; its full CI-engine gate remains unverified. This PR is a draft pending normal upstream checks and review. Local UI verification is PARTIAL: the built CLI starts, but the deployed child-consumer path is unavailable locally.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ local rig and CLI startup |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Baseline `4360b003a087fe9e57f6ffbe7ba48795980b59c3`, Node 22.23.2, Qwen CLI 0.25.0. Real durable Session state and restored Hook owner; the remote Workspace Broker boundary is stubbed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: conservative admission based on eligible result-command catalog entries; matcher matching remains conservative because later tools may match while a background child is alive.
- Not validated / out of scope: a deployed Java shared-workspace consumer and child model/tool process. The real CLI Session request returned `hosted_tool_profile_unavailable` without a deployment Broker. Current HTTP/function execution also acquires a mount; this existing discrepancy with the issue's assumption is disclosed in the issue thread, and its requested admission behavior is preserved here. Later lifecycle hooks can also acquire while a background child lives; this PR implements the three result-event admission cases chosen by the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: affected child requests now refuse early; no configuration or persisted-state migration.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13709

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

Hosted child agent 准入现在将 PostToolUse、PostToolUseFailure 和 PostToolBatch 上启用且可信的 command hook 计入潜在的 Session 级 Workspace 挂载占用。前台、后台请求都会在创建子任务前拒绝。提示会说明 Session owner 的限制，不再建议通过后台启动或换下一轮来释放它。

准入复用现有的 Hook 执行资格规则，已消耗的 once hook 或不符合 owner/agent scope 的条目不会造成未来挂载误拒绝。

## 为什么需要

恢复后的 hook catalog 起初可以没有挂载占用。此前，即使结果 hook 随后会取得父 Session 的挂载并在本轮结束后继续持有，子 agent 也会被放行。只检查当前占用会漏掉这个生命周期变化。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

恢复只包含一个启用且可信的结果 command hook 的 catalog，确认没有当前挂载，然后分别请求前台、后台子 agent。应拒绝请求，且没有持久化子任务。对三个结果事件分别验证。执行一次 once hook，关闭其 owner，再恢复同一 Session：两种子任务模式都应放行，且不重复执行该 hook。现有 Hook/MCP owner 占用仍应拒绝；HTTP/function/prompt hook、禁用或不可信的 command hook，以及无关事件的 command hook，应保持原来的准入行为。没有 Hook owner 的后台子 agent 仍应正常启动。

### 证据（修改前后）

| 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 恢复 PostToolUse command，前台 | 子任务放行；父 hook 挂载在本轮结束后仍持有 | 拒绝，无子任务 |
| 恢复 PostToolUse command，后台 | 子任务放行；父 hook 挂载在本轮结束后仍持有 | 拒绝，无子任务 |
| 现有 Hook 占用，两种模式 | 拒绝 | 拒绝 |

相同的真实 Session/Hook/ToolTurn 夹具复现了两个缺口，修复后五个探针全部通过。补充的 consumed-once 探针在资格判断修正前复现了前后台误拒绝。最终 child-agent 测试套件 62 个用例通过，附近 HookSession 套件 86 个通过；回退最初生产改动后六个回归用例失败（三个结果事件 × 两种模式）。build、bundle、全仓 typecheck、改动文件 ESLint 和 Prettier 均通过。仅运行两个相关测试文件，没有运行全量测试。独立复核和有调用上限的 Qwen 源码复核均未发现本次引入的正确性问题。本地验证限定在相关文件，已停止自动 Qwen medium 流程扩展的 build/test；完整 CI 引擎门禁仍未验证。此 PR 保持 draft，等待上游常规检查和评审。本地 UI 验证为 PARTIAL：构建后的 CLI 可启动，本机无法验证部署后的子任务消费者路径。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地夹具和 CLI 启动 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

基线 `4360b003a087fe9e57f6ffbe7ba48795980b59c3`，Node 22.23.2，Qwen CLI 0.25.0。使用真实的持久化 Session 状态和恢复后的 Hook owner；远端 Workspace Broker 边界使用 stub。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：按具备执行资格的结果 command catalog 条目保守拒绝；matcher 保持保守判断，因为后台子任务存活期间，后续工具可能匹配它。
- 未验证或不在范围内：部署后的 Java 共享 Workspace 消费者和子 agent 模型/工具进程。没有部署 Broker 时，真实 CLI 的 Session 请求返回 `hosted_tool_profile_unavailable`。当前 HTTP/function 执行也会取得挂载；这个与 issue 假设不一致的既存情况已记录在 issue 讨论中，本次保留 issue 要求的准入行为。后续生命周期 hook 也可能在后台子任务运行时取得挂载；此 PR 实现 issue 选定的三个结果事件准入场景。
- 破坏性变化或迁移说明：受影响的子任务请求会提前拒绝；没有配置或持久化状态迁移。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13709

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): Add FG7 channel fault gates for the channel domains (#13802)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Implements [#13802](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13802): Stage F fault gates FG7 for the two channel domains that were enabled to commit by an earlier slice. Nineteen multi-process cases now prove that channel side effects stay honest when control-plane answers are lost after commit, when the Spring control plane or the adapter dies mid-send, and when the provider's answer is ambiguous. The shape follows FG6 exactly: real packaged harness binary, a lose-once fault proxy in front of the internal adapter listener, a real MySQL lane, and one named mutation per gate that turns exactly its gate red before being reverted. The change touches no production code.

Five letters of injection gates run against an in-JVM Spring (reply loss on inbound/claim/receipt, SQL-trigger store faults with `FG7B_*` markers, production-relay-driven cancellation, read-ledger continuity, and the unknown-delivery family), and four crash cases run against a killable child-JVM control plane plus SIGKILL/SIGSTOP adapter processes. One parametric TypeScript driver owns the choreography: a content-aware proxy (a claim drop fires only on an answer that actually carries deliveries), the real email adapter connected to scripted fake IMAP/SMTP servers, and a recording control-plane client that wraps the production client verbatim so the wire shape can never drift from the shape production uses.

Two scope decisions the design document records honestly: FG7e gates read-ledger continuity rather than SSE resume, because channels publish no event stream today — deliveries are read through cursor-paginated REST only, and the cursor guarantees the doc asserts are the ones SSE resume would have asserted, aimed at the surface that exists. FG7f gates the `unknown` family; `partial` is unreachable in v1 (the email plan is always one segment), so that gate waits for H5d's multi-segment plan. A gate-discovered semantic is also documented: a lost claim answer strands the delivery at `sending` by design (at-most-once, never a second dispatch), and the lease reconciler is what settles it `unknown` — if a later slice adds claim replay keyed by the claim row, the gate's expectation upgrades from `unknown` to `delivered`.

CI budget: the two new classes join the existing hosted-harness-mysql lane (`Hosted*IT` naming adopts them automatically, and the failsafe-report check enforces it). Measured at ~60 s of added test time (~150 s wall-clock on the shared fork), the budgets move fork 900 s → 1200 s, Verify step 25 → 35 min, and job 148 → 160 min, all three pinned by the existing CI-guard test, plus a local-only focused profile for iterating.

## Why it's needed

Channel side effects leave the process: a re-send is a user-visible duplicate email, and a silent `accepted` whose receipt never arrived is a lie the record cannot take back. The domains committing these records have been enabled since [#13572](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13572), but until this PR nothing proved the honesty invariants across the multi-process path — that re-driven admissions never mint a second physical send, that receipts settle idempotently by provider identity, that a killed worker's claim settles unknown instead of silently advancing, that cancellation of a claimed send settles physically rather than by fiat, and that read pagination never duplicates or skips while states advance underneath it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The lanes a reviewer would normally check are subprocess orchestration, so the useful review is of evidence and of the mutation discipline rather than of watching suites run. Everything below was executed on macOS (M3, JDK 21, Node 22, MariaDB 10.11 via a throw-away datadir); the CI lane runs MySQL 8.4 on Ubuntu.

1. Full gate suite green: `mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql clean verify` in `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server` — the two new classes run in the hosted lane; all 19 cases pass, and every case asserts its fault actually fired (proxy drop counters, `FG7B_*` markers in captured Spring output, kill markers). Locally the two classes finish in ~50 s of test time.
2. Letter-level iteration: `-Dit.test='HostedChannelFaultGatesIT#fg7a*' -Dqwen.fg7a.case=claim-reply` (per-letter selectors; crash class `-Dqwen.fg7c.case=adapter-kill`).
3. Mutation discipline: fifteen red signatures verified by execution — the ten designed mutations (service-side replay bypass, adapter receipt identity minting, funnel idempotency/refusal shapes, reconciler unknown-settle skip, funnel unknown-as-terminal, funnel cancel fabricating a terminal, cancelled deliveries claimable, inclusive cursor tiebreak, ambiguous-as-accepted) each turned exactly their named gate red, and the two whose red signatures a review round expanded (receipt identity minting also reds receipt-reply; the reconciler skip also reds spring-kill-dispatch, adapter-stop, cancel-unsettled, receipt-never-arrived) were re-applied, observed red with gate-specific assertions, reverted, and the suite re-run green.
4. Design and runbook: `docs/design/2026-10-10-channel-fault-gates.md` (English) and `docs/design/2026-10-10-channel-fault-gates.zh-CN.md` (中文) hold the scope decisions, the gate ledger, the fixture details, all ten mutation entries plus the two provably indistinguishable-in-v1 ones, and the validation record.
5. CI budget coherence: `npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` — 16/16 (the fork/step/job triple this PR raises plus the sibling pins).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only infrastructure; no user-visible surface. Before: no Hosted-channel IT classes existed, and the hosted lane's failsafe report check had no channel coverage to enforce. After: the report check enforces both new classes in the hosted lane, and the mutation table documents what each gate catches.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested (MariaDB 10.11, full suite ×7) |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A (crash class asserts POSIX and jumps off Windows; the CI lane is Ubuntu) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally — delegated to the CI lane the classes are built for (MySQL 8.4) |

### Environment (optional)

Local runs used a system MariaDB 10.11 with a throw-away datadir (`mariadb-install-db --auth-root-authentication-method=normal`), JDK 21, Node 22; the full instructions live in the design document's validation section.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the hosted-harness-mysql lane's shared fork grows by ~150 s wall-clock; the budget triple (fork/step/job) was raised with 2× headroom and is pinned by the existing guard test so a later budget drift fails loudly. The crash class is POSIX-only by assertion (signal kills), which the Ubuntu CI lane satisfies.
- Not validated / out of scope: the `partial` delivery state needs H5d's multi-segment plan (out of scope, recorded as design decision 2); a WebShell mirror route inheriting the FG7e continuity assertions (recorded as an open question for that slice); claim replay keyed by the claim row (open question 2 — the strand-settles-unknown semantics are pinned intentionally for the current surface). No production code is touched; no migration, no contract version change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design document: [English](../blob/codex/fg7-channel-fault-gates/docs/design/2026-10-10-channel-fault-gates.md) · [中文](../blob/codex/fg7-channel-fault-gates/docs/design/2026-10-10-channel-fault-gates.zh-CN.md) — complete and synchronized (decisions, constraints, mutation table, acceptance, open questions); a review round's deferral log records three zh-CN sentence compressions as follow-up wording alignment.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13802

prs.title: feat(core): shrink tool results to the headroom left before auto-compaction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is close to auto-compaction, shrink the next request's tool results to its remaining headroom. Use only the same chat's last successful usage report for the current provider route and unchanged history prefix. System instructions, session context and tool declarations must match that report; equivalent refreshes preserve it, while changed inputs and obsolete in-flight responses invalidate it without clearing usage counters. Explicit truncation settings take priority.

Measure headroom against auto-compaction and share the selected budget across the batch, charging protected text, media and framing first. Keep the tighter aggregate budget and avoid cutting results twice. If an allocation cannot fit a complete truncation notice, preserve the batch for normal compaction and hard-limit admission. When an artifact path cannot fit, use a complete pointerless notice. Save full originals through the existing best-effort persistence path whenever results are shortened. Before persistence, resolve any read that the selected preview would shorten. If a regular-chat read cannot be traced to a path in model history, preserve the entire batch for normal compaction and overflow handling so worker cache residency still matches the full content the model receives.

Defaults stay at 25,000 characters / 1,000 lines. Result-size accounting moved to #13652. Design: [English](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.zh-CN.md).

## Why it is needed

#2566: static tool budgets can push a long session over the compaction trigger prematurely. A hard-ceiling anchor cuts too late; an obsolete usage anchor cuts against the wrong context. At the other extreme, sub-notice allocations erased failure diagnostics and could advertise a nonexistent partial artifact path. A supported PreToolUse repair can supply a read path while recorded model arguments remain `{}`; shortening that result without notifying the worker could then make a later read incorrectly omit the full body.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Near the auto trigger, return a large result: it should shrink to available headroom. Far from or past auto, or after restore/route change/explicit settings, it should keep the static behavior.
- Change fixed inputs, including during a held response: stale usage should not reanchor. Equivalent refreshes should retain the headroom anchor and usage counters.
- Leave only enough headroom for an empty or incomplete notice: original output and error should reach normal compaction admission. A larger but path-insufficient preview should contain a complete notice, a nonempty error indication and no partial recovery path.
- Check the complete persisted original after a meaningful cut and verify user/protected text and previous file-read rights survive.
- Repair an empty-argument read through PreToolUse: the full result should remain in request/history before persistence, and a later unchanged-file placeholder should be valid. With a resolvable original path, normal shortening should notify the worker, preserve prior-read rights and allow a subsequent full reread.

### Evidence (Before & After)

[Current before/after report and actual tmux excerpts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599#issuecomment-6080873864). The current repair passed 35 focused pressure cases, affected Core build/typecheck and static checks. The first full-file run passed 589/590; a media fixture lacking its recorded read call was corrected, and its original media headroom assertions plus inode invalidation passed in the final pressure group. No fresh all-590 pass is claimed.

Actual compiled-Core API/tmux controls exercise the hook and separate worker cache: repaired original `{}` preserves 20,033 characters, while resolvable original path still shortens to 2,576 characters, notifies the worker and rereads the full body. Each makes two controlled generation calls; all 11 watched compiled modules loaded with matching hashes. The generator and compaction boundary are controlled (NOOP), with observer loader/assertion failures retained. The resolved-control mutable cache receipt reflects a later reread, not a frozen after-cut snapshot. Earlier tiny-budget and CLI/TUI evidence stays tied to its tested commit.

### Tested on

macOS, Node 22.22.0, current commit `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859`. Current necessary CI is tracked separately.

## Risk & Scope

The tiny-budget fallback and unresolved-read whole-batch preservation can require normal compaction instead of suppressing text. The latter deliberately may exceed the selected finite character budget; existing compaction, hard admission and overflow handling apply, potentially adding text or compaction. It does not guarantee exact token admission. A pointerless preview omits detailed content when it cannot fit; persistence remains best effort under existing disk limits. Shortened file reads disarm quote-back residency while retaining prior-read rights; uniquely correlated shell shortening leaves file-read residency intact. Existing fork ownership remains unchanged. Unresolved would-cut reads in regular chat now preserve the full batch before persistence; there is no worker API change or blanket cache clear that revokes prior-read rights. The current controlled-Core fixture does not establish a new CLI, browser, real-model or cross-platform result. Line caps and defaults do not adapt.

## Linked Issues

Closes #2566
Result-size accounting split to #13652 (#11536).

接近自动压缩时，根据同一聊天、同一路由且固定输入和历史仍有效的成功用量报告缩小下一请求的工具结果；等价刷新保留依据，内容变化或在途旧响应不重建过期依据，也不清空用量计数。保护文本、媒体和结构先计入余量，与聚合预算取较紧值且不重复裁剪。放不下完整提示时保留原文交给压缩/硬上限准入；完整路径放不下时只发送完整无指针提示，正常裁剪仍尽力保存完整原文。默认25k字符/1000行保持不变，结果统计另在#13652。

本次修复 PreToolUse 补齐实际读取路径、历史原始参数仍为 `{}` 的缓存缺口。落盘前先检查最终预览将裁剪的读取，普通聊天无法定位路径时保留整个批次，确保 worker 驻留状态与模型实际收到的内容一致；可定位读取仍正常裁剪、通知 worker 并保留先读权限，没有新增 worker API。例外批次可能超过有限字符预算，交由正常压缩、硬准入或溢出处理，可能增加文本和压缩，不能声称精确 token 准入。双语设计同步记录。

当前提交 `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859` 的35项压力测试及Core构建/类型/静态检查通过。首次全文件589/590通过，媒体fixture未记录读取调用；补齐路径关联后，原媒体预算断言和inode解除断言在最终压力组通过，未冒称全590重新通过。实际编译Core API/tmux中，修正读取保留20,033字符；可定位读取仍裁到2,576字符、通知worker，随后完整重读。每种两次受控生成调用、11个加载模块散列匹配；generator/NOOP压缩是控制边界。保留loader和观察断言失败及修正后的结果。控制中二次读取会更新缓存对象，不能将序列化结果视为裁剪后的冻结快照。历史极小预算及CLI/TUI证据保留原提交，本轮不冒称新CLI、Docker、浏览器、真实模型或真实压缩验收。CI、人工批准、合并和发布独立判断。
