prs.title: feat(office): insert tables and pictures in the Word editor
prs.body:
## 背景

用户反馈：“Word 文件编辑不支持插入表格、图片之类的吗？”Word 编辑内核（`@docx-editor.dev/core` 2.22）本身具备这些能力，但第一阶段只接了文字格式工具栏。本 PR 补上入口，并处理接入时遇到的内核光标问题。

## 改动

- **插入表格**：工具栏新增 Word 式 10×8 尺寸网格，悬停预览“N 行 × M 列”，支持方向键 + 回车。插入位置与 Word 一致：段首插在段前，段末插在段后且不多出空段，段中拆段后插在中间；标题后拆出的空段改为正文样式（与 AI 编辑同一规则，抽到 `wordStyles.ts`）。多步插入合并为一次撤销（`recordAgentEdit` 泛化为 `recordEditSteps`）。
- **表格操作菜单**：光标在表格中可用，支持上/下插入行、左/右插入列、删除行/列/表格。内核 2.22 不支持合并单元格，未放入。
- **插入图片**：按钮选文件、粘贴截图、拖入图片文件。按字节识别格式、按文件头读 DPI 与尺寸；WebP/BMP 转为 PNG 存储；插入后文档会超过 25 MB 编辑上限时提前提示；内核自己会落地文字/HTML 的粘贴与拖放时让路。
- **图片选中**：选框 + 8 个缩放手柄（`WordImageOverlay`，参照上游 React 适配层简化实现），Delete/Backspace 删除。
- **内核行为处理**（`wordInsertion.ts`，升级内核需复测，详见 spec）：
  - 内核拒绝在内联对象正前方插图，且插图后把光标留在新图前：插入前跳过光标处的对象，插入后等重绘及选区回读结束再把光标移到图后。
  - 换行独占一行的内联图片点击后无法选中：点击结束后把光标移到图后重新选中。

实现记录：`specs/features/office-editing/2026-10-10-word-insert-table-image.md`

## 影响范围

仅渲染进程 Word 编辑器。没有 IPC、存储、主进程、preload、OpenClaw 配置变更，也没有新增依赖。

## 验证

- 新增 `wordImages.test.ts`（8 项）；Office 相关 30 个测试文件 210 项通过。
- `tsc`、改动文件 ESLint、`npm run build` 通过。
- 完整 `npm test` 中 `skillManager.watcher.test.ts` 在与构建并发时失败一次，单独重跑通过，与本改动无关。
- 用仓库 Vite 配置 + 内存文件桥加载真实 `WordFileEditor` 实测：各光标位置插表与撤销/重做、表格菜单、键盘网格、按钮/粘贴/拖入插图、连续插图、点选图片后粘贴、插图后打字、缩放与删除、窄面板/英文/深色模式；导出的 docx 通过主进程 `inspectWordPackage` 准入（无只读原因）。
- 未覆盖：完整 Electron 应用内手测、Windows、用真实 Word/WPS 打开导出文件对比。

prs.title: fix(artifacts): keep the open preview when a later reply rewrites the file
prs.body:
## Summary
After the agent edits a file the user is previewing, the preview closes as soon as the turn ends and the user has to click the file again.

The artifact panel keeps each preview tab on an artifact id. Every `write`/`edit` tool call and every reply that links a file creates a new artifact for that file, and the panel's display dedupe (`dedupeArtifactsForDisplay`) keeps only the newest one per file. Before bd7903af, `addArtifact` replaced same-path artifacts in the store and moved open tabs to the new id (`replacePreviewTabArtifactId`). Since then, cards from different replies are kept apart, so an open tab keeps naming the replaced artifact: `CoworkSessionDetail` drops it from the tab strip and `ArtifactPanel` falls back to the file list. Office files the agent edits live through `word_edit`/`excel_edit`/`ppt_edit` close the same way once its final reply links the file.

## Related Issue
User feedback, no GitHub issue: "AI实时编辑文件后，会关闭预览文件，需要用户再次手动点击预览".

## Changes Made
- `src/renderer/store/slices/artifactSlice.ts`
  - After `addArtifact` stores an artifact, preview tabs move to the artifact the panel displays for their file (`syncPreviewTabsToDisplayArtifacts`, built on the existing `resolveArtifactIdForDisplay`). The active tab and `selectedArtifactId` follow; tabs whose artifact is still displayed are untouched.
  - `replacePreviewTabArtifactId` folds a tab into an existing tab for the target artifact instead of leaving two tabs with the same id (for example a tab opened from the library before its artifact loaded).
- `src/renderer/components/cowork/CoworkSessionDetail.tsx`: the built-in browser's HTML preview artifact id is resolved the same way before it reaches `ArtifactPanel`. Before, once the agent rewrote the page, the browser tab lost its HTML artifact: it stopped watching the file, and its toolbar offered "部署" for the internal loopback preview server instead of "分享".
- `src/renderer/store/slices/artifactSlice.test.ts`: 4 new tests.

Renderers are not remounted. The Office editors and the Markdown editor are keyed by file path, so a moved tab keeps the same editor instance and its undo history.

## Type of Change
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Testing
- [x] Tested locally
- [x] Added new tests
- [ ] Updated existing tests
- [x] Manual testing performed

- `artifactSlice.test.ts`: 16 passed, 4 new: an open tab follows a later reply's artifact, a background tab follows while the active tab stays, an older card leaves the tab alone, a duplicate tab is folded. The first two fail on the old slice; the fold test fails without the new guard.
- `npm test`: 6454 passed. 3 files failed only because the worktree had no `node_modules` of its own (`sheetCommandPolicy`, `mcpLaunchResolverManager` and `windowsInstallerContract` build paths from the repo root); they pass in a full checkout (58/58).
- `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and ESLint with CI rules (`--max-warnings 0`) on the touched files: clean.
- Real app in an isolated instance (own profile, Vite/HMR/CDP ports) with a scripted OpenAI-compatible mock model, same flow on the old and the new code:

| Scenario | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Markdown: turn 1 `write`, turn 2 `edit` | tab gone, file list shown | tab stays and shows the edited text |
| Word: turn 1 links the .docx (auto-preview opens the editor), turn 2 `lobster-word__word_edit` inserts a paragraph live | editor unmounted, file list shown | the same editor instance stays, inserted paragraph visible |
| HTML in the built-in browser: `write`, then `edit` twice | toolbar shows "部署" | toolbar shows "分享" |

## Screenshots (if applicable)
The table above records what the panel showed after each turn, read from the DOM over CDP; before/after screenshots of the Word case are available on request.

- [x] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [x] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [x] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [x] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

- [ ] Changes to main process (src/main/)
- [ ] Changes to preload script (src/main/preload.ts)
- [ ] Changes to IPC communication
- [ ] Changes to window management
- [x] None

Renderer only: no IPC, storage or OpenClaw config changes.

## Additional Notes
- A moved tab gets the new artifact's tab id (`artifact:<id>`), as same-message replacements already did. If the file-list drawer or the actions menu is open at that moment, it closes.
- Found during testing and not changed here: the built-in browser's HTML preview does not refresh when the agent edits the file. On macOS, `fs.watch` reports OpenClaw's `edit` writes as `rename` (inode unchanged), and `artifact:watchFile` in `src/main/main.ts` only handles `change`; an in-place write by another program does refresh the page. Fixing it affects every artifact file watcher, including Office autosave, so it is left for a separate PR.

prs.title: fix(office): show when Excel or WPS holds a file and save once it is closed
prs.body:
## Summary
On Windows, Excel and WPS keep the document they show open without sharing writes. The in-place Office editors save by writing a temporary file next to the document and renaming it over the original. Windows refuses that rename (`EPERM`) while the file is open elsewhere, and `OfficeFileStore` mapped every non-package error to `io`. Users who had the file open in Excel or WPS saw "保存失败 · 无法访问或保存这个 Excel 表格，请检查文件是否有效，以及是否有写入权限", although the file was valid and writable. Agents only got `saved: false`.

This PR detects the lock and tells the user as soon as the file opens. While the file is held, edits wait in the recovery copy instead of being reported as a failed save, and they are written once the file is released. macOS and Linux have no such locks, so nothing changes there apart from the extra refreshes described below.

## Related Issue
User feedback, no GitHub issue: "使用本地工具打开文件，在龙虾端修改该文件时会提示无法访问或保存".

## Changes Made
- `src/main/office/core/officeFileStore.ts`: on Windows, probe the document with an `r+` open. A sharing violation (`EBUSY`) means another program holds it.
  - `open`/`read` snapshots now carry `inUse`.
  - `save` refuses with the new `OfficeFileError.InUse` before writing a temporary file.

prs.title: fix(cowork): time new tasks from submit and label engine waits
prs.body:
## Summary
A Windows user reported that after the engine starts, the first task takes minutes and its timer restarts partway through. The logs show two separate problems.

- **The wait:** after every gateway start, the third-party plugin nsp-clawguard 2.5.5 writes about 1,429 skill-scan findings synchronously in its `gateway_start` hook. That blocks the gateway's event loop for 3–5 minutes (`process was frozen ~226802ms`, `config.get 256179ms`). A task submitted in that window waits for the engine (`start IPC dispatched to runtime ... Elapsed 271690ms`). This PR does not change that wait. It needs a fix in the plugin.
- **The timer reset (this PR):** the renderer shows an optimistic `temp-` session timed from the click. The main process created the stored session and its user message only after `ensureOpenClawRunningForCowork` returned, so the message got the later time. When the stored session replaced the temp one, the timer jumped from about 4:31 back to 0. During the wait the indicator also said 正在思考 / 模型仍在响应, although no model had been called yet.

## Related Issue
None. User log report from 2026-10-10.

## Changes Made
- **Timer** (`main.ts`, `cowork:session:start`):
  - The first user message is stored with the time the start request arrived (`ipcStartedAtMs`). `CoworkStore.addMessage` already accepts a timestamp. The stored turn keeps the start time the renderer was already counting from.
  - Messages are ordered by `sequence`, and the following `updateSession(..., running)` still moves `updated_at`, so message and session-list order do not change.
  - A finished turn's duration now includes the engine wait, which is the time the user actually waited.
- **Waiting label** (`AssistantTurnBlock.tsx`, `CoworkSessionDetail.tsx`, `i18n.ts`):
  - While the current session is still the temp session and 2 s have passed since submit, the activity indicator shows 正在等待 AI 引擎就绪… / "Waiting for the AI engine to be ready…". It replaces the thinking phases and the long-wait hint.
  - A normal start returns within milliseconds and never shows it. Once the stored session takes over, the usual labels return.
- **Shared constant:** the `temp-` prefix was duplicated in `CoworkView.tsx` and `coworkSlice.ts`. It is now `COWORK_TEMP_SESSION_ID_PREFIX` in `src/shared/cowork/constants.ts`.

- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

    - within the 2 s grace period it still reads as thinking;
    - after it, it shows the engine wait, with the counter running from the submit time (`4m 0s`);

  - `vitest run cowork i18n`: 810 pass in 81 files.

They come from this Windows environment (macOS ASAR packing, QQ bot packaging, the Word dev build, POSIX permission, CRLF and rename fixtures) and from tests that read the OpenClaw runtime, which was being rebuilt during the run.

prs.title: fix(openclaw): drop the retired meta.lastTouchedAt when persisting config
prs.body:
## Problem

A Windows tester upgraded a fresh 2026.9.4 install to 2026.9.24 (test channel). The gateway never started:

> AI 引擎状态升级失败：[auth-profiles] Auth profile migration failed: Error: Auth migration cannot repair unrelated config errors at: meta.

2026.9.4 (OpenClaw v2026.6.1) and that runtime stamp `meta.lastTouchedAt` on every `openclaw.json` write. OpenClaw v2026.8.1 rejects the key (`meta` is a strict object). 2026.9.22/9.23 dropped it in `stampConfigMeta`. In release/2026.9.24, b6b9ee2d0 changed startup to write config through `prepare()` + `persistOpenClawConfigTarget()`, which bypasses that code:

- The rebase merges into the on-disk file, and `meta` is a shared section, so the old stamp survives.
- `withoutOpenClawWriteMetadata` ignores the key, so a file that differs only by the stamp counts as unchanged and is never rewritten. "重新启动网关" therefore never heals it.

Every direct upgrade from a pre-v2026.8.1 build (≤ 2026.9.13) fails until Quick Repair. Without sessions it fails at the auth-profile migration. With legacy sessions, the `doctor --session-sqlite` import fails earlier with `Invalid config … meta: Unrecognized key "lastTouchedAt"`. Users already on 2026.9.14–9.23 and fresh installs are unaffected.

## Fix

- `rebaseOpenClawConfigTarget` drops the retired stamp from its output. This covers the signed-in sync, the no-model config path, and `config.apply` delivery.
- `persistOpenClawConfigTarget` rewrites the file when the stamp is the only difference, so installs already rewritten by the regressed build heal on the next start.
- One helper in `openclawManagedModelPolicy.ts` owns the retired key; `stampConfigMeta` and the comparison reuse it.

No OpenClaw patch is involved. `meta.lastTouchedVersion` and `meta.migrations` behave as before.

## Testing

- New unit tests in `openclawConfigTarget.test.ts` (3) and `openclawConfigSync.runtime.test.ts` (2: `prepare()` → `persistOpenClawConfigTarget()`, signed in and no model, including a relaunch over a config the regressed build already rewrote).
- New case in `tests/openclawAuthProfileMigration.integration.test.ts`: the bundled startup migration fails at `meta.` on a 2026.9.4 config and reports `skipped` after the host persists it. It runs with `OPENCLAW_STARTUP_MIGRATION_RUNTIME`, like the rest of that file.
- All 6 new cases fail with the source changes reverted. With only the rebase change, the 3 relaunch cases still fail.
- Related config tests: 268 passed. Integration file: 23/23 passed against a local v2026.8.1 runtime. ESLint (CI rules) on the changed files: no warnings. `npm run compile:electron`: passes.
- Full `npm test` in a worktree without its own `node_modules`: 6425 passed. 4 files failed for unrelated reasons: 3 build `<worktree>/node_modules/...` paths (`sheetCommandPolicy`, `mcpLaunchResolverManager`, `windowsInstallerContract`), and `skillManager.watcher` is a timing flake under load that passes 3/3 alone.
- E2E with the dev app on an isolated profile (macOS):
  - Setup: signed-in sync via a `custom_0` provider, then the config was rewritten with 2026.9.4's `meta` and the startup-prep marker removed.
  - Before the fix: the same error dialog as the report, and "重新启动网关" fails the same way.
  - After the fix, first upgrade from the 2026.9.4 state: startup migration `skipped`, gateway running, no dialog.
  - After the fix, relaunch over a config the regressed build already rewrote: same result.
  - In both runs, `openclaw.json` and `.bak` no longer contain `lastTouchedAt`.

## Behavior notes

This changes OpenClaw config writes only: startup bootstrap, restart `beforeStart`, and `config.apply` delivery content. No IPC, storage schema, or restart policy changes.

prs.title: fix(security): harden MCP stdio command and external URL boundaries
prs.body:
**Problem**

MCP stdio command/args flow from forms, JSON imports and config sync into openclaw.json without shell metacharacter or command path validation. Renderer-provided URLs are also passed directly to shell.openExternal without a protocol allowlist. For an application that executes third-party MCP configs and model-generated links, both boundaries can lead to unintended local process or OS protocol execution.

**Solution**

Add two Electron-free shared pure validators and apply them at multiple boundaries: IPC entry, SQLite persistence, command resolution, final OpenClaw config writing, the OpenExternal IPC handler and window.open handling. The design favors fail-closed validation with skip-and-log behavior for legacy invalid config, without changing existing public signatures or adding runtime dependencies.

**Changes**

- Add `validateStdioCommand()` for MCP stdio commands and args.
- Add `openExternalSafe()` with an http/https/mailto/tel protocol allowlist.
- Enforce stdio validation in `McpStore`, MCP IPC handlers, `resolveStdioCommand`, `mcpRuntime` and `openclawConfigSync`.
- Enforce URL protocol validation in `ShellIpc.OpenExternal` and `setWindowOpenHandler`.
- Add unit tests, store/config-sync compatibility tests and a runnable demo.

**Testing**

- 6 targeted Vitest files, 127 tests pass.
- `tsc -p electron-tsconfig.json --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` pass.
- ESLint passes on all touched files with `--max-warnings 0`.
- Demo: `node --experimental-strip-types scripts/demo-security-validation.mjs`.

**Notes for Reviewer**

Args allow spaces and `$` but reject `& | ; < >` and backticks, because OpenClaw spawns MCP stdio with `shell: false`. Legacy invalid stdio entries are skipped for OpenClaw sync while remaining visible for editing in the UI. No runtime dependencies or public API signature changes are introduced.

## Summary
Follow-up to #2819. When config recovery stalls (a restarted gateway still cannot apply the latest config), the stall was broadcast as an engine error. The composer was disabled, cowork task admission and IM connections were refused, Settings showed the engine as failed, and the collapsed overlay read "网关启动失败" (Gateway failed to start), although the gateway kept running on the config it had already applied. This PR keeps work flowing during a stall and makes the notice describe what actually happened.

## Related Issue
None. Found while end-to-end testing #2819 against the field case of 2026-10-09 (the gateway restarted on its own about every 10 minutes while idle).

- **Admission** (`main.ts`):
  - `waitForOpenClawConfigApply` no longer refuses or waits on a stall. Cowork tasks, IM gateway connections and Quick Repair proceed on the config the gateway already applied.
  - A config the gateway rejected as invalid (`OpenClawConfigRecovery.rejected`) still blocks, as before.
- **Overlay** (`EngineFailureOverlay.tsx`, `i18n.ts`):

prs.title: fix(openclaw): recheck unfinished progress-card plans before a run stops
prs.body:
## Summary
Users reported the composer progress card stuck on "第 3/10 步 · 本轮已结束" during a long evaluation task (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview). The model had saved a 10-step `progress_card` plan, written a progress report ("评测尚未收尾，我会继续完成剩余交付物…") and stopped without a tool call. OpenClaw v2026.8.1 treats that reply as the end of the turn and only recovers empty or reasoning-only turns, so the run completed with seven steps pending and nothing resumed the work.

This PR backports upstream's fix ([openclaw/openclaw#160297](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160297), v2026.9.7) as a version-scoped patch. If a run saved an unfinished plan and then stops normally, it gets one hidden, same-run completion check. The model continues feasible work, reconciles the plan, or reports the concrete limitation. The PR also fixes a LobsterAI rendering issue that the E2E run exposed in this flow.

## Related Issue
None. Field report 2026-10-10 (progress card "第 3/10 步 · 本轮已结束" after the agent promised to continue).

## Changes Made
- **`zz-openclaw-plan-completion-check.patch`** (v2026.8.1). Backports #160297 and the `progress_card` wording from [openclaw/openclaw#162903](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162903).
  - The check runs at most once per run and replays no completed tool call.
  - It applies only when the run owes a visible reply and the model stopped with `stop`.
  - It is skipped for old cards, cancellation, timeouts, yields, refusals, length stops, approval prompts, async tasks, accepted child sessions, queued user messages and plugin `finalize` decisions.
- **Adaptations for v2026.8.1**:
  - The NO_REPLY clause of [openclaw/openclaw#164896](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164896) is left out. v2026.8.1 has no kept-answer delivery, and LobsterAI's silent-final branch deletes the turn's current assistant message. A blocked model restates its limitation instead.
  - `deferTerminalDelivery` is ported. In v2026.8.1 any `onBeforeTerminalDelivery` buffers every assistant stream event until the run ends. Without this port, desktop sessions would lose live streaming.
  - Any accepted `sessions_spawn` child counts as pending work, since v2026.8.1 has no `expectsCompletionMessage` marker. A subscription closed during the finalize hook, or an attempt that no longer owns the active run, skips the check.
- **LobsterAI checkpoint event**: when the check continues a run, the patched runtime emits a `checkpoint` agent event after the finished answer is flushed. `OpenClawRuntimeAdapter.processAgentCheckpoint` closes that assistant segment (`AgentEventStream.Checkpoint`).
  - Without the event, the adapter splits segments only on tool starts or a large stream reset (≥40 chars).
  - In that case a short answer such as "文件：big.log…可以删除 big.log 吗？" followed by a restated limitation was overwritten. `syncFinalAssistant` then kept only the last history message.
- **Patch bookkeeping**:
  - `RETAINED_PATCHES` entry, `planCompletionCheck.test.ts`, and strong validators in `apply-openclaw-patches.cjs`.
  - A README section with removal guidance. Retire the patch at upstream v2026.10.1; upstream has no `checkpoint` event, so recheck the short-answer case then.

## Type of Change
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Testing
- [x] Tested locally
- [x] Added new tests
- [x] Updated existing tests
- [x] Manual testing performed

OpenClaw, in a v2026.8.1 worktree with all patches applied:
- **Integration test** `attempt-plan-completion.test.ts` (22 cases): real `AgentSession`, subscription and stream prepare, with a mocked model stream.
  - Covers continuation, the replacement/policy matrices ported from upstream, and live streaming while only the check is armed.
  - With the fix disabled, the 8 cases that expect a check or live streaming fail.
- **Subscribe and unit tests**: subscribe-level checkpoint ordering, plus `progress-card-tool`, harness selection and the related runner and subscribe suites.
- **Static checks**: `tsgo` core passes. The test shards add no new errors; the remaining ones are in 4 baseline files. Type-aware oxlint and oxfmt are clean.
- **Patch application**: `apply-openclaw-patches.cjs` applies all 64 patches cleanly to a fresh tree. Strong validators pass.

LobsterAI:
- `npm test`: 601 files and 6429 tests pass.
- `npm run compile:electron` and ESLint on the changed files pass.
- New adapter test: a short answer, a checkpoint, then more text keeps both messages. It fails without `processAgentCheckpoint`.

E2E setup: an isolated profile, a runtime built from the patched tree, and a scripted OpenAI-compatible model.

| Scenario | Model requests | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Report then stop | 4: plan, report, hidden check → plan completed, final | Same turn. Card goes "第 2/3 步" → "已完成全部 3 步" and never shows "本轮已结束". The report streamed live. |
| Needs user confirmation | 3: one check, no loop | Both replies kept, also after reload. Card ends on "本轮已结束", as intended. |
| Short report, then text + tool | 4 | Short report is no longer overwritten. |
| Plan already complete | 2 | No check. |

Across all scenarios, the hidden check message never appears in chat, the local DB or the reloaded history.

No UI change. The visible effect is that the run continues instead of stopping on "本轮已结束".

- [ ] Changes to window management

The OpenClaw runtime must be rebuilt (`npm run openclaw:runtime:host`) for the patch to take effect. The adapter change is inert on an unpatched runtime.

## Additional Notes
- **One check only**: a weak model may still stop after the check, and a genuinely blocked run still ends on "本轮已结束".
- **Non-streaming IM channels**: when a blocked run restates its limitation, these channels receive only the last message, the restatement. Upstream v2026.10.1 fixes this with kept-answer delivery and NO_REPLY.

prs.title: fix(cowork): keep steered turns running and drop queued steer input on stop
prs.body:
## Summary

Two fixes for steering a running turn on OpenClaw v2026.8.1. Both are in `openclawRuntimeAdapter.ts`:

1. `6369c342` drops queued steer input when the user stops a turn. This is the same commit as #2823; see that PR for details. This PR includes it and supersedes #2823. If #2823 merges first, this PR's diff shrinks to the second commit.
2. `d33af551` keeps a steered turn running through the steer's own acknowledgement. This is the "known related issue" listed in #2823.

## Problem (second fix)

OpenClaw ends a steer's own `chat.send` with a `chat` final that has no message. It sends this once the input is injected into the running execution, or queued behind it. The OpenClaw sources are `chat-send-message-injection.ts` (injection committed), `chat-send-agent-dispatch.ts` (queued as a follow-up), and `chat-send-dispatch-errors.ts` (dispatch error after it was queued).

The adapter bound that run id to the active turn and handled the final as the end of the turn. If the main run had no text or tool work yet:

- the turn was marked completed a few seconds later, with a desktop completion notification, while OpenClaw kept running it;
- later events for the main run were dropped as "late chat event for a closed run", so the answer never rendered;
- `getConfigRestartWorkloadSnapshot()` no longer counted the run, so a deferred gateway restart could kill it.

Binding the steer run id also cleared `yieldedRunId` and canceled a pending lifecycle error fallback. Both compare against the turn's latest run id.

## Change (second fix)

- `submitSteer` records each steer run id as awaiting acknowledgement before it sends the request. OpenClaw can broadcast the acknowledgement before the request resolves. The map is capped at 200 entries.
- `handleChatEvent` checks for the acknowledgement before session resolution, because resolution is what binds the run id. A final with no message, for a steer run id that is not yet routed as its own execution, is consumed. It does not bind to a turn and does not finish one.
- This also covers an acknowledgement that arrives after the steered turn already closed. Before, that created a ghost turn, a second completion, and marked the steer run id as closed.
- A steer that OpenClaw runs as its own execution is unaffected. Its events bind the run id first, so its own final still ends the turn.

Electron behavior: main-process runtime adapter only. There are no IPC, storage, config or renderer changes.

Behavior change to note: when a queued steer's follow-up run starts within the 800 ms deferred-completion window after the main run's final, it joins the same turn. The UI shows two assistant messages and one completion notification. Before this fix, the turn had already been closed early, so the follow-up started a separate turn.

## Verification

- New Vitest cases in `openclawRuntimeAdapter.test.ts`. Four of them fail without the fix:
  - the acknowledgement keeps the main run open, later deltas render, and the main final completes the turn once;
  - an acknowledgement after the turn completed starts no turn and sends no second completion;
  - the lifecycle error fallback of the steered run stays armed;
  - a yielded run keeps waiting for its subagents.
- A fifth case guards the steer-as-its-own-execution path: its final still ends the turn. A mutation that removes the routed-run check makes it fail.
- `openclawRuntimeAdapter.test.ts`: 306 passed. `npm test`: 6434 passed. The one failure, `skillManager.watcher.test.ts`, is a file-watcher timing flake under full-suite load. It passed 3/3 when run alone and is unrelated to this change.
- CI-equivalent eslint on touched files is clean. `npm run compile:electron` passes.
- App-level e2e with an isolated instance and a mock model whose first token arrives after 8 s. The steer is sent right after the run starts, so OpenClaw queues it as a follow-up:

| | Before (stop fix only) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Session status while the main request is open | `completed` 3 s after the steer | `running` |
| Main run output | Never rendered; 21 events dropped as a closed run | `t1 … t20` streams from +10 s |
| Final transcript | Only the follow-up answer | Main answer and follow-up answer |

- Stop regression on the fixed build: no steer request reaches the model after a stop, both for a steer sent while streaming and for one sent during run startup.

## Known remaining gap

If a steer's dispatch fails before it is queued, OpenClaw sends `chat` `error` for the steer run id. That is still treated as the main turn's error. It is rare, and a proper fix needs a "steer not delivered" signal in the UI, so it is left for a separate change.

prs.title: fix(openclaw): count only awake time while waiting for gateway startup
prs.body:
## Summary
Gateway startup and Quick Repair measured their deadlines with `Date.now()`. Wall-clock time keeps running while the machine sleeps, so the first check after wake saw hours of waiting and silence. Startup was declared timed out, the gateway was stopped mid-startup, and the engine could be left in an error state until the user restarted it. Yet the gateway had been frozen along with everything else, and it resumes on wake. This PR counts only awake time.

## Related Issue
None. Found while end-to-end testing #2819 on Windows 11. The machine slept for 8.7 hours while a gateway was starting during Quick Repair. On wake, the startup wait logged `timed out after 31269671ms (116 polls): reached the 900000ms startup limit`, although it had polled for only about 70 s. It then force-killed the gateway and left the engine in `error` ("OpenClaw gateway failed to become healthy in time.").

## Changes Made
- **`awakeClock.ts` (new):**
  - `AwakeClock` counts only the time the process was observably running.
  - A gap between observations beyond 15 s is a suspension (sleep, hibernation, a frozen machine) and is left out. Normal polling gaps are at most about 2.1 s: a 600 ms interval plus a 1.5 s probe timeout.
  - A wall clock set backwards adds nothing.
  - Gap detection does not depend on how each OS's monotonic clock treats sleep. It also does not depend on whether powerMonitor `resume` arrives before or after the first poll after wake.
- **Startup wait** (`openclawEngineManager.ts`, `waitForGatewayReady`):
  - The base deadline, the idle window and the absolute limit all use awake time.
  - Silence restarts at the first poll that sees new output.
  - A detected suspension is logged.
- **Repair wait** (`openclawRepairProcess.ts`):
  - Same accounting. The precise deadline timer is kept and re-evaluates when it fires, rescheduling if a sleep left awake time owed. A 5 s heartbeat keeps the clock observed.
  - Reports record `awakeMs` and `suspendedMs`, and the timeout message reports awake seconds.
  - This half matters more: on wake, the old deadline could kill Doctor while it was writing config and databases.

## Type of Change
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Testing
- [x] Tested locally
- [x] Added new tests
- [ ] Updated existing tests
- [x] Manual testing performed

Run on Windows 11.
- **Automated:**
  - New tests cover:
    - `AwakeClock`: ordinary polling gaps, an 8.7-hour sleep, and a clock set back;
    - the startup wait across an 8.7-hour sleep: it resumes and becomes ready, and a silent gateway still times out once the awake deadline passes;
    - the repair wait across an 8-hour sleep: no kill on wake, and awake silence still bounds it.
  - All 4 new wait tests fail on the previous implementation.
  - Targeted suites: 121 pass.
  - Full `vitest run`: 6430 pass. 22 fail in 10 files, and the same 22 fail on the unmodified HEAD. They come from this Windows environment (macOS ASAR packing, QQ bot packaging, the Word dev build, POSIX and CRLF fixtures).
  - Type checks pass: `tsc --noEmit` for `electron-tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.json`. ESLint with the CI rules passes on the 6 touched files.
- **Dev app with simulated sleep:** the Electron main process and the whole gateway process tree were suspended with `NtSuspendProcess` for 5.5 minutes right after the gateway spawned, then resumed together.
  - **Before:** 0.7 s after resume, the log shows `waitForGatewayReady: timed out after 336981ms (9 polls): no gateway output for 336924ms`. The gateway was stopped and a cold restart followed.
  - **After:** the log shows `no poll for 332840ms (system sleep or a frozen process); that time does not count toward the startup limits`, then `gateway startup complete after 52874ms (54 polls)`. The gateway pid stayed the same, with no timeout, no restart and no forced kill.
- **Not covered:**
  - Quick Repair across a sleep in the real app. It is covered by unit tests only.
  - A real OS sleep after the fix. It was simulated by process suspension.

## Screenshots (if applicable)
None. No UI change.

prs.title: fix(cowork): drop queued steer input when the user stops a turn
prs.body:
## Problem

If a user steers a running turn and then stops it, OpenClaw v2026.8.1 replays the steer input still in its native queue as a new turn:

- **Steer sent while the model streams**: the input waits to be injected into the run. When the run is aborted first, OpenClaw withdraws it and starts a new turn with `runId = clientSteerId`.
- **Steer sent while the run is still starting**: injection is not possible yet, so the input goes to the follow-up queue. It runs after the aborted run is cleared, under a random run id.

LobsterAI does not track either run, because the session was manually stopped. The run is invisible in the UI and `getConfigRestartWorkloadSnapshot()` reports idle. A pending deferred gateway restart then hard-restarts the gateway and kills it.

## Decision

Stopping a turn drops queued steer input; it is not run as the next turn.

## Change

- `submitSteer` records each steer's chat.send run id on the active turn before sending the request.
- `stopSession` aborts each recorded steer run id with `chat.abort`, then aborts the main run.
  - This cancels a pending injection and a steer queued as a follow-up.
  - It does nothing for steer input the run already consumed.
- If a steer is acknowledged after the stop, it is aborted again and returned as `Rejected / NoActiveTurn`. The renderer shows the localized "steer not delivered" toast and keeps the input text.

Aborting by run id leaves BTW side questions and the existing subagent cascade unchanged. A session-wide `sessions.abort { clearQueued: true }` would have killed both.

Electron behavior: stopping a turn now sends one extra `chat.abort` per steer sent during that turn. There are no IPC, storage, or config changes.

## Verification

- New Vitest cases in `openclawRuntimeAdapter.test.ts`:
  - steer accepted → stop → steer aborted before the main run;
  - stop while the steer request is in flight;
  - a steer replayed after a turn ends normally (no stop) is still tracked as busy.
  The first two fail without the fix.
- `src/main/libs/agentEngine` tests: 479 passed. CI-equivalent eslint on touched files is clean. `npm run compile:electron` passes.
- App-level e2e with an isolated instance and a mock model:

| Scenario | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Steer while streaming → stop | Steer runs as a new turn | No steer request reaches the model |
| Steer during run startup → stop | Steer runs as a new turn | No steer request reaches the model |
| Rotate key → deferred restart → steer → stop (with task-scoped admission `3a09cc55`) | `runId=steer-e2e-1` starts, then the deferred hard restart kills it | Steer dropped; restart runs with no work in flight |

## Known related issue (separate fix)

OpenClaw sends a bare `chat` final for the steer's own run id. The adapter can treat it as the main turn's final and mark the turn completed while the main run is still waiting for its first token. That is tracked separately.

prs.title: fix(office): allow clipboard access for the app renderer
prs.body:
## Summary
Users reported that copy and cut in the spreadsheet editor show Univer's warning "无法访问剪贴板 / 请允许 Univer 访问您的剪贴板。", and nothing reaches the clipboard. The cause is in the main process. The default session has only one permission request handler. It was added for voice input in bdd16b94 and denies every permission except the microphone. Electron routes the async Clipboard API through that handler, so `navigator.clipboard.write` in the Univer editors fails with `NotAllowedError: Write permission denied.` This PR grants the two clipboard permissions to the app's own page and keeps everything else denied.

## Related Issue
None. User report on 2026-10-10: copy and cut in the Excel editor show "无法访问剪贴板".

## Changes Made
- **Root cause:**
  - `registerVoiceInputPermissionHandler` installs the only `setPermissionRequestHandler` on `session.defaultSession`. It calls back `false` for anything except `media` with audio.
  - Electron asks that handler for `clipboard-sanitized-write` on plain-text and HTML writes. It asks for `clipboard-read` on reads and on writes that carry custom formats, such as Univer's `web application/x-univer-sheets-formula`.
  - Univer's `BrowserClipboardService` catches the rejection and shows the warning.
  - The app's other copy buttons go through the `clipboard:writeText` IPC first, which hid the problem. The Univer editors have no such path.
- **Fix** (`src/main/permissions/rendererPermission.ts`):
  - `clipboard-sanitized-write` and `clipboard-read` are granted only to the main window's main frame, and only while it shows the app's own page. That is `file:` in packaged builds and the dev server origin in development, the same check the microphone already uses.
  - Frames inside the page (artifact previews), other windows and remote pages stay blocked. Each blocked request logs a `[Permissions]` warning.
  - Microphone handling is unchanged. All other permissions are still denied.
  - Renamed `voiceInputPermission.ts` to `rendererPermission.ts`, with `registerRendererPermissionHandler` and `RendererPermissionHandlerOptions`, because the handler is now the session-wide policy. A doc comment notes that anything it does not allow fails in the renderer.
- **Side effect:** two other direct `navigator.clipboard` callers rely on the same permission and failed silently until now. One is the GitHub Copilot device-code copy button (`ModelSettingsSection.tsx`), the other is copying a data-URL image artifact (`ArtifactPanel.tsx`). I did not test either one separately.

    - artifact-preview frames, `file:` subframes, other web contents and remote pages are blocked;

prs.title: fix(openclaw): admit tasks unaffected by a pending config change
prs.body:
## Summary
While a config change is still unapplied (a deferred gateway restart, or an `config.apply` whose runtime application is not confirmed yet), task admission refused **every** new session, continuation, steer, side question and goal command, even when the pending change could not affect them. One long-running task then blocked all other work until it finished.

A user report (macOS, release/2026.9.24 head) shows the chain: session A runs a long task → the user switches another agent's model → OpenClaw 2026.8.1 defers the channel reload until all active runs end → the host cannot confirm application and schedules a deferred restart → every new message is refused. #2819 stopped this from pinning the global startup overlay; this PR removes the needless refusals themselves.

Admission now checks only the model the task pins before its turn: a task is held back only while that model's runtime settings differ between the config the running gateway confirmed applying and the pending target.

## Related Issue
N/A — user report with logs (gateway "restart" stuck mid-conversation; only quitting the app recovered).

## Changes Made
- **Task-scoped admission** (`src/main/libs/openclawConfigAdmission.ts`, `waitForOpenClawConfigApply` in `src/main/main.ts`): compare the task's model between the applied config and the pending target — provider settings, the model entry, per-model agent defaults, compatibility profiles (and the plugin's enabled flag for providers it hooks), and the secret values the provider references. Unaffected tasks are admitted; affected ones are refused with `configApplyPendingReason: model_settings` and a specific message. A ref that matches no model entry is compared against its whole provider.
- **Applied baseline** (`OpenClawConfigRecovery.appliedRawFor`): remember the target content each gateway generation confirmed applying (only without an outstanding respawn demand, since plugins and env load at spawn). The engine manager now keeps the secrets a gateway process was spawned with (`getGatewayProcessSecretEnvVars`), because config syncs replace the desired ones at any time.
- **Entry points**: new session, continue, side question (`/btw`) and goal commands pass the model the runtime will pin (session override, else the normalized agent model). Steer input joins the active turn and skips the config barrier.
- **Unknown stays conservative**: without an applied baseline (cold start before confirmation, gateway restart, stopped gateway) or without an explicit model, admission behaves exactly as before.
- **Diagnostics**: every admission decision while config is pending is logged with model and impact (`[OpenClawConfigApply] admitted …` / `refused … Impact credentials`); previously a refusal left no trace in the log.
- Moves the `lobsterai-model-compat` plugin id to `src/shared/openclawEngine/constants.ts`; zh/en strings for the new message.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Testing
- [x] Tested locally
- [x] Added new tests
- [x] Updated existing tests
- [x] Manual testing performed

- Unit: `openclawConfigAdmission.test.ts` (agent-model switch admits pinned tasks, provider/model/defaults/compat/credential changes affect only their model, aliases, unknown cases), recovery baseline per generation, spawn-time secrets on the real start path, renderer message selection — 32 tests pass.
- `npx eslint --ext ts,tsx --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0` on all touched files: clean. `npm run compile:electron` and renderer `tsc --noEmit`: pass.
- Full `npm test`: 6449 passed, 1 failed (`skillManager.watcher.test.ts`, file-watch timing under load; passes 4/4 when run alone, unrelated).
- End-to-end, isolated instances (base f6f50dce vs this branch) with a local OpenAI-compatible mock: long task A on `custom_0`, then rotate `custom_1`'s API key (env change → restart deferred while A runs):

| Action while A runs | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| New task B on `custom_0` (unaffected) | refused: "OpenClaw 正在应用配置，请稍后重试。" | admitted, request reaches the mock |
| New task C on `custom_1` (new key not applied) | refused (same generic text) | refused, `model_settings`: "所选模型的最新设置还没生效…" |
| Steer A | refused | accepted |
| Stop A, then task D on `custom_1` | succeeds with the new key | succeeds with the new key |

## Screenshots (if applicable)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [x] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [x] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

## Electron-Specific Changes
- [x] Changes to main process (src/main/)
- [ ] Changes to preload script (src/main/preload.ts)
- [x] Changes to IPC communication — `cowork:session:start/continue`, btw, steer and goal replies: refusals now only happen for tasks whose model is affected; the reply's engine status may carry `configApplyPendingReason`

## Additional Notes

It needs a product decision (drop queued steer on stop, or track that run) and is being handled separately.
- Not covered here: IM channel start/connection still uses the global config barrier; a refused queued follow-up is not re-sent after convergence; sign-in/sign-out still hard-restarts the gateway when the `lobsterai-model-compat` entry toggles.

prs.title: feat(support): add Windows loopback connection and network filter collectors
prs.body:
## Summary
Two double-click diagnostics for support cases where LobsterAI starts its engine but never reaches it on 127.0.0.1. They are what located the Windows Firewall "Query user" default block in the 2026-10 field case that #2817 fixes. They stay useful for the cases #2817 cannot fix: its "rule added, but still blocked" message points at other security software, and the network filter collector names the filter responsible.

Both tools only read and package information. They change nothing, upload nothing, and do not ship in the installer.

## Related Issue
None. Field case 2026-10 (gateway unreachable after reboot); product fix in #2817.

## Changes Made
- **Connection collector** (`collect-connection.ps1`, `connection-probe.cjs`, `README-connection.txt`):
  - Records the root error code behind the app's "fetch failed" (`ETIMEDOUT` for a dropped connect, `ECONNREFUSED` for a closed port).
  - Self-tests loopback in PowerShell, and in the LobsterAI runtime both in-process and cross-process.
  - Checks the gateway port owner, proxy settings, Winsock providers, network drivers and loopback-related hosts entries, and includes recent app and gateway logs.
- **Network filter collector** (`collect-network-filters.ps1`, `network-filter-probe.ps1`, `README-network-filters.txt`):
  - Tests loopback, then after one UAC prompt dumps Windows Filtering Platform filters, drop events, state and firewall rules.
  - Marks the filter that dropped loopback with ★, with its conditions, the affected programs and a plain-language explanation. For Windows Firewall's "Query user" default block, the explanation is the inbound allow rule fix.
  - The zip is built file by file, so one unreadable file is listed in `zip-skipped.txt` instead of failing the package.
- **Shared packaging** (`single-file-collector.cjs`): each collector is built into one `.cmd` that embeds its PowerShell and helpers. The performance collector now uses it too; its generated output is byte-identical.
- **Tests:** `tests/windowsConnectionDiagnostics.test.ts` and `tests/windowsNetworkFilterDiagnostics.test.ts` cover the probe, the launcher layout, encodings and the probe-report parsing. PowerShell fixtures live in the `*.helpers.ps1` files.

issues.title: Discord: forward DM vs guild so operator DMs can be trusted (tools), instead of always fail-closed as shared
issues.body:
**Problem**

On Discord, channel turns are *always* treated as "shared", so tools are always stripped — even in DMs, and even when the sender is listed in the account's `operators`.

`crates/channels/src/chat_classification.rs`:

```rust
ChannelType::Discord | ChannelType::MsTeams | ChannelType::Matrix => true, // always shared
```

A Discord snowflake doesn't encode DM-vs-guild, and the adapter doesn't forward it, so `is_trusted_channel_turn = is_operator && !is_shared_chat(...)` can never be true for Discord. `operators` is therefore inert on Discord.

**Observed:** DM the bot a URL and ask it to parse the page → it replies *"I can't fetch the live page from this chat…"* because `web_fetch` (and every other tool) was removed from the turn.

**Request**

Forward the conversation kind from the Discord adapter (DM vs guild channel) and let an operator **DM** qualify as a direct/trusted turn — the same way WhatsApp treats `@s.whatsapp.net`/`@lid` as direct. Guild channels should stay fail-closed as shared.

Expected with:

```toml
[channels.discord.rio-home]
operators = ["123456789012345678"]
```

- A **DM** from an operator → trusted turn → tools available (`web_fetch`, `exec`, etc.).
- A **guild** message → still shared → no tools (unchanged, safe).

issues.title: Bug: runtime datetime never injected (host context sets time=None, today unset)
issues.body:
**Problem:** the agent can't answer "what's the date/time?". Moltis is supposed to inject the current datetime into the turn (`runtime_datetime_message()` prepends `[The current user datetime is …]`), but it never fires because the host runtime context is built with `time: None` and `today` left unset.

In `crates/chat/src/prompt.rs`:

```rust
let mut host_ctx = PromptHostRuntimeContext {
    ...
    time: None,
    ...
    ..Default::default()   // `today` is never set either
};
```

`PromptHostRuntimeContext` has `time`/`today` fields, and the docs' example Host line shows `time=… today=…`, but the formatter (`format_host_runtime_line`) doesn't emit them either. Net: the model gets no clock at all.

**Expected:** populate `host.time` / `host.today` (honouring `[user] timezone`), so the documented runtime datetime is actually injected on every turn — including channel turns where tools are denied.

**Workaround in the meantime:** a `[chat] context_command` that shells `date`:

```toml
[chat]
context_command = "TZ=Australia/Sydney date '+Current user datetime: %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z (today is %A %d %B %Y)'"
```

Works, but a first-class field is cleaner and would fix the documented `Host: … time=… today=…` line too.

prs.title: fix(discord): classify direct messages as direct chats
prs.body:
## Summary

Every Discord chat is classified as shared today (`ChannelType::Discord => true` in `crates/channels/src/chat_classification.rs`) because Discord channel ids do not encode conversation kind and the adapter did not forward it. As a result, a 1:1 DM between an operator and the bot runs with the untrusted ceiling (`_tool_audience = "public"`, `_tool_policy = {"deny": ["*"]}`, no private context), and operator direct-chat commands (`/context`, `/sessions`, `/agent`, `/sh`) fail closed, as `docs/src/discord.md` notes.

This PR makes the Discord adapter forward whether a conversation is the bot's own DM, so the gateway can classify it as direct, the way Telegram positive chat ids and Slack `D…` conversations already are. Shared chats are exactly as restrictive as before.

Related precedents: #1224 / #1238 (Slack) and #1264 / #1265 (Telegram) dealt with tools in shared chats by exposing the `untrusted_audience` / `untrusted_tools` opt-in. Those channels could already prove a DM from the chat id; Discord could not, so its DMs never reached the "operator in a proven direct chat" path at all. This PR closes that gap only; it does not add the shared-chat opt-in to Discord.

## What changed

- **`ChannelReplyTarget::direct_chat: bool`** (`crates/channels/src/plugin.rs`): adapter evidence that the conversation is one-to-one with the bot. `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Not::not")]`, so existing stored bindings deserialize as `false` and serialized JSON is unchanged when it is `false`.
- **Classification** (`crates/channels/src/chat_classification.rs`): new `is_shared_chat_with_hint` / `classify_chat_with_hint`. The hint is honoured **only for Discord**; every other channel type ignores it and keeps its id-based allowlist, so a stray `true` cannot turn a Telegram group, Slack channel, Teams/Matrix room or a phone call into a direct chat. A Discord DM classifies as `"direct"`; guild chats keep `None`.
- **`ChannelReplyTarget::is_shared_chat()` / `classify_chat()`**: the gateway's `is_shared_channel_target` and the hook `ChannelBinding` conversion now use these.
- **Discord adapter** (`crates/discord/`):
  - Gateway messages: `direct_chat = guild_id.is_none()`. Guild messages always carry a `guild_id` and bot users cannot be members of group DMs, so a message without one is the bot's DM.
  - Slash commands and component interactions: `direct_chat` only when there is no `guild_id` **and** `context == Some(InteractionContext::BotDm)`. A user-installed app can be invoked in the user's other DMs and group DMs (`PrivateChannel`), so a missing guild alone is not enough; a missing context fails closed.
  - DM access for interactions (770a3491): slash commands and component interactions in the bot DM now pass the same `dm_policy` / DM allowlist check (`access::check_access` with `ChatType::Dm`) as a direct message, through a new `authorize_interaction` that is the only way either handler gets a reply target. A refused interaction gets an ephemeral refusal and never reaches the gateway, the same outcome as the message path dropping a refused DM, rather than being downgraded to a shared chat. Interactions outside the bot DM are unchanged; no guild-side check is added or relaxed.
- All other `ChannelReplyTarget` constructions set `direct_chat: false` (mechanical, no behaviour change).
- **Docs**: `discord.md`, `channels.md` and `security.md` no longer say Discord DMs fail closed; they describe what is direct (bot DMs) and what stays shared (guild channels, threads, interactions outside the bot DM). Non-operator DM senders are still guests and keep tool-free chat, as on other channels.

The trust rule itself is unchanged: a turn is trusted only when the sender is in `operators` **and** the chat is proven direct.

## Validation

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: clean
- `cargo clippy -p moltis-channels -p moltis-discord -p moltis-chat -p moltis-matrix -p moltis-msteams -p moltis-nostr -p moltis-signal -p moltis-slack -p moltis-telegram -p moltis-telephony -p moltis-whatsapp -p moltis-gateway --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- `cargo test -p moltis-channels -p moltis-discord`: 280 passed, 0 failed (285 after 770a3491; `cargo clippy -p moltis-discord --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt` clean)
- `cargo test -p moltis-chat -p moltis-matrix -p moltis-msteams -p moltis-nostr -p moltis-signal -p moltis-slack -p moltis-telegram -p moltis-telephony -p moltis-whatsapp -p moltis-gateway`: 1742 passed, 0 failed (6 ignored)
- `git diff --check`: clean

New tests:
- `chat_classification::tests::discord_dm_is_direct_only_with_adapter_evidence`: Discord DM is direct, guild is shared
- `chat_classification::tests::direct_hint_is_ignored_outside_discord`: the hint cannot widen any other channel type
- `plugin::tests::reply_target_direct_chat_serde_is_backward_compatible`: legacy JSON stays shared; the flag round-trips; hook binding gets `chat_type = "direct"`
- `handler::implementation::tests::dm_message_reply_target_forwards_direct_chat` / `guild_message_reply_target_stays_shared`
- `commands::tests::bot_dm_interaction_forwards_direct_chat` / `non_bot_dm_interactions_stay_shared` (guild, `PrivateChannel`, missing context, guild + `BotDm`)
- `channel_events::tests::discord_dm_forwarded_by_adapter_is_direct_and_guild_stays_shared`: operator DM is trusted and passes `OperatorDirect`; guest DM and operator-in-guild are not
- `channel_events::tests::direct_chat_hint_cannot_make_an_id_classified_group_direct`
- `commands::tests::bot_dm_interaction_is_refused_when_dms_are_disabled` / `bot_dm_interaction_is_refused_for_user_off_the_allowlist`: a bot-DM interaction is refused under `dm_policy = "disabled"` (even for an allowlisted user) and for a user off the allowlist (or with an empty allowlist); both fail if the check is removed
- `commands::tests::allowed_bot_dm_interaction_is_direct` / `bot_dm_interaction_matches_allowlist_by_username`: an allowed user in the bot DM still gets a direct target
- `commands::tests::dm_policy_does_not_change_interactions_outside_the_bot_dm`: guild, `PrivateChannel` and missing-context interactions are unaffected by the DM policy and stay shared

I did not run `./scripts/local-validate.sh` or the macOS/iOS builds, and I have not done live Discord QA. Suggested manual QA: with the sender in `operators`, DM the bot and confirm a configured MCP tool runs and `/context` works; @mention the bot in a guild channel and confirm tools and `/context` are still denied; DM the bot from a non-operator allowlisted account and confirm it stays tool-free; with `dm_policy = "disabled"`, run `/context` in the bot DM and confirm an ephemeral refusal.

## How this was made

This was written with Claude Code, from a bug we hit on a self-hosted deployment: a Discord DM with an operator never got tools, while the same setup worked on Telegram. Key decisions:

- **Forward the conversation kind instead of adding the shared-chat opt-in to Discord.** The opt-in would also unblock tools, but it widens every shared chat on the account; classifying the DM correctly fixes the operator case without loosening guilds.
- **Put the flag on `ChannelReplyTarget`** because that is what `is_shared_channel_target` already receives on every path (messages, commands, interactions, attachments). This needed `direct_chat: false` at every other construction site, which is most of the file count.
- **Honour the flag for Discord only**, so the existing id-based allowlist stays the sole source of truth for every other channel and the field cannot be used to escalate them.
- **Require `InteractionContext::BotDm` for interactions**, because user-installed apps can be invoked from DMs where the bot is not the other party.
- **Refuse bot-DM interactions the DM policy denies** (raised in review). Downgrading them to shared would still let a barred user reach the gateway; refusing matches what the message path does with a refused DM.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

# QwenPaw 上游 Bug 反馈：`ProviderManager.active_model` 启动不加载 + `_load_agent_model_settings` 静默吞异常，叠加导致服务型 cron（dream）每晚必失败

- 提交日期：2026-10-11
- 报告环境：QwenPaw（site-packages 安装，Python 3.11），Linux 4.4.302+ x86_64，Docker 容器内运行；多 agent（6 个 workspace）
- 严重度：中（不影响有 agent 级模型的实例，但产生长期无人察觉的错误噪音，并使「无 agent 级模型」的 workspace 记忆固化功能静默失效）

## 一、症状

`qwenpaw.log` 每晚 23:00 固定出现 N 条（N = `active_model` 为空的 workspace 数）：

```
ERROR | app/crons/manager.py:735 | Failed to execute memory cron job dream: No active model configured.
```

本例从 2026-08-27 起持续 45+ 天，累计 471 次该错误文本，每晚 4 条。期间没有任何人收到告警。

## 二、完整 traceback（一手证据）

```
app/crons/manager.py:721  _run_service_job
  → agents/memory/reme_light_memory_manager.py:952  _run_scheduled_action("auto_dream")
  → agents/memory/reme_light_memory_manager.py:899  run_action
  → agents/memory/reme_light_memory_manager.py:612  _run_reme_job_unlocked
  → agents/memory/reme_light_memory_manager.py:503  _update_qwenpaw_model
  → agents/model_factory.py:2205  create_model_and_formatter  → ProviderManager.get_active_chat_model()
  → providers/provider_manager.py:963  raise ProviderError("No active model configured.")
```

## 三、根因：两个缺陷叠加

### 缺陷 1 — `agents/model_factory.py` `_load_agent_model_settings()` 静默吞异常

```python
# model_factory.py:2054 附近
    except Exception:
        pass
```

该函数负责读取 agent 级模型槽（`agent_config.active_model`）。任何异常（含配置读取/解析问题）都被吞掉，`settings.model_slot` 保持 `None`，随后 `create_model_and_formatter` 走「回退到全局 active model」分支：

```python
# model_factory.py:2205
    model = ProviderManager.get_active_chat_model()
```

没有任何日志说明「为什么 agent 级槽没用上」，排查时无法区分「agent 本来就没配模型」与「读取失败」。

### 缺陷 2 — `providers/provider_manager.py` 的 `active_model` 只在内存，启动时不从磁盘加载

```python
# provider_manager.py:96
    self.active_model: ModelSlotConfig | None = None
```

只有 `save_active_model_async()`（:564）写盘，**没有对应的 load**。因此进程重启后，除非有人再通过 UI/API 选一次模型，全局回退源恒为 `None` → `get_active_chat_model()` 抛 `ProviderError("No active model configured.")`。

### 叠加效果

agent 级槽解析失败（缺陷 1，无日志）→ 回退全局（缺陷 2，恒为空）→ 抛错。
命中面恰好是 `active_model` 为空的 workspace。本例为 `default`、`cloud-orchestrator`、`cloud-executor`、`cloud-verifier` 四个（它们继承 `dream_cron_enabled=true`），正好对应每晚 4 条错误；而配了 agent 级模型的 `QwenPaw_QA_Agent_0.2` 的 dream 完全正常（23:05:41 `ReMe result pushed`）。

## 四、附带发现：服务型 cron 失败不进 history、无告警

`_register_service_jobs()`（`app/crons/manager.py:321`）注册的 `_service:memory:dream` 这类任务，失败只写一行 ERROR 日志，**不出现在 `GET /api/cron/jobs/<id>/history`**（该端点只列用户任务）。因此 45 天的持续失败对用户完全不可见。

另外 `_register_service_jobs()` 用 `replace_existing=True` 但不清理「上次注册过、这次不再声明」的 service job id；虽然 workspace reload 会新建 scheduler 从而间接清掉，但同一 scheduler 内缩小声明集合时存在残留风险。

## 五、建议修法

1. **`_load_agent_model_settings` 不要裸吞异常**：`except Exception` 至少 `logger.warning("agent %s model slot load failed: %r", agent_id, exc)`，让「agent 级模型解析失败」可见。
2. **`ProviderManager` 启动时 load `active_model`**：在 `get_instance()`/构造流程里从持久化文件读回，使全局回退源跨重启稳定。
3. **`get_active_chat_model()` 的错误信息可操作化**：提示「该 agent 未配 active_model，且全局 active_model 为空；请在 /api/agents/{id} 设置 active_model 或关闭其 memory cron」。
4. **服务型 cron 失败纳入可见渠道**：写入 history 或推送 inbox/告警，避免长期静默失败。
5. （可选）`_register_service_jobs` 注册前先按 `source` 前缀清理旧的 service job id。

## 六、本例已采用的规避（workaround）

不改源码的前提下，二选一即可止噪：
- 给这些 workspace 设 `active_model`（`PUT /api/agents/{agentId}`，会触发 zero-downtime reload）；或
- 关掉它们的 `running.reme_light_memory_config.dream_cron_enabled`。

本例选后者：2026-10-11 11:56 对 `default`、`cloud-orchestrator`、`cloud-executor`、`cloud-verifier` 逐个 `PUT /api/agents/{id}` 置 `dream_cron_enabled=false`，日志确认 zero-downtime reload 且重载后不再注册任何 service cron。

## 七、复现步骤

1. 新建一个 workspace（不设置 `active_model`），保持 `dream_cron_enabled=true`（默认）。
2. 重启 QwenPaw 进程（关键：重启后 `ProviderManager.active_model` 变为 `None`）。
3. 等到 23:00（或手动触发该 service job）→ 日志出现 `Failed to execute memory cron job dream: No active model configured.`，且 `GET /api/cron/jobs` 的 history 里查不到这次失败。

issues.title: [Feature]: web_search 内置 tavily provider 应支持配置自有 API key（当前只能 keyless 匿名请求，付费额度无法使用）(built-in tavily provider has no API-key config surface)
issues.body:
## 1. 问题简述 / Summary

内置 `web_search` 工具的 tavily provider 固定走 keyless 匿名 REST（请求头 `X-Tavily-Access-Mode: keyless`），**没有任何配置入口填入用户自己的 Tavily API key**。持有 Tavily 订阅的用户既无法消耗自有额度，还随时受匿名通道限流。

*EN: The built-in tavily provider always uses keyless anonymous REST; there is no config surface for a user API key. Paid Tavily quota is unusable through it.*

## 2. 背景与复现 / Background

- 环境：QwenPaw 2.2.1，macOS arm64；Tavily Researcher 计划（1000 credits/月）
- 现状排查：`web_search.config` schema 与 Console 下拉仅有 provider 选项（`tavily` / `anysearch`），两处均无 api_key/credential 字段；抓出站请求确认全部 keyless，自有额度零消耗
- keyless 并非纯理论风险：日志中有真实 **HTTP 432**（额度类错误）触发的失败记录
- 复现：任何位置尝试配置 Tavily key → 无处可填 → web_search 仍走匿名通道

理解 keyless 是"开箱即用"的产品决策，无意要求默认改变；诉求只是**给有 key 的用户一扇门**。这与 #8139、#7711（新增 web_search provider）同属该能力的自然演进。

## 3. 我们的临时解决及代价 / Workaround & Its Cost

直改 venv site-packages：新增 authed provider（从 QwenPaw **既有 credentials 库**读 key ref → authed POST `api.tavily.com/search`；遇 432/429/401/网络异常自动降级 keyless 重试），并同步修改 factory 默认值与 Console 下拉选项。端到端验证通过（authed 真实命中 + 回退路径 PASS）。

代价有二：① `qwenpaw update` 即被覆盖，属明确技术债；② 过程中暴露关联问题——AgentConfigWatcher 只热更 JSON 配置，Python 代码变更不会生效，运行中的旧进程持续报 `Unknown web_search provider`，**框架无任何"需重启"提示**。

## 4. 建议修法 / Suggested Implementation

1. `web_search.config` 增加 `api_key_ref` 字段，指向框架已有的 credential store（我们已验证该存储对工具层可读，实现成本低，且避免明文落盘 agent.json）；Console 表单同步露出密钥输入；
2. 官方实现 **authed→keyless 自动回退**：额度耗尽/限流时降级并在日志注明——这正是我们手搓方案里最有价值的部分，建议原样吸收；
3. （顺带）启动或配置变更时检测工具层模块 mtime 晚于进程启动时间 → WARN "restart required"，避免同类"改了没生效还不知为何"的困惑。

严重级别：**功能缺失级**。以上实现细节均可提供，欢迎维护者在评论区索取。谢谢！

issues.title: [Feature]: 模型目录请为 Aliyun Token Plan 模型声明 thinking_param_style（Console 思考控件被隐藏）
issues.body:
## Summary

模型目录（`model_catalog.json`，catalog_version 2026.08.27）没有为 Aliyun Token Plan 的模型声明 `thinking_param_style`，导致 Console 中这些模型的思考控件（模型管理弹窗的"思考模式/推理强度"区块、Agent 设置的 "Thinking level" 下拉）被隐藏或禁用。这些模型的上游端点实际支持 `reasoning_effort` / `thinking_budget` / `enable_thinking`，希望官方目录补上声明。

## Component(s) Affected

- [x] Core / Backend (providers / `model_catalog.json` 目录数据)
- [x] Console (frontend web UI)（控件按目录能力门控）

## Problem / Motivation

- Console 的思考控件是能力门控的：
  - 模型管理编辑弹窗（`ModelConfigEditor`）仅在 `thinking_param_style` 非空时渲染思考区块；
  - Agent 模型设置（`AgentModelSettings`）的 "Thinking level" 下拉要求 `supports_agent_thinking === true`，而该字段由 `thinking_param_style` 推导。
- 当前目录中仅 DASHSCOPE 的 `deepseek-v4-pro`、`glm-5.2` 两条声明了 `"thinking_param_style": "effort"`；`ALIYUN_TOKENPLAN_MODELS` 下 15 个模型全部为 `null`。
- 但 Aliyun Token Plan 的**提供商级**已经定义了 `reasoning_effort_options: ["none","minimal","low","medium","high","xhigh"]` 与 `thinking_budget_range: [1, 81920]`——数据基本现成，只差模型级 style 声明这一步。
- 用户侧后果：无法在 UI 中调整推理强度，只能手改安装目录下的 `model_catalog.json`（升级会被覆盖）或在 `generate_kwargs` 里手写 `extra_body`（可发现性差）。

## Proposed Solution

为 `ALIYUN_TOKENPLAN_MODELS` 中已验证支持的模型补上 `"thinking_param_style": "effort"`（或按模型选择合适 style）。依据千问AI平台官方文档（「思考模式」及 Chat Completions API 参考），以下模型支持 `extra_body.enable_thinking` / `thinking_budget` / `reasoning_effort`：

- `qwen3.8-max`、`qwen3.8-flash`、`qwen3.7-plus`、`qwen3.7-max`、`qwen3.6-plus`、`qwen3.6-flash`（混合思考，默认开启）
- `deepseek-v4-pro`、`deepseek-v4-flash`
- `glm-5.2`、`glm-5.1`、`glm-5`

注意事项（来自上游文档，供逐模型声明时参考）：

- `reasoning_effort` 与 `thinking_budget` 互斥，同时传入会报错；
- 各模型支持的 effort 档位与默认值不同（如 qwen3.8-max 为 low/medium/xhigh，默认 xhigh）；
- `thinking_budget` 仅 Chat Completions / DashScope 支持，Responses API 暂不支持；kimi-k3 不支持 `thinking_budget`；
- `kimi-k2.5` / `k2.6` / `k2.7-code`、`MiniMax-M2.5` 等参数方言不同（如 MiniMax 用 `thinking` 参数），建议只对验证过的模型加声明，维持现有保守门控策略。

## Alternatives Considered

- 手动在安装目录 `model_catalog.json` 补字段后重启：实测有效（重启后模型管理弹窗出现思考区块、Agent 设置 "Thinking level" 下拉可用、请求链路正常），但升级会覆盖，普通用户难以发现。
- 在模型的 `generate_kwargs` 写 `{"extra_body": {"reasoning_effort": "..."}}`：功能等效，但绕过了 UI。

## Additional Context

- 环境：QwenPaw Desktop 2.2.2b3（Windows 10），catalog_version 2026.08.27
- 相关：#7062 / #7899 已实现 per-agent / per-session 思考控制，功能本身没问题；本 issue 仅请求补齐目录能力声明，让 Aliyun Token Plan 模型能用上它。

## Willing to Contribute

- [x] I am willing to open a PR for this feature (after discussion).

issues.title: [Bug]: Codex 后端热重载后 harness↔codex 连接断裂致会话静默失联；僵尸 running 记录使所有官方恢复路径失效，仅 chat/stop API 可救 (harness↔codex reconnect broken after restart; zombie run blocks all recovery paths)
issues.body:
## 1. 问题简述 / Summary

QwenPaw 重启后，codex 后端 agent 与新派生的 app-server 之间连接未正确重建：用户消息进入会话队列后无任何 turn 开始，agent 彻底静默。同时，重启瞬间未收尾的 turn 在 TaskTracker 中留下永久 `running` 的僵尸记录，导致该 agent 的新实例无法替换旧实例、同会话后续消息全部被拒。**框架自带的三种恢复手段全部无效**，最终只有手动调用 `POST /api/console/chat/stop` 才清除僵尸状态。

*EN: After a QwenPaw restart, the codex-backend agent's connection to its newly spawned app-server is broken: inbound messages queue but no turn ever starts. Meanwhile the interrupted turn leaves a permanent zombie `running` entry in TaskTracker, which blocks instance replacement and rejects new messages (409). All three built-in recovery paths failed; only `POST /api/console/chat/stop` cleared it.*

## 2. 环境与背景 / Environment

- QwenPaw **2.2.1**，macOS arm64，飞书渠道
- ritsuko agent，backend=codex（本地 Codex CLI，`session_resume: true`）
- 触发场景为普通的服务重启（与插件装载无因果关系，已排除其他变量）

## 3. 现象与复现 / Symptoms & Reproduction

实测时间线（日志完整可查）：

1. 02:31 重启 QwenPaw → 新 codex app-server 正常拉起，但与既有会话的连接已坏；
2. 02:31:48 / 02:34:17 / 02:34:27 三条飞书消息进入 session，**均无任何 turn 开始日志**；其中一条被系统秒回非 LLM 的状态消息；新 app-server CPU 0.0%——不是在执行长任务，是无人处理；
3. 次日 08:49 再发消息，日志实锤：`Message ignored (task already running)`；服务日志自 08:06 起每分钟刷：`Tasks are still active for old instance ritsuko. Keeping it alive until they finish.`；
4. 前端持续轮询一个不存在的 tool-call ID（满屏 404）；同一会话再发消息直接 **409 Conflict**。

**复现步骤**：① codex 后端 agent + 任意渠道；② 在该 agent 有进行中或刚结束 turn 时重启 QwenPaw 进程；③ 向既有会话发消息 → 静默无响应，且该 agent 堵死。

**已尝试且无效的官方恢复路径**（这是本单的核心）：

| 手段 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `PUT /api/config/channels` 热重载 | 新实例起来、WebSocket 重连 ✅，僵尸 run 未清 ❌ |
| disable→enable toggle（硬重启 workspace） | `Workspace stopped` 全新重建 ✅，但 codex app-server 仍是僵死的旧 PID ❌ |
| 等待 delayed_cleanup | `multi_agent_manager.py:415` 逻辑为等任务自然结束，最长 **24 小时**；期间 agent 完全不可用 |

**与已有 issue 的区别**：#7991 是聚合计数失真（显示层），#7534 是渠道层 queue consumer 卡死；本单是 **harness 层连接断裂 + `_runs` 条目永驻导致 agent 功能整体瘫痪且全部公开恢复路径失效**，根因和症状均不同。

**源码线索**：`app/task_tracker.py` 中 `_runs[run_key]` 仅在 producer 协程的 `finally` 里 pop；若底层 stream 挂掉前异常路径未走完，条目永驻，`has_active_tasks()` 恒真。

**附带发现**：对第三方后端，用户自救命令 `/new`、`/stop` 均不可用（codex adapter 仅实现 `compact/review/skills/status`），这解释了为什么用户在断连后连"开个新会话"都做不到。

## 4. 我们的临时解决及局限 / Current Workaround

`POST /api/console/chat/stop` 取消僵尸任务（返回 `stopped: true`）后整体重启，agent 恢复。但该手段无 UI/CLI 入口、属内部 API；且断连本身每次重启都可能复发，我们被迫形成了"重启前先确认无活跃 turn"的人肉纪律，并在外部另建了一条独立救援通道兜底——侧面说明此问题对可用性的影响程度。

## 5. 建议修法 / Suggested Fixes

1. codex harness 在 app-server 派生后对既有 session 做**连接健康探测**，失败则自动重连或显式标记 session 需重建，不要让消息沉入黑洞；
2. TaskTracker 为 run 增加**空闲看门狗**（producer 长时间无输出且子进程零 CPU 即判死并清理 `_runs`），替代"最长等 24h"；
3. reload / disable-enable 路径提供**强制清理语义**（如 force 参数：取消旧实例全部 run 后再切换）——既然 chat/stop 能做到，公开重载路径理应也能走到同样的清理；
4. 对不支持 `/new`、`/stop` 的第三方后端，在渠道侧返回明确提示而非静默忽略。

严重级别：**可用性级（agent 变砖，无自愈）**。可提供当时的完整日志与 session 记录，需要请在评论区留言。谢谢！

issues.title: [Bug]: Console 聊天间歇性静默空完成——回合约 1 秒结束、output 为空、模型从未被调用，前端无任何回复
issues.body:
## QwenPaw Version / Environment

- QwenPaw **2.2.0**（Docker，Linux x86_64，Python 3.11，NAS 部署）
- 故障渠道：**Web 控制台（console channel）** 内嵌在 PawApp 里的聊天面板（不是 feishu 等其他渠道）
- 故障 agent：`qwenpaw-data`（由 PawApp 模板 `pawapp:qwenpaw-data` 创建），模型 `octopus/keyong`（OpenAI 兼容网关，实测稳定 5/5）
- 会话：`pawapp:qwenpaw-data`，上下文约 70K–105K tokens

## Description / 现象

在 console 聊天里发送消息，**间歇性得不到任何回复**。抓 SSE 流可见失败回合长这样：

- 事件只有三个：`created` → `in_progress` → `completed`，`output: []`
- 约 **1 秒**完成（正常回合 2.5–12 秒）
- `turn_usage`：`completion_tokens: 0`，`provider_id: ""`，`model_name: ""` —— **模型从未被调用**
- 全程无任何错误日志：runtime 无 unhandled error、无 ConfigurationException、无 429、无 HTTP 错误
- 服务端日志签名（可 grep）：`console stream done: event_count=3 has_response=True`

用户体验：消息发出去，界面既不出回复也不报错，唯一的信号是“什么都没发生”。

## Steps to Reproduce / 复现实测

```http
POST /api/agents/qwenpaw-data/console/chat
X-Agent-Id: qwenpaw-data
Content-Type: application/json

{"session_id":"pawapp:qwenpaw-data","user_id":"default","channel":"console",
 "input":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"诊断测试1：请只回复一个字：好"}]}]}
```

连发 10 次（每次间隔约 3 秒，payload 仅序号不同）：

| # | 时间 | 耗时 | output | completion_tokens | provider | 结果 |
|---|------|------|--------|-------------------|----------|------|
| 1 | 23:35:44 | 1.34s | 0 | 0 | '' | 空输出 |
| 2 | 23:35:48 | 0.91s | 0 | 0 | '' | 空输出 |
| 3 | 23:35:52 | 1.08s | 0 | 0 | '' | 空输出 |
| 4 | 23:35:56 | 1.22s | 0 | 0 | '' | 空输出 |
| 5 | 23:36:01 | 11.88s | 1 | 2 | octopus | 正常（回复“好好”） |
| 6–10 | 23:36:15–23:36:54 | 2.5–9.2s | 1 | 2 | octopus | 正常 |

失败率 4/10。模式：**长时间空闲后的前几个回合集中失败，之后同样 payload 全部成功**。当晚三次观察一致：23:01 与 23:03 用户两条真实消息零回复 → 23:20 复现失败一次 → 23:22 同样内容成功 → 23:35 四连败后全成功。

## Actual vs Expected

- Actual：有效用户消息被静默吞掉，回合空完成，前端无回复、无错误提示。
- Expected：要么正常回复，要么给出可见错误；任何情况下 `completed` 的 response 不应是空 output 且无任何日志。

## 已排除的可能（都不是根因）

1. **模型不可用**：绕过 agent 直调 `octopus/keyong` 的 `/chat/completions`，5/5 成功（1.5–5.4s）。
2. **任务卡死占场**（409）：TaskTracker reconnect 挂上来返回空流（idle）；chat 记录 status=idle。
3. **插件 hook 短路**：`qwenpaw-data` 插件未注册任何 SHORT_CIRCUIT/SKIP_AGENT hook；全部已装插件的 hook 也均不短路上两阶段。
4. **ConfigurationException**：日志无 `runtime: configuration required`。
5. **no-text debounce 吞消息**：`_content_has_text()` 对文本 content 返回 True，不会进缓冲分支。
6. **QwenPaw Data 后端/Neo4j**：context service access log 无卡住请求，execute_sql/datasources/bolt 全部 200。
7. **飞书主链路**：同期 feishu 会话（default agent）回复完全正常。

## 代码路径与疑似点（供定位，未确认根因）

调用链：

```
POST /console/chat
→ TaskTracker.attach_or_start
→ ConsoleChannel.stream_one        (app/channels/console/channel.py:358)
→ Workspace.stream_query           (app/workspace/workspace.py:414)
→ Runtime.run（8 阶段）             (runtime/runtime.py:50)
→ AgentExecutor.run                (runtime/executor.py:37)
→ agent.reply_stream → _reply_impl  (agentscope/agent/_agent.py:915)
```

“零事件空完成”在 `_reply_impl` 里有两条退出路径会产生完全相同的现象：

- `inputs` 为空列表 → `_handle_incoming_messages` 的 `if msgs:` 不成立 → 上下文不追加 → `_next_action` 首轮即 `Exit` → 唯一 yield 的 `exit_msg` 又被 `reply_stream`（`yield_final_msg=False`）过滤 → 客户端收到空 `completed`；
- 或首轮 `_next_action` 直接判 Exit（上下一条末条是 assistant 消息时）。

两种都等价于一个结论：**用户消息没有进入 agent 的 input_msgs**。可疑丢失点（按链路顺序）：

- `app/channels/console/channel.py` `stream_one` 的 debounce / merged / `build_agent_request_from_native` 路径；
- `runtime/runtime.py` `_build_context`：`input_msgs=_request_input_to_msgs(request.input)`；
- `runtime/message_convert.py` 的请求→Msg 转换；
- scroll 上下文系统（`persisted_ids` / `seen_*` 去重）与新回合输入合并的竞态——注意每轮日志都有 `builder: built agent ... model=octopus/keyong tools=31`，即 runtime 完整构建后直接空完成，agent 本身已就绪。

另一个附带问题（可独立修）：失败回合的 `completed` 完全静默——`_commit_turn_usage` 记了一条 provider 为空的 usage，但没有任何 WARNING/ERROR。建议对“无 content 事件的空 completed”至少打一条 WARNING，否则用户侧根本无法排查。

## Logs / 证据样本

失败回合（23:35:44–45，grep `pawapp:qwenpaw-data`）：

```
23:35:44 | INFO | runtime/builder.py:538 | builder: built agent for session=pawapp:qwenpaw-data agent=qwenpaw-data model=octopus/keyong tools=31
23:35:45 | INFO | app/channels/base.py:1962 | Usage for session pawapp:qwenpaw-data: {'provider_id': '', 'model_name': '', 'prompt_tokens': 70801, 'completion_tokens': 0, ...}
23:35:45 | INFO | app/channels/console/channel.py:494 | console stream done: event_count=3 has_response=True
```

用户侧对话记录（dialog jsonl）：23:01:04、23:03:43 两条 user 消息后无任何 assistant 消息。

复现脚本与原始数据（本地，未随 issue 附）：`scripts/_debug/pawapp_repro.py`、`scripts/state/pawapp_repro_result.jsonl`。

## Additional Notes

- 与 open issue **#7549**（Ark trailing assistant 400）不同：那例有明确 400 报错，本例零错误、模型未调用。
- 与 **#5856**（compaction 丢 tool_call 结构）不同症；但本例失败回合 `prompt_tokens≈70.8K` 恒定、scroll 每轮 compact，供参考。
- 临时规避：重发同一消息通常可触发（不是每次都需要多重试，观察到的模式是空闲后前几发性失败）。

---

### English summary (for maintainers)

Intermittent silent failure in the console (web) chat: a valid user message sometimes produces an "empty completion" — SSE shows only created/in_progress/completed with `output: []` in ~1s, `turn_usage` has `completion_tokens=0` and empty `provider_id`/`model_name`, i.e. the model is never called, and nothing is logged as an error. Reproduced 4/10 consecutive POSTs to `/api/agents/<id>/console/chat` (first attempts after idle fail, later identical requests succeed). Model, task tracker, plugin hooks, configuration errors, debounce and the data backend were all verified healthy. Suspect the user message is lost before reaching the agent's `input_msgs` (console `stream_one` → `Runtime._build_context` → `_request_input_to_msgs`, or a race with the scroll context system), so `_reply_impl` exits with zero events. Suggest also logging a WARNING when a response completes with no content events — right now the failure is completely silent.
